transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Julie, it's Ricky.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：嗨，朱莉，我是里基。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Ricky, how are you? I noticed you weren't in Psychology today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：嗨，里基，你好吗？我注意到你今天没去上心理学课。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm feeling sick so I didn't go to school today. Would you mind telling me what I missed in class?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：我觉得不舒服，所以今天没去上学。你能告诉我我错过了什么课吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure thing. I'm sorry you're not feeling well! Anyway, we spent most of the class talking about a new essay that Professor Johnson assigned. You need to choose one of the bold headings from the note system and research it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：当然可以。很抱歉你不舒服！总之，我们大部分时间在讨论约翰逊教授布置的一篇新论文。你需要从笔记系统里选择一个粗体标题，然后进行研究。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, I picked the wrong day to miss class, huh?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：哇，我真是选错了缺席的日子，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: You sure did.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：你确实是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Could you tell me the specific requirements of this paper?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：你能告诉我这篇论文的具体要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. You need to find scientific research that supports your claim as one of your references. It can be from some of the case studies we discussed in class, or you can find your own. Or even better, you can conduct your own research! I'm sure that would get you an A.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：当然。你需要找到支持你论点的科学研究作为参考来源之一。可以是我们在课堂上讨论过的一些案例研究，也可以自己找。甚至更好的是，你可以自己进行研究！我敢肯定那样能得A。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you decided what you're going to do yet? Also, where are you getting your references?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：你已经决定怎么做了吗？还有，你的参考资料从哪里找？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, I'm going to research facial recognition by infants. I've already found a few experiments in scientific journals. That would probably be a good start for you - there are tons of journals in the library.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：是的，我打算研究婴儿的面部识别。我已经在科学期刊里找到了一些实验。那对你来说可能是个好的开始——图书馆里有大量的期刊。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great idea, thanks. I'm considering writing my essay on the effects of one of the psychotropic drugs we talked about in class. I'm sure there is lots of stuff about it on the Internet. Are we allowed to use information from the Internet?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：好主意，谢谢。我在考虑写我们课上讨论过的某种精神类药物效果的论文。我肯定网上有很多相关内容。我们可以使用互联网上的信息吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, you can use that as long as it's not your main source for information. You'll probably want to cite some of the experiments we went over.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：当然可以用，只要不是你的主要信息来源就行。你很可能需要引用一些我们课上讲过的实验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good idea, thanks. I'm gonna try to find some information from a bunch of different sources.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：好主意，谢谢。我会尝试从各种不同的来源找信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Are there any specifications on how the essay should be written?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：对论文的写作格式有什么具体要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, Professor Johnson wants it double-spaced. It should be between 6 to 10 pages long.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：是的，约翰逊教授要求双倍行距。长度应该在6到10页之间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: 6 to 10 pages? That's so much! It's going to take forever.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：6到10页？太多了！得花很长时间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: I know. The whole class groaned when he said that. Anyway, you also need to put the title in italics, and -
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：我知道。他说的时候全班都抱怨了。另外，你还需要把标题设为斜体，还有——

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wait, each section heading, or just the main heading?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：等等，是每个节标题，还是只有主标题？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Only the main heading should be in italics. I think section titles are supposed to be in the same format, but maybe in bold. You'll have to check that in class next time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：只有主标题用斜体。我觉得节标题应该是同样的格式，但可能用粗体。你下次课上得确认一下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh Okay. So I take it that the report has to be typed. since there are so many requirements. What are the other formatting requirements?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：哦好的。那我明白了，报告必须是打印的，因为要求这么多。还有其他格式要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yep, it's got to be typed. Aside from that, there are still a few more specifications. You should number each page. Make sure it goes up in the top right corner.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：是的，必须打印。除此之外还有几条格式要求。每页都要标页码。确保标在右上角。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, I'll make sure to write that down. I always forget to number the pages. Do we need to title and date each page, too?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：好的，我一定记下来。我总是忘记标页码。每页也需要标题和日期吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: You need the shortened title on every page, but no need to include the date. That should just be on the cover page.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：每页都需要简写标题，但不需要日期。日期只放在封面页就行了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, thanks.

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE

transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：没问题。另外，确保页边距为3.25像素宽。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: What? I'm not even sure how to do that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：什么？我甚至不知道怎么设置那个。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's Okay, I can show you. It's really easy. I think that's all the directions he gave us. A lot of formatting requirements, but we have the freedom to research many things that we like, so that's good. Oh, I almost forgot - remember to put down your ID number on your report.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：没关系，我可以教你。很简单。我想这就是他给我们的所有要求了。格式要求很多，但我们可以自由研究自己喜欢的东西，这挺好。哦，我差点忘了——记得在报告上写上你的学号。

transcriptSentences.speaker: RICKY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks so much for your help, I'll see you in class Monday!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 里基：非常感谢你的帮助，周一课上见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: JULIE
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem, glad I could help. See you later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 朱莉：不客气，很高兴能帮忙。回头见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning and welcome to yet another lecture in Environmental Science. I don't think I am telling you a secret when I mention that water is a big worry here in Australia. The stuff is scarce. Perhaps that's why we drink so much beer, eh?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：早上好，欢迎来到环境科学的又一场讲座。我说水在澳大利亚是个大问题，这应该不算什么秘密。这玩意儿很稀缺。也许这就是我们喝这么多啤酒的原因，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Seriously, though, a safe and reliable source of water is one of the great concerns of people everywhere. Moreover, as world population grows, the pressure on existing water supplies grows greater and greater. Think about it. Our economic system demands that there be more and more consumers. The growing number of people has been tied to climate change, including droughts. So more people means less water. But our economic system demands a high birth rate. Forget about oil. Soon enough you will see wars for water. Mark my words.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：不过认真地说，安全可靠的水源是各地人们最关心的问题之一。此外，随着世界人口增长，对现有供水资源的压力越来越大。想想看。我们的经济体系要求越来越多的消费者。人口增长与气候变化（包括干旱）密切相关。所以人口越多，水越少。但我们的经济体系要求高出生率。忘了石油吧。用不了多久你们就会看到为水而战的战争。记住我的话。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: But today, I'm going to confine my remarks to Australia. As noted already, here down under, the water supply is extremely scarce. The only drier continent is Antarctica--and remember, no one really lives there anyway. Moreover, in recent years, the wind patterns have changed. Rain that used to fall on the country now falls out to sea hundreds of miles to the south.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：但今天，我将只谈澳大利亚。如前所述，在澳大利亚，水供应极为稀缺。唯一更干燥的大陆是南极洲——而且记住，反正没人真正住在那儿。此外，近年来，风型发生了改变。过去降落在澳大利亚的雨水，现在降落在以南数百英里外的海上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, when I speak of people needing water, most of you probably think of drinking. Certainly everyone needs water for drinking. But, surprising as it may sound, drinking is not anywhere near being the main use for water. Most water is actually used for washing. When you take a shower, you probably use well over a hundred litres of water. Every time you flush your toilet, that's about eight liters. But most people drink no more than two liters or so per day.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：当我说人们需要水时，你们大多数人可能想到的是饮用水。当然，人人都需要饮用水。但是，听起来可能令人惊讶，饮用水远不是水的主要用途。大部分水实际上用于洗涤。你洗一次澡，可能用掉一百多升水。每次冲马桶，大约用八升。但大多数人每天喝水不超过两升左右。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, where to get water? It could be obtained from rainwater, but often rainfall consists of other harmful pollutants that evaporated with the water. In fact, acid rain, an intense example of this, causes harmful effects on the wildlife of the habitat on which it falls. Water from underground could also be used, though it is more difficult to contain and often must go through an extensive cleansing process. The purest water is found in rivers, creeks, lakes and dams. And, sad to say, Australia has precious few of these. Really, how many of your hometowns have rivers? Year-round rivers, I mean. The soil tends to be sandy, so water soaks into the ground. Many places are rocky too, so 87% of the rainfall is lost to evaporation. That's almost twice the evaporation rate in my native Canada!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么，水从哪里来？可以从雨水获取，但雨水通常含有蒸发时带来的其他有害污染物。事实上，酸雨就是一个典型的例子，对降落地点的野生动物栖息地产生有害影响。地下水也可以利用，尽管更难采集，而且通常需要经过广泛的净化过程。最纯净的水来自河流、小溪、湖泊和水坝。遗憾的是，澳大利亚这类水源少得可怜。真的，你们的家乡有几条河流？我指的是常年性的河流。土壤往往是沙质的，所以水会渗入地下。很多地方也是岩石地貌，所以87%的降水都蒸发掉了。这几乎是我老家加拿大的两倍！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Speaking of rain, we already heard how rainfall is diminishing here in Oceania. The quantity itself isn't the only problem, either. Going back to the problems with obtaining rainwater, a further problem is that rain is a useful source of water only if air pollution is fairly mild. Again you're in a situation where you can't win. You need water where most people live. People tend to build cities where rainfall is adequate. But then modern cities tend to feature polluted air which renders the rain far less easily usable. OK, let's take a look at the table here, you'll see it showing the relative pollution of rainfall in the world's cities. The more people, the dirtier the rain.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：说到雨，我们已经听到大洋洲的降雨量在减少。数量本身也不是唯一的问题。回到获取雨水的问题上，进一步的问题是，只有在空气污染相当轻微的情况下，雨水才是有用的水源。你又陷入了一个两难的境地。你需要在大多数人口聚居的地方获取水。人们倾向于在雨水充足的地方建城市。但现代城市往往有空气污染，使得雨水变得远不那么容易利用。好的，让我们看看这里的表格，你会看到它展示了世界各城市降雨的相对污染程度。人口越多，雨水越脏。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This is becoming a huge concern for people in the West, who want their water to be pure and safe. Though reliable drinking water is important everywhere, the concern in the West is reflected in all the government regulations and political campaigns aimed at solving this problem. In contrast, there are not as many demands made on the governments in Asian and African cultures to improve the water, as their focus is on other issues.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这对于西方人来说正成为一个巨大的担忧，他们希望水纯净安全。虽然可靠的饮用水在任何地方都很重要，但西方人的这种担忧体现在所有旨在解决这个问题的政府法规和政治运动中。相比之下，亚洲和非洲文化中，对政府改善水质的诉求没有那么多，因为他们的重心在其他问题上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, whatever the source of water, we can never afford to forget that all water is highly vulnerable to contamination. Whether we're getting it from the ground, from bodies of water, or rainfall, it is susceptible to a variety of toxins. In fact, that's why we clean it before using it: water carries with it filth and dirt. This problem shows up in a number of different ways.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在，无论水源是什么，我们都不能忘记所有水都非常容易受到污染。无论我们是从地下、从水体还是从雨水中获取，它都容易受到各种毒素的侵害。事实上，这就是我们在使用前要净化的原因：水携带着污垢和脏东西。这个问题以多种不同的方式表现出来。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As humans and all other animals need water to survive, it's no surprise to us that one of the most important domestic uses of water is for drinking. Yet if you have old-fashioned lead pipes, you may slowly be poisoning yourself by drinking that nice clear water. The industrial pollution, farm chemicals, and leaky landfills are well known sources of contaminants as well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：由于人类和所有其他动物都需要水来生存，水最重要的家庭用途之一是饮用，这一点不足为奇。然而，如果你有老式的铅管，喝那看似清澈的水可能会慢慢中毒。工业污染、农用化学品和渗漏的填埋场也是众所周知的污染物来源。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what is being done to ensure we Australians a safe and steady supply of drinking water? There are a lot of initiatives that make admirable efforts to remedy this issue. We'll be talking about this when we meet again on Thursday. But, as a preview, I can tell you that so far the amount of real solutions that have been produced is not nearly adequate. Traditionally, province tend to go its own way. So the mechanisms for water management are, in a word, insufficient.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么，正在采取什么措施来确保我们澳大利亚人有安全稳定的饮用水供应？有很多倡议都做出了可贵的努力来补救这个问题。我们周四再见面时会讨论这个。但作为预告，我可以告诉你们，到目前为止产生的实际解决方案远远不够。传统上，各省倾向于各行其是。所以水资源管理的机制，一句话，是不够的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To begin seeing how this is so, I want you to read something before our next class. Though a lot of previous data on water usage and water management are inconclusive and have thus caused quite a concern, we can learn a lot from the content of reports written on the subject. The basis for the government's water-policy is the 1989 White Paper reporting on "Water Use: Present and Future". If you compare the numbers offered in the paper with those in the text, you'll find that the report is rather untrustworthy. Truth being told, I'm being too kind when I say that!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：为了开始理解为什么会这样，我希望你们在下节课前阅读一些材料。虽然大量关于用水和水资源管理的先前数据尚无定论，因此引起了相当大的担忧，但我们可以从有关该主题的报告内容中学到很多。政府水政策的基础是1989年关于“用水：现在与未来”的白皮书。如果你把报告中提供的数字与文本中的数字进行比较，你会发现该报告相当不可信。说实话，我说得已经够客气了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. City House Services. How may I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：早上好。城市房屋服务。我能为您做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. I'd like to arrange to have my house cleaned.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：早上好。我想安排人打扫我的房子。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Certainly. I just need to ask a few questions. First, could I take your name?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：当然可以。我只需要问几个问题。首先，能告诉我您的名字吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it's Barbara Hill.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好的，我叫芭芭拉·希尔。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you. Next, is your house in London?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：谢谢。其次，您的房子在伦敦吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it's in Kingston in Southwest London.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：是的，在伦敦西南部的金斯顿。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, Southwest London and...er, what's the post code?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的，伦敦西南部……呃，邮编是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：SW 105。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: And what is the square footage and what rooms will we be cleaning?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：房子面积是多少平方英尺？我们需要打扫哪些房间？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The whole house is 268 square feet and there is no need to clean all the rooms. I only want to have my bedrooms cleaned.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：整栋房子是268平方英尺。不需要打扫所有房间，我只想打扫卧室。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, how many bedrooms does the house have?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的，房子有几间卧室？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Three bedrooms. Oh no, sorry, we used to have three bedrooms but we only have two bedrooms now.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：三间卧室。哦不，抱歉，我们以前有三间，但现在只有两间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Are those single bedrooms or doubles?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：是单人卧室还是双人卧室？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Doubles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：双人间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Fine, two doubles...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的，两间双人卧室……

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is one more room which needs cleaning. It was used as bedroom before and now we have converted it into an office.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：还有一个房间需要打扫。以前是卧室，现在改成了办公室。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: I understand. Three rooms have got to be cleaned, and are all of those rooms upstairs?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我明白了。三个房间需要打扫，都在楼上吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. Then downstairs we have a kitchen-diner, conservatory and lounge. The kitchen-diner is quite large and has the usual equipment - cooker with oven, refrigerator, cupboards and worktops. The conservatory has a lot of plants, but there's no need to take care of them. The lounge has a leather three-piece suite and a large coffee table.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：是的。楼下有厨房兼餐厅、阳光房和客厅。厨房兼餐厅很大，有常用设备——带烤箱的炉灶、冰箱、橱柜和操作台。阳光房里有很多植物，但不需要打理。客厅有一套三件套皮沙发和一张大咖啡桌。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you. And do you keep any pets?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：谢谢。您养宠物吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, I really love keeping them. I've got two dogs and three cats.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：是的，我很喜欢养宠物。我有两只狗和三只猫。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, then if our staff come over to offer the service please take your pets away. Have you looked at our services packages?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的，那如果我们的员工上门提供服务，请把您的宠物带走。您看过我们的服务套餐了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I have one in front of me.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：看过，我面前就有一份。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Excellent.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：很好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Any extra services you need?--- switching bed linen, work in the garden, cleaning the glass in the conservatory, that kind of thing?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：您还需要额外服务吗？——更换床单、园艺工作、擦阳光房的玻璃之类？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Err... no... err... actually, replacing the bed linen... yes... that would be good.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：呃……不……呃……实际上，更换床单……是的……那挺好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. I'll just make a note of that. How about curtains, mats and carpets? What would you like us to do with those items?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：没问题。我记下来。窗帘、地垫和地毯呢？您想让我们怎么处理那些？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The curtains... I'll have to think about that. I think we should have the carpets cleaned really well every quarter. Mats can just be done with the laundry.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：窗帘……我得想想。我觉得地毯应该每个季度彻底清洗一次。地垫跟洗衣物一起洗就行了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. How about clothes? We can have our staff wash and iron them or we can have them taken to a dry cleaner.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：当然。衣服呢？我们可以让员工洗熨，或者送到干洗店。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Washing and ironing. No, just ironing. That'll be OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：洗熨。不，只要熨烫就行。那样就可以了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, fine. I know quite a bit about what you want now. I should let you know that we locate on 12, Amyes Road, that's A-M-Y-E-S.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的，可以。现在我对您的要求了解得差不多了。我应该告诉您，我们的地址是艾米斯路12号，A-M-Y-E-S。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Em.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：嗯。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: And we work on from Monday to Sunday except Tuesday and Wednesday. Could you let me know when is convenient for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我们周一到周日营业，除周二和周三外。您能告诉我什么时间方便吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next Friday... err... no, that's no good. My son invites his friends over in the afternoon that day. Perhaps next Thursday or next Saturday? Let me check, OK, next Thursday.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：下周五……呃……不行，那天下午我儿子要请朋友过来。也许下周四或下周六？我看看，好的，下周四。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: When is it convenient for us to come over and provide the service? Is it OK if we come in the morning? Or we may come in the afternoon? It depends on your schedule.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我们什么时候上门提供服务方便呢？早上来可以吗？还是下午来？这取决于您的时间安排。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm OK with any time. Just give me a call to let me know you're coming before you arrive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：我任何时间都可以。只要来之前给我打电话通知我就行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure we will.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我们一定会。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: By the way how long would it take for the service?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：顺便问一下，服务大概需要多长时间？

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: We usually work 1-3 hours for house cleaning and the work will take three hours at most. And of course if it takes more than three hours, you should pay extra for it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：房屋清洁我们通常工作1-3小时，最多三小时。当然，如果超过三小时，您需要额外付费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Er... Fine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：呃……好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi everyone, and welcome to the Sydney Airport. Today I'll be giving you the inside information on the day-to-day operations of the Australian Quarantine Service here. We hope to provide you with a better understanding of why such heavy security regulations are necessary by educating you on how we operate and why we do the things we do. We're not here to try to persuade you to fly through Sydney Airport, though we hope you'll find your experience relatively stress-free and comfortable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家好，欢迎来到悉尼机场。今天我要向大家介绍澳大利亚检疫服务在这里的日常运作内幕。我们希望通过对我们的运作方式和做事原因的讲解，让你们更好地理解为什么这些严格的安全规定是必要的。我们不是来劝你们飞悉尼机场的，不过我们希望你在这里的体验相对轻松舒适。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First thing's first, our personnel. Can anyone guess how many people work at the Sydney Airport? We have 200 alone working in Terminal 2, so can you guess how many in the whole airport? I heard someone say 360, that's getting closer... What? Did someone say 2,000? That's waaayy too high. The Sydney Airport actually employs 440 people. A lot, right? And about half of those employees work in security-related matters.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，我们的员工。有人能猜出悉尼机场有多少名员工吗？仅2号航站楼就有200人，那么整个机场有多少人？我听到有人说360，接近了……什么？有人说2,000？太高了。悉尼机场实际上雇佣了440人。很多，对吧？其中约一半员工从事安全相关工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Moving on to our not-so-human employees, let's come see favorite pooch, Milton. Milton is our best drug-sniffing dog on the force. He's friendly to most people - you can even come pet him at the end of our tour. Burnouts beware, though, he'll find everything. Notice that even though there are so many of us around him, Milton stays quite calm. This is the precise reason he was chosen for the job. Dogs that are chosen are not predisposed to sniff out different narcotics - that's something we teach them already.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：接下来看看我们的非人类员工，来看看我们最喜欢的狗狗米尔顿。米尔顿是我们这里最棒的缉毒犬。它对大多数人很友好——你们甚至可以在参观结束时来抚摸它。不过瘾君子们注意了，它什么都能找出来。注意到尽管我们这么多人围在它身边，米尔顿还是很平静。这正是他被选中的原因。被选中的狗并不天生就具备嗅出各种毒品的能力——那是我们后来教的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So here's a part of the airport most people never notice - the cargo transport terminal. This is where packages are shipped to and from. Normally we ship around 4,400 packages per month. In this airport alone, over 52,000 packages were shipped in and out over the past year. We ship to and from 170 different countries. Not bad, eh? Probably it will go up to over 72,000 packages this year. And despite over 100 flights in and out of here daily, the number of lost or delayed packages is impressively low. If you send your package through here, rest assured we'll get it where it's going.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这里是机场中大多数人从未注意到的部分——货物运输站。包裹从这里收发。我们通常每月发送约4,400个包裹。仅这一个机场，去年收发超过52,000个包裹。我们与170个不同国家通邮。不错吧？今年可能会超过72,000个包裹。虽然每天有超过100个航班进出，丢失或延迟的包裹数量低得惊人。如果你从这里寄包裹，放心，我们会把它送到目的地。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's move on to the area most of us are familiar with, the passenger terminals. In order to be allowed into this area, you must pass through security with your ticket and if you're traveling internationally, your passport. If you're traveling domestically, you just need a legal form of ID. If you don't have those, you will not be allowed to pass through security and board your flight.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们再到大多数人熟悉的区域——旅客航站楼。要获准进入这个区域，你必须持机票通过安检，如果是国际旅行还需要护照。如果是国内旅行，只需要合法身份证件。没有这些证件，将无法通过安检和登机。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: During the security scan, your carry-on items will be checked for dangerous items such as weapons, sharp objects, and liquids that exceed our specified limit. If you attempt to pass any of the prohibited items on this list posted at the entrance, you are still allowed to board the plane, but you'll be given a warning and your item will be confiscated. Don't worry, we will not arrest you for having too much shampoo in your bag, or anything like that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在安检扫描期间，随身行李将接受检查，看是否有危险物品，如武器、尖锐物品和超过规定限量的液体。如果你试图携带入口张贴的清单上的违禁品，你仍然可以登机，但会收到警告，物品将被没收。别担心，我们不会因为背包里有太多洗发水之类的东西而逮捕你。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: We also search your carry-ons and parcels for any perishable items. We prohibit the transportation of local vegetation and prohibit parcels containing any insects in them. You may or may not have learned about this in Biology class, but when some plants are introduced to a new environment, they spread wildly and wipe out the current species around it. It is important to control the introduction of new plants into an ecosystem, so we must prohibit the transport of any fertile seeds.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们还会检查随身行李和包裹中是否有易腐烂物品。我们禁止运输当地植物，也禁止包裹中含有任何昆虫。你可能在生物课上学过，也可能没学过——当某些植物被引入新环境时，它们会疯狂蔓延，消灭周围的现有物种。控制新植物引入生态系统非常重要，所以我们禁止运输任何有繁殖力的种子。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what happens to parcels containing possibly suspicious items? It's of course something we do not take lightly here. If an object passes through the scanner that appears suspicious in any way, it is separated out for manual search by a member of our trained security personnel. If an illegal plant or simple sharp object like a pocket knife is found, it is simply disposed of in our biohazard waste containers, and the package itself is returned to the sender (or passenger, if it is for a passenger flight). More serious weapons are reported to higher authorities for investigation. As far as parcel security, the material of the parcel is important. For shipped goods, the most common material used (and the most widely accepted) is paper. Make sure it is packed sturdy enough, with no rips or tears. We've definitely had packages rip open before due to haphazardous packing. A more common problem, though, is the package labels. When an item does not make it to the right place, this is the most common reason. The label may not be in the right place, or marked clearly enough.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么含有可疑物品的包裹会怎样？我们当然不会掉以轻心。如果有任何物品通过扫描仪时看起来可疑，就会被挑出来由训练有素的安保人员进行人工检查。如果发现非法植物或简单的尖锐物品如小刀，就会被扔进生物危害废物容器中处理，包裹本身退还给寄件人（如果是旅客航班上的，则退还给旅客）。更严重的武器会报告给上级机关进行调查。就包裹安全而言，包裹材料很重要。对于托运货物，最常用（也是最广泛接受）的材料是纸张。确保包装足够结实，没有撕裂或破损。我们确实有过因为粗心包装而导致包裹撕裂的情况。不过更常见的问题是包裹标签。如果物品没有送到正确的地方，最常见的原因就是这个。标签可能放错了位置，或者标记得不够清晰。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you're receiving any items from abroad that must be declared, please remember our guidelines in order to ensure the timely delivery of your item. Make sure it is packed correctly, and we ask that you notify custom between 2 and 10 days within the item's scheduled arrival date.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你要接收来自国外需要报关的物品，请记住我们的指引，以确保物品及时送达。确保包装正确，我们要求您在物品预定到达日期的2至10天内通知海关。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, before we move on, are there any questions?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，在我们继续之前，有问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome! Please come in and gather over here around the tables. My name is Adam Smith, and I'm the librarian here. I'll show you around today, and explain how to use these facilities. Hopefully when I'm done with it, you'll know the ropes, and please feel free to let me know of any questions or concerns that you may have. Now, we're at the gate of the library. Upon entering into the door, you'll find that the restrooms are on your left-hand side, and opposite them is a Photocopy Room. Many of you are wondering about the check-in and check-out process, what you have to do is go to the Circulation Desk, which is to the east of the Photocopy Room. The Reading Room is a really large area in the center of the library, just to the north of the Circulation Desk. I'm sure you won't miss it. If you're here to do research, this is where you should bring books to look through. However, if you're here to do any group projects or other interactive activities, I advise you to use one of the study rooms, which are just to the east of the Reading Room. Moving on to the southeast corner we have the Periodicals Section, just next to the study rooms. We have a collection of different newspapers and magazines in this section. You can get last week's weather reports, or all the top stories five years ago - our periodicals can be traced back 20 years to the time when our school library was built. Ah, our first question! Yes?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：欢迎！请进来，在桌子周围聚一下。我叫亚当·史密斯，是这里的图书管理员。今天我会带你们参观，并解释如何使用这些设施。希望我讲完之后，你们能熟悉情况，有问题或顾虑请随时告诉我。现在，我们在图书馆的入口处。进门后，你们会发现洗手间在左手边，对面是复印室。很多人想知道借书还书的流程，你们需要去流通服务台，在复印室的东边。阅览室是图书馆中心一个非常大的区域，就在流通服务台的北边。我相信你们不会错过。如果你们来这里做研究，就应该把书带到这儿来看。不过，如果你们做小组项目或其他互动活动，我建议你们使用自习室，就在阅览室的东边。继续往东南角走是期刊区，紧挨着自习室。这个区域收藏了各种报纸和杂志。你们可以查到上周的天气预报，或者五年前的所有头条新闻——我们的期刊可以追溯到20年前学校图书馆建成的时候。啊，第一个问题！请说？

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Can we check out magazines from the Library?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：我们可以从图书馆借杂志吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm sorry but you cannot take any periodicals out of the library. You're welcome to read them for as long as you want while you're there, but you cannot check them out.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：很抱歉，期刊不能借出图书馆。你们可以在那里随意阅读，但不能借走。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: I wonder if there is any place where we can get some food in the library. Do we have a store here?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：我想知道图书馆里有没有地方可以买吃的。这里有商店吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. The Food Service Center is just meters away from the study rooms. It's on the northeast corner as you look at the map. The Food Service Center offers different kinds of snacks though it's not big. Well, moving on along to the west, you will find the Video Resource Center on your right hand. We have educational videos and documentaries, as well as major motion pictures. We ask that you pay attention to the tag on the video that you pick up, as many of our documentaries are for on-site viewing only and may not be taken out of the library. To the west of the Video Resource Center is our Satellite TV station. Here we stream the news from Channel 19 for most of the day.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：当然有。餐饮服务中心离自习室只有几米远。看地图的话，它在东北角。餐饮服务中心供应各种零食，虽然不大。继续往西走，右手边是视频资源中心。我们有教育视频、纪录片以及主要故事片。请注意你们拿的录像带上的标签，因为很多纪录片仅供馆内观看，不能借出图书馆。视频资源中心西边是我们的卫星电视站，大部分时间都在播放19频道的新闻。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: How many channels does it have?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：它有多少个频道？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: (laughs) It does have nearly 200 channels, but we generally will give top priority to channels with some big events, like presidential addresses or other breaking news. During the coverage of the presidential debate, students will take a break from studying and flock to watch it. Last but perhaps most important is the Inquiry Desk. It's just on the left-hand side when you walk into the library, so it's impossible to miss it. If you have any questions about how to use equipment or where to find something, come and ask the assistant. Don't be shy, because that's what they're here for!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：（笑）它确实有近200个频道，但通常我们会优先播放有重大事件的频道，比如总统演讲或其他突发新闻。在总统辩论报道期间，学生们会放下学习涌去看。最后但可能最重要的是咨询台。就在进图书馆时的左手边，不可能错过。如果你们对如何使用设备或在哪里找东西有任何问题，来问助理。别害羞，因为他们就是为此而来的！

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: Speaking of questions, one of the questions we get asked is how to actually check out a book once a student has picked one out. If it's a fiction or non-fiction book, look for the pink and yellow check-out card inside the back cover of the book. You can also find information about the book on these cards including its publishing date, genre, ISBN, and a log of dates it's been checked out before. Present this card to me or any library assistant and we'll stamp it and then the book can be kept for three weeks. You can find general information on a field of study by using one of our subject guides. We have them on paper here, but any of our computers will allow you to search within fields as well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：说到问题，我们经常被问到的一个问题是，学生选好书后如何借书。如果是虚构或非虚构类书籍，在封底内侧找粉色和黄色的借阅卡。这些卡片上还有书籍信息，包括出版日期、体裁、ISBN号和之前被借出的日期记录。把这张卡给我或任何图书馆助理，我们会盖章，然后书可以借三周。你们可以通过我们的学科指南找到某一研究领域的一般信息。我们这里有纸质版，但我们的任何电脑也允许你们按领域搜索。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: What if the library doesn't have a resource we're looking for?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：如果图书馆没有我们要找的资源怎么办？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR. SMITH
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great question, I'm going to address that. Our library is in a network with a number of other universities in the area, so if there is something you're looking for and it's available somewhere in the area, we'll be able to get it for you. However, there are universities which are not part of the network, so we do not share resources with them. If you want more information about the library and its resources, you'll find it in a labeled blue folder on my desk in the enquiry section. Okay so that's a lot of information all at once, and I don't expect you to remember it all. The most important thing is, please be respectful of the staff and if you need help with anything at all, come and ask me or one of my assistants. Alright, any questions?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 史密斯先生：好问题，我来回答。我们的图书馆与地区内其他多所大学有联网合作，所以如果你们要找的东西在地区内某个地方有，我们可以为你们拿到。但有些大学不在这个网络内，所以我们不与他们共享资源。如果你们想了解更多关于图书馆及其资源的信息，可以在咨询台我的桌子上找到标有蓝色文件夹的资料。好的，这些信息一下子很多，我不指望你们全记住。最重要的是，请尊重工作人员，如果你们需要任何帮助，来找我或我的助理。好的，有问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning! Today we will continue our study of Crocodylus niloticus by talking about its living habits. We've already discussed the evolutionary attributes that set it apart from its crocodile relatives. Does everyone remember that? Yes, it has an extremely narrow snout, and three or four rows of protective scales on its back, as compared to two rows on other members of the Crocodylus genus.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：早上好！今天我们将继续研究尼罗鳄，讨论它的生活习性。我们已经讨论过使其区别于其他鳄鱼亲属的进化特征。大家都记住了吗？是的，它有非常狭窄的口鼻部，背部有三四排保护性鳞片，而鳄属其他成员只有两排。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's take a look at how these carnivorous man-eaters live, where they live, and finally, whether they really deserve their vicious reputation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：让我们来看看这些食人的肉食动物是如何生活的，它们生活在哪儿，最后，它们是否真的配得上它们的恶名。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To start, I'd like to address a great question posed to me by a student during yesterday's office hours. We talked about the distribution of crocodiles in Africa and saw that they are highly concentrated in the South and West of the continent. This student noticed that on the map displaying the distribution of crocodiles across Africa, there were no crocodiles in the Northern Region, and found no mention in the literature of the existence of crocodiles in the North of Africa. Why might there be no crocodiles in North Africa? Let's save this question for later in the lecture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，我想回答一位学生昨天在办公时间向我提出的一个好问题。我们讨论过鳄鱼在非洲的分布，并看到它们高度集中在大陆的南部和西部。这位学生注意到，在显示非洲鳄鱼分布的地图上，北部地区没有鳄鱼，文献中也没有提到北非有鳄鱼。为什么北非可能没有鳄鱼？我们把这个问题留到后面再讲。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To find out more about the social habits of the African crocodile, one researcher named Tara Shine of the University of Ulster in Northern Ireland conducted a survey of the wetlands in Mauritania and received reports of 46 crocodiles living in one group, or float as we say when referring to crocodiles, though the usual number is a little less than half that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：为了进一步了解非洲鳄鱼的社会习性，一位名叫塔拉·夏恩的研究员（来自北爱尔兰阿尔斯特大学）对毛里塔尼亚的湿地进行了调查，收到报告称有46条鳄鱼生活在一个群体中，或者用我们称呼鳄鱼的术语叫“浮群”，不过通常数量略少于这个的一半。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In general, crocodiles are more highly concentrated in wet, sub-tropical environments near bodies of water and rich vegetation. While South American crocodiles thrive in cool rainforests, the African crocodile is more equipped for heat. Though they can survive at the hot temperatures found in some deserts, they are not equipped to handle dry climates and thus cannot survive in places like the Sahara Desert of North Africa. As cold-blooded animals, crocodiles' core temperatures fluctuate from their average of 38 degrees Celsius as external conditions change, thus they need to avoid extreme temperatures. Others live an underwater life, keeping a body temperature close to that of the water. As their own unique method of regulating their body temperatures, some African crocodiles have made dens by digging holes in the ground to provide themselves with a cool, dark place to retreat from the hot African sun.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：总的来说，鳄鱼更集中在水体和丰富植被附近的潮湿亚热带环境中。虽然南美鳄鱼在凉爽的雨林中繁盛，但非洲鳄鱼更能适应炎热。尽管它们能在某些沙漠的高温下生存，但它们无法应对干燥气候，因此无法在北非的撒哈拉沙漠等地方生存。作为冷血动物，鳄鱼的核心温度会随着外部条件的变化而偏离其平均38摄氏度，因此它们需要避免极端温度。其他鳄鱼生活在水中，保持体温接近水温。作为调节体温的独特方法，一些非洲鳄鱼通过在地上挖洞来建造巢穴，为自己提供一个凉爽、黑暗的地方来躲避炎热的非洲太阳。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Speaking of the hot African sun, let's go back to the question asked at the beginning of the lecture. We know that there used to be crocodiles in Northern Africa, yet today there are none. What are some possible explanations for this?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：说到炎热的非洲太阳，让我们回到讲座开始时提出的问题。我们知道北非曾经有鳄鱼，但今天却没有了。对此有哪些可能的解释？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Some students have suggested that the African crocodile has evolved from a desert creature into a wetland creature, thus causing them to migrate south for more appropriate condition. Others presume that the crocodile was hunted out of Northern Africa by a fiercer predator. While these are intelligent guesses, the real story is a little bit different.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：一些学生提出，非洲鳄鱼已经从沙漠生物进化成湿地生物，从而促使它们向南迁徙寻找更适宜的条件。其他人推测鳄鱼是被更凶猛的捕食者从北非捕杀殆尽的。虽然这些都是聪明的猜测，但真实情况有点不同。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The key to this migration is that the Sahara Desert did not always cover the north of Africa. About 8,000 years ago, the land was fertile wetlands perfect for breeding crocodiles. Over time, though, the area dried out and the wetland slowly turned to desert, leading the African crocodile to migrate south to the marshlands they call home today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这次迁徙的关键是撒哈拉沙漠并非一直覆盖着非洲北部。大约8000年前，这片土地是肥沃的湿地，非常适合鳄鱼繁殖。然而，随着时间推移，该地区变干了，湿地慢慢变成沙漠，导致非洲鳄鱼向南迁徙到他们今天称之为家园的沼泽地。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Some crocodiles did, however, adapt to living in dry conditions. In Mauritania, some crocodiles have learned to survive in an area where they can go up to 8 months with no water by spending the driest of times in what's called a torpor, or short period of hibernation. To utilize every bit of rainfall, these desert crocodiles dig underground caves that collect runoff, thus staying cool and hydrated.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，有些鳄鱼确实适应了干燥环境的生存。在毛里塔尼亚，一些鳄鱼学会了在没有水的地区生存长达8个月，在最干旱的时候进入所谓的“蛰伏”或短暂的冬眠状态。为了利用每一滴雨水，这些沙漠鳄鱼会挖掘地下洞穴来收集径流，从而保持凉爽和水分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: During the mating period in November and December, males attract females to their viciously protected territory through a number of behaviors that range from snapping their jaws all the way to sending infrasonic pulses through the water. Afterwards the female digs a hole up to 60 cm in depth to store the eggs for an 80-day incubation period. The female protects these eggs during the period, and sometimes even helps crack the eggs with her snout at the end.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在11月和12月的交配期，雄性通过各种行为将雌性吸引到它们被凶猛保护的领地，从咔嚓咔嚓地咬下颚到通过水发送次声波脉冲。之后，雌性挖一个深达60厘米的洞来存放卵，孵化期为80天。雌性在此期间保护这些卵，有时甚至在最后用口鼻部帮助破壳。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: These teeth-gnashing carnivores are softer than we think. Although these vicious creatures have attacked humans on a few occasions, the residents are not afraid of them. In fact, they show a great deal of reverence toward these wondrous creatures. Some say that crocodiles bring water to their habitat, so if they leave, they will bring the water with them. Obviously this is not true, but it demonstrates the admiration the inhabiting people have for crocodiles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这些咬牙切齿的食肉动物比我们想象的要温和。虽然这些凶猛的生物偶尔会袭击人类，但居民们并不害怕它们。事实上，他们对这些奇妙的生物表现出极大的敬畏。有人说鳄鱼会给它们的栖息地带来水，所以如果它们离开，就会把水带走。这显然不是真的，但这表明了当地居民对鳄鱼的钦佩。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Generally crocodiles do not predate on humans. They attack when humans populate the crocodiles' habitat, instilling fear and uneasiness in the crocs. Like any other species, crocodiles are known to attack when feeling fear.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：一般来说鳄鱼不以人类为捕食对象。当人类进入鳄鱼的栖息地时，它们会攻击，这给鳄鱼带来恐惧和不安。像任何其他物种一样，鳄鱼在感到恐惧时也会攻击。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There's still a lot more to be discovered about the African crocodile. Researchers want to know more about the population size - how many crocodiles inhabit Africa in all, how they form separate floats, etc.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：关于非洲鳄鱼，还有很多有待发现。研究人员想更多地了解种群数量——非洲总共有多少条鳄鱼，它们如何形成不同的浮群等。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is still also much to learn about migration patterns, and relations to other populations of crocodiles now found in other parts of the world.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：关于迁徙模式以及与现在世界其他地区发现的鳄鱼种群的关系，也还有很多需要了解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next time we'll examine a few specific case studies of crocodile populations in Southern Africa.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下次我们将考察南部非洲鳄鱼种群的一些具体案例研究。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you all for coming to our community meeting. As you know, we are excited to unveil our improvement plan as we look forward to the influx of tourists in the summer months. I'll start with a quick overview of the main points of interest in the area for anyone who may not quite know his or her way around yet, and then I'll get into the improvements made.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：感谢大家来参加我们的社区会议。如你们所知，我们很高兴能公布我们的改造计划，以迎接夏季游客的大量涌入。我先快速介绍一下该地区的主要景点，给那些还不太熟悉环境的人，然后再谈谈所做的改进。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First off is my favorite, the Science Museum, which is on the corner of Saint George Road. If you have not visited it yet, I encourage you to go before the busy season. It is absolutely spectacular - there is even a flight simulator you can try out!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先是我最喜欢的科学博物馆，在圣乔治路拐角。如果你们还没去过，我鼓励大家在旺季前去看看。绝对壮观——甚至还有一个飞行模拟器可以体验！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Just west of the Science Museum is the National History Museum. It's a site not to be missed as well, with each floor devoted to a different era in our nation's history. There are special exhibits for children with interactive games and fun history lessons, too.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：科学博物馆西边是国家历史博物馆。这也是一个不容错过的地方，每层楼都展示我国历史的不同时代。还有专门为儿童设计的特别展览，包含互动游戏和有趣的历史课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you're looking for parking, it is available on the intersection of Queen Street and South King Street in the Car Park. Standard hourly and daily rates do apply.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你在找停车位，女王街和南国王街交叉口的停车场可以停车。按标准收取小时费或日费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The best place for souvenirs is the Shopping Mall, though it gets extremely busy during peak times. You can get there from the tube, or the entrance on Timber Road, just south of Cornwell Road.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：买纪念品最好的地方是购物中心，虽然在高峰期会非常拥挤。你可以从地铁过去，或者从康威尔路以南的汀伯路入口进入。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This area has students everywhere, usually from the Primary School across the street from the Shopping Mall. Classes often take field trips and engage in guided tours through the area. So that's the overview of the main sites and hopefully by now I've given you a general idea of the area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这一带到处都能看到学生，通常来自购物中心对面的小学。班级经常组织实地考察，参加该地区的导览游。以上就是主要景点的概况，希望到现在我已经让你们对该地区有了一个大致的了解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now I'm going to outline the improvements we have made in our efforts to make the experience even better for each and every one of our visitors.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我要概述我们为提升每一位游客体验所做的改进。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: You probably noticed when you first drove into the Car Park this morning, that there is now additional signage to help avoid confusion. The directions were not entirely clear at first, so we have increased the number of one-way signs indicating the correct direction of traffic flow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：你们可能注意到，今天早上开车进停车场时，新增了更多的标识来避免混淆。以前的方向指示不够清晰，所以我们增加了单行标志的数量来指示正确的车流方向。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Not far from there, in line with our mission of giving back to the community, we constructed a brand new playground for the Primary School. It is really something to be excited for - the equipment is state-of-the-art and includes swings, a small climbing wall, and even an obstacle course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在不远处，为了践行我们回馈社区的使命，我们为小学新建了一个游乐场。这真的令人兴奋——设备是最先进的，包括秋千、一个小攀岩墙，甚至还有一个障碍训练场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now we'll head north and take a look at the Science Museum. In response to our feedback from past visitors to the museum, there is now free information available outlining not only upcoming IMAX showings, but also natural wonders like meteor showers, eclipses, and other cool natural events.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我们向北走，看看科学博物馆。根据过去游客对博物馆的反馈，现在有免费的信息资料，不仅列出了即将上映的IMAX影片，还有流星雨、日食和其他酷炫自然天象等自然奇观。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The Science Museum isn't the only Museum improving the experience of its visitors. The National History Museum has added an entire new wing to its facility to accommodate the large crowds of people gathering to see the Civil War exhibit, inventions timeline exhibit, and other wonderful sections of the museum. The increase in space will definitely give a more calm, comfortable experience for visitors.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：科学博物馆并不是唯一在改善游客体验的博物馆。国家历史博物馆在其设施中增加了一整个新的翼楼，以容纳大量前来参观内战展览、发明时间线展览以及博物馆其他精彩展区的人群。空间的增加肯定会给游客带来更平静、舒适的体验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: And finally, remember when there was actually a line at the mall entrance from the Tube Station? It was terrible trying to get anywhere from the Tube because foot traffic got so backed up sometimes. We have addressed that by adding another entry point into the mall from the other end of the platform to disperse the crowd.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，还记得地铁站通往商场入口处排长队的情况吗？有时人流量堵塞，从地铁站去任何地方都很糟糕。我们已经在站台另一端增加了另一个商场入口来分散人群，解决了这个问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So those are the major improvements we have made. Clearly having too many people that want to visit and enjoy what our community has to offer the public is a good problem to have, and I am confident that we have made the changes necessary to accommodate the growing interest in the area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：以上就是我们所做的主要改进。显然，有太多人想来参观和享受我们社区提供给公众的东西，这是一个好的问题，我相信我们已经做出了必要的改变，以适应人们对这个地区日益增长的兴趣。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As always, we welcome any questions, comments, or concerns about the new improvement plan. In a few minutes I will open up the floor for questions but you can also contact me or any other board member by email or through the city website. Thank you for coming, and I now encourage you to stay for the Questions and Answers panel occurring between now and 10.30...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：一如既往，我们欢迎关于新改造计划的任何问题、意见或顾虑。几分钟后我将开放提问环节，但你们也可以通过电子邮件或城市网站联系我或任何其他董事会成员。感谢大家的到来，我现在鼓励大家留下来参加从现在到十点半进行的问答讨论环节……

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: So you were both given your project assignments for your Senior thesis today, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：所以你们俩今天都收到了毕业论文的项目任务，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, and we already have to submit our topics next week!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：是的，而且我们下周就得提交论文题目！

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: But how could they give us a grade this soon?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：但他们怎么能这么快就给我们打分？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, next week's due date will not be counted towards your final grade. The teachers are just going to read your topic and give you feedback.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不，下周的截止日期不算入你们的最终成绩。老师们只是阅读你们的选题并给你们反馈。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I see. So first we should come up with our topics, and then what?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：哦，我明白了。所以我们先要想出选题，然后呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, once you know what you want to study, you need to think about how you'll study it. You need to decide on your research methods. The methods will be the main part of your paper.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：一旦你们确定了研究方向，就需要思考如何进行研究。你们需要确定研究方法。研究方法将是你们论文的主要部分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about the results section?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：那结果部分呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I can give you feedback on that, but you will be the one carrying out an experiment and thus will have to produce the results on your own. What I would like to do today is practice writing research papers before you even begin your report. I'll give you samples of old data from past experience, and you can practice writing results and drawing conclusions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，我可以给你们这方面的反馈，但你们得自己进行实验，自己得出结果。今天我想做的是，在你们开始写报告之前先练习写研究论文。我会给你们一些以往经验中的旧数据样本，你们可以练习写结果和得出结论。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANE
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think that would be really helpful.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：我觉得那会很有帮助。

transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, it sounds like a lot of extra work, but I'm sure it will make our actual project easier.

transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh man, I'm starting to understand why they give us all semester to do this. Are there any other small details like that that we should know about?

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello class, and welcome back to Marketing Strategies. This week I will expand upon last week's lecture by talking about factors you should consider when creating advertising materials and the effects they can have on your product sales.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：同学们好，欢迎回到市场营销策略课。本周我将延续上周的讲座，谈谈在制作广告材料时应该考虑的因素，以及它们可能对产品销量产生的影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Lesson one: limit your advertising to the geographic area of your target market. Though you may have a product that people want in a large area, the distance that customers are willing to travel is a significant factor in their choice of where to purchase that product.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第一课：将你的广告限制在目标市场的地理区域内。虽然你的产品可能在大范围内都有需求，但顾客愿意走多远的路程，是他们选择在哪里购买该产品的一个重要因素。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Take this example - if you are really hungry and decide you want a burrito, would you choose the restaurant that is a block from your apartment, or the one that is just as good - or even slightly better - across town? Of course you'll pick the closer restaurant.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：举个例子——如果你真的很饿，决定想吃墨西哥卷饼，你会选择离你公寓一个街区的那家餐馆，还是同样好——甚至稍好一点——但在城对面的那家？你当然会选择近的那家。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next, there's the method of communication to your target market. How do you decide among radio ads, TV commercials, fliers, or even word of mouth?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：接下来，是与目标市场沟通的方式。你如何在电台广告、电视广告、传单甚至是口碑之间做出选择？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: While we often think of the visual presentation of ads, there is much more to advertising than the look. Studies show that consumers are much more likely to remember advertising slogans if there is also a sound played. Did you know that your sense of smell is closely linked with memory? Think about Mandy's Candy Store up the road. Every time you walk past it, you can just smell the chocolate, right? I bet you can almost smell it now. Just mentioning the name brings about the smell memory, and in turn a chocolate craving. What better way to sell chocolate bars?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：虽然我们经常想到广告的视觉呈现，但广告远不止是外观。研究表明，如果有声音播放，消费者更有可能记住广告口号。你知道你的嗅觉与记忆密切相关吗？想想路边的曼迪糖果店。每次你走过它，都能闻到巧克力的味道，对吧？我敢打赌你现在几乎都能闻到。仅仅提到名字就会唤起嗅觉记忆，进而引发对巧克力的渴望。还有什么比这更好的卖巧克力棒的方式呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Obviously sometimes appealing to the senses isn't the most practical way to advertise. For example, it is a good idea to come up with a marketing strategy that adapts to the product, especially digital products. The flexibility of this kind of product is extremely important, so it is very common for advertisers to form one single layout for all of their ads - the visual, the medium, even the majority of the content - and simply update the ad each time they come out with a new version.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：显然，有时诉诸感官并不是最实用的广告方式。例如，想出适应产品的营销策略是个好主意，尤其是数字产品。这类产品的灵活性极为重要，因此广告商很常见的一种做法是为所有广告设计一个单一的布局——视觉、媒介、甚至大部分内容——每次推出新版本时只需更新广告即可。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Remember, advertising is all about stirring up the right feeling in your potential customers, whether by stimulating the senses, appealing to intellect, and so on. Once the customer experiences the ad, the important thing is his or her reaction. Someone could love the ad you made, but unless he or she considers buying the product, you have failed to get the reaction you were looking for.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：记住，广告就是要激起潜在客户的正确感受，无论是通过刺激感官、诉诸理智还是其他方式。一旦客户体验了广告，重要的是他或她的反应。有人可能喜欢你做的广告，但除非他或她考虑购买该产品，否则你未能获得你想要的反应。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So once you have successfully reached your target customer and you have his or her business, often you will want to expand to a larger market. More often than not, the same marketing strategies you used in your small campaign may not work for a larger audience. The larger you scale your product, the more factors you must consider. For instance, Apple operates worldwide, so they must tailor their advertising for each market they enter. Often you'll see Apple ads on international flights that appear not only in English, which is the lingua franca of most regions, but also in the native language of the majority of passengers. I traveled to Russia last week, and it was really interesting to see the same Nike ad that I have seen a hundred times - except this time it was in Russian!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：因此，一旦你成功地接触到了目标客户并获得了他们的生意，你往往会想扩展到更大的市场。很多时候，你在小型营销活动中使用的相同营销策略可能不适用于更大的受众。你扩展产品的规模越大，需要考虑的因素就越多。例如，苹果公司全球运营，所以他们必须为进入的每个市场量身定制广告。你经常会在国际航班上看到苹果广告，不仅用英语（多数地区的通用语），还用大多数乘客的母语。我上周去了俄罗斯，看到同一个耐克广告——我已经看过一百遍了——非常有趣，只不过这次是俄语的！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, going back to the medium of the advertisement, even after choosing to create print ads (instead of radio announcements, television commercials, etc) there is more to consider. If you print your ad in a newspaper, it will be read by a far different audience than if you print your ad in a popular magazine. Would you put an ad for the new Justin Bieber album in a newspaper? Probably not, because that product is most suitable for youths. Let's face it - do you know anyone under the age of 25 that buys a newspaper? No!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，回到广告媒介，即使选择制作印刷广告（而不是电台公告、电视广告等），也还有更多需要考虑。如果你把广告登在报纸上，受众与登在流行杂志上完全不同。你会把贾斯汀·比伯新专辑的广告放在报纸上吗？大概不会，因为那个产品最适合年轻人。面对现实吧——你认识25岁以下还买报纸的人吗？不认识！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now let's try a few strategy exercises. Imagine you are a company that is aiming to improve the environment by making products that reduce human waste. How would you advertise your product? Clearly it would send the wrong message if you put up fliers or other materials that cause lots of waste paper. Consider instead putting commercials on the Health Channel, or buying ad space on websites like UNESCO.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我们来做几个策略练习。假设你是一家旨在通过制造减少人类废弃物的产品来改善环境的公司。你会怎么做广告？显然，如果你张贴传单或其他会造成大量废纸的材料，会传递错误的信息。考虑在健康频道投放广告，或者在联合国教科文组织这样的网站上购买广告位。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Or here's another example: What is one great place to advertise suntan lotion? How about a swimming pool? It has the exact group of people that need the product. Alright, one last thing. Let's say you're filming a commercial for a water filter pitcher. What would be good scenery to use for the background? Think about somewhere calm and relaxing with clean, fresh water. Can't you see how much more effective a commercial with the beautiful scenery and flowing rivers of a national park would be than, say, water dripping from a tap?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：或者另一个例子：防晒霜在哪里做广告最好？游泳池怎么样？那里正好有需要该产品的人群。好了，最后一点。假设你在为一个滤水壶拍摄广告。什么场景适合做背景？想想那些平静、放松、有清洁淡水的地方。你看不出一个以国家公园美丽风景和流淌的河流为背景的广告，比水龙头滴水的画面有效得多吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So to wrap things up today, think about the geography of your target market, the type of marketing material you should use, and the most effective way to appeal to the customer in order to make a successful ad campaign.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：所以总结一下今天的内容，要想成功开展广告活动，要考虑目标市场的地理位置、应使用的营销材料类型，以及吸引客户的最有效方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: That is all I have for you all today. Make sure to read through chapter 8 for Monday if you have not done so already. OK, now I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这就是我今天要讲的全部内容。如果你们还没读过第八章，务必在周一前通读。好的，现在我乐意回答你们的任何问题……

transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I have been serving and protecting the city of Nottingham for over 20 years now as a member of the police department. On campus, however, I'm happy to say that the overall crime rate has fallen this year. You wouldn't think so if you have seen the extremely exaggerated stories in the media. The media has done nothing but cause more concern about crime in our area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：东米德兰兹地区的犯罪率很难控制。我们希望今年的犯罪率保持不变，但过去三年来一直在稳步上升。不过，在校内，我很高兴地说，今年的整体犯罪率下降了。如果你看过媒体上那些极度夸张的报道，你可能不会这么想。媒体除了引起人们对我们地区犯罪的更多担忧之外，什么也没做。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: Even the crime shows you see today are a little bit farfetched, but at least viewers know they are not real events. We would really like to see more factual news articles out there so the public can have a rational sense of the safety level of our society.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：即使是今天你看到的犯罪节目也有点牵强，但至少观众知道那不是真实事件。我们真的很希望看到更多实事求是的新闻文章，这样公众就能对我们社会的安全水平有一个理性的认识。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, let's move on to what to do when you see a crime. Do not get involved if at all possible, and do not draw too much attention to yourself by running away in a conspicuous manner.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：好的，让我们来看看当你目击犯罪时该怎么做。如果可能的话不要介入，也不要用过于显眼的方式逃跑来引起太多注意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: Though most likely (and hopefully) you will not have to experience this situation, if you are being mugged please do not try to resist. Instead, be compliant and seek help after the incident.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：虽然很可能（也希望）你们不会经历这种情况，但如果你遭到抢劫，请不要试图抵抗。而是要顺从，在事件发生后寻求帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: Like I said, though, it is highly unlikely that you will find yourself amidst a crime, but it is important to be prepared should it ever happen. We find that educating students and staff on the correct precautions to take is the best way to increase your safety. Just remember to be smart when you're out late at night, and avoid any area or person that looks suspicious. I know it sounds obvious, but I cannot stress this enough.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：不过，正如我所说，你身处犯罪现场的可能性极低，但做好准备以防万一仍然很重要。我们发现，教育学生和教职员工采取正确的预防措施是提高安全的最好方法。只要记住晚上外出时要明智，避开任何看起来可疑的区域或人。我知道这听起来很明显，但我怎么强调都不为过。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is also not a bad idea to have your mobile phone with you at all times, but be careful. If you are chatting on your smart phone on your way home, you are a prime target for thieves.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：随时带着手机也不是坏主意，但要小心。如果你在回家的路上用智能手机聊天，你就是小偷的首要目标。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'd like to see a show of hands - how many people have left work or the library after 10 p.m. to go home before? A lot of you, right? If you do have to go home late at night, please don't walk home alone.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：我想请大家举一下手——有多少人曾经晚上10点后下班或离开图书馆回家？很多人，对吧？如果你确实需要深夜回家，请不要一个人走路回去。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: More often than not there is someone there that will be walking the same direction as you at some point. Walk home with a friend or coworker. Even if you must use your phone to call someone that is nearby to walk with you, it is always safer to walk home with someone.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：通常情况下，总会有人和你走同一个方向。和朋友或同事一起走回家。即使你必须打电话叫附近的人来陪你走，和人一起走回家总是更安全的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: So when you're walking home, you may feel more comfortable with some sort of self-defense, such as pepper spray. Now, it's your call whether you want to carry something like this or not. However, I absolutely advise against carrying a knife or any other offensive weapon. All too often they can be used against you if you are disarmed, putting yourself in more danger.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：所以当你走回家时，有某种自卫工具如防狼喷雾可能会让你感觉更安心。要不要携带这种东西由你自己决定。然而，我绝对建议不要携带刀具或任何其他攻击性武器。它们太容易被夺走反过来对付你，让你陷入更大的危险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: For all those interested, the recreation centre offers a free self-defense class to all students every Thursday evening. While obviously an introductory self-defense class may not equip you to fight off villains like a regular superhero, it does come in handy sometimes. After taking a self-defense class, you will surely be more aware of possible dangers and how to deal with them. So hopefully now you have a more complete understanding of the nature of crimes committed on your campus, and how to avoid being a victim. I know most students at the University of Nottingham are not the criminal types, but remember that there is no barrier like a wall or something keeping non-students out. There is no army force securing the borders, and I doubt anyone wants it that way. The campus is generally a safe place, but it is not immune to small crimes once in a while.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：所有感兴趣的同学注意，娱乐中心每周四晚上为所有学生提供免费的自卫课程。虽然很明显，入门自卫课可能无法让你像超级英雄一样击退恶棍，但它有时候确实能派上用场。上完自卫课之后，你肯定会对可能的危险以及如何应对它们更有意识。所以希望现在你们对校园里犯罪的性质以及如何避免成为受害者有了更全面的了解。我知道诺丁汉大学的大多数学生都不是犯罪类型的人，但记住没有像墙壁之类的屏障把校外人员挡在外面。没有军队守卫边界，而且我怀疑有人希望那样。校园总体上是一个安全的地方，但它对偶尔的小犯罪并非免疫。

transcriptSentences.speaker: CARLOS
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright. That's all I have to say for today. Stay safe!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 卡洛斯：好了。这就是我今天要说的全部内容。注意安全！

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Bobby, go ahead and sit down. Tell me about your research project.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗨，鲍比，进来坐下吧。跟我说说你的研究项目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I decided to research football, and keys for success on a football team.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：嗯，我决定研究足球，以及足球队成功的关键。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds great. What are the guidelines for the test? Did the teacher talk to you about it in class?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：听起来不错。这项测试的指导原则是什么？老师课上跟你说过吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, everything is on a handout that was passed out. It says that the first draft is due at the end of next week, and the second and third are due later on in the month. I don't understand why we have to keep revising and fixing it. Is this assignment really that important?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：没有，所有内容都在发下来的讲义上。上面说初稿下周底交，第二稿和第三稿在这个月晚些时候交。我不明白为什么我们要不断修改。这个作业真的那么重要吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, this project is a major requirement for passing 11th grade English and will go on your permanent record.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，这个项目是通过11年级英语的主要要求，还会记入你的永久档案。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh really? Does that mean it will affect what English level I am placed in next year?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：哦真的吗？那意味着会影响我明年被分到什么英语级别吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, not exactly. You need a good grade to move on, but it is your overall grade and teacher recommendation that determines what level of English you are placed in next year. Anyway, tell me about your topic choice. Do you play football?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，不完全是。你需要一个好成绩才能升级，但决定你明年英语级别的是你的总成绩和老师推荐。不过，告诉我你为什么选这个题目。你踢足球吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, actually it's because my father loves the sport. He watches it every weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：嗯，实际上是因为我父亲喜欢这项运动。他每个周末都看。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Cool! It's a good idea to report on something you're interested in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：酷！报告你感兴趣的东西是个好主意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see you worked hard calling players and the head coach to talk, so let's see what information you got.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我看你很努力地打电话给球员和主教练进行交谈，所以我们来看看你得到了什么信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you have to listen carefully to the first call on the recording. It's really hard to hear because the background noise is louder than the person's voice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：嗯，你得仔细听录音里的第一个电话。很难听清，因为背景噪音比人的声音还大。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it is a bit tough to discern. I'm afraid the player's answer is too short as well. You will have to interview him again and try to get him to give a better answer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的，确实有点难分辨。而且恐怕那个球员的回答也太短了。你得重新采访他，想办法让他给出更好的回答。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. I thought that might happen. I will call him again tomorrow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：好的。我料到可能会这样。我明天再打给他。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Moving on, let's look back at this question. You asked, "Tell me about a time when you learned a major life lesson through playing football, and explain how that has shaped the person and player you have become now, and how you hope to pass on that lesson." It is a great idea for a question, but in an oral interview it is far too complex. I would advise you to break it up into multiple parts to get a better response.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：接下来，我们看看这个问题。你问的是：“讲述一个你通过踢足球学到重要人生教训的经历，并解释那如何塑造了现在的你作为一个人和球员，以及你希望如何传承这一教训。”这个问题想法很好，但在口头采访中太复杂了。我建议你把它分解成多个部分，以获得更好的回答。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: I guess you're right - I wouldn't want to have to provide an answer to a question like that. I will simplify it. I found that when I asked players this question, it took too much time because they were struggling to answer the question completely. In fact, this is the question Joe Billings was answering when the tape ran out.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：我想你是对的——我也不想回答那样的问题。我会简化它。我发现当我问球员这个问题时，太花时间了，因为他们在努力完整回答问题。事实上，磁带用完时乔·比林斯正是在回答这个问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: He did tend to ramble on all the questions, didn't he?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：他确实在所有问题上都喜欢漫无边际地说，是吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: He sure did.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：他确实。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I would recommend that when you go back and interview players again that you use a more sophisticated recording device. This recording is spotty, which indicates that the equipment wasn't working consistently.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我建议你再去采访球员时，使用更精良的录音设备。这段录音质量参差不齐，说明设备工作不稳定。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. I guess it probably wasn't the best idea to use the sound recorder on my phone. Hey, could you give me some feedback on the content of the report itself?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：好的。我想用手机录音可能不是最好的主意。嘿，你能就报告的内容给我一些反馈吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure! Let's start by focusing on your topic. While I like that you chose to cover football, it seems inexplicit. The keys for success of a player and team is quite an interesting topic, but what is your thesis? That is to say, what conclusions can you draw from your research? I would suggest coming up with a strong thesis statement and then shaping your report based on that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然！我们先从你的选题开始。虽然我喜欢你选择足球这个主题，但看起来不够明确。球员和球队成功的关键是个很有趣的题目，但你的论点是什么？也就是说，你能从研究中得出什么结论？我建议你想出一个有力的论点陈述，然后以此为基础来构建你的报告。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Is it really too vague? I put a whole lot of facts into it. I list the top 10 goal-scorers in football history, and later on provide statistics for a few of the most famous coaches and their records as coaches.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：真的太过宽泛了吗？我放入了大量的事实。我列出了足球史上十大射手，后来又提供了一些最著名教练的统计数据和他们执教记录。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think that's great that you included these facts, but I think you focused too much on the facts and not enough on connecting these facts to make your point.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我觉得你加入这些事实很好，但我认为你太关注事实本身，而没有足够的将这些事实联系起来以论证你的观点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: BOBBY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ah, I see. Okay. So it looks like I have quite a bit of work to do before the deadline!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 鲍比：啊，我明白了。好吧。看起来我在截止日期前还有很多工作要做！
