transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. Today I am going to cover the daunting task of giving a quality speech - a thought that makes most of us cringe. In fact, 90% of all people feel nervous about public speaking, about 10% of whom are described as genuinely terrified. Hopefully when we are finished here today, you all will be in the 10% of the population who do not feel nervous at all.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：早上好。今天我要讲的是做一场高质量演讲这一艰巨任务——这个想法让大多数人畏缩。事实上，90%的人对公开演讲感到紧张，其中大约10%被描述为真的非常害怕。希望今天结束时，你们都能成为那10%完全不紧张的人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Did you know that lecturers tend to get more nervous if the speech they are giving is an important one? It makes sense, right? You probably wouldn't be nearly as nervous to address your residence hall about the proper use of the recycle and compost bins as you might be if you were asked to give the graduation speech to your entire 5,000-student class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：你们知道吗，如果演讲很重要，演讲者往往会更紧张？有道理，对吧？让你对学生宿舍的人讲正确使用回收和堆肥桶，和你被要求给5000人的毕业班做演讲相比，前者肯定不会让你那么紧张。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what is it that makes some people completely comfortable in front of crowds? Some people think that the ability to give a good speech is a gift that others are simply born with. This is almost never the case. Public speaking can be learned with practice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么是什么让一些人在人群面前完全自在呢？有些人认为做一场好演讲的能力是一种天赋，别人天生就有。事实几乎从来不是这样。公开演讲是可以通过练习学会的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first, most important thing you can do to improve your confidence in delivering a speech is to prepare a quality speech. Honestly, while the content of your speech is relatively important, the audience will really only remember the last sentence you say. It is a good idea to structure the rest of your speech to lead up to this last point to really drive your message home. This is a good way to ensure that your speech is well-organised.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：要提高演讲自信，你能做的第一件也是最重要的事，就是准备一场高质量的演讲。说实话，虽然演讲内容相对重要，但听众真正记住的只有你说的最后一句话。把演讲的其余部分结构设计得层层递进，导向最后这一点，以真正把你的信息讲透，是个好主意。这是确保演讲结构良好的好方法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Once you are confident in the quality of the speech you have written, the rest is just about your stage presence. Let's go through some do's and don'ts of public speaking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：一旦你对自己写的演讲质量有信心了，剩下的就是你的舞台表现力。让我们过一遍公开演讲的一些注意事项。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First, you want to command the attention of the room. Do not - I repeat, do not proceed with your speech until the audience is paying attention. Even Martin Luther King, Junior's I Have a Dream speech wouldn't have made any difference in the world without the undivided attention of his audience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，你要掌控全场的注意力。不要——我重复，不要在听众注意之前开始你的演讲。即使是马丁·路德·金的《我有一个梦想》演讲，如果没有听众的全神贯注，也不会有任何影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To continue with the I Have a Dream example, one of the reasons that MLK was such an effective orator was his ability to speak with passion and engage with his audience. That sort of charisma does not come from reading straight from paper. Don't get me wrong - it is a good idea to write your main ideas down on a note card, sheet of paper, or something. But one factor that will consistently lead to a boring, forgettable speech is writing down your entire speech. Do not write your full speech down. If you are constantly reading your paper, you are not making eye contact with your audience, and thus failing to really express the feeling that goes with your ideas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：继续以《我有一个梦想》为例，马丁·路德·金之所以是一位如此出色的演说家，原因之一是他能够充满激情地演讲并与听众互动。那种魅力不是来自照本宣科。别误会——把主要想法写在索引卡、纸或类似的东西上是好主意。但有一个因素会持续导致演讲枯燥、令人遗忘，那就是写下完整讲稿。不要写完整讲稿。如果你一直在读稿子，你就没有和听众进行眼神交流，从而无法真正表达伴随你想法的那种感受。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I advise you write one or two ideas, so if you suddenly draw a blank you have something to jog your memory. If you've written a good speech that you believe in, those ideas should be sufficient to keep you on track. Once you have those ideas written down, give your speech a few practice runs in front of the mirror, into your sound recorder on your phone, or with a friend before it comes time to address a crowd. That way you can hear how the ideas come across, make sure there are no abrupt transitions, and find out whether you're talking too fast or too slow. Timing is important - make sure you time yourself beforehand to see how long your speech is.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我建议你写一两个要点，这样如果你突然大脑一片空白，就有东西能唤起你的记忆。如果你写了一篇你相信的好演讲稿，这些要点应该足以让你保持在正轨上。一旦你写下了这些要点，在对着人群演讲之前，先在镜子前、用手机录音功能、或跟朋友练习几次。这样你可以听听自己的想法表达得如何，确保没有突兀的过渡，并发现自己语速是太快还是太慢。时间把控很重要——提前给自己计时，看看你的演讲有多长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: That is pretty much it! With practice you'll be able to deliver an expert speech that engages and even maybe inspires your audience. Just remember - speak with emotion. No one wants to listen to someone reading from a script.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：基本上就是这些了！通过练习，你将能够做出一场吸引人、甚至可能激励听众的专业演讲。只要记住——带着感情演讲。没人想听别人照着稿子念。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As I come to a close in my speech, I'll point out that I have employed all of these tips that I have covered. I practiced my speech ahead of time and timed it, and I can even show you my one small index card with just three simple bullets on it. It's as easy as that!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在我演讲快要结束时，我想指出，我运用了刚才讲的所有技巧。我提前练习并计时了，我甚至可以给你们看我那张小小的索引卡，上面只有三个简单的要点。就这么简单！

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello, London Police Department.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：你好，伦敦警察局。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I would like to report a robbery.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：是的，我想报一起抢劫案。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright, just a minute while I pull up the form. OK, could you give me your first and last name?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：好的，稍等，我调出表格。好了，能告诉我你的姓名吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Anna Grieg.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：安娜·格里格。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Anna, Greg? G-R-E-G?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：安娜，格雷格？G-R-E-G？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, Grieg. G-R-I-E-G.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：不，格里格。G-R-I-E-G。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Got it. Alright moving on: gender - female. Date of birth?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：明白了。好的继续：性别——女。出生日期？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: 15th of March, 1980.

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright, thanks. Just a few more personal information questions and then we can address your claim.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：好的，谢谢。再问几个个人信息问题，然后我们就可以处理你的报案了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: What is the address?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：地址是哪里？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: 4 Ellendale St. That's E-L-L-E-N-D-A-L-E.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：埃伦代尔街4号。E-L-L-E-N-D-A-L-E。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh right, Ellendale Street. Yeah we've had a lot of break-ins in that area lately. And the postal code?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：哦对，埃伦代尔街。是啊，最近那个区域发生了很多入室盗窃案。邮编呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: W5 2AT.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：W5 2AT。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: And are you a citizen of the UK?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：你是英国公民吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: No.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：不是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, what type of citizenship do you have?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：好的，你拥有什么国籍？

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I lived in the United States for most of my life, but I am actually of Grenadian nationality.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：嗯，我大半生都住在美国，但我的国籍实际上是格林纳达。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, so is that the country that issued your passport?

transcriptSentences.speaker: ANNA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 安娜：是的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: POLICE
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 警察：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, Mark. Hi, Gina. What can I help with?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗨，马克。嗨，吉娜。我能帮什么忙？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: So we were hoping you could help us with this extracurricular project.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：我们想请你帮我们做这个课外项目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure - what is the topic?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然——主题是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Attending business school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：进入商学院。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: This sounds like a great idea. So you're going to explain the requirements for getting into business school?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：听起来是个好主意。你们要解释进入商学院的条件吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: Not exactly. It will be more broadly about the experience - the academics, accommodation, and social experience that comes with being a part of the business school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：不完全是。它会更广泛地关于体验——学业、住宿，以及作为商学院一份子的社交体验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. So would your audience be the general public?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我明白了。那你们的受众是普通大众吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, we would probably want more to focus on members of the institution - we would especially like to reach individual applicants to the business school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：嗯，我们可能更想关注这个机构的成员——我们尤其想接触商学院的申请者个人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. Now what form will this information be? You could give a talk to all the summer courses - all you would need is permission from the course director. Or you could pass out information outside the student union.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我明白了。这些信息会以什么形式呈现？你们可以给所有暑期课程做一个演讲——只需要课程负责人的许可。或者你们可以在学生会外面分发信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: Those are both good ideas. What about sending out pamphlets in the mail?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：这些都是好主意。那通过邮件寄送小册子呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Most college students never check their mail. Maybe you could make a video and show it on campus?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：大多数大学生从不查看信件。也许你们可以做一个视频，在校园里播放？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a great idea. We'll do the video.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：好主意。我们就做视频。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great. And as members of the business school, do you have an incentive to attract new students? If so, this idea is a great way to do that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：太好了。作为商学院的成员，你们有吸引新生的激励措施吗？如果有的话，这个想法是很好的方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, the idea actually came about because of how much students like us worry about their studies.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：没有，这个想法其实是因为像我们这样的学生多么担心学业。

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah - when I got into business school, there were a lot of things I had not prepared for, so the video would cover a lot of things Mark and I wish we had known upon entering business school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：是的——当我进入商学院时，有很多事情我没有准备好，所以这个视频会涵盖马克和我希望我们在进入商学院时就知道的很多事情。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: What would you talk about first?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你们会先谈什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first and probably most important section would be academics.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：第一个，也可能是最重要的部分，会是学业。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good idea. So would you provide guidance on what courses to take?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好主意。那你们会提供选课指导吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: We want to focus especially on the approaches professors take - their teaching methods. It is far different than what students are used to in high school, and even in liberal arts college.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：我们想特别关注教授采取的方式——他们的教学方法。这与学生在高中甚至文理学院习惯的非常不同。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good idea. And how long do you think you would spend explaining academics?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好主意。你们觉得会用多长时间解释学业部分？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: We'll probably spend 7 minutes on it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：我们可能花7分钟在上面。

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: We also have some ideas for talking about housing, food options, and stuff like that. We're not really sure how to tie it all together though.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：我们也有一些关于住宿、饮食选择等内容的想法。不过我们不太确定如何把它们串起来。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think it would be suitable to title that section accommodation - what do you think?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我觉得把那部分命名为“住宿”会很合适——你们觉得呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: That could work. We'll definitely describe the different dining options at the cafeteria, and then walk students through flats and the grueling process of finding one near the business school campus.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：可以。我们肯定会描述食堂的各种餐饮选择，然后带学生了解公寓以及在学校附近找房的艰辛过程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay - so we would cover specifics on the cafeteria, as well as flats?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：好的——我们会涵盖食堂的具体信息，以及公寓？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think those are both helpful. We could spend about 6 minutes on accommodation, and be sure to touch on those specifically.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：我觉得两者都有帮助。我们可以在住宿上花大约6分钟，并确保具体谈到这些。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great. Is there anything else you would talk about?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：很好。还有什么你们会谈到的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: We definitely want to go over the social aspect of attending school here.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：我们肯定要谈谈在这里上学的社交方面。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. I think it's good to have a little fun once in a while when you're working so hard in school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然。我觉得在学校学习这么辛苦，偶尔有点乐趣是很好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think we are going to introduce new students to the disco that so many upperclassmen know and love. Maybe we'll include a few other places too, but that's the main one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：我想我们会向新生介绍那个很多高年级学生都知道且喜爱的迪斯科舞厅。可能还会包含其他一些地方，但那是主要的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: We're also going to invite students to the international evening taking place in the first week of school as a great chance for our large international student population to meet a lot of other new students.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：我们还会邀请学生参加开学第一周举行的国际之夜，作为我们庞大的国际学生群体认识很多其他新生的好机会。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: It can definitely be hard to meet people as an international student. I think that is a great idea. You may want to spend slightly longer on this section than the other two.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：作为国际学生，认识人肯定很难。我觉得这是个好主意。你们可能想在这一部分比其他两部分花更长一点时间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm...how about 8 minutes?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：嗯……8分钟怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds reasonable. So overall, the introduction should take 3 minutes, and then the conclusion should take 4, giving us a total of 28 minutes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：听起来很合理。所以总的来说，引言应该花3分钟，然后结论花4分钟，总共28分钟。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I wouldn't rush your introduction. Maybe give it between 4 and 6 minutes. The conclusion, though, can be shorter since it's just a quick refresher of each of the topics. Give that not more than 2 minutes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：引言不要匆忙。也许给它4到6分钟。不过结论可以短一些，因为它只是每个话题的快速回顾。给它不超过2分钟。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MARK
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. So in total the video should take about the same time, just more intro and less conclusion?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 马克：好的。所以视频总时长应该差不多，只是引言长一点，结论短一点？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Precisely.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：正是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: GINA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright - we are going to get to work on our video. Thanks for your help!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉娜：好的——我们开始制作视频了。谢谢你的帮助！

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: So tell me about your research project, John.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：跟我说说你的研究项目吧，约翰。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: I created a questionnaire for the study to determine people's opinions of the relative feasibility of earning a living in Brisbane.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：我为这项研究设计了一份问卷，以确定人们对在布里斯班谋生的相对可行性的看法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, cool. How is it scored? Are they all multiple choice questions?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：哦，酷。怎么计分？都是选择题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the questions consist primarily of yes/no responses. There are two free response questions at the end. Participants will use a computer to fill in their answers; that way it is really easy to analyse the data afterward.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：嗯，问题主要是“是/否”回答。最后有两个开放式问答题。参与者将使用电脑填写答案；这样之后分析数据就很容易。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! It sounds like you have a pretty solid idea of what you should do. Just don't forget to submit a copy of your plans to Professor Curran by the 15th.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：太好了！听起来你对自己的方向已经很明确了。别忘了在15号之前把你的计划副本交给柯伦教授。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I almost forgot!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：哦，我差点忘了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, you don't do it for high grade or appraise, but he can review and give you feedback.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：嗯，你不是为了高分或评价才这么做，但他可以审阅并给你反馈。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right, that will be helpful - he has been conducting studies like this for 30 years now.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：对，那会很有帮助——他做这类研究已经有30年了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yep, oh and I'm curious - are you going to be in the room giving subjects directions for the questionnaire?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：嗯，哦我很好奇——你会待在房间里给受试者做问卷指导吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I think the instructions will be provided by another representative who will not be analysing the data. I want them to feel they can answer and be completely anonymous, so I will not be in the room. Anonymity is really important for this study.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：嗯，我觉得指导会由另一位不分析数据的代表来提供。我想让受试者感觉到他们可以完全匿名回答，所以我不会在房间里。匿名性对这项研究真的很重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: I agree. Good idea. You should tell the representative to remind subjects to fully consider both sides of each issue. Sometimes it's really easy to immediately check "yes" or "no" without stopping to think about it completely.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：我同意。好主意。你应该告诉代表提醒受试者充分考虑每个问题的两面。有时候人们很容易不假思索地立刻勾选“是”或“否”。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's so true! It's like a race to finish the questionnaire first or something. I'll make sure to include that in the instructions. This report has to be perfect!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：太对了！就像比赛谁先完成问卷一样。我会确保把这一点加进指导里。这份报告必须完美！

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, what's the big deal? I know it's part of your grade and all...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：哇，有什么大不了的？我知道这占你成绩的一部分……

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well it's that, but also a well-executed study could grab the attention of faculty in the department, which would be a huge deal.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：嗯，这是一方面，但做得好的研究也能引起系里老师的注意，那会是件大事。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: So... for attention?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：所以……为了引起注意？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: No silly! I mean I could really gain the respect of professors who may later take me on as a graduate student in their labs.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：不是啦！我的意思是，我真的能赢得教授的尊重，他们以后可能会接收我进他们的实验室做研究生。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I see.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：哦，我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me take a look at the survey. Wow, this looks great! The map of the median income by region is a great tool - where did you find it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达尼：让我看看这份问卷。哇，看起来不错！这张按地区划分的收入中位数地图是个很好的工具——你在哪里找到的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well thanks! I read a lot of sources and just noticed this one in a small psychology journal called Modern Psychology. It's more helpful than the photo I added, but I think the photo is just so interesting. It was in the newspaper last year during that huge wage strike.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：谢谢！我读了很多资料，刚好在《现代心理学》这本小型心理学期刊里注意到这个。它比我加的图片更有用，但我觉得那张图片也很有趣。是去年大罢工期间在报纸上看到的。

transcriptSentences.englishText: It's great. Probably not necessary, but it looks great. I don't understand - what is WKRX's involvement here?

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, interesting. So you don't have to pay for any of this?

transcriptSentences.speaker: DANI

transcriptSentences.speaker: JOHN

transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰：上个月在心理学俱乐部理事会上，有人谈到从本地企业获取赞助有多容易，所以我听了他们的建议，打电话到处问！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon. In the last few lectures we've been covering the social and political pressures that influenced the rise of the rebellion of 1679. Today I would like to focus on the Pleasanton Town Market.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下午好。在过去的几节课中，我们一直在探讨影响1679年叛乱兴起的社会和政治压力。今天我想集中讲讲普莱森顿镇市场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, why are we talking all about some market? It's not like it was the first market ever, or even a particularly large market. The Pleasanton Town Market is important because it is often mentioned in the literature found in the library. If you have ever been there, you have probably seen all of the hand-crafted items sold there now. But what was originally bought and sold in the town market?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么，我们为什么要谈论一个市场？它既不是第一个市场，也不是一个特别大的市场。普莱森顿镇市场很重要，因为它经常出现在图书馆的文献中。如果你去过那里，你可能见过那里现在出售的各种手工艺品。但最初在镇市场上买卖的是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In the beginning, the market sold products such as meats, furs, and simple tools. Over time, though, it became known as the place to find quality livestock. People came from all over the world to find the biggest and best cows, pigs, and chickens. In fact, the profits from the Town Market became the savior of a plummeting economy during a time of much turmoil. Not to be confused with the reconstruction era, a period of rapid development came about in the 1660's as a result of the market's vendors contributing their profits to building up much needed public facilities and defense, which would later make a huge impact on the outcome of the war.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：起初，市场出售肉类、皮毛和简单工具等产品。但随着时间的推移，它逐渐成为寻找优质牲畜的地方。人们从世界各地来到那里，寻找最大最好的牛、猪和鸡。事实上，镇市场的利润在动荡时期成为了经济下滑的拯救者。不要与重建时期混淆，1660年代出现了一段快速发展时期，因为市场的商贩们把利润贡献出来建造急需的公共设施和防御工事，这后来对战争的结果产生了巨大影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For many years, the market flourished and began to draw in large tourism crowds in addition to the throngs of livestock customers. However, as revolutions in farming came about, more people moved to farms far from the city centre. Customers grew more and more reluctant to travel all the way to the town centre for their meats when they could easily choose to buy from local farmers near them for a fraction of the price.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：许多年来，市场繁荣发展，除了大批牲畜顾客外，也开始吸引大量游客。然而，随着农业革命的发生，越来越多的人搬到了远离市中心的农场。顾客越来越不愿意大老远跑到镇中心买肉，因为他们可以轻松地以更低的价格从附近当地农民那里购买。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: With such a fall in the profits of the town's major profit generator, some quality town planning was needed. In the mayoral election of 1668, a young man of little fame just barely claimed the popular vote - none other than the now legendary John C. Wiley.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：随着镇主要利润来源的利润下降，需要进行高质量的城市规划。在1668年的市长选举中，一位不太出名的年轻人仅仅以微弱优势赢得了普选票——不是别人，正是现在传奇人物约翰·C·威利。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wiley's first decision as mayor of Pleasanton was to deal with the quickly failing Town Market. The building with the large clock was a landmark that had symbolised growth in Pleasanton for a generation. Wiley decided to use the notoriety of the Town Market to set an example. During the historical Rotterdam Rebellion, Wiley gave all those involved lifetime prison sentences in the very same building. It stayed a prison for about 50 more years until they transported all remaining prisoners to other facilities and turned it into the historical monument today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：威利作为普莱森顿市长的第一个决定就是处理迅速衰败的镇市场。那座带大钟的建筑是一代人的地标，象征着普莱森顿的发展。威利决定利用镇市场的名声来树立榜样。在历史上鹿特丹叛乱期间，威利就在这同一栋建筑里给所有涉案者判了终身监禁。它作为监狱持续了大约50年，直到他们把剩余所有囚犯转移到其他设施，并将其变成了今天的历史纪念碑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now that you know the basics of the history of the Pleasanton Town Market, I will introduce your next group project. I want you, to make a short film based on the real historical events that occurred in Pleasanton before and during the uprising.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：既然你们了解了普莱森顿镇市场历史的基本情况，我来介绍一下你们的下一个小组项目。我希望你们根据普莱森顿在起义前后发生的真实历史事件制作一部短片。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I will give you some class time to look through the library's reference section, but you will be responsible for conducting further research outside of class. I suggest starting by looking for information on the market itself. You'll find plenty of information - in fact, some students complain that there is actually too much information on it. On your own time, you could find family members of old war veterans to conduct interviews. Sometimes they provide wonderful insight that you wouldn't find in proper history books, but be careful - an interview that is riddled with bias is useless.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我会给你们一些课堂时间查阅图书馆的参考书区，但你们需要负责在课外进行进一步研究。我建议从查找市场本身的信息开始。你们会找到很多信息——事实上，有些学生抱怨关于它的信息太多了。你们可以在课外找老退伍军人的家人进行采访。有时他们会提供你在正规历史书中找不到的精彩见解，但要小心——充满偏见的采访是没有用的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I myself have some very old photographs here that you are welcome to take a look at for some inspiration. I'm lucky enough to own this one of Jimo & iles himself! Very interesting to see, but does not provide enough information to add much to your film.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我自己有一些非常老的照片，你们可以看看，找找灵感。我很幸运拥有这张吉莫和伊尔斯本人的照片！看起来很有趣，但没有提供足够的信息为你们的电影增加多少内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Feel free to take this film into whatever direction you choose. You could even do a crime thriller based on real outlaws. All you would have to do is look through the newspaper archives in the crime section during that time period. Try to get as much detail as you can, but you may end up having to draw your own conclusions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：你们可以自由地将这部电影带向任何方向。甚至可以根据真实的亡命之徒拍一部犯罪惊悚片。你们只需要查看那个时期报纸档案中的犯罪版块。尽量获取尽可能多的细节，但你们可能最终不得不自行得出结论。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, that's enough from me, so let's go on to...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好了，我就说这么多，让我们继续……

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hey Jim, it's Peter.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嘿，吉姆，我是彼得。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh hey Peter. What's up?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哦嘿，彼得。怎么了？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I thought I'd call so we could hammer out the details for next year's lease.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我想打个电话，好把明年的租约细节敲定下来。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a good idea. Did we ever decide on how to split the total rent?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好主意。我们定下来怎么分摊房租了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I was thinking since my room is bigger I probably should pay a little more, so I could pay £110 and you could pay £80. Does that sound okay?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，我在想既然我的房间大一些，我大概应该多付一点，所以我可以付110英镑，你付80英镑。听起来可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Considering that my old apartment cost me £100 for a smaller room, I'm definitely alright with that! Hey, I was looking at a map of the area, and can't seem to find a bus stop near it. Do you know where we would catch the bus?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：考虑到我之前那间更小的公寓都要100英镑，我当然没问题！嘿，我刚看了这附近的地图，好像找不到公交站。你知道我们在哪里坐公交吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the bus is actually pretty far from us, but we have that garage that we can park our cars in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，公交站离我们其实挺远的，但我们有那个车库可以停车。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, that's great! Convenient parking is hard to find, so we're lucky we have that. Okay, so we have a whole lot of things we'll need to buy when we move in - how do you want to split that up?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哇，太好了！方便的停车位很难找，所以我们有那个真幸运。好吧，搬进去之后有很多东西要买——你想怎么分摊？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I was wondering - do you still work at the supermarket?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我在想——你还在超市上班吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yep, every Tuesday and Saturday.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：是的，每周二和周六。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Would you be able to buy things from there if I send you a shopping list?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：如果我给你一张购物清单，你能从那里买吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, I can do that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：当然，我可以。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great. Then I can take care of whatever else we need that you wouldn't get at a supermarket. If you want, I'll pick you up from work that day and we can go to the apartment together.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：太好了。那超市买不到的东西就我来处理。如果你愿意，那天我可以去接你下班，然后我们一起回公寓。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: That would be great, thanks.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：那太好了，谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem - that way we can split the cost of petrol.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：没问题——这样我们也能分摊油费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Works for me. It's so expensive these days, isn't it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：我没问题。现在油费这么贵，是吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's downright obscene.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：简直是离谱。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: So let's figure out what appliances we need. Do we have a microwave?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：那我们来看看需要什么电器。有微波炉吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, the landlord's providing that for us. Hey, do you still have that space heater though? We need one for the kitchen since it's not connected to the central heating.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：有，房东给我们提供。嘿，你还有那个小型取暖器吗？厨房需要一台，因为它没接中央供暖。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, right, I'll bring that. Anything else?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哦对，我带来。还有别的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I have some dining room and living room furniture I can bring, so that should take care of most of the big stuff. You know what we do need though? Could you bring a toaster?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，我有一些餐厅和客厅的家具可以带，所以大部分大件应该没问题。不过你知道我们确实需要什么吗？你能带个烤面包机吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: I actually don't have one. It doesn't come with the microwave?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：我其实没有。微波炉不带烤面包功能吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, the landlord is only supplying the microwave. It would really help if you could bring one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：不，房东只提供微波炉。如果你能带一个真的很有帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, I'll pick one up at the store. You know, I also have this cool antique rotary phone that would be a cool addition to the apartment. Sort of as decoration and utility.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好的，我去店里买一个。你知道吗，我还有一个很酷的古董转盘电话，放在公寓里会很酷。既有装饰性又实用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh cool! The only thing is, we'd have to put it in the kitchen, unless you want it in your room.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：哦酷！不过问题是，我们得把它放在厨房，除非你想放在自己房间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why not put it in the living room?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：为什么不放在客厅呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The living room is too loud to have a phone conversation. The noise sort of carries, so if one person is trying to watch TV or have friends over the person on the phone won't be able to hear.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：客厅太吵了，没办法打电话。噪音会传过去，所以如果一个人在客厅看电视或招待朋友，打电话的人就听不清了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, okay, well I guess kitchen it is then. Any other big things we need? That seems like everything.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：嗯，好吧，那就放厨房吧。还有什么大件需要吗？听起来都全了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's all I can think of. And of course, move-in is -
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我能想到的就这些了。当然，搬进去的日期是——

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: June 1st. I can't wait. We'll be able to watch the big game in our new apartment - it's going to be awesome!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：6月1日。我等不及了。我们可以在新公寓看大赛了——肯定会很棒！

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, we can move in in the morning and then Friday night we can sit back and cheer on Liverpool.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：是啊，我们早上搬进去，然后周五晚上就可以坐下来为利物浦加油了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have an exam in the morning, but will be done around 11 a.m. and can move in after. Wait...Liverpool? You're joking, right? I thought you were a Manchester United fan?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：我早上有考试，但大约11点考完，之后可以搬家。等等……利物浦？你开玩笑的吧？我以为你是曼联球迷？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PETER
transcriptSentences.englishText: MAN U? No way! Liverpool all the way!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：曼联？不可能！永远支持利物浦！

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIM
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh no. I don't know if I can live with a Liverpool fan...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哦不。我不知道我能不能和一个利物浦球迷住在一起……

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Before your application, you might be curious about what sort of places you could go to. There are four main locations, but you also have the freedom to submit a different location and if they can make the necessary arrangements, you can go. The first country Earn and Learn established locations in was the U.S., where you may choose from multiple locations, as long as you can commit to their more rigid schedule of August to December.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在申请之前，你们可能好奇可以去哪些地方。有四个主要地点，但你们也可以自由提交不同的地点，如果他们能做必要的安排，你们就可以去。Earn and Learn 最先设立分部的国家是美国，那里你可以从多个地点中选择，只要你能遵守他们更严格的时间表——8月到12月。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Also, you could do the Australia internship. That one is really cool - you work at a wildlife shelter and learn about the business practices of nonprofit organisations. You do have to be willing to commit 8 months for that one, though. Perhaps that's a long time to be so far away, but I would say it is really an amazing opportunity.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：另外，你们可以参加澳大利亚的实习。那个真的很酷——你在野生动物收容所工作，学习非营利组织的商业运作。不过你得愿意投入8个月时间。也许离家那么远是挺久的，但我要说这真的是一个很棒的机会。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I don't know whether some of you are in decent physical shape. If so, the South Africa internship is another exciting one - you learn a lot about sustainable farming - but you would be doing some of the manual labor involved in maintaining a farm. Indeed, it's hard work, but I think you would definitely be able to do it. It may be wise to wait until after their summer is over so it's not so terribly hot.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我不知道你们有些人身体条件怎么样。如果好的话，南非实习是另一个令人兴奋的选择——你会学到很多关于可持续农业的知识——但你需要做一些维护农场的体力劳动。确实很辛苦，但我相信你们肯定能做到。明智的做法可能是等到他们的夏天结束之后再去，这样就不会那么热了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In addition, there is a most recently established location in India. This one gives you more of a study abroad feel, given that they arrange a host family for you to stay with. In the other locations, you live in an apartment with other interns, so this is definitely a unique experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，最近还在印度设立了分部。这个更像出国留学的感觉，因为会安排寄宿家庭给你们住。在其他地点，你们和其他实习生一起住公寓，所以这绝对是一种独特的体验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Regardless of where you go, at the end of the program you get a Global Traveling Certificate, as long as you can explain your experience. You can provide a written log of what you did. I recommend writing journal or blog entries about what you do every day, or a weekly summary of each day. Of course you don't have to write up a formal report or anything like that. And you need to apply for it once you have returned.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：无论你去哪里，在项目结束时你都会获得一份全球旅行证书，只要你能说明你的经历。你可以提供一份书面日志记录你所做的事情。我建议写日记或博客，记录你每天做的事情，或者每周总结。当然你不必写正式报告之类的东西。你需要在回来后申请。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Some students may want to know whether this is a paid internship. Actually you have to pay for the flight there yourself. But you have the opportunity to create your own small business, which could earn you money if it's successful. So basically you pay for it all up front, but when you're there you can find ways to make money. That is to say, you pay for two thirds of the cost up front as a deposit, and then give the final installment one month prior to your return.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有些学生可能想知道这是否是带薪实习。实际上你得自己付机票钱。但你有机会创办自己的小生意，如果成功的话可以赚钱。所以基本上你是先付所有费用，但到了那里你可以想办法赚钱。也就是说，你先付三分之二的费用作为押金，然后在返回前一个月付清尾款。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Finally, I have to remind you that you need a health check before you go, to make sure you're not going to spread any communicable diseases. In addition, before you go, you don't have to attend any meetings or workshops. You'll meet everyone you'll be working with once you get there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，我必须提醒你们，出发前需要进行健康检查，以确保不会传播任何传染病。此外，在出发前你们不需要参加任何会议或研讨会。到了那里，你们会见到所有同事。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, well, that's all I've time for today. Thanks for listening and I'm happy to take any questions if you have them...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好了，这就是我今天有时间讲的全部内容了。谢谢大家的聆听，如果你们有问题我很乐意回答……

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, Professor Timmons? Do you have a few minutes? I was hoping to talk about what I missed on Thursday.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：嗨，蒂蒙斯教授？您有时间吗？我想问问周四我错过的内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello, come in. Sure, sit down. Could you tell me your name please?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：你好，进来吧。当然可以，请坐。能告诉我你的名字吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Margaret, sir. Margaret Parkinson. I apologise for missing your class but I had to go to the hospital.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：玛格丽特，先生。玛格丽特·帕金森。很抱歉我没来上课，但我不得不去医院。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm sorry to hear that! Everything is OK now though, I hope?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：很抱歉听到这个！不过希望现在一切都好了？

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, thanks.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：是的，谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Glad to hear it. So on Thursday I outlined the research project that will account for 30% of your grade. All students will be divided into groups and will give a well-researched presentation to the class covering a specific topic relevant to student life.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：很高兴听到这个。那么周四我介绍了占你们成绩30%的研究项目。所有学生将被分成小组，就与学生生活相关的特定主题做一次经过充分研究的课堂展示。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that sounds interesting - can we choose just any topic that pertains to life as a student, like how to start your own student organisation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：哦，听起来很有趣——我们可以选择任何与学生生活相关的主题吗，比如如何创办自己的学生组织？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, though I'm sure that would be an informative presentation, I have already chosen a list of topics which I will assign. As an example, I assigned one group the topic of student loans. They are to research not just the prevalence of students who have loans to pay for their tuition, but information as to how best to manage these loans and possible scholarships that could alleviate some of the financial burden.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：嗯，虽然我相信那会是很丰富的展示，但我已经选定了一系列题目会分配给各组。举个例子，我给一组分配了学生贷款的主题。他们不仅要研究有多少学生靠贷款支付学费，还要研究如何最好地管理这些贷款，以及可能减轻部分经济负担的奖学金信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: That one sounds particularly interesting to me - could I request that topic? I could easily find out a lot about it by stopping by the Finance Office on my way to class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：那个主题听起来特别有趣——我可以申请那个题目吗？我可以在去上课的路上顺便去财务处了解很多相关信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Unfortunately, that one is already taken by another group. I have however assigned you to a group and given you all one of two choices.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：不幸的是，那个已经被另一组选了。不过我已经把你们分好组了，给你们两个选择中的一个。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I see. What are the choices?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：哦，我明白了。有哪些选择？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first is discussing smoking. Trends in the number of student smokers compared with the general population, popular reasons students take up smoking, and more healthy alternatives to smoking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：第一个是讨论吸烟。学生吸烟者数量与普通人群相比的趋势、学生开始吸烟的常见原因，以及更健康的吸烟替代方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, that one could be interesting. I'm not a smoker myself, but will see what my group thinks. If we did choose this topic, we would rather not put our fellow students on the spot to interview them - where else could we gather information?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：嗯，那个可能有点意思。我自己不抽烟，但看看我组员怎么想。如果我们选了这个主题，我们不想让同学难堪去采访他们——我们还能从哪里收集信息？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: How about where the cigarettes are sold?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：卖香烟的地方怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's a great idea. I could interview the manager of a supermarket and find out the average age of people buying cigarettes, or how much they buy, that sort of thing?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：哦，这是个好主意。我可以采访超市经理，了解买烟的人的平均年龄，或者他们买多少，这类信息？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Precisely.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：正是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, I'll keep that in mind. And what was the other topic?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，我记下来。那另一个主题是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: The other topic is the practice of natural medicine. It sounds far more specific than the others, but it is more an exercise of outlining a career path. If your group chooses this, you would cover the specifics of becoming a Doctor of Natural Medicine, how to become licensed to practice natural medicine, what the career outlook is, etc. you could find much of the information you need on this in the Careers Office.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：另一个主题是自然医学实践。它听起来比其他更具体，但更多是描绘职业路径的练习。如果你们组选了这个，你们需要涵盖成为自然医学博士的具体细节、如何获得执业许可、职业前景等等。你们可以在职业办公室找到许多相关信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, that would be really helpful not just in learning about natural medicine, but in how to approach researching any career path.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：哇，那不仅对了解自然医学有帮助，对如何研究任何职业路径也很有帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's the idea. I want groups to really think outside the box to find information on their topics. They should interview multiple sources.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：就是这个想法。我希望各组能跳出框框思考，找到关于他们主题的信息。他们应该采访多个来源。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, now I think I have the general idea.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，现在我大致明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: When is the presentation due?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：展示什么时候交？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I expect each group to send me an email attachment of the plan ahead of time - by October 10th - so that I can ensure that you are on the right track.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：我希望各组在10月10日前提前把计划以邮件附件发给我，这样我能确保你们的方向正确。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's actually really reassuring. I would hate to spend so much time on a presentation only to find we had taken it in the wrong direction! So when is the presentation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：哦，那其实让人很放心。我可不想花了那么多时间做展示，结果发现方向错了！那展示是什么时候？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I let groups choose from the list of time slots I have between November 1st and November 5th.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：我让各组从我列出的11月1日到5日之间的时间段中选择。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, how about the 3rd? I'll have to check with my group, of course, but maybe we could write a tentative time?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，3号怎么样？当然我得和组里确认，但也许我们可以先定个暂定时间？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, let me take a look. I'm actually booked completely through the 3rd and 4th now. How about sometime in the afternoon of the 5th?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：当然，让我看看。实际上3号和4号都已经排满了。5号下午某个时间怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! How about 2 o'clock?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：太好了！下午两点怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. I'll pencil your group in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：没问题。我会把你们组先记下来。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, thanks. And to clarify, what exactly is due in the first phase?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，谢谢。那么明确一下，第一阶段具体要交什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Before the October deadline, I want your group to have compiled resources and then to provide some initial data analysis to support your claims.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：在10月截止日期之前，我希望你们组已经整理好资料，然后提供一些初步数据分析来支持你们的论点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, so data analysis is due the 10th of October, and then the um, the -
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，所以数据分析是10月10日交，然后嗯——

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: - Presentation? Yes. The final phase is simply giving the presentation on the 5th of November.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：——展示？是的。最后阶段就是在11月5日做展示。

transcriptSentences.speaker: STUDENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright, I think I have all the information I need. Thanks!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，我想我需要的都有了。谢谢！

transcriptSentences.speaker: PROFESSOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: You're welcome. See you in class tomorrow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 教授：不客气。明天课上见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Today I'd like to tell you about how U.K. architects are playing their part to address the issue of global warming. You have seen many of these iconic buildings while going about your everyday life, but you may not know how they are affecting your tomorrow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天我想谈谈英国建筑师如何为解决全球变暖问题尽一份力。你们在日常生活中见过许多这样的标志性建筑，但你们可能不知道它们如何影响着你们的明天。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 2003, construction was completed on the famous Swiss Re Building, or more informally called the Gherkin, a true masterpiece commissioned by the law offices of Foster and Partners.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：2003年，著名的瑞士再保险大楼——更通俗的叫法是“小黄瓜”——完工了，这是福斯特建筑事务所受委托设计的真正杰作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This is not the first ambitious endeavor of the firm - they are renowned for their various philanthropic, environmental efforts. The Gherkin, with its cutting edge green initiative and sharp design, is gaining recognition as an icon in modern architecture. You can pick it out of the London skyline by its unorthodox cigar shape.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这不是该事务所第一次雄心勃勃的尝试——他们以各种慈善和环保努力而闻名。“小黄瓜”凭借其前沿的绿色倡议和犀利的设计，正逐渐被认可为现代建筑的标志。你可以通过它非传统的雪茄形状在伦敦天际线中认出它。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: While its appearance is the obvious attribute at which to marvel, there is far more to this building than meets the eye. And let's face it - there's a lot about this building that meets the eye. The building helps reduce the city's carbon footprint in a number of ways.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：虽然它的外观是令人惊叹的显著特征，但这栋建筑远不止表面所见。而且说实话——这栋建筑外表上就有很多可看的。这栋建筑通过多种方式帮助减少城市的碳足迹。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Just a quick note - in case you're not familiar with the term 'carbon footprint,' get used to it! It's a buzzword you'll hear relentlessly to talk about reducing emissions. Think of it as the amount of harmful greenhouse gases that are given off into the environment by a single person, organisation, or product.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：简单说一句——如果你们对“碳足迹”这个术语不熟悉，得习惯它！这是一个你会不断听到的热词，用来谈论减少排放。你可以把它理解为一个人、组织或产品向环境中排放的有害温室气体的量。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So going back to the Gherkin Building - perhaps the most obvious as well as the most significant eco-friendly feature is the glass windows, which allow light to pass through the building, both reducing heating costs and brightening up the workspace.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：回到“小黄瓜”大楼——也许最明显也最重要的环保特色是玻璃窗，它们让光线穿过建筑，既降低了供暖成本，又使工作空间更加明亮。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The ingenuity behind the various eco-friendly aspects of the Gherkin has seen its fair share of publicity both from serious and silly sources. In a recent April Fool's Day edition, one e-publication printed a story detailing plans to replace 50% of the current exterior with grass, which would not only make large steps in the name of sustainability, but also give the building the green hue that would truly earn it the nickname of the Gherkin. The only drawback is, as you may have guessed, that this story was an April Fool's Day joke and completely made up.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：小黄瓜各种环保设计背后的巧妙构思，从严肃和搞笑的渠道都得到了不少宣传。在最近一期愚人节特刊中，一家电子刊物刊登了一个故事，详细描述了用草皮替换目前50%外墙的计划，这不仅会在可持续发展方面迈出一大步，还会给建筑增添绿色色调，让它真正配得上“小黄瓜”的绰号。唯一的缺点，正如你们可能猜到的，这个故事是愚人节玩笑，完全是编造的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In all seriousness though, the building is setting a new standard of design that other architects and city planners just cannot ignore. The building's bold and cost-efficient design has won a number of architecture awards, including the Stirling Prize, the London Region Award, and the Emporis Skyscraper Award among others. The design comfortably accommodates a large number of offices while keeping maintenance and operation costs down, striking a superb balance between nature and the workplace.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：不过，严肃地说，这栋建筑正在树立一个其他建筑师和城市规划者无法忽视的新设计标准。这栋建筑大胆且成本效益高的设计赢得了许多建筑奖项，包括斯特林奖、伦敦地区奖和安波利斯摩天大楼奖等。该设计舒适地容纳了大量办公室，同时保持了较低的维护和运营成本，在自然和工作场所之间取得了极佳的平衡。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Nature is well and good, as long as the weather is nice outside. Given London's notoriously bad weather, the architects knew they must devise a quality temperature regulation system, and that they did. A special system designed to reduce the building's reliance on air-conditioning was devised that cuts consumption in half compared to standard office buildings. There are atria that link each floor vertically to one another, forming spiraling spaces up the entire building. They serve not just as social common spaces but also act as the building's lungs, distributing clean air from the opening panels in the facade through the entire building.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：只要室外天气好，自然是好事。考虑到伦敦出了名的糟糕天气，建筑师们知道他们必须设计出一套优质的温控系统，他们确实做到了。一套旨在减少建筑对空调依赖的特殊系统被设计出来，与标准办公楼相比，能耗减少了一半。有中庭将各层垂直连接起来，形成贯穿整栋建筑的螺旋空间。它们不仅是社交公共空间，还充当建筑的“肺”，将来自外立面开口面板的新鲜空气分配到整栋建筑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The building isn't all business though - it has its fair share of fun as well. At the very top, a clubroom offers a picturesque entertainment spot for company functions, private parties, etc., with a breathtaking panoramic view of the city.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这栋建筑也不全是商务用途——它也有不少娱乐功能。在最顶层，有一个俱乐部房间，为公司活动、私人派对等提供风景如画的娱乐场所，拥有令人叹为观止的城市全景视野。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The creation of such an innovative structure has many wondering what the future of urban planning and architecture may be. Well, if the other projects currently commissioned by Foster and Partners are any indication, the entire city constructed with similarly eco-friendly buildings is not far in the distance. The Masdar City development aims to create a desert city that produces zero waste and removes as much carbon dioxide from the atmosphere as it puts in - a huge feat in protecting our earth.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如此创新的建筑让许多人思考城市规划和建筑的未来会是什么样。如果说福斯特建筑事务所目前受托的其他项目有任何预示的话，那么整座城市由类似环保建筑构成的那一天并不遥远。马斯达尔城项目旨在建造一座零废弃的沙漠城市，从大气中消除的二氧化碳量与其排放量相当——这是保护地球的一大壮举。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The Gherkin is a truly impressive feat, yet it is not the only one worth noting. Now to move on to another green initiative, I'll tell you about the Eden Foundation Building, found in Cornwall...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：小黄瓜确实是一项令人印象深刻的成就，但它并不是唯一值得注意的。现在转到另一个绿色倡议，我将告诉你们位于康沃尔的伊甸基金会大楼……

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：你好？

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I'd like to speak with Janet Evans, please.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：是的，我想找珍妮特·埃文斯。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Speaking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：我就是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Ms. Evans, this is Jim Rodriguez calling from Farrelly Mutual about your recent homeowner's insurance inquiry.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：埃文斯女士您好，我是法雷利互助保险公司的吉姆·罗德里格斯，关于您最近的家庭保险咨询。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, hi. Thanks for returning my call.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：是的，你好。谢谢你回我电话。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: My pleasure. I understand you are potentially interested in insurance for a bungalow located a bit out of town. Could you give me the address?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我的荣幸。我了解到您可能对位于城外的一栋平房有兴趣投保。能给我地址吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, it's 49 Greenway Court. Greenway is one word.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：当然，是格林威苑49号。格林威是一个词。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you. Alright, and would you prefer to be contacted via email or phone?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：谢谢。好的，您更倾向于通过电子邮件还是电话联系？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Either one is fine - maybe try emailing me first and as an alternative I can give you my phone number.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：都可以——也许先发邮件给我，作为备选我可以给你我的电话号码。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great - and what is your email address?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的——您的邮箱地址是？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: pk2@cat.com.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：pk2@cat.com。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, did you say "cat," as in the animal?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：嗯，您说的是“cat”，就是那个动物吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. It is the acronym for the construction company I work for - I'm sure you've seen them around.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：是的。这是我工作的建筑公司的缩写——我相信您见过他们。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I have. And could you give me your primary phone number, and the best time to reach you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：是的，我见过。能给我您的主要电话号码，以及联系您的最佳时间吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure - the number is (020) 4251-9443. I am generally unable to answer my phone at work, but anytime after 5.30 p.m. is fine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：当然——号码是(020) 4251-9443。我上班时通常不能接电话，但下午5:30以后的任何时间都可以。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: I will make a note of that here. Now I'm going to ask you a little bit about the property itself so we can make an accurate estimate of the cost of insuring your home. Could you tell me the size of your house?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我记下来。现在我想问一些关于房产本身的情况，以便准确估算您房屋的保险费用。能告诉我您房子的面积吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Um, well, I don't have the exact measurements, but I'm pretty sure it's right around 80 square metres. Should I measure it and call you back later?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：嗯，我没有确切的尺寸，但我相当确定大约是80平方米。需要我量一下再打给您吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, that's completely alright. I'll write 80 square metres for now to get the estimate and then an agent will come get the exact measurements later on if you decide to purchase our insurance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：不用，完全没关系。我先写80平方米来做估算，如果您决定购买我们的保险，之后会有代理人来测量精确尺寸。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, great.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：好的，太好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: And what material is your house made of? For example, wood, brick, stucco...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：您的房子是什么材料建的？比如，木材、砖、灰泥……

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's mainly brick.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：主要是砖。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great - that will give you a lower rate than most other materials since it is so strong.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：太好了——因为砖很坚固，所以费率会比大多数其他材料低。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wonderful!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：太好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: And do you have any sort of home security, Ms. Evans?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：您有安装任何家庭安全设施吗，埃文斯女士？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Um, we don't have a fence or anything yet, but we have an alarm system that we use regularly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：嗯，我们还没有围栏之类的，但我们有一个经常使用的报警系统。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now I'll go through a number of things we offer coverage for, and I'd like you to tell me which items you want your policy to cover.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：现在我会过一遍我们提供保障的一系列项目，您告诉我希望保单覆盖哪些。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: We'll start with the building itself first - would you like us to cover incidental damage to the structure to your house?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：我们先从建筑本身开始——您希望我们承保房屋结构的意外损坏吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Absolutely.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：当然。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Splendid. And the contents inside your house - we usually cover all items with an appraised value above £200. Would you like us to cover theft and damage beyond natural wear-and-tear? I will let you know that the second option here will come with a considerable increase in your rates.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：很好。还有您房屋内的物品——我们通常承保评估价值超过200英镑的所有物品。您希望我们承保盗窃和自然磨损之外的损坏吗？要提醒您，第二个选项会使您的保费大幅增加。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think I'd just like the contents of the house to be covered against theft then.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：我想我只想保房屋内的物品盗窃险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright - and would you like any other insurance - fire, flood, etc?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的——您还需要其他保险吗——火灾、水灾等？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes - I definitely want flood coverage. It rains a lot here, and the drainage system in the area is not the greatest.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：是的——我一定要水灾险。这里雨水很多，而且该地区的排水系统不是很好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. I am calculating your quotation now. It will just take a second. (Two seconds pause) It looks like your annual insurance rate will be €148.30.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：好的。我现在在计算您的报价。只需要一下就好。（两秒停顿）您的年度保险费看起来是148.30欧元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks, that seems somewhat reasonable. I would like to take some time to think about it. How long does it take to begin receiving coverage after signing up?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：谢谢，看起来还算合理。我想花点时间考虑一下。签约后多久开始生效？

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: It depends on the time of year - it can take anywhere from two to six weeks. I would say if you sign up by July 1st, you could start your coverage by August 1st.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：这取决于一年中的什么时候——可能需要两到六周。如果您在7月1日前签约，我想您可以在8月1日开始生效。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. Okay, thanks for your help. Should I call you back at this number when I have made my decision?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：我明白了。好的，谢谢你的帮助。我做决定后打这个电话找你吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, please. And so that we can look up your account faster, I'll give you a reference number that you should provide when calling. Ready?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：是的，请。为了我们能更快查到您的账户，我会给您一个参考编号，您打电话时请提供。准备好了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yep!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's TR278Q.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：是TR278Q。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JANET
transcriptSentences.englishText: Got it. Thanks!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 珍妮特：记下了。谢谢！

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you, and have a nice day!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 代理人：谢谢您，祝您有愉快的一天！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hey if you're just joining us on WKPX "The Sound", welcome. We're here in the studio with Matt and Cam in the morning, and this morning we're talking about keeping the kids occupied on summer vacation. Folks, there's a new kid in town in the world of summer fun. Get ready for the Pool for the People, a pool and outdoor venue created by - that's right - the people.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：嘿，如果你刚刚收听WKPX“声音”电台，欢迎你。我们早上在直播室和马特和卡姆一起，今天早上我们要聊的是暑假如何让孩子们有事做。各位，暑期娱乐界来了个新玩家。准备好迎接“人民泳池”吧，一个由——没错——由人民创建的泳池和户外场所。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Scheduled to open in November, the ideas for everything from the design of the pool right down to the items sold in the snack bar have been decided upon by a sample of 1,050 members of the public.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：计划于11月开放，从泳池设计一直到小吃店出售的物品种类，所有想法都由1,050名公众成员样本决定。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The public selected two top proposals from over a dozen created by renowned architect Ned Mosby, and the final design is truly something else. The pool is shaped like a fishbowl, sinking down into the ground, and there's - you guessed it - a real, live fish tank in the centre! It's certainly the centre of attention in the Bridgewater area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：公众从著名建筑师内德·莫斯比设计的十几个方案中选出了两个最佳提案，最终设计确实与众不同。泳池形状像一个鱼缸，沉入地下，而且——你猜对了——中心有一个真正的活鱼缸！它无疑是布里奇沃特地区的焦点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, you are probably wondering how much an extravagance like this must cost right? Well, have no fear. At just £15 for adults and £10 for kids, it's an affordable way to entertain the kids in those dog days of summer. The only problem now is the possibility that it will in fact become too popular! The pool is only so large, so swarms of people coming to enjoy it may cause quite a crowd in its first summer of opening.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在，你可能在想这样的奢华设施要花多少钱吧？放心。成人票仅15英镑，儿童票10英镑，这是在酷暑天让孩子娱乐的实惠方式。唯一的问题是它可能太受欢迎了！泳池就这么大，蜂拥而来的人群在开放的第一个夏天可能会造成拥挤。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There will be an opening party for a select audience, and in line with the pool's mission, the people have decided on all the arrangements. They collectively decided on actress Rebel Wilson to host the festivities scheduled for later this month, and even dictated the playlist by ranking their top 10 songs from a list of hundreds.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：将有一个针对特定观众的开幕派对，秉承泳池的使命，公众决定了所有安排。他们共同决定由女演员瑞贝尔·威尔森主持定于本月晚些时候的庆典活动，甚至通过从数百首歌曲中选出他们最爱的10首来指定了播放列表。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is some discrepancy, however, on the sculpture design for the foyer at the entrance. The people elected a jellyfish sculpture to greet entering visitors, but given last week's vicious attack by a box jellyfish on a local youth, coordinators fear it will bring too much fear to patrons.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，在入口大厅的雕塑设计上存在一些分歧。公众选了一个水母雕塑来迎接来访者，但考虑到上周箱水母对当地一名青年的恶性攻击事件，协调员担心这会给顾客带来太多恐惧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The theme of the clubhouse is set to be "international waters" with a different...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：俱乐部的主题定为“国际水域”，有不同的……

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Before we start, Jimmy and Kathy, thanks for coming in today to talk about your current research paper! Well, I will also give you some suggestions for your future presentation later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：在开始之前，吉米和凯西，感谢你们今天来谈谈你们目前的研究论文！嗯，之后我也会给你们将来做展示提些建议。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：太好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, I have read the introductory chapter, and so far I like where you're going with your research, you two.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，我读了引言章节，到目前为止我喜欢你们的研究方向。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks! What did you think of the procedure section?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：谢谢！你觉得方法部分怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I haven't gotten there yet. I will get to that and the results and discussion section in a bit.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我还没看到那里。我一会儿会看方法、结果和讨论部分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh. If you haven't read the rest, are you just saying you like the introduction?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：哦。你还没看剩下的部分，你只是说你喜欢引言吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: No - the layout is really well done. You have each section clearly marked and have the header and footer perfectly formatted, and your title page is right on the money. A lot of students have trouble with that one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不——版面设计得很好。每个部分都清晰标明了，页眉页脚格式完美，标题页也做得很到位。很多学生在这方面有困难。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: To be honest, we did refer a lot to the example we received in class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：说实话，我们确实参考了很多课堂上发的范例。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good to do for spacing and layout, as long as you're not also copying the information. The background information is a little sparse, though. You may want to add to it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：在间距和版面方面参考范例是好的，只要不抄袭内容就行。不过背景信息有点单薄。你们可能想补充一下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: You think so? I was more worried about whether I had enough data.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：你觉得会吗？我更担心的是数据够不够。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: You definitely need more background information. I would think about finding some more online articles or doing more research in the campus library.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你们肯定需要更多背景信息。可以考虑找更多的在线文章，或者在校园图书馆做更多研究。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a good idea - we can go tomorrow. I find it too tough finding the subject matter in the online journal database.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：好主意——我们明天可以去。我觉得在在线期刊数据库里找主题内容太难了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: I also like being able to flip through the physical journal as opposed to trying to scroll down on a computer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我也喜欢翻阅实体期刊，而不是在电脑上滚动浏览。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Me too. Oh, I almost forgot. I've included all of my citations in the abstract, but could you help me with the bibliography? I should be using a bibliography, right? Not an appendix?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：我也是。哦，我差点忘了。我把所有引用都放在了摘要里，但你能帮我看看参考书目吗？我应该用参考书目，对吧？不是附录？

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, I can help with that. Yes - for this type of scientific research paper, list all sources that you cite in the body of your paper in a bibliography. Go to the website I gave you last time to see the exact way to list each source.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然，我可以帮忙。是的——对于这种类型的科学研究论文，把所有在论文正文中引用的来源列在参考书目里。去我上次给你的网站看看每种来源的准确列出方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, thanks. I'll do that. We still have a lot of things to fix up.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：好的，谢谢。我去做。我们还有很多东西要修改。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, but there's a lot of good stuff here to work with. So enough about the paper, how is the presentation going?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是啊，但这里有很多好东西可以用。论文就谈到这，展示准备得怎么样了？

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it's alright. I am going to go try out the new presentation software while Jimmy's working on the bibliography.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：嗯，还不错。我打算去试试新的演示软件，吉米则负责参考书目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, we are hoping to make an animation of an actual pump but still have a lot to learn about how to do that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：是的，我们希望制作一个实际泵的动画，但在如何做到这一点上还有很多要学。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Who would have thought before we started this project that we would be able to recreate the motion of a pump? This stuff is just so interesting.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：在我们开始这个项目之前，谁会想到我们能够重现泵的运动呢？这真是太有趣了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: So glad to hear it!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：很高兴听到你们这么说！

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, I am glad I took engineering this semester. I would definitely like to keep up with it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：是的，我很高兴这学期选了工程学。我肯定会继续学下去。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: You know, there's an organisation called the Machine Engineer Society. You should look into joining it. You would need to score well in your engineering class to qualify, but I think you can do it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你们知道，有一个叫机械工程师协会的组织。你们可以考虑加入。需要在工程课上取得好成绩才有资格，但我相信你们能做到。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, interesting. I will definitely check it out. I would really like to get in contact with some professionals in the engineering field to find out more. I don't really know anyone in the field now, though.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：嗯，有意思。我一定会去看看。我真的很想和工程领域的一些专业人士联系以了解更多。不过我现在在这个领域不认识什么人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think if you keep meeting people in your classes and professors you'll be able to get in contact with some really helpful people.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：我想如果你继续在课堂上认识人，还有教授们，你就能联系到一些真正有帮助的人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well said, Jimmy. If engineering pumps is something you both are specifically interested in, make sure you stay up to date on new developments. In fact, you could visit the local water treatment facility periodically to see what new developments are going on.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：说得好，吉米。如果泵工程是你们俩都特别感兴趣的，一定要跟上新的发展动态。事实上，你们可以定期参观当地的水处理设施，看看有什么新发展。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hm, that may be a good way to get some practical experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：嗯，那可能是获得一些实践经验的好方法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I don't think they would let you handle any equipment by just visiting the facility. If you really want to get your hands dirty, so to speak, I would recommend instead seeking a summer internship.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，我觉得他们不会因为你们参观就允许你们操作设备。如果你们真想亲自动手——这么说吧——我建议你们找暑期实习。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, you have so many helpful suggestions for getting a leg up. Now if only you could tell me how to get my work published!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：哇，你给了这么多有用的建议来帮助我进步。现在要是你能告诉我怎么发表我的作品就好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: JIMMY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Haha, wouldn't that be nice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉米：哈哈，那岂不是很好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: TUTOR
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, honestly, all you really need to do is once you have a dissertation, present it. Present it often and to many audiences, and once you get feedback, adjust it. You'll get published one day.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，说实话，你们真正要做的是一旦有了论文，就去展示。经常向不同的听众展示，一旦得到反馈，就进行调整。总有一天你们会发表的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: KATHY
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, this meeting has been truly inspiring. Thanks for your help!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯西：哇，这次谈话真的很有启发。谢谢你的帮助！
