transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi there, welcome to the Job Centre. How can I help?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：你好，欢迎来到就业中心。我能帮什么忙？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning, I'm here to enquire as to whether you have any jobs available at the moment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：早上好，我来是想问一下你们目前有职位空缺吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, we have several available. What kind of job is it that you're looking for?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：有的，我们有几个空缺。你在找什么样的工作？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, um, I'll take any part-time jobs I can get. I'm really strapped for cash at the moment.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：嗯，呃，只要是兼职我都可以。我现在真的很缺钱。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, bear with me while I have a browse on our system. [Pause] Here we are. We have three vacancies at the moment, all involving quite different roles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：好的，稍等，我在系统里看一下。【停顿】有了。我们目前有三个空缺，职位都相当不同。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds promising. What are they?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：听起来很有希望。是什么职位？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first one is for a post as a receptionist. It says here that experience in reception or general administration is preferred, but not essential. Have you worked on a reception desk previously?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：第一个是前台接待员的职位。上面说最好有前台或一般行政经验，但不是必须的。你以前做过前台吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, I haven't. I had a baby quite young, and so I have very little work experience. Could you tell me a few more details?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：不，没有。我很年轻的时候就生了孩子，所以工作经验很少。你能告诉我更多细节吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, of course. The job will be to mainly provide quality customer service both over the phone and in person. When customers are waiting you will be expected to provide them with refreshments and ensure they have a first-rate experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：当然。这份工作主要是通过电话和当面提供优质的客户服务。当客户等候时，你需要为他们提供茶点，确保他们有最好的体验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think I could manage that, and I'm a very friendly person!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：我觉得我能做到，而且我是个非常友好的人！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：太好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you have any information about the hours involved?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：关于工作时间有什么信息吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: It says here that you will be expected to work several early mornings, 4 days a week.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：上面说你需要上几个早班，每周4天。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Any other requirements?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：还有其他要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, you'll have to go through a couple of weeks of unpaid training before qualifying for the post.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：是的，你需要经过几周的无薪培训才能正式上岗。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hmm, I don't know if I would be able to fully commit to that. Did you say it's 4 days per week?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：嗯，我不知道我能不能完全做到。你说的是每周4天？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, it says here 4 days a week, with another day off per week when requested in advance. It also explicitly states that at least one of your working days must fall on a weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：是的，上面说是每周4天，提前申请的话每周可以多休一天。还明确规定至少有一个工作日必须在周末。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll have to think about that and talk to my babysitter.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：我得考虑一下，和我的保姆谈谈。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Are there any other roles beginning later in the day?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：还有其他时间开始晚一点的职位吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, there's an advertisement here for a driver. It says you'll need a clean and valid UK driver's license, with absolutely no exception.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：是的，这里有一个司机的招聘广告。上面说你必须有干净有效的英国驾照，绝对没有例外。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problems there. I passed my test first time and have never received any points.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：那个没问题。我一次就通过了考试，而且从来没被扣过分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: It also explicitly states that you must be over twenty-five and have been driving for at least six years.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：还明确规定你必须年满25岁，并且有至少六年的驾龄。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds quite exciting. Is there any more information?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：听起来挺有意思的。还有更多信息吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yep, it says here that working hours are flexible, and the employers are happy to work within your personal schedule since they employ multiple drivers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：是的，上面说工作时间灵活，雇主很乐意根据你的个人时间来安排，因为他们雇了多个司机。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：太好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: The employers ask for a commitment to either mornings 5 days per week, evenings 5 days per week, or three full working days per week.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：雇主要求承诺每周5个上午、或每周5个晚上、或每周3个全天。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm sure I can handle all that without a problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：我相信我处理好这些没有问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: As well as driving the employers to and from work, they will ask you to perform various duties on their behalf, such as collecting the grocery shopping, and picking their children up from school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：除了接送雇主上下班外，他们还会要求你代表他们执行各种任务，比如取杂货、接孩子放学。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do they need me to work a day on the weekend as well?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：他们也需要我周末工作吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, it says here that they only require you to work on weekdays, not weekends.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：不，上面说只需要你工作日上班，不需要周末。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds interesting.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：听起来不错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, there's only one more left, another customer service-related post. It looks like it requires you to work short hours, quite late at night, so it might not be suitable for you. Do you want to hear about it anyway?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：好的，只剩最后一个了，另一个与客服相关的职位。看起来工作时间短，但挺晚的，可能不适合你。你想听听吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, can't do any harm.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：好的，听听也无妨。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, so it's a post for a cashier in a cinema in the centre of town. I'm sure you've been to the cinema a few times, so you can guess what kind of role it would be. They're quite short and late shifts, between 17.30 and 22.30 most nights, with slightly longer shifts on Friday and Saturday nights.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：好的，是市中心一家电影院的收银员职位。我相信你去过电影院几次，所以你能猜到是什么角色。工作时间短且晚，大多数晚上在17：30到22：30之间，周五和周六晚上稍长一些。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Mmm, can you tell me what the job involves?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：嗯，你能告诉我这份工作具体做什么吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, sure. It says that you'll be required to sell and dispense tickets, and provide refreshments. Also, they ask that you be quick on the computers since you'll also need to take bookings over the phone, but you'll receive basic training for that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：当然可以。上面说你需要售票、出票，并提供茶点。另外，他们要求你电脑操作熟练，因为你还需要通过电话接受预订，但你会接受基本的培训。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do they need me to work weekdays as well?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：他们也需要我工作日上班吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Manager
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it says here that if you request at least a fortnight in advance, they will grant you a day off on Mondays, but never on a weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 经理：嗯，上面说如果你至少提前两周申请，他们可以让你周一休息，但周末绝对不行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Lauren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Mmm. I'll think it over and let you know later. Thanks for all your help.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 劳伦：嗯。我会考虑一下，回头告诉你。谢谢你的帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you all for coming to my talk this evening. It's nice to see so many people in the audience. For those of you who don't know very much about 'Connection', let me start by giving you some background information about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：感谢大家今晚来听我的讲座。很高兴看到这么多人在观众席。对于那些对“Connection”不太了解的人，让我先给大家介绍一些背景信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: 'Connection' is a British organisation that facilitates homestays all over the globe. This organisation prides itself on matching tens of thousands of host families with guests every single year, allowing travellers to discover a country's culture in a way like no other. Homestays are ideal for both travellers and homeowners, enabling inter-cultural exchanges and the development of life-long friendships, while providing travellers with often discounted accommodation costs, and host families with a steady income from the comfort of their own homes. The homestay experience is particularly popular with university exchange students looking for a more genuine insight into their country of choice, and an unrivalled opportunity to develop their language skills. The homestay experience is truly unique and once-in-a-lifetime, and one that you will likely remember for the rest of your lives. It is important to note, however, that some people will find it difficult to adapt to the new country, with many enduring what is known as 'culture shock'. Connection's advice for those suffering from culture shock, is to go out and make as many friends as possible, no matter how difficult you may find it. Friends are guaranteed to help you feel more integrated as part of the local society, and show you some great places to hang out. At first, it might seem extremely challenging to overcome the language barrier between you and your host family; however, you will find that you quickly overcome this and develop a very close and almost familial relationship. Many of our travellers have suggested that they have found discussing their hobbies and other interests with their host families is the best way to overcome any barriers, since you are more than likely to find something you share in common. For example, you might find that you are both passionate about football, and end up playing in the local field every week. One of our guests undertaking a homestay in a rural area of the UK told us that she and her host now take a Tai Chi class together upon a hilltop at sunrise, calling the experience 'absolutely breathtaking'. After the first few weeks, you will find your understanding of the people around you and their culture deepens by leaps and bounds, and you will soon become one of the locals. Our hosts, in over 140 countries, turn a location into a culture, time into experience and strangers into friends.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：“Connection”是一个英国组织，促进全球范围内的寄宿家庭服务。该组织每年为数以万计的寄宿家庭与客人成功匹配而自豪，让旅行者以一种无与伦比的方式发现一个国家的文化。寄宿家庭对旅行者和房主来说都是理想的选择，促进了跨文化交流和终身友谊的发展，同时为旅行者提供通常有折扣的住宿费用，为寄宿家庭提供足不出户的稳定收入。寄宿体验在寻求更深入了解所选国家、获得发展语言技能的绝佳机会的大学交换生中尤其受欢迎。寄宿体验确实是独特且千载难逢的，很可能会成为你终身难忘的经历。不过，需要注意的是，有些人会发现难以适应新国家，许多人会经历所谓的“文化冲击”。Connection 给那些遭受文化冲击的人的建议是，无论你觉得多难，都要走出去结交尽可能多的朋友。朋友一定会帮助你更好地融入当地社会，并带你去一些很棒的地方。起初，克服你和寄宿家庭之间的语言障碍似乎极具挑战性；但你会发现很快就能克服，并建立起非常亲密、几乎像家人一样的关系。我们的许多旅行者表示，与寄宿家庭讨论他们的爱好和其他兴趣是克服任何障碍的最佳方式，因为你很可能会找到一些共同点。例如，你可能会发现你们都对足球充满热情，最终每周都会在当地的球场上踢球。我们的一位在英国乡村寄宿的客人告诉我们，她和她的寄宿家庭成员现在每天日出时一起在山顶上上太极课，称这一经历“绝对令人叹为观止”。几周之后，你会发现你对周围的人和他们的文化的理解突飞猛进，很快你就会成为当地人之一。我们在140多个国家的寄宿家庭，将一个地点变成一种文化，将时间变成经历，将陌生人变成朋友。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So how can you find out about applying for a homestay? The best way would be to visit Connection's website, www.connection.com, and contact one of their friendly advisors for more information. Once you have confirmed your interest in the service, we would strongly advise that you remain in close contact with the registration office, which will send you several emails keeping you up-to-date with potential matches in your country of choice. Once registered, Connection will require you to send various documents, and will act as an intermediary between you and the host family prior to final confirmation and payment. During this stage, Connection will ask you to provide two photos, one for the host family, and the other for our own records. Please ensure that you sign the back of each photo. Due to the nature of the service Connection provides, security is an absolute must, and they will ask you to send in photocopies of your passport, birth certificate, and a bank statement as confirmation of your identity. On receipt of these documents, the official process will begin and your bank account will be debited for the initial deposit of £200. If you haven't received any acknowledgement confirming receipt of these documents from us within seven working days, please contact the main office. As I mentioned before, due to the nature of the organisation, Connection operates a meticulous screening process, and all applicants will undergo an interview in our head office in London, with exceptions made in extreme circumstances. After your interview, it may take us several weeks to carry out the decision process, so please be patient with us. If you would like a fast-track service, please indicate this on your application and we will notify you of the additional charges. Finally, once we have come to a result about your application, you will receive a decision in the post. If you do not receive an offer of placement, we will refund your deposit within 7 working days.

transcriptSentences.speaker: Professor

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everyone! Today I'm going to talk about the graphical symbol. A graphic symbol is a written symbol that is used to represent speech, such as those used in the Greek alphabet. The term 'graphic symbol' encompasses anything from the logographs used in Egyptian hieroglyphic writing, to ancient Chinese pictograms. Early symbols were based on pictographs and ideograms before they were developed into logographic writing systems. These systems are still in use in some non-literate cultures in Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. Indeed, elements of pictography are still found in modern Chinese characters, and it is often an interesting exercise to trace the origins of some Chinese characters. Pictographs remain in common commercial use today as signs, instructions, or statistical diagrams. Road signs and public toilet signs, and even flat-pack assembly instructions utilising pictures are considered pictographic.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好！今天我要讲的是图形符号。图形符号是用于代表语言的书写符号，例如希腊字母中使用的那些。“图形符号”一词涵盖从埃及象形文字中使用的语标到中国古代的象形文字。早期的符号建立在图画文字和表意文字的基础上，之后发展为语标文字系统。这些系统在非洲、美洲和大洋洲的一些无文字文化中仍在使用。事实上，现代汉字中仍然有象形文字的元素，追溯某些汉字的起源通常是一项有趣的练习。图画文字今天在商业中仍然普遍用作标志、说明或统计图表。路标和公共厕所标志，甚至使用图片的平板包装组装说明，都被认为是图画文字。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ancient graphic writing systems provide researchers with a wealth of knowledge about past civilisations. In 1799, one of the most important historical discoveries was made by accident when members of Napoleon's expedition to Egypt found a stone in Rosetta that exhibited three different scripts. The stone, now known as the Rosetta Stone, was studied in significant depth by scholars, and was first deciphered by Frenchman Jean-Francois Champollion in 1822. He was able to correctly determine the phonetic values of the symbols, and later research has confirmed his findings. In many of these symbols, lines are used to portray a multitude of meanings, and knowledge and understanding of these lines holds the key to comprehension of graphic writing systems.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：古代图形书写系统为研究者提供了关于过去文明的丰富知识。1799年，拿破仑远征埃及的成员在罗塞塔偶然发现了一块刻有三种不同文字的石头，这是历史上最重要的发现之一。这块现在被称为罗塞塔石碑的石头，经过学者们深入研究，于1822年由法国人让-弗朗索瓦·商博良首次破译。他能够正确确定符号的语音值，后来的研究证实了他的发现。在许多这些符号中，线条被用来表达多种含义，对这些线条的知识和理解是理解图形书写系统的关键。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A key moment in the history of communication was the invention of the camera obscura, or camera. Although the concept can be traced back to the fifth century B.C. Chinese philosopher Mo Ti, the first photographic image was ultimately created in 1826 by Joseph Nicéphore Niépce. Photography, as it was later known, enables researchers to piece together and better understand history. Today, photography forms a huge part of everyday life and most publications contain a vast number of photographs. Photography is used in advertising, and is now becoming a way to increase awareness of existing world issues. For example, animal welfare charities are increasingly using photography to advertise animals that are at high risk of endangerment. Charity workers are sometimes flown to far-flung locations to document the suffering endured by high-risk animals in an attempt to raise human awareness of their consumption activities, and how they impact others. One recent high profile campaign was undertaken by attaching a camera to the foot of a bird, in order to obtain photographs of the animals in their natural habitats, and understand how often they come into contact with human waste. A soon-to-be-released documentary about the suffering of animals on Midway Island shows the full extent to which human consumption is harming animals thousands of miles away from us.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：传播史上的一个关键时刻是暗箱——即相机的发明。虽然这一概念可以追溯到公元前五世纪的中国哲学家墨子，但第一张照片最终于1826年由约瑟夫·尼塞福尔·尼埃普斯拍摄。后来被称为摄影的技术，使研究者能够拼凑并更好地理解历史。如今，摄影构成了日常生活的很大一部分，大多数出版物都包含大量照片。摄影被用于广告，现在正成为一种提高人们对现有世界问题认识的方式。例如，动物福利慈善机构越来越多地使用摄影来宣传濒危风险高的动物。慈善工作者有时被派往遥远的地方，记录高风险动物所遭受的痛苦，试图提高人们对自身消费活动及其对他人影响的认识。最近一项备受瞩目的活动是将相机绑在鸟的脚上，以获取动物在其自然栖息地的照片，并了解它们与人类废物接触的频率。一部即将上映的关于中途岛动物苦难的纪录片，展示了人类消费对千里之外的动物造成伤害的全部程度。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As photography continues to progress, with the use of drones now becoming somewhat commonplace, we should expect more and more objects to be included in the future, expanding the horizon of photography ever further. Indeed, the downward pressure on traditional media prices means that media companies are being forced to get creative on how to make a profit. Many have found that the answer to this lies in advertising, and companies are now willing to devote a large portion of their budgets to advertising in newspapers. By the same token, marketing has become an essential part of a company's business model, often meaning the success or failure of a company. As a result, much time and money has been pumped into the development of effective branding, with attractive packaging playing a large role in this. However, many governments are now seen to be cracking down on marketing and packaging in an attempt to protect consumers from being misled. In particular, tobacco companies are now subject to ever increasing regulation. For example, in the United Kingdom, legislation is soon to pass preventing any form of branding or differentiation on cigarette packaging in efforts to curb the harmful effects of smoking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：随着摄影的不断进步，无人机的使用如今已变得相对普遍，我们应该期待未来会有越来越多的物体被纳入，进一步拓展摄影的视野。确实，传统媒体价格的下行压力意味着媒体公司被迫在如何盈利方面发挥创意。许多公司发现答案在于广告，现在公司愿意将预算的很大一部分投入报纸广告。同理，营销已成为公司商业模式的重要组成部分，往往决定了公司的成败。因此，大量时间和金钱被投入到有效品牌的发展中，有吸引力的包装在其中扮演了重要角色。然而，许多政府现在正在打击营销和包装，以保护消费者不被误导。特别是烟草公司正受到日益严格的监管。例如，在英国，即将通过立法禁止香烟包装上的任何品牌标识或差异化，以遏制吸烟的有害影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Finally, one must not forget the fundamental role that graphic writing systems have had to play in mathematics. Graphs, icons, and diagrams often form the very basis of these branches of academia. Indeed, one needs to look no further than chemistry's periodic table to see a perfect example of graphic writing systems in use today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，我们不能忘记图形书写系统在数学中发挥的基本作用。图表、图标和示意图往往构成了这些学术分支的基础。事实上，只需看看化学的元素周期表，就能看到当今图形书写系统使用的完美例子。

transcriptSentences.speaker: PRESENTER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning, listeners! And welcome back to Star Radio! Today on the show we have a visitor from Yazoo Car Rental who is going to give us an insight into his company and into the public transport system! Welcome Jonathan!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主持人：听众朋友们早上好！欢迎回到星际电台！今天我们的节目来了一位来自亚祖租车公司的嘉宾，他将为我们介绍他的公司以及公共交通系统！欢迎乔纳森！

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you for having me. Yes, I would like to start by introducing my company Yazoo Car Rental. We are the cheapest and most reliable rental company in the city and have won multiple awards for the quality of our services. This success did not come easily, however, and it proved important that we stay fresh and are always thinking of ways to attract new customers. Our first attempt to do this was to offer a free gift with every car rental, which we were confident the customers would be very interested in. The offer of a free hoover with each rental, however, did not attract any new customers so we quite quickly stopped offering it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：谢谢邀请我。是的，我想先介绍一下我的公司亚祖租车。我们是本市最便宜、最可靠的租车公司，并因服务质量赢得了多个奖项。然而，这种成功来之不易，事实证明，保持新鲜感并不断思考吸引新客户的方法很重要。我们第一次尝试是在每次租车时赠送一份免费礼物，我们相信客户会对此非常感兴趣。然而，每次租车赠送一个免费吸尘器的优惠并没有吸引任何新客户，所以我们很快就停止了这一优惠。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 2002, a new taxi company opened next door to us and we started losing a lot of business to them, so we introduced an offer that we hoped might compete with their service. We offered a new package where you could rent a car with a driver for a small extra fee. By introducing this offer, we found that all of our customers preferred to drive the cars themselves, so again this offer was unsuccessful in attracting more customers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：2002年，一家新的出租车公司在隔壁开业，我们开始失去很多业务，所以我们推出了一项我们希望可以与他们的服务竞争的优惠。我们提供了一种新套餐，您只需支付少量额外费用即可租用带司机的汽车。通过推出这一优惠，我们发现所有客户都更喜欢自己开车，所以这一优惠再次未能成功吸引更多客户。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Learning from these mistakes, we decided to offer a package service where the customer no longer had to come to our offices to pick up the rental car. Instead we could drop off and pick up the car anywhere in the city to make the customer's experience a lot more stress free. This offer was very popular and increased our profits by 30%.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：从这些错误中吸取教训后，我们决定提供一种套餐服务，客户不再需要来我们的办公室取车。相反，我们可以在城市的任何地方送车和取车，让客户的体验更加轻松无压力。这一优惠非常受欢迎，使我们的利润增加了30%。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: In order to attract a younger demographic, we updated the models of cars that we offered for rental. We began offering more trendy cars such as minis and smart cars that we thought might appeal to the younger crowd and we also purchased them in more fun colours like reds and greens. This offer attracted some new customers of a younger age group, however not as many as we hoped.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：为了吸引更年轻的人群，我们更新了可供租赁的车型。我们开始提供更时尚的汽车，如迷你车和智能车，我们认为这可能会吸引年轻群体，我们还购买了更有趣的颜色，如红色和绿色。这一优惠吸引了一些年轻的新客户，但没有我们希望的那么多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next I decided to offer our services at a discounted price on our website where it could be seen by thousands of people. I thought that this could be a great way to attract a number of new customers who would never have heard of us before and it worked fantastically well. Following the success of the discount offer, we had so many customers that it became necessary to open a new branch of the company in the centre of the city. The cost of renting offices in the city centre was very high, so we hoped that our profits would justify this expensive decision. We made enough profit to keep our city centre offices open, but we had hoped for a greater increase in customer numbers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：接下来，我决定在网站上以折扣价提供服务，这样可以让数千人看到。我认为这可能是吸引许多以前从未听说过我们的新客户的好方法，而且效果非常好。折扣优惠成功后，我们的客户太多，以至于有必要在市中心开设一家新分公司。在市中心租用办公室的成本非常高，所以我们希望利润能证明这个昂贵的决定是合理的。我们赚了足够的利润来维持市中心办公室的运营，但我们原本希望客户数量有更大的增长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now for the second part of my talk, which is on the topic of public transport. There are many benefits to public transport, for example, the recent introduction of bus lanes has meant that buses are now unaffected by traffic jams and are able to stay on schedule. Unfortunately, as fewer and fewer people are taking the bus nowadays, the service has become quite inefficient. This reduction in passengers may be due to the stories in the newspaper about the dangers posed to pedestrian safety by the buses, however this is largely untrue as buses are responsible for far less pedestrian-related accidents than cars. I use the bus service often, as car petrol is so expensive nowadays that the bus is far more affordable. However, if I am in a rush I prefer to take a taxi as they tend to get you to your destination very quickly so you can remain punctual for your appointments. I also very much enjoy flying to my destinations, as the service is incredibly fast and the airports are always very easy to find. Personally, my favourite mode of transportation is the bus. Due to the lack of people using the service I have found that the buses are never overcrowded so there is always a seat available. They are also never dirty as they get cleaned regularly. However, I have found that sometimes the bus can be over a half hour behind schedule which can be very frustrating. There has been a lot of fluctuation in the price of bus tickets in the last couple of years. In the past, €1.80 for a ticket was enough to sustain the bus companies, however, as the price of fuel increased so did the ticket prices. Now the ticket prices are declining as the bus companies try to encourage more people to use their service again.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：现在是我演讲的第二部分，关于公共交通的话题。公共交通有很多好处，例如，最近引入的公交专用道意味着公交车现在不受交通堵塞的影响，能够准点运行。不幸的是，由于现在乘坐公交车的人越来越少，这项服务已经变得相当低效。乘客减少可能是由于报纸上关于公交车对行人安全构成威胁的报道，但这在很大程度上是不真实的，因为公交车造成的行人事故远少于汽车。我经常使用公交车服务，因为现在汽车汽油太贵了，公交车更实惠。不过，如果我赶时间，我更喜欢坐出租车，因为它们通常能很快把你送到目的地，这样你就能准时赴约。我也很喜欢坐飞机去目的地，因为服务非常快，而且机场总是很容易找到。就个人而言，我最喜欢的交通方式是公交车。由于使用该服务的人不多，我发现公交车从不拥挤，所以总是有座位。它们也从不脏，因为定期清洁。不过，我有时发现公交车可能会晚点超过半小时，这很令人沮丧。在过去几年里，公交车票价格波动很大。过去，1.80欧元的票价足以维持公交公司的运营，但随着燃料价格上涨，票价也上涨了。现在票价正在下降，因为公交公司试图鼓励更多人再次使用他们的服务。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONATHAN
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, that's all from me today. Thank you for listening.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 乔纳森：好了，这就是我今天要讲的全部内容。谢谢收听。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Excuse me, Dr Thompson. May I speak to you for a minute?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：打扰一下，汤普森博士。我能和您谈一会儿吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. Please come in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：当然，请进。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm Alexandra Jones. I'm studying Business here at the university and for my assignment I have to carry out a survey of people who own their own organisations. I heard that you are the founder of your own company, and I was wondering if I could ask you some questions about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：我是亚历山德拉·琼斯。我在这所大学学习商科，我的作业需要我对拥有自己企业的人进行一项调查。我听说您是自己公司的创始人，我想请问您能否回答我一些问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, of course, please fire away.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：是的，当然，请问吧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK great, we'll get started! Did you encounter any problems whilst you were starting your company?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：太好了，我们开始吧！您在创办公司时遇到过什么问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually it was not as hard as I anticipated. I started out with very clear objectives, so I knew exactly what I wanted my corporate identity to be. It was very difficult to find the correct premises as the property market in London is so competitive, but eventually I found the perfect site. The hardest part was structuring the business, as I had no formal template so I had to create it myself.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：实际上并不像我想象的那么困难。我一开始就有非常明确的目标，所以我很清楚我的企业形象想要什么。由于伦敦的房地产市场竞争激烈，找到合适的场地非常困难，但最终我找到了完美的地方。最难的部分是构建业务结构，因为我没有正式的模板，所以我不得不自己创建。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that is very impressive. Was it difficult dealing with staff?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：是的，非常了不起。与员工打交道困难吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's always tricky trying to satisfy a group of people with varying interests, however, I didn't encounter many problems. I found it very important to make the staff feel appreciated, so I hosted a staff day where we could all introduce ourselves and get to know each other as individuals. I was also able to talk to them about the type of work that they would be doing and gave them the opportunity to share with me the issues they had with the allocation of the work.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：试图满足一群兴趣各异的人总是很棘手，不过我并没有遇到太多问题。我发现让员工感到被重视非常重要，所以我举办了一个员工日，让大家互相介绍，作为独立的个体相互了解。我还能和他们谈谈他们将做的工作类型，并给了他们机会与我分享他们在工作分配方面的问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Did you hire a management team or did you take on the role of the manager?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：好的。您聘请了管理团队还是自己担任经理？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh no, I already had enough tasks to take care of. I employed someone else to take on the role of the manager, however, he never consulted me before making decisions so I was forced to let him go and hire someone else.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：哦不，我已经有足够多的任务要处理了。我雇了别人来担任经理，但他做决定之前从不咨询我，所以我不得不让他走人，另雇他人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: And what did the other staff think of the new manager?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：其他员工对新经理的看法如何？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: They had a great deal of respect for him. It definitely helped that I consulted with them before hiring him. They were surprised that he has been so successful in his role at the company, despite the longer meeting hours.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：他们对他非常尊重。我在雇佣他之前咨询了他们的意见，这肯定有帮助。他们惊讶于他在公司如此成功，尽管会议时间更长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Since the company opened, has it had any great achievements?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：公司开业以来，有什么大的成就吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: There are many aspects of the company that I am pleased with, however, there is one achievement of which I am particularly proud. I wanted a mural painted to brighten up our entrance area, so I decided it would be a great idea to invite the local primary school to create one for us. The youngsters had a great time and I know they were thrilled to be included.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：公司有很多方面我都满意，但有一个成就我特别自豪。我想画一幅壁画来美化我们的入口区域，所以我决定邀请当地小学来为我们创作一幅。孩子们玩得很开心，我知道他们很高兴能参与进来。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's lovely.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：哦，太好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you encountered any major problems since you opened the company?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：公司开业以来您遇到过什么重大问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, we are always encountering issues with employment because it is very hard to find people who are qualified for the roles that we were offering, but unfortunately there is no solution to this. One of our administrators also recently left to go on maternity leave, which put us in a tricky situation, however, we have managed to find a temporary replacement for her. It's also now approaching the period when we must carry out our financial training so I need to find a venue with enough space to hold everyone. It will be interesting trying to organise that event!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：是的，我们总是遇到雇佣问题，因为很难找到符合我们职位要求的人，不幸的是这个问题没有解决办法。我们的一位行政人员最近也休产假了，这让我们陷入了困境，不过我们设法找到了她的临时替代者。现在也快到我们必须进行财务培训的时期了，所以我需要找到一个有足够空间容纳所有人的场地。组织那个活动会很有意思！

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh gosh, I can imagine. I find it hard enough to organise myself!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：天哪，我能想象。我觉得组织好自己都够难的了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Organisation is a difficult thing to master, but it is also essential for success! Whilst I was learning how to stay organised, I realised that the role of motivation is essential.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：组织是一项很难掌握的技能，但对成功也至关重要！在学习如何保持组织性的过程中，我意识到激励的作用至关重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's great!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：好的，太好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: I also suggest that you visit the library, as there is a section on culture that will have some very valuable material on how to develop your organisation skills.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：我还建议你去图书馆，那里有一个关于文化的区域，会有一些非常有价值的材料，教你如何培养组织能力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, I'll head to the library when we're finished.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：好的，我们结束后我就去图书馆。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think you will find it very useful. They also have a collection of documentaries on the subject of personal organisation and I suggest that you look up the literature on management of change. I personally found these sources incredibly useful. Articles are also a valuable resource and we have a whole collection of them in our university library. I advise that you look at Section 2 where you will find articles on the nature of volunteering.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：我想你会发现它非常有用。他们还有关于个人组织主题的纪录片收藏，我建议你查阅关于变革管理的文献。我个人觉得这些来源非常有用。文章也是一种宝贵的资源，我们大学图书馆有整套收藏。我建议你看看第二部分，那里有关于志愿服务本质的文章。

transcriptSentences.speaker: ALEXANDRA
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great, thank you so much for your help.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 亚历山德拉：太好了，非常感谢您的帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：不客气。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome class to your very first lecture in this series on Architecture conducted by myself, Dr Torben Dahl. Today we will be looking into the relationship between climate and architecture, where I will be giving you a critical overview of the main climate influences that shape the design of buildings. Throughout this lecture series we will be looking at the latest research into climatic design carried out by experts in the field in addition to case studies and examples drawn from modernist practice both in cities and rural areas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎同学们来到我自己——托本·达尔博士——主持的建筑系列讲座的第一讲。今天我们将探讨气候与建筑之间的关系，我将对影响建筑设计的主要气候因素做一个批判性概述。在整个系列讲座中，我们将研究该领域专家在气候设计方面的最新研究，以及来自城市和乡村现代主义实践的案例研究和实例。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, acid rain is one of the climatic elements with the most devastating effects on our architecture. The chemicals in acid rain can cause paint to peel, corrosion of steel structures such as bridges, and erosion of stone statues. Since the 1970s, our government has been making great effort to reduce the release of these chemicals into the atmosphere with positive results. Private organisations have also been raising awareness and funds and recently received a huge donation from the bank. It is interesting to look at the studies that have been carried out into the effects of acid rain at varying altitudes. Research has shown that there are lower levels of acid in the damaging pollutants at higher altitudes, meaning that skyscrapers are much less vulnerable to the negative effects as they are exposed to acid rain with far lower levels of damaging pollutants.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：酸雨是对建筑影响最具破坏性的气候因素之一。酸雨中的化学物质会导致油漆剥落、钢结构的腐蚀（如桥梁）以及石像的侵蚀。自20世纪70年代以来，我们的政府一直在努力减少这些化学物质向大气的排放，并取得了积极成果。私人组织也一直在提高意识和筹集资金，最近还收到了一笔来自银行的大额捐款。研究酸雨在不同海拔高度的影响是很有趣的。研究表明，在高海拔地区，有害污染物中的酸含量较低，这意味着摩天大楼暴露在有害污染物水平低得多的酸雨中，因此其受负面影响的可能性要小得多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Recently, the Alter Project was founded to carry out further research into acid rain. This project is directed towards studying the effects of acid rain on old, traditional buildings of stone construction that are vulnerable to damage caused by acid rain. Masonry is particularly vulnerable as it is easily corroded and weakened by the acidic chemicals. It is imperative that we protect these buildings, as they are valuable examples of our history and culture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最近，Alter Project 成立以对酸雨进行进一步研究。该项目旨在研究酸雨对老式传统石结构建筑的影响，这些建筑容易受到酸雨造成的损害。砖石建筑尤其脆弱，因为它容易被酸性化学物质腐蚀和削弱。保护这些建筑是至关重要的，因为它们是我们历史和文化的宝贵范例。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Pollution is one of the main sources of concern in the present day. The construction industry contributes considerably as a source of pollution in its day-to-day processes of creating building materials such as concrete and glass, however, more new sustainable methods are being developed to counter this. A recent case study for this is Sky Tower, whose windows have been made from recycled glass to prevent pollution from the glass-making process.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：污染是当今主要的担忧之一。建筑行业在其日常生产建筑材料（如混凝土和玻璃）的过程中是污染的重要来源，不过，更多新的可持续方法正在开发来应对这一问题。最近的一个案例是天空塔，其窗户由回收玻璃制成，以防止玻璃制造过程中的污染。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Water is the most problematic element to be considered in construction. It is imperative that construction elements such as the insulation are fitted into the building in dry weather to prevent it from getting wet. This makes winter an undesirable season for construction as the heavy rainfall can have adverse effects on the building. Another climate type that has an enormous affect on buildings is humidity. Constructions made of steel and stone are largely unaffected by humidity, however, it can have a serious effect on wooden constructions if the timber has not been correctly treated. Moisture from the air can condense in the grain of the wood, which then swells and shrinks in proportion to the magnitude of change in its moisture content. This variation in size can have disastrous consequences.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：水是建筑施工中最需要考虑的问题。建筑构件如保温层必须在干燥天气安装，以防止受潮。这使得冬季成为一个不理想的施工季节，因为大雨会对建筑产生不利影响。另一种对建筑有巨大影响的气候类型是湿度。钢材和石材建筑在很大程度上不受湿度影响，但如果木材没有经过正确处理，湿度会对木结构产生严重影响。空气中的水分可以在木材的纹理中凝结，然后随着含水量的变化而膨胀和收缩。这种尺寸变化可能带来灾难性后果。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In areas of the world that are prone to earthquakes, certain design and environmental conditions are preferable for protecting buildings in the event of a tremor. Engineers have come up with numerous building procedures to help minimise shaking in buildings. For example, tall buildings have height restrictions and counterweights and multi-storey buildings have reinforced floors and walls. Ground conditions are a cause for worry in many constructions as often the soil is of the wrong density to protect the foundations.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在世界上的地震多发地区，某些设计和环境条件更适合在地震时保护建筑。工程师们已经提出了许多建筑规程来帮助减少建筑的震动。例如，高层建筑有高度限制和配重，多层建筑有加固的地板和墙壁。在许多建筑中，地面条件是一个令人担忧的问题，因为土壤密度往往不适合保护地基。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Luckily technology has now been developed that can help to minimise damage by earthquakes. Seismic sensors can give prior warning when an earthquake is about to happen so that preparations can be made to protect both the people and the buildings from harm. The movement of building structures can now also be measured and monitored over time by architects. It has been expressed by architects within the design community that it would be valuable to be given special courses for designing buildings within earthquake zones. Guidelines are also expected to be produced by the government in the near future that will give architects a universal checklist to follow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：幸运的是，现在已经开发出可以帮助减少地震损害的技术。地震传感器可以在即将发生地震时发出预警，以便做好准备保护人员和建筑免受伤害。现在建筑结构的运动也可以由建筑师进行长期测量和监测。设计界的建筑师们表示，如果能提供专门针对地震区建筑设计的课程会非常有价值。政府预计在不久的将来也会发布指导方针，为建筑师提供一份通用的检查清单。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: That wraps up the lecture for today. Please remember that attendance is mandatory... [fade out]
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天的讲座到此结束。请记住出勤是强制性的……【淡出】

transcriptSentences.speaker: AGENT
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have arranged for the tenant to leave the property on Friday so I can show the house to prospective renters. Would you be able to make that day?

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everybody and welcome to the Australian Wild Zoo. I would like to start by introducing you to the new features that we have added to our zoo in the recent renovation. Being the only zoo in the area, we receive thousands of visitors a year. We found that this huge footfall was too demanding for the facilities that we were able to provide, and so we decided to expand ourselves in order to give every visitor a brilliant and exciting experience. We initially intended to build a new dog-walking area, however we felt that the zoo should cater only to exotic animals. During our previous renovation we expanded the exhibition centre and so we felt that this time the zoo would benefit most from introducing a new batch of animals, so visitors can now see a whole range of new additions at the Australian Wild Zoo, including lions and bears.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好，欢迎来到澳大利亚野生动物园。我想先向大家介绍我们在最近的翻新中增加的新设施。作为该地区唯一的动物园，我们每年接待成千上万的游客。我们发现这巨大的人流量对我们提供的设施来说要求太高了，所以我们决定扩建，给每位游客带来精彩刺激的体验。我们最初打算建一个新的遛狗区，但后来觉得动物园应该只服务于外来动物。在之前的翻新中，我们扩建了展览中心，所以这次我们认为动物园从引进一批新动物中获益最大，所以现在游客可以在澳大利亚野生动物园看到一系列新成员，包括狮子和熊。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: With this huge improvement to our facilities, we also found it necessary to change our regulations, which we put into action in June. We now allow visitors access to the zoo during weekdays and, as some of our newly added animals are nocturnal, guests may also now visit the animals late at night. Unfortunately some visitors had started feeding the animals during these late night viewing times, which disrupted their feeding pattern and as a result we had to ban food in the viewing areas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：随着设施的巨幅改善，我们也发现有必要改变我们的规定，这些规定已在六月实施。我们现在允许访客在平日入园，并且由于我们新增的一些动物是夜行动物，客人现在也可以在深夜探访动物。不幸的是，一些游客在深夜观赏时段开始喂食动物，这扰乱了它们的进食模式，因此我们不得不禁止在观赏区携带食物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: One of our most exciting additions to the zoo is our native kangaroo, who we have named Frisbee. For a fee of just $5, visitors can have their photo taken with him and have it printed onto a selection of items such as key rings and mugs. At first, visitors were also allowed to feed Frisbee items that we provided, such as carrots and leaves, however some guests started feeding him hamburgers and chips so we were forced to forbid visitors from feeding him. As kangaroos are such calm animals, Frisbee isn't disturbed by the noises and shouting of visitors at the zoo, which has helped him to settle in at his new home very quickly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们动物园最激动人心的新增项目之一是本地袋鼠，我们给它起名为飞盘。只需支付5美元，游客就可以与它合影，并将照片印在各种物品上，如钥匙圈和杯子。起初，游客也被允许用我们提供的物品喂飞盘，如胡萝卜和叶子，但一些客人开始喂它汉堡和薯条，所以我们不得不禁止游客喂食。由于袋鼠是非常安静的动物，飞盘不会被动物园里游客的噪音和喊叫打扰，这帮助它很快适应了新家。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The pye-dog zone has been permanently closed throughout the winter period to allow the dogs to hibernate as they would in their natural habitat. We were very excited to be reopening the zone, however unfortunately we have been forced to close it temporarily as the result of a broken fence, which will take about one week to fix. We were intending to renovate the zone with the other constructions that we were undertaking, but unfortunately we did not have sufficient funds. We understand that this temporary closure may disappoint our visitors, and so we have decided to offer a discounted price on our tickets for the next week. If you ask at the reception desk, they will happily direct you to the photo shop where you can purchase the ticket. The ticket will also entitle you to a 10% discount off any item in our gift shop where we sell a range of items including postcards and fluffy toys.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：野狗区在整个冬季永久关闭，让狗像在自然栖息地一样冬眠。我们本来非常兴奋要重新开放该区域，但不幸的是，由于围栏损坏，我们被迫暂时关闭，修复大约需要一周时间。我们原本打算与其他在建工程一起翻修该区域，但不幸的是我们没有足够的资金。我们知道这次临时关闭可能会让游客失望，因此我们决定在下周提供折扣门票。如果您向前台询问，他们会很乐意指引您去照相馆购买门票。门票还可以让您在礼品店享受10%的折扣，我们出售各种商品，包括明信片和毛绒玩具。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now we're currently standing at the gate, which is marked with the arrow on the map. Now if any of you need to visit the toilets before we get started, they're right here to our left. Out to the east, just across the grass, there is the bird hide where we have over one hundred species of birds for you to watch. We even have an interactive zone where you can feed them with seed and take photographs with our parrots! What a great souvenir to remember your trip! And up the path to the north, if you look in front of you now, there is the pye-dog zone. Although it is closed, if any of the dogs are playing outside, you will be able to see them through the fence. And then let's pass by the refuge. This area is a sheltered part for Brolga watchers who can use it to spy through binoculars. And after that, I suggest that you all visit the rest area for some cold drinks and snacks as it is very hot outside. It is just at the northwest corner of the zoo. After that you could cut across the path to the large rectangular hut where you will be able to see our new addition of fierce lions. The mother has just had cubs, so it is really quite a rare thing to see! And around to the west, for those of you who want to visit Frisbee, our native kangaroo, he is in the circular shaped hut just up the path to the left. Don't forget to have your photo taken with him! Now, as I mentioned before, you can purchase your discounted tickets at the photo shop and this is also where you will come to collect any photos you have had taken at the zoo during your visit. The photo shop is located at the southwest corner of the zoo. Okay, ladies and gentlemen, enjoy your visit.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们现在站在大门口，地图上标有箭头。在我们开始之前，如果你们谁需要上厕所，就在我们左手边。东边穿过草地就是观鸟屋，那里有超过一百种鸟类供您观赏。我们还有一个互动区，您可以用种子喂它们，还可以和我们的鹦鹉合影！多么棒的旅行纪念品！沿小路向北，如果你们看向前方，就是野狗区。虽然关闭了，但如果有些狗在外面玩耍，你们可以通过围栏看到它们。然后我们经过休息区。这个区域是为蓑羽鹤观察者提供的遮蔽处，他们可以用望远镜观察。之后我建议大家去休息区喝点冷饮、吃点零食，因为外面很热。它在动物园的西北角。之后你们可以穿过小路来到大长方形的小屋，在那里你们可以看到我们新引进的凶猛的狮子。母狮子刚生了幼崽，所以这真是难得一见的景象！西边，那些想去看飞盘——我们的本地袋鼠——的朋友，它就在左边小路的圆形小屋里。别忘了和它合影！正如我之前提到的，你们可以在照相馆购买折扣门票，这也是你们在参观期间拍摄照片的取片处。照相馆位于动物园的西南角。好了，女士们先生们，祝你们参观愉快。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello, Mr Thompson. May I speak to you for a minute?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：您好，汤普森先生。我能和您谈一会儿吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. Please come in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：当然，请进。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm Alexandra Jones. I'm studying Sustainability here at the university and I heard about the summer course that you offer every year. I was considering joining the course and wanted to ask you some questions about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：我是亚历山德拉·琼斯。我在这所大学学习可持续发展学，我听说您每年都开设暑期课程。我在考虑参加，想请教您一些问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, of course, please fire away.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：当然可以，请问吧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Has the course been effective in improving the environment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：这门课程在改善环境方面有效果吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, absolutely. We have seen great results. Last year we planted a small field of trees and we have been measuring their oxygen outputs to see the benefits that they have provided to the environment. Since we were regulated by law last month, we are now able to hugely enhance our efforts. Our current goal is to introduce a lot more tree species to the plot so that we can establish a complex habitat and compare the benefits of each species. In order to do this we need to get a lot more students involved in the project, so I am very pleased to hear about your interest.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：是的，当然。我们看到了很好的成果。去年我们种了一小片树，一直在测量它们的氧气输出量，以了解它们对环境的好处。自上个月受到法律监管以来，我们现在能够大大加强我们的努力。我们目前的目标是在这块土地上引进更多的树种，建立一个复杂的栖息地，并比较每个物种的好处。为此我们需要让更多学生参与这个项目，所以我很高兴听到你感兴趣。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the project sounds fascinating. I would definitely like to be involved.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：嗯，这个项目听起来很吸引人。我肯定想参与。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Absolutely. Over the years we have received funding from private investors and from selling shares, but the biggest improvement in our research came from a government fund that we received in the first year. This has greatly improved the organisation and we have since won prizes for our research.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：太好了。多年来，我们从私人投资者和出售股份获得资金，但我们研究最大的改善来自于第一年获得的一笔政府基金。这大大改善了我们的组织，此后我们的研究还赢得了奖项。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, how impressive!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：哇，真了不起！

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it is of the utmost importance to our organisation that we find a way to repair the terrible damage that has been done to the environment by the human species. This is no small undertaking and our resources still need management, but from reports taken of our studies we have found that teachers and students have greatly benefitted from field trips to the tree plantation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：是的，找到修复人类对环境造成的可怕破坏的方法，对我们组织来说至关重要。这不是一件小事，我们的资源仍然需要管理，但从我们的研究报告来看，我们发现教师和学生从树木种植园的实地考察中受益匪浅。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I visited the plantation myself on a field trip two years ago and I found myself greatly impressed by it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：是的，我两年前也实地参观过种植园，印象非常深刻。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: We have received a lot of feedback from visiting groups telling us how impressed teachers, researchers and students alike have been during their visits. Due to the educational facilities that we have carefully structured, I know that the visits are useful and engaging for students and that their experience is particularly special.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：我们收到了很多来自参观团体的反馈，告诉我们教师、研究人员和学生都在参观中深受感动。由于我们精心构建的教育设施，我知道这些参观对学生既有用又有吸引力，他们的体验特别独特。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what is the particular focus of the organisation and the reports that it provides?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：那么组织的特别关注点及其提供的报告是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: I am personally very interested in soil erosion, so I knew that I definitely wanted to focus some of the report on this area. Before I set up the organisation, I looked up information on what areas were currently being researched and I found that there were already studies into air pollution and water pollution. I obviously wanted to find a unique area to research and so these were no good. I was tempted to look into the background of overgrazing, but the impacts of forest exploitation are far more devastating and very little research has been carried out on this subject, so I decided that this should also form some focus for the report.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：我个人对土壤侵蚀非常感兴趣，所以我知道我肯定想把报告的一部分集中在这个领域。在我建立组织之前，我查阅了当前正在进行研究的领域，发现已经有关于空气污染和水污染的研究。我显然想找一个独特的研究领域，所以那些都不行。我曾想研究过度放牧的背景，但森林开发的影响更为严重，而且关于这一主题的研究很少，所以我决定这也应该成为报告的一部分重点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that makes sense. What have you found to be the greatest benefits of the activities carried out by the organisation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：是的，有道理。您发现组织活动最大的好处是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have found that the greatest benefits are not the ones that anyone can learn from a book, like how to collect data, but more importantly are life lessons that one can gain only from experience. Students who have partaken in the summer course have massively enhanced their confidence, which will prove invaluable for the rest of their lifetime. The people who partake in the summer course already know the importance of environmental protection, so it is not important that we spend time teaching them this. Students instead benefit from learning the importance of punctuality, as each day they have to wake up early to make sure that they are not late for their practical experience sessions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：我发现最大的好处不是任何人都能从书本上学到的东西，比如如何收集数据，更重要的是那些只能从经验中获得的人生教训。参加过暑期课程的学生自信心大大增强，这将在他们的余生中被证明是无价的。参加暑期课程的人已经知道环境保护的重要性，所以花时间教他们这个并不重要。学生反而从学习守时的重要性中受益，因为每天他们都必须早起，确保不会迟到实践课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: If I decide to attend the summer course, what will I be doing for the rest of the time when no activities are going on?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：如果我决定参加暑期课程，没有活动的时候我其余时间做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, we unfortunately don't yet have a library on site, so you would be unable to read reference books although you are obviously welcome to bring some books of your own with you. We offer a range of fun hobbies, such as games and painting, for students to participate in outside of their classes so you could participate in one of these activities. We do not offer tutorials outside of the scheduled classes, however you are free to interview teachers and ask them any questions you may have about the research.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：嗯，不幸的是我们现场还没有图书馆，所以你无法阅读参考书，不过你显然可以自带一些书籍。我们提供各种有趣的爱好，如游戏和绘画，供学生在课外参与，你可以参加其中一项活动。我们不提供课外辅导，但你可以自由采访老师，询问任何关于研究的问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: JONES
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the course sounds fantastic. I would definitely like to participate during the summer. Thank you so much for your help.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 琼斯：嗯，这门课听起来太棒了。我肯定想在夏天参加。非常感谢您的帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: MR THOMPSON
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem at all, here is a form with all of the details. I look forward to seeing you there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤普森先生：不客气，这是一份包含所有细节的表格。期待在那里见到你。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. In the last few lectures I've been talking about the history of technology in the modern world. But today I want to use Roberts as our case study, which is a company that develops complex camera technology for a range of industries and disciplines. Since the camera was invented in 1816, it has changed and improved dramatically with cameras now in existence that can fit on the head of a pin. The company has been founded on a series of principals by which the company operates in its day-to-day business, the most important of these being to enhance the present development of camera technology.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：早上好。在过去的几讲中，我一直在讨论现代世界技术史。但今天我想以罗伯茨公司作为我们的案例，这是一家为各种行业和学科开发复杂相机技术的公司。自1816年相机发明以来，它发生了巨大的变化和改进，现在甚至有了可以放在针头上的相机。该公司建立在一系列原则之上，这些原则指导着公司的日常运营，其中最重要的是推动相机技术的当前发展。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Roberts has a philosophy pioneering and innovation, having been responsible for the invention of numerous technologies since it was founded by Dwayne Roberts in 1957. It has achieved many of its aims over the years, but its principal and founding aim persists through time, which is to explore new facts and imagine the unimaginable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：罗伯茨公司秉承开拓和创新的理念，自1957年德韦恩·罗伯茨创立以来，已经发明了众多技术。多年来它实现了许多目标，但它的主要和创始目标始终如一，即探索新事实，想象不可想象的事物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The cameras produced by Roberts have a multitude of potential applications that are currently being explored. One of these is an anti-gravity camera that they aim to attach to a space satellite from where it will record live, high-definition video and provide fascinating new views of planet earth. It could also prove useful in exploring other planets by providing researchers with never before seen images of the universe. Roberts are also experimenting with attaching the cameras to small drones that will fly through the rainforest in search of plants that could be used to develop future medicine. The camera also has the potential to be used on the roads. As it is 20% cheaper than the speed cameras that are currently in operation, this means that more of them could be distributed across the road network where they can control traffic by making sure that all cars abide by the speed regulations. Despite this diverse range of potential applications, the cameras are presently used for very different, more domestic purposes. Roberts' cameras are presently used as nanny-cams, which allow parents to watch their nannies to ensure that they are responsibly attending to the children that they have been employed to care for. These cameras give parents peace of mind and more control over their child's welfare whilst they are at work or otherwise occupied. The highest sales of the company are in toys that have the cameras hidden within them. This clever idea means that the cameras are camouflaged from view and do not look out of place in the child's nursery. The toys are also very robust, so children can play with them without damaging them in the process. The toys are designed to look like animals and come in a range of shapes, sizes and colours as well as different animal species such as monkeys and bears. These toys are incredibly popular and can be bought in any toy store for only $20. Always eager to be constantly improving their products, Roberts are now working on a product that will change the way people see photography. This new contraption is a mini camera that is built into eyewear such as glasses and sunglasses where it can capture the world as you see it. Holiday makers and tourists no longer have to carry a big, heavy camera around with them on their travels! They can instead purchase a set of eyewear with the built-in camera, which will capture the moment with a simple tap.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：罗伯茨生产的相机有大量潜在的应用正在探索中。其中一个是反重力相机，他们计划将其安装在太空卫星上，从那里实时录制高清视频，提供地球迷人的新视角。它还可以通过为研究人员提供前所未有的宇宙图像，在探索其他行星方面发挥作用。罗伯茨公司还在试验将相机安装在小无人机上，在雨林中飞行，寻找可用于开发未来药物的植物。相机还有潜力用于道路。由于它比目前使用的测速相机便宜20%，这意味着可以在道路网络上安装更多这样的相机，通过确保所有汽车遵守速度限制来控制交通。尽管有这么多不同的潜在应用，但这些相机目前用于非常不同的、更家庭化的用途。罗伯茨的相机目前被用作保姆摄像头，让父母可以监控保姆，确保她们负责地照顾所雇佣的儿童。这些相机让父母安心，在他们工作或忙碌时对孩子的福利有更多控制。该公司销量最高的是隐藏在玩具中的相机。这个巧妙的想法意味着相机从视线中伪装起来，在孩子的育儿室里不会显得突兀。这些玩具也非常耐用，孩子们可以在玩的时候不损坏它们。这些玩具设计成动物的样子，有各种形状、大小和颜色，包括不同种类的动物，如猴子和熊。这些玩具非常受欢迎，在任何玩具商店都可以买到，只需20美元。罗伯茨公司一直渴望不断改进产品，现在正在研发一款将改变人们对摄影看法的产品。这款新产品是一种内置在眼镜和太阳镜等镜框中的迷你相机，可以捕捉您看到的世界。度假者和游客不再需要在旅行中携带沉重的大相机！他们可以购买一副内置相机的眼镜，只需轻轻一敲就能捕捉瞬间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Roberts are also developing a model of this tiny camera for use during medical procedures and operations. The camera will be used during non-invasive keyhole surgeries to enable the surgeon to see what they are doing inside the body without having to make a large incision. This innovative application for the camera could make surgeries a lot faster and the saved time and energy will also make it far more efficient. As the patient will no longer have to undergo a large incision for their surgery, it also means that their recovery will be much faster with a greatly reduced chance of post-op infection.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：罗伯茨公司还在开发这种微型相机的一个型号，用于医疗程序和手术中。该相机将用于非侵入性锁孔手术，使外科医生能够看到他们在体内的操作，而无需做大切口。这种相机的创新应用可以大大加快手术速度，节省的时间和精力也会使其效率大大提高。由于患者不再需要承受大切口手术，这也意味着恢复会快得多，术后感染的机会也大大降低。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If any of you have an interest in working in this field of technological invention, Roberts is a very diverse and fast-growing company that would be a fantastic internship opportunity. Every year they organise a series of competitions where entrants stand the chance of winning a place in their internship programme, so I would suggest that all of you enter. That wraps up the lecture for today. Please remember that attendance is mandatory... [fade out]
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你们中有谁对在这一技术发明领域工作感兴趣，罗伯茨是一家非常多元化、快速发展的公司，将是一个绝佳的实习机会。他们每年组织一系列比赛，参赛者有机会赢得他们的实习名额，所以我建议你们都参加。今天的讲座到此结束。请记住出勤是强制性的……【淡出】

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon. Welcome to Matrix Printing, I'm John Smith. How can I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：下午好。欢迎来到矩阵印刷，我是约翰·史密斯。我能为您做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon. I'm here to reprint a brochure for our hotel. There are some pages that need revising.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：下午好。我来这里是要重印我们酒店的 brochure。有些页面需要修改。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, how may I address you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的，我该怎么称呼您？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I'm Mary Jane from Central Hotel Chains. Nice to meet you. I've got samples of the previous version.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：哦，我是中央连锁酒店的玛丽·简。很高兴见到你。我有之前版本的样本。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: I assume it is your company's advertising brochure?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：我猜这是贵公司的宣传册吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：是的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: What exactly is the problem?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：具体是什么问题？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it was printed the year before, so some of the information is already out-of-date. There are also a couple of problems with the layout. Firstly, the letters of the address on the front page are far too small. It's hard to see when glancing at the cover.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：嗯，这是前年印刷的，所以一些信息已经过时了。版面也有几个问题。首先，封面上的地址字母太小了。浏览封面时很难看到。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: How big do you need it to be?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：您需要多大？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Increase the letters by 3 font sizes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：把字母增大3个字号。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Just a minute. Let me take notes of your requirements...OK, what else needs changing?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：稍等。我记一下您的要求……好的，还有什么需要改的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: The information regarding the pool should be deleted, because it is currently under renovation and is not available.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：关于游泳池的信息应该删除，因为它目前正在翻修，不开放。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: So all of the relevant descriptions on page 2 should be removed? What do we replace it with? We can't just leave the whole page blank.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：所以第2页上所有相关的描述都要删除？那用什么替换？我们不能让整页空白。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Just fill it in with the introduction of our newly-opened gym. I've included all the relevant information here in this flash drive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：就用我们新开的健身房的介绍来填充。我把所有相关信息都放在这个 U 盘里了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me check...Um, I see. No problem then.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：我看看……嗯，明白了。那没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: What is also bothering us is that the description under the top photo on page 4 is incorrect. The word lounge needs to be replaced with reception.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：还有一点让我们困扰的是第4页顶部照片下的描述有误。“lounge”这个词需要改成“reception”。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Fully noted. Is that all?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：完全记下了。就这些吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, there is more. Turn to page 5. We feel that showing merely the picture of our exterior and interior decoration does not fully represent the appeal of our hotel. On second thought, we've decided to use a picture with the view of the hotel.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：不，还有更多。翻到第5页。我们觉得仅仅展示酒店外观和室内装饰的照片并不能充分代表酒店的吸引力。再考虑后，我们决定使用一张带有酒店景观的照片。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you have the original copy of the picture?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：您有这张照片的原图吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it is also enclosed in the flash drive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：有的，也附在 U 盘里了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, we'll reedit the whole layout of the photos.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的，我们会重新编辑整个照片版面。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's turn to the next page.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：我们翻到下一页。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, what's wrong with that? It seems perfectly fine to me.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的，那一页有什么问题吗？我觉得看起来挺好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: At first sight, it seems fine. But according to the feedback of the customers, the prices do not stand out, so we want to change the print from black to red to make it pop out.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：乍一看似乎不错。但根据顾客的反馈，价格不够突出，所以我们想把印刷颜色从黑色改为红色，让它更显眼。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. I've made notes of all your requests. Is there anything else?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的。我已经记录了你所有的要求。还有其他事吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: I appreciate it. Just one final request. Could you translate the whole brochure into Spanish? We have customers worldwide, you know, especially those from Latin countries.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：非常感谢。最后一个请求。你能把整本 brochure 翻译成西班牙语吗？你知道，我们有来自世界各地的客户，尤其是拉丁国家的客户。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. What about other languages, like Japanese, Chinese or German? These are our most popular target languages.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：没问题。那其他语言呢，比如日语、中文或德语？这些都是我们最常翻译的目标语言。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have to ask the manager about the Chinese version. There's been a surging number of Chinese clients during recent years. However, we don't need German or Japanese translations as we currently don't have many customers from those two countries.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：中文版我得问经理。近年来中国客户数量激增。不过，我们不需要德语或日语翻译，因为目前来自这两个国家的客户不多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. Just keep me updated.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的。随时告诉我进展。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: So roughly when could we get the revised print? We need it before the end of July.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：那么我们大概什么时候能拿到修订后的印刷品？我们需要在七月底之前拿到。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's late June now. Roughly it'll take 3 weeks to reedit, so it will definitely be ready before the deadline.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：现在是六月下旬。重新编辑大约需要3周时间，所以肯定能在截止日期前准备好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：太好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: To where shall we send the samples?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：样本寄到哪里？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: The address is No. 9 Green Drive, Cliffton, NY21300.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：地址是克里夫顿格林路9号，邮编NY21300。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: How do you spell Cliffton?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：Cliffton怎么拼？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: C-L-I-double F-T-O-N, Cliffton.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：C-L-I-双写F-T-O-N，Cliffton。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: And the telephone number?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：电话号码呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's 9-0-3-0-3-6-6-0-2. Also, if you have any further questions, you can reach me through this number.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：是 9-0-3-0-3-6-6-0-2。另外，如果你有任何后续问题，可以通过这个号码联系我。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Employee
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 员工：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to Byron National Park. I am Jim Carson, your tour guide for the trip. First, I'd like to give you some basic information about the park.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎来到拜伦国家公园。我是吉姆·卡森，这次旅行的导游。首先，我想给大家介绍一下公园的一些基本信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Covering 7,000 acres of land and spanning across 3 states, Byron National Park was established to protect the area's most spectacular scenic values. With unique geologic features, natural history and native plant and animal life, it is an ideal destination for recreation as well as research purposes. The park has a breathtaking waterfall connecting the longest river in the country, but it is most renowned for having the largest sub-tropical rainforest worldwide. There are many layers of tall, medium and low vegetation growing with seasonal variations in the park. It is a place where the air seems green.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：拜伦国家公园占地7，000英亩，横跨3个州，建立目的是保护该地区最壮观的风景价值。凭借独特的地质特征、自然历史和本土动植物，它是休闲和研究的理想目的地。公园有一个令人叹为观止的瀑布，连接着该国最长的河流，但最著名的是拥有全球最大的亚热带雨林。公园内生长着多层高、中、低植被，随季节变化。这是一个空气仿佛都带着绿色的地方。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ardent hikers can find an awesome array of options here. Apart from the dense green rainforest, tourists can also hike along the mountain trail. Despite the stunning view, taking photos is not advised on the way up, I'm afraid, as one might get distracted and the narrow trail by the sheer cliff is quite dangerous. When you reach the top of the mountain, there is nothing better than having a picnic under the trees with your family. Accompanied mostly by wildlife, walkers as well as cyclists may find the Bush Track a good choice for having a tranquil time to themselves. As your tour guide, I suggest that only expert hikers take the Creek Circuit, because its beautiful and inspiring scenery through the subtropical jungle is paralleled by its physical challenges.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：热情的徒步旅行者在这里可以找到大量选择。除了茂密的绿色雨林，游客还可以沿着山间小径徒步。尽管景色迷人，但上山的路上不建议拍照，因为可能会分散注意力，而且悬崖边的小路很窄，相当危险。当你到达山顶时，没有什么比和家人一起在树下野餐更好的了。步行者和骑行者大多与野生动物为伴，会发现丛林小径是享受宁静时光的好选择。作为你们的导游，我建议只有专业徒步者走溪谷环线，因为穿过亚热带丛林的美丽而鼓舞人心的风景与它的体力挑战是并存的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A list of transport is available within the park. Bicycles are a popular choice as it is the most flexible way to get around. Electric trams are temporarily closed for maintenance. Boat trips down the river are an ideal way to spend a tranquil afternoon. Rest assured that transport within the park is covered in the bill.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：公园内提供多种交通方式。自行车是很受欢迎的选择，因为这是最灵活的出行方式。电动车暂时关闭维护。顺流而下的船游是度过宁静下午的理想方式。放心，公园内的交通费用已包含在账单中。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Extreme sports is another highlight of the park. They are for adventurous grown-ups, especially those who are comfortable with having a racing heart. Scary as it may sound, it is actually safe to participate in extreme sports under strict instructions and close supervision. Abseiling is available regardless of the weather. It is a fun way to overcome fear of heights, gain new skills and get an adrenaline rush. Bungee jumping and paragliding are also available except for during the summer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：极限运动是公园的另一大亮点。它们适合喜欢冒险的成年人，尤其是那些不介意心跳加速的人。虽然听起来可怕，但在严格指导和密切监督下参加极限运动实际上是安全的。无论天气如何都可以进行绕绳下降。这是克服恐高、获得新技能和体验肾上腺素飙升的有趣方式。蹦极和滑翔伞除夏季外也可进行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: At this point, you might worry about meals here. Well, even though there is only one restaurant in the park at the moment, the variety of dishes is astonishing. There are two meals included in the price. Just get your meal ticket at the reception before dining. Also, there is no need to make reservations or worry about availability since there are plenty of tables.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：说到这里，你们可能会担心用餐问题。虽然公园目前只有一家餐厅，但菜品种类惊人。价格包含两餐。只需在用餐前到前台领取餐券即可。此外，不需要预订，也不用担心没位置，因为有很多餐桌。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: During your stay here, you might want to know what there is to do. Let's turn to the plan so I can familiarise you with the layout of the park.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在你们逗留期间，可能会想知道有什么可做的。让我们看一下平面图，以便我让你们熟悉公园的布局。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Most tourists would choose to stay in our guest house located in the southeast corner. It features 63 tastefully appointed guest rooms, many of which offer spectacular views of the park. You'll find a home away from home at our guest house.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大多数游客会选择住在位于东南角的宾馆。它有63间布置典雅的客房，其中许多房间可以看到公园的壮丽景色。在我们的宾馆，你们会找到家的感觉。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: But for those who want to experience the natural beauty up-close, there is also a campsite. When you get out of the guesthouse, go straight ahead, turn right at the end of the road. To your left, there is a campsite amongst the trees where you could spend a night under the stars together with owls and chipmunks.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：但对于那些想近距离体验自然美景的人来说，还有一个露营地。从宾馆出来后直走，在路尽头右转。你的左手边，树丛中有一个露营地，你可以在那里与猫头鹰和花栗鼠一起在星空下过夜。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you look at the top left of the plan, you will notice a picnic area. You can either bring your own food or we can deliver food to you. Barbeque is an option. The Business Centre is situated directly opposite the picnic area. It provides flexible, fully serviced offices, conferencing suites, meeting rooms and is equipped with the latest multi-media facilities. Wired as well as wireless high speed Internet is available within the entire premises. The Centre is designed to cater to both individual travellers and corporate groups.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你看平面图的左上角，你会注意到一个野餐区。你可以自带食物，也可以由我们送餐。烧烤也是一种选择。商务中心位于野餐区的正对面。它提供灵活的、全方位服务的办公室、会议套房、会议室，并配备了最新的多媒体设施。整个场所都有有线和无线高速互联网。该中心旨在满足个人旅客和团体客户的需求。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Visitors can also go to the museum which holds a vast collection, that exhibits local history and a natural habitat. You start from the guesthouse, just turn left at the first conjunction, then walk past the teahouse, turn right. You'll see the museum after making the 3rd right. Have you found it?...Pretty easy, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：游客还可以去博物馆，那里收藏了大量展品，展示当地历史和自然栖息地。从宾馆出发，在第一个路口左转，然后经过茶馆，右转。在第三次右转后你就会看到博物馆。找到了吗？……很简单，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To spend a delightful afternoon with a book and a fresh cup of coffee, you can go to the only café in the park. From the guesthouse you go straight, then take the 2nd right and you'll see the café right in front of you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：想拿着一本书和一杯新鲜咖啡度过愉快的下午，你可以去公园里唯一的咖啡馆。从宾馆直走，在第二个路口右转，咖啡馆就在你面前。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: You might want to check out our all-season tennis court which offers instruction for all ages and skill levels. It is located right opposite the café...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：你可能想看看我们的四季网球场，它提供适合所有年龄和技能水平的指导。它就在咖啡馆的正对面……
