transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Helen and Paul, congratulations to you both for doing so well the past semester. You two have exhibited an impeccable performance during your first year in the nursing program. I'd like to get some feedback from the two of you to better improve the program and to provide guidance for our prospective students. I'd like to start with you, Helen. So first of all, which aspect of the program impressed you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：海伦和保罗，恭喜你们俩上学期表现如此出色。你们在护理专业的第一年展现了无可挑剔的表现。我想从你们俩那里得到一些反馈，以便更好地改进该专业，并为未来的学生提供指导。我想先问问你，海伦。那么首先，专业中哪个方面让你印象深刻？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, to be honest, when I was enrolled into the course, I was expecting a group of classmates my age. But as I stepped into the classroom for the first time, I was surprised by the diversity. Most were in their twenties, but there were also those in their thirties or even forties. As it turns out, the intergenerational communication has sparked intense debate and new thinking, and I think that's something special about the program that I appreciate very much.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：嗯，说实话，当我被录取进入这个专业时，我本以为会是一群和我年龄相仿的同学。但当我第一次走进教室时，我被这种多样性震惊了。大多数人在二十多岁，但也有三十多岁甚至四十多岁的。事实证明，代际交流激发了激烈的辩论和新思维，我认为这是这个专业非常特别的一点，我很欣赏。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about you, Paul? What do you think of the program?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你呢，保罗？你对这个专业有什么看法？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Paul
transcriptSentences.englishText: For me the group project we carried out last semester is another key feature of the program. The whole class was divided into 8 different groups working on 8 perspective cases. Team building sessions were conducted in a collaborative way most of the time. Comprised of five members, our group studied acute pancreatitis. During the process, we broke the task into different parts and assigned them to each member. We were then able to tackle the complex problem by pooling our knowledge and skills. More importantly, stronger links were established between the group members. Because of the project, we've all become good friends.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 保罗：对我来说，上学期进行的小组项目是该专业的另一个关键特色。全班被分成8个不同的小组，研究8个不同的案例。大多数时候，团队建设以协作方式进行。我们小组由五名成员组成，研究急性胰腺炎。在这个过程中，我们把任务分解成不同部分，分配给每个成员。然后我们通过汇集知识和技能来解决复杂的问题。更重要的是，小组成员之间建立了更牢固的联系。因为这个项目，我们都成了好朋友。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's true. According to graduates, group projects prepare them for the work world in which teamwork and collaboration are increasingly the norm. So tell me, Paul, what else do you like about the program?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的。根据毕业生的反馈，小组项目让他们为工作世界做好准备，在工作世界中团队合作和协作越来越成为常态。那么告诉我，保罗，你还喜欢这个专业的什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Paul
transcriptSentences.englishText: I want to be a registered nurse working in a public hospital after graduation. So the internship provided is a valuable opportunity for clinical practice in a supportive learning atmosphere. However, I was amazed by the amount of written assignments since I thought the course should have focused more on practice-oriented learning.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 保罗：我想毕业后成为在公立医院工作的注册护士。所以提供的实习是在支持性学习环境中进行临床实践的宝贵机会。然而，我对大量的书面作业感到惊讶，因为我觉得这个专业应该更注重实践导向的学习。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I have to disagree with you, Paul. The essays demonstrate your understanding of the course. For me, writing essays is a process that involves critical thinking which challenges me to develop my points more thoroughly. I thus managed to gain a diversity of perspectives.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：嗯，我得不同意你的看法，保罗。论文展示了你对课程的理解。对我来说，写论文是一个涉及批判性思维的过程，它挑战我更透彻地展开我的观点。因此我得以获得多元的视角。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: The program is designed to deliver basic and advanced theoretical knowledge of core concepts including health care systems concepts, together with practicum or clinical practice experience to bridge the classroom content to the practice setting. So I'm afraid written work is unavoidable. Also this year, we've added a module of law. How do you feel about that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：该专业旨在传授核心概念的基础和高级理论知识，包括医疗保健系统概念，同时结合实习或临床实践经验，将课堂内容与实践环境联系起来。所以恐怕书面作业是不可避免的。另外今年，我们增加了法律模块。你们觉得怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: At first we felt that learning law is kind of redundant and too time-consuming. After a few sessions, we realised that it is necessary in dealing with future medical disputes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：起初我们觉得学习法律有点多余，太耗时。经过几节课后，我们意识到在处理未来的医疗纠纷中是必要的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you have any suggestions for prospective students?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你们对未来的学生有什么建议吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Paul
transcriptSentences.englishText: What bothers me most is handing in essays on time. I almost missed the deadline once because there were three essays due within the same week. So rationalising your time is critical.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 保罗：最困扰我的是按时交论文。有一次我差点错过截止日期，因为同一周内有三篇论文要交。所以合理安排你的时间至关重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, that's true. The lectures deliver so much useful information. I have poor memory so I kept making notes and revisiting them on a regular basis. To my surprise, at the end of the semester, I have learnt the key concepts by heart.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：嗯，确实如此。讲座提供了很多有用的信息。我记性不好，所以我一直做笔记并定期复习。令我惊讶的是，在学期末，我已经把关键概念牢记在心。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: How was the research? I heard that it was quite challenging. How did you manage to overcome the difficulties?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：研究怎么样？我听说很有挑战性。你们是怎么克服困难的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Paul
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's true. The majority of us had no clue how to carry out the research at first. Fortunately, when I was digging up reference materials at the library, I sought help from the librarian. She taught me about finding the appropriate resources and choosing the proper research methods.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 保罗：确实如此。我们大多数人一开始都不知道如何进行这项研究。幸运的是，当我在图书馆查找参考资料时，我向图书管理员寻求了帮助。她教我怎么找到合适的资源和选择适当的研究方法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you checked out the online forum?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你们看过在线论坛吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it has become a habit for me to visit the forum regularly. In a sense, it extends classroom learning. It is where the students post academic problems that they come across and get support from the faculty members.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：是的，定期访问论坛已经成为我的习惯。从某种意义上说，它延伸了课堂学习。学生们在那里发布他们遇到的学术问题，并从教师那里获得支持。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Paul
transcriptSentences.englishText: Some of my classmates didn't do so well during the placement tests. I feel that background reading is necessary.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 保罗：我的一些同学在分班考试中表现不太好。我觉得背景阅读是必要的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Lastly, do you have anything to say to the freshmen?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：最后，你们有什么想对新生说的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Helen
transcriptSentences.englishText: I was really ambitious at first, trying to get straight A's on my transcript. I made tons of notes and worked hard even on the optional assignments to get extra credit. I stressed myself out before having an emotional breakdown. After consulting my advisor, I found it important to set realistic goals. Don't push yourself too hard. It is wise to sort out your priorities.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 海伦：一开始我真的很雄心勃勃，想在成绩单上拿全A。我做大量的笔记，甚至为额外学分在选修作业上也很努力。在情绪崩溃之前我把自己逼得太紧。在咨询了我的导师后，我发现设定现实的目标很重要。不要把自己逼得太紧。理清优先事项是明智的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you for coming here today and providing valuable feedback on the program. Have a great summer break.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：感谢你们今天来为这个专业提供宝贵的反馈。祝你们暑假愉快。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everyone. Today's lecture is about a type of adorable animal the penguin. When you think of penguins, you may picture them surrounded by snow and ice. But not all penguins live where it's cold---African penguins live in the southern tip of Africa. They are usually found within 40 kilometres of the shore and on a number of its surrounding islands.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好。今天的讲座是关于一种可爱的动物——企鹅。当你想到企鹅时，你可能会想象它们被冰雪包围。但并不是所有企鹅都生活在寒冷的地方——非洲企鹅生活在非洲南端。它们通常出现在海岸40公里范围内及其周围的许多岛屿上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: African Penguins are also known as Jackass Penguins, because they make donkey-like braying sounds to communicate. African penguins can keep their body temperature at a stable level. But their land habitat can get quite warm, so there are a number of ways for them to stay cool. They limit their daylight movements on breeding sites on land to early mornings and early evenings to avoid too much sun. The pink glands above their eyes can help them cope with the temperate climates. Like other penguins, African penguins spend most of the day feeding in the ocean, which also helps keep them cool.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：非洲企鹅也被称为“驴企鹅”，因为它们发出像驴一样的叫声来交流。非洲企鹅能保持体温稳定。但它们的陆地栖息地可能相当温暖，所以它们有几种方法来保持凉爽。它们将陆地上繁殖地的日间活动限制在清晨和傍晚，以避免阳光太强。它们眼睛上方的粉色腺体可以帮助它们应对温带气候。像其他企鹅一样，非洲企鹅一天中大部分时间在海洋中觅食，这也有助于保持凉爽。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Being a type of small to medium sized penguin species, African penguins average about 60 centimetres tall and weigh up to 3.6 kilograms. They have a black stripe and a pattern of unique black spots on their chest. Males are larger than females and have larger beaks. Even though they are categorised as birds, African penguins aren't able to fly because of their heavy bones. Their wings are more like flippers that make them particularly suited for life in the water. When they're on land, their flippers and their tails help them keep their balance and walk upright.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：作为一种中小型企鹅物种，非洲企鹅平均身高约60厘米，体重可达3.6公斤。它们有一条黑色条纹，胸部有独特的黑斑图案。雄性比雌性大，喙也更大。尽管它们被归类为鸟类，但非洲企鹅由于骨骼较重不能飞行。它们的翅膀更像鳍状肢，特别适合水中生活。在陆地上时，它们的鳍状肢和尾巴帮助它们保持平衡，直立行走。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: African Penguins begin to breed at the average age of four. When a male and female pair up, they tend to breed together for the rest of their lives. Most other penguins nest and lay their eggs out in the open, but African penguins have a different approach. They dig holes under bushes out of their own excrement, called guano, so they are sheltered from the sun and predators.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：非洲企鹅平均在四岁时开始繁殖。当雄性和雌性配对后，它们倾向于终生一起繁殖。大多数其他企鹅在地面开阔处筑巢产卵，但非洲企鹅有不同的方式。它们用自己排泄物——鸟粪——在灌木丛下挖洞，从而免受阳光和捕食者的侵害。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The African Penguin survives on a diet that is comprised mainly of marine organisms. They feed primarily on fish like sardines, along with the occasional squid and shellfish. But when normal food is in short supply, they eat tree roots as well. The streamlined body of the African Penguin allows it to move through the water like a rocket, capable of reaching a speed of around 20 kilometres per hour when hunting for food.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：非洲企鹅以海洋生物为主要食物来源。它们主要以沙丁鱼等鱼类为食，偶尔也吃鱿鱼和贝类。但当正常食物短缺时，它们也会吃树根。非洲企鹅流线型的身体能让它们像火箭一样在水中移动，觅食时速度可达每小时约20公里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The African Penguin's smaller size means that it has many predators both in the water and also on dry land. Their natural predators at sea include seals and sharks. The biggest threat to them on land is not just towards the adult penguins. The penguin chicks are sometimes taken by seagulls into the air and dropped from above. The seagulls could thus feed on them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：非洲企鹅体型较小，这意味着它们在水上和陆地上都有许多捕食者。它们在海上的天敌包括海豹和鲨鱼。陆地上对它们最大的威胁不仅针对成年企鹅。企鹅幼崽有时被海鸥叼到空中并从高处扔下，这样海鸥就可以吃掉它们。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: At risk from predators, young penguins are protected for about 40 days after hatching by both parents. They will leave the colony when they are between 3 to 5 months old and will return a few years later. The entire surface of their body is densely covered with feathers, which fall off during the winter. This process is called molting and takes about three weeks to complete. During that time, they are unable to forage. Therefore prior to this, African penguins spend about five weeks laying down fat deposits.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：面临捕食者的威胁，小企鹅在孵化后约40天内受到父母的保护。它们在3到5个月大时会离开群落，几年后再返回。它们的整个身体表面密布羽毛，在冬季会脱落。这个过程被称为换羽，大约需要三周才能完成。在那段时间里，它们无法觅食。因此在此之前，非洲企鹅大约要花五周时间储存脂肪。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: They generally live between 10 to 15 years, however many do not reach their full life span. Their population has drastically declined. Approximately 120,000 African penguins remain in the wild, and their population has decreased by 90% in the past 60 years. They are considered to be vulnerable and have been listed as being endangered. Two major factors have contributed to their decline. They are struggling for nesting space due to human disruption and competing for food due to overfishing and pollution.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：它们通常能活10到15年，但许多无法活到完整寿命。它们的种群数量急剧下降。野外大约还有12万只非洲企鹅，在过去60年中它们的数量减少了90%。它们被认为是脆弱的，已被列为濒危物种。两个主要因素导致了它们的下降：由于人类干扰，它们在争夺筑巢空间；由于过度捕捞和污染，它们在争夺食物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: With the limited number of breeding pairs, survivorship becomes difficult for African penguins. This makes them especially vulnerable as environmental conditions change or an outbreak of a disease occurs. For instance, avian malaria has caused 27% of the captive-breeding penguins' deaths annually. The more genetic diversity there is within a species, the higher the likelihood that at least some of the individuals will adapt and survive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：由于繁殖对数量有限，非洲企鹅的生存变得困难。这使得它们在环境条件变化或疾病爆发时尤其脆弱。例如，禽疟疾每年导致圈养繁殖企鹅27%的死亡。物种内遗传多样性越高，至少一些个体能够适应并生存的可能性就越高。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon. May I speak to Emma's parent?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：下午好。我能和艾玛的家长通话吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Afternoon. I'm her father. Who am I speaking to?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：下午好。我是她父亲。请问您是？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: This is Emma's teacher Jane Carson calling from the Art Centre. I'm just calling to talk about her drama class at the centre.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：我是艾玛的老师简·卡森，从艺术中心打来的。我打电话是想谈谈她在中心的戏剧课。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, thank you for calling. How's Emma doing in drama class? You know she just transferred here last month, unlike the others in her class who have been taking the course the whole semester since June. So I'm a bit worried that she might not fit in so well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：哦，谢谢您打电话来。艾玛在戏剧课上表现怎么样？您知道她上个月才转学过来，不像班上其他同学从六月起就上了整个学期的课。所以我有点担心她可能不太适应。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: There's no need to worry. She exhibits a strong performance in her drama class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：不用担心。她在戏剧课上表现很出色。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Is that so?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：是吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. She didn't adapt to the new environment as quickly as I originally expected, and seemed a bit shy at first. But a few days later, she made a couple of friends and became more talkative and also more involved in class. Emma really is a role model for others, because she has always been an active participant during class. She voices her own ideas and is very creative.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：是的。她没有像我最初预期的那样迅速适应新环境，一开始有点害羞。但几天后，她交了几个朋友，变得更爱说话了，也更多地参与到课堂中。艾玛真的是其他人的榜样，因为她在课堂上一直很积极参与。她表达自己的想法，而且很有创造力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: I didn't expect that. But I can tell that she really enjoys the course, because she's been talking about it at home frequently these past few weeks.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：我没想到。不过我能看出来她真的很喜欢这门课，因为这几周她在家经常谈起。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great to hear. Interest is always the best teacher. I also have to inform you that there's been an adjustment in the timetable of the drama class next term.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：听到这个太好了。兴趣永远是最好的老师。我还得通知您，下学期的戏剧课时间表有调整。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's not that the music room that we currently use isn't available. As there are too many enrolling for the coming semester, increased class size means that space is limited to house the whole class. Also the new classroom we use is not available during the current timeframe, so I'm afraid we have to change the time for it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：不是我们现在使用的音乐教室不能用。由于下学期报名人数太多，班级规模增大意味着空间有限，无法容纳全班。而且我们要用的新教室在现在的时间段不能用，所以恐怕我们得改时间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. So when would it be?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：我明白了。那改成什么时候？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: As you know, the current class begins at three fifteen. But the new time of the drama class would be a quarter to five.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：如您所知，目前是三点十五分开始。但新的戏剧课时间是四点四十五分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm afraid I have errands to run during that time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：恐怕那个时间我有事要办。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: On the other campus the class still begins at three fifteen, but for the campus Emma goes to, it is the only time available for drama class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：在另一个校区，课程仍然是三点十五分开始，但对于艾玛所在的校区，这是戏剧课唯一可用的时间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I see. I have to make adjustments to my chore schedule then. No problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：哦，我明白了。那我得调整一下我的日常安排。没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Miss Carson, I'm thinking about signing Emma up for another art course. I'm thinking about dance class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：卡森老师，我在考虑给艾玛再报一门艺术课。我在考虑舞蹈课。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Dance class is a popular course here, a great choice for a child to shape up and have fun. But unfortunately, it is over-subscribed at the moment. I have to put you on the waiting list.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：舞蹈课在这里很受欢迎，对孩子们来说既能塑形又很有趣。但不幸的是，目前已经报满了。我得把您放在等候名单上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's too bad. What else can I choose from then? Could you give me some advice?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：太遗憾了。那我还可以选什么？您能给我一些建议吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. Emma could take singing class as well. This would improve her musicality.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：当然。艾玛也可以上歌唱课。这能提高她的音乐素养。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds good. When is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：听起来不错。什么时候上课？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is held every Friday evening.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：每周五晚上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's too bad. Emma already has a swimming class earlier that evening. It will be too late for her to come home if she takes this course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：太糟糕了。艾玛那天晚上已经有游泳课了。如果她再上这门课，回家就太晚了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is also a vocal course available. Emma's got a great voice, I'm sure she'll stand out in the class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：还有一门声乐课。艾玛的声音很好，我相信她会在班上脱颖而出的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Tell me about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：请介绍一下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: The vocal course starts at 4.30 pm every Tuesday. It isn't fully booked yet. Great teacher, experienced and beloved by students. The price is a bit higher though.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：声乐课每周二下午四点半开始。还没有报满。老师很棒，经验丰富，深受学生喜爱。不过价格稍微高一点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: How much is it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：多少钱？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's 110 dollars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：110美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's too much, way over our budget. We have to cover the extra cost if we choose it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：哦，太贵了，远远超出我们的预算。如果选这个，我们得自己承担额外费用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Or maybe Emma could take music class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：或者艾玛可以上音乐课。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: What is it about? Learning about songs and musicals?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：那是关于什么的？学习歌曲和音乐剧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the students have the opportunity to play different instruments like the piano, drum and so on. They can also learn how to write music under professional guidance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：嗯，学生们有机会演奏不同的乐器，比如钢琴、鼓等等。他们还可以在专业指导下学习作曲。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's exactly what Emma is eager to learn. How much would it cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：这正是艾玛渴望学习的。费用是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: It was 63 dollars last term. But this term it is 85 dollars, 22 dollars more than the original price.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：上学期是63美元。但这学期是85美元，比原价多了22美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: We can afford that. When does the course begin?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：我们可以负担。课程什么时候开始？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: The course starts on September 7th.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：课程于9月7日开始。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Can we start one week later, on September 14th? My daughter will be on a trip to France with her Mom on the 7th.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：我们可以晚一周，在9月14日开始吗？我女儿7号要和她妈妈去法国旅行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. And the teacher for the class is Jamal Curtis. Just contact him if you have any further questions regarding the course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：没问题。这门课的老师是贾马尔·柯蒂斯。如果您对课程有任何进一步的问题，直接联系他。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Jamal Curtis? How do you spell Curtis?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：贾马尔·柯蒂斯？Curtis怎么拼？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Teacher
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it's C-U-R-T-I-S.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 老师：哦，是C-U-R-T-I-S。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Father
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 父亲：谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everyone and welcome to the Annual Ski and Snowboard Exhibition held from April 8th to 17th. I am Mary Granger, coordinator of the event this year. The 10-day event features many highlights. As a snow sports lover, I know you are looking forward to a great time here. Now I'd like to offer you some practical information about the whole event and what to expect from it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好，欢迎来到4月8日至17日举办的年度滑雪和单板滑雪展览。我是玛丽·格兰杰，今年活动的协调员。为期10天的活动有许多亮点。作为一名雪上运动爱好者，我知道你们期待在这里度过美好时光。现在我想给你们一些关于整个活动的实用信息，以及你们可以期待些什么。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This might be the first time coming here for some of you. So for those who are still wondering about the right accommodation, I recommend Sky Hotel. It has its own health and sports clubs just like most of the hotels here, but I love it because of its incredibly cozy beds which guarantees good rest after an exhausting day of exploration. If you haven't brought your own equipment, like poles, boots and skis, they are available for purchase or rent at Ski Set or Snow Rental.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：对你们中的一些人来说，这可能是第一次来这里。对于那些还在考虑合适住宿的人，我推荐天空酒店。它和这里的大多数酒店一样有自己的健康和运动俱乐部，但我喜欢它是因为它非常舒适的床，能保证你在一天的探索疲惫后得到良好的休息。如果你没有带自己的装备，比如雪杖、雪靴和滑雪板，可以在Ski Set或Snow Rental购买或租赁。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The exhibition this year provides a colorful look into the history of skiing and an inspiring peek into the future prospects of the sport. Apart from the fascinating photo exhibitions and the most up-to-date skiing gear like always, this year we have added four computers which can imitate the process of skiing, ensuring the same physical activity and sensations that appear during the skiing process on downhill slopes. But I have to warn you that it might be quite time-consuming to line up for the free trial experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今年的展览丰富多彩地展示了滑雪的历史，并激励人心地展望了这项运动的未来前景。除了迷人的照片展览和一如既往的最新滑雪装备，今年我们还增加了四台电脑，可以模拟滑雪过程，确保与下坡滑雪过程中相同的身体活动和感觉。但我必须提醒你，排队等待免费试玩可能会相当耗时。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Many have posed the question as to how to enter the skiing and snowboarding competition. Well, rather than filling out the back of the entrance ticket or bombarding the committee with emails, the most effective method is by checking out the exhibition newsletter delivered every month for availability. As the most beloved local event, the exhibition has also drawn attention from the press. Last year, massive media coverage was on the worrisome amount of snowfall. In order to avoid the same predicament, several artificial skiing slopes have been built. With more participants this year, we have lowered the entrance fee which has been widely reported by local newspapers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：许多人提出了如何参加滑雪和单板滑雪比赛的问题。与其填写门票背面或给组委会狂发邮件，最有效的方法是查看每月发布的展览通讯，了解是否有名额。作为最受喜爱的本地活动，展览也引起了媒体的关注。去年，大量媒体关注的是令人担忧的降雪量。为了避免同样的困境，已经建造了几条人工滑雪道。今年由于参与者更多，我们降低了入场费，当地报纸对此进行了广泛报道。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A bonus for our participants is the ski program. It offers a wide variety of lessons and sessions with qualified instructors ensuring that all ages and abilities are catered to from the first timers to seasoned amateurs. I strongly advise you to sign up for the program as it is offering an unprecedented 30% discount. That's mainly because we are cooperating with the program organiser who promises affordable prices only for the participants of the festival this year.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：参与者的一个额外福利是滑雪课程。它提供各种课程和训练班，有合格的教练，确保从初学者到经验丰富的业余爱好者，所有年龄段和能力水平都能得到满足。我强烈建议你们报名参加这个课程，因为它提供了前所未有的30%折扣。这主要是因为我们在与课程组织者合作，他们承诺只对今年的节日参与者提供实惠的价格。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now I would like to introduce to you the list of presentations during the following week so that you can better plan your schedule.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我想向大家介绍接下来一周的演讲列表，以便你们更好地安排日程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first presenter Simon is one of our best ski instructors. As an experienced instructor, he will inform you about the dangers that face skiers and snowboarders. Accidents happen mostly to those who are careless or ignorant. Good risk management involves considering both the probability and consequences of an accident.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第一位演讲者西蒙是我们最好的滑雪教练之一。作为一名经验丰富的教练，他将告诉你滑雪者和单板滑雪者面临的危险。事故大多发生在粗心或无知的人身上。良好的风险管理包括考虑事故的概率和后果。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The next speech titled Solution is given by Jamie Kurt. A list of problems may occur to novice skiers and snowboarders, so he is going to offer useful information for first timers on choosing the appropriate gears, the right dress code and ways of protecting your skin. For instance, some of you may have rented the skiing equipment, but rental footwear is notoriously uncomfortable. Then Jamie will provide instructions to help make your footwear fit better.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下一个题为《解决方案》的演讲由杰米·库尔特主讲。新手滑雪者和单板滑雪者可能会遇到一系列问题，所以他将为初学者提供有用信息，包括选择合适的装备、正确的着装要求和保护皮肤的方法。例如，你们中的一些人可能租了滑雪装备，但租来的滑雪靴是出了名的不舒服。杰米会提供指导，帮助你们的滑雪靴更合脚。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The third speech is about a documentary introducing skiing and snowboarding and the difference between the two sports. It also depicts a group of snow lovers exploring new slopes with breath-taking views. The director Andy Fisher will be there, addressing the whole shooting experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第三个演讲是关于一部介绍滑雪和单板滑雪以及这两项运动差异的纪录片。它还描绘了一群雪上爱好者在令人叹为观止的景色中探索新雪道。导演安迪·费舍尔将在现场，讲述整个拍摄经历。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The fourth talk is about the tricks of skiing, presented by Harry Tyson. It is most useful for those who have already tried skiing, yet still need more practice to master the sport. Harry will teach you how to turn more skillfully. A lot of people can keep their skis roughly parallel but there's no point if you make it hard to work with and slide around out of control. Useful exercises will also be suggested to improve your parallel skiing technique so that you can tackle steeper slopes and enjoy yourself more.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第四个演讲是关于滑雪技巧的，由哈里·泰森主讲。这对那些已经尝试过滑雪、但仍需要更多练习来掌握这项运动的人最有用。哈里将教你们如何更熟练地转弯。很多人可以大致保持滑雪板平行，但如果操作困难、失控滑行，那就没有意义了。他还会建议有用的练习来提高你的平行滑雪技术，这样你就可以应对更陡峭的雪道，享受更多乐趣。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Johnson Smith will be the last presenter, mainly addressing towards advanced skiers. He manages to apply snow climbing into skiing. Climbing in soft snow, you are floundering around. Walking becomes harder, so a good trick during climbing is to maintain a wider gait, approximately shoulder width, so that you are more stable while walking. This works for skiing as well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：约翰逊·史密斯将是最后一位演讲者，主要面向高级滑雪者。他成功地将雪地攀登应用于滑雪中。在软雪中攀登时，你会挣扎。行走变得更困难，所以攀登时的一个好技巧是保持更宽的步幅，大约与肩同宽，这样行走时更稳定。这也适用于滑雪。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Jerry, how did it go with preparing your lessons? Is there anything you would like to discuss?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：杰瑞，备课准备得怎么样了？有什么想讨论的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, this is actually the first time that I have ever taught in an elementary classroom. After 8 years of learning pedagogy, I want to practice what I've learned in an instructive manner, but I'm a bit stuck right now. You know the topic I want them to research is a bit hard for pupils. I'm afraid that they won't be able to handle it on their own. So I need new ideas on designing more effective teaching methods. Mr. Carter, do you have any suggestions?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：嗯，这实际上是我第一次在小学课堂上教学。经过8年的教育学学习，我想以一种有指导性的方式实践我所学的东西，但我现在有点卡住了。你知道我想让他们研究的主题对小学生来说有点难。我担心他们无法独立完成。所以我需要关于设计更有效教学方法的新想法。卡特先生，您有什么建议吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you should probably read this book called Professional Learning, written by J.K. Simmons. He is a professor who just transferred here last semester but is already popular amongst the students for his creative teaching methods. There is an extensive range of learning approaches mentioned in the book including approaches for team research, which might be helpful to you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，你也许应该读一下这本叫《专业学习》的书，作者是J·K·西蒙斯。他是一位上学期刚转来的教授，但已经因其创造性的教学方法在学生中很受欢迎。书中提到了广泛的学习方法，包括团队研究方法，可能对你有帮助。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: You mean dividing the students into groups to do research? I've never thought of this before. How does it work?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：您是说把学生分成小组做研究？我以前从没想过这个。怎么操作？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Professor Simmons has already demonstrated how efficient this approach can be. Basically it aims to increase cooperation between students so they can present the results in a collaborative fashion. It helps them to develop their own voice and perspective.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：西蒙斯教授已经证明了这种方法有多高效。基本上它旨在增加学生之间的合作，让他们以协作的方式展示结果。这有助于他们发展自己的观点和视角。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll check out the book as soon as possible. It seems I can borrow some of the essential concepts and work them into my course design.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：我会尽快看这本书。看来我可以借用一些基本概念，将它们融入我的课程设计。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I was thinking maybe I could use both observation and non-observation as part of my teaching methodology. Could you take a look at my teaching plan?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：嗯，我在想也许我可以用观察和非观察两种方法作为我教学方法的一部分。您能看看我的教学计划吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. What kind of observational methods do you have in mind?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然。你有什么观察方法的想法？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: For the observational part, I intend to include two approaches. First, the pupils can assess each other's behaviour. I feel that reviewing fellow students through criteria-based reference evaluation allows constructive feedback. It can also improve their understanding of the subject material.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：对于观察部分，我打算包括两种方法。首先，学生可以评估彼此的行为。我觉得通过基于标准的参考评价来评审同学，可以实现建设性的反馈。这也可以提高他们对学科材料的理解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a smart move for a large class that would be hard to observe all by yourself. Also, you might want to get the feedback from several different individuals rather than just one. So how do you plan to carry out the peer assessments?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：对于大班教学来说，这是一个聪明的做法，因为靠你自己很难观察周全。另外，你可能想从多个不同的个体那里获得反馈，而不是只从一个。那么你计划如何进行同伴评估呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, every pupil will be required to write a diary, which includes group projects, presentations and in-class discussions. They'll put down their remarks. I'll collect them on a regular basis which can also help me see whether they can keep up or not.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：哦，每个学生都会被要求写日记，包括小组项目、课堂展示和课堂讨论。他们会写下自己的评论。我会定期收集，这也可以帮助我了解他们是否能跟上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good, what else do you intend to do?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，你还打算做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Besides that, I also plan to do video recording. I've already purchased a camera just in case I miss anything important. I can go back and review their performances anytime I want.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：除此之外，我还计划进行视频录制。我已经买了一台相机，以防我错过任何重要的事情。我可以随时回去查看他们的表现。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Would you record every in-class activity?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你会录制每一个课堂活动吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, I'll just keep track of an in-class simulation, which would require every pupil to fully participate. Students will act as members of a City Council meeting, discussing issues like whether or not prohibition should be instated in the United States.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：不，我只记录一次课堂模拟活动，那会要求每个学生都充分参与。学生将扮演市议会会议的成员，讨论诸如美国是否应该实行禁酒令等问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: This kind of teaching method is both inspiring and challenging. I can't wait to see how yours work out. Do you send me a copy of the assessment afterwards, will you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：这种教学方法既鼓舞人心又具有挑战性。我等不及要看看你的会有什么效果。之后你会给我发一份评估副本吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what do you have in mind for the non-observational approaches?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：那么非观察方法你有什么想法？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, my plan is to quantify the statistics. Numbers do not lie. It is the most direct way to measure their performance. See how well they've learned.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：嗯，我的计划是量化统计。数字不会说谎。这是衡量他们表现的最直接方式。看看他们学得怎么样。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Where does the data come from?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：数据从哪里来？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll evaluate the test results including the mid-term, final exam and pop quizzes, which would only take up about 40 percent of the overall assessment.

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds like a lot of tests and assignments. Please remember that you don't want to wear out your students. Keeping them engaged is the key to efficient learning. Once they are exhausted, they just stop trying.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：听起来有很多测试和作业。请记住你不想让学生筋疲力尽。让他们保持投入是高效学习的关键。一旦他们疲惫了，就会停止努力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I haven't thought about that. You are right, I don't want to frighten them with tons of assignments and exams. I'll make note of that. Thanks for the advice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：哦，我没考虑到这一点。你说得对，我不想用大量作业和考试吓到他们。我会记下来的。谢谢您的建议。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: I remember last time you mentioned questionnaires, right?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's true. But it is not for my students. In fact, they have to design their own questionnaires and choose the respondents using the Internet. As a complement of other teaching activities, it would deepen the creative learning process.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰瑞：是的。但不是给我的学生的。事实上，他们必须自己设计问卷并使用互联网选择受访者。作为其他教学活动的补充，这会加深创造性学习过程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Is that all?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jerry

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon and welcome to my talk on urban migration today. The world has experienced unprecedented urban growth in the recent decades. As much as 3% of Earth's landmass has been urbanised, an increase of at least 50% over previous estimates. Today, people living in cities already outnumber those in rural areas and the trend does not appear to be reversing. In addition, cities have larger amounts of carbon consumption than rural areas. This is a result from two major aspects. First, with the increase of urban population around the world, the massive construction of urban infrastructure and residential housing is hard to avoid. Second, urban households have a higher rate of car ownership and use more gasoline products.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下午好，欢迎今天来听我关于城市迁移的讲座。近几十年来，世界经历了前所未有的城市增长。地球上高达3%的陆地面积已经城市化，比之前的估计至少增加了50%。如今，城市人口已经超过农村人口，这一趋势似乎没有逆转的迹象。此外，城市的碳消费量比农村大。这主要来自两个方面。首先，随着世界城市人口的增长，大规模的城市基础设施和住宅建设是不可避免的。其次，城市家庭汽车拥有率更高，使用更多汽油产品。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Even though rural exodus is often negatively judged, there are also benefits of migration shared by the local environment and the society as a whole. Well, firstly, global trends of increasing urban migration and population urbanisation can provide opportunities for nature conservations, particularly in regions where deforestation is driven by agriculture. As rural dwellers leave their homes, local forests are left to recover.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：虽然农村人口外流常常受到负面评价，但迁移对当地环境和整个社会也有共同的好处。首先，城市迁移和人口城市化增加的全球趋势可以为自然保护提供机会，特别是在那些由农业驱动的森林砍伐地区。当农村居民离开家乡时，当地森林得以恢复。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: What's more, it is easier for city dwellers to get around. Living in the country means transport can be very difficult. For instance, after midnight there are no buses or taxis in the countryside. However, there is still a number of public transport modes to choose from in the city.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，城市居民出行更方便。生活在农村意味着交通可能非常不便。例如，午夜之后农村没有公共汽车或出租车。然而，城市里仍然有多种公共交通方式可供选择。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Finally, with more funds and advanced technology, cities endeavour to produce clean energy. New power plants have been built to take harmful methane gas created by the decomposition of rubbish, and convert it into electricity. By doing so, an important greenhouse gas is turned into useful energy rather than being directly emitted into the atmosphere.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，凭借更多的资金和先进技术，城市努力生产清洁能源。新建的发电厂利用垃圾分解产生的有害甲烷气体，将其转化为电能。这样做可以将一种重要的温室气体转化为有用的能源，而不是直接排放到大气中。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The hustle and bustle of city life offers women the opportunity to explore different professions and pursue their own careers. Women in cities work as engineers, managers and even football players. This change of roles has affected their marital status and family life. More women are choosing their careers over marriage, which raises the graph of late marriages. As a result, more are remaining single well into their late thirty's. They want to be independent and earn money on their own. It is also easier for them to get a promotion while working in the city. Women are slowly achieving wider participation at work, while in rural areas the mindset is still very conservative.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：城市生活的喧嚣忙碌为女性提供了探索不同职业和追求自己事业的机会。城市中的女性担任工程师、经理甚至足球运动员。这种角色变化影响了她们的婚姻状况和家庭生活。更多女性选择事业而非婚姻，这导致晚婚比例上升。结果，更多人到了三十多岁仍然单身。她们想要独立，自己赚钱。在城市工作也更容易获得晋升。女性正在慢慢实现在工作中更广泛的参与，而在农村地区，观念仍然非常保守。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: However, cities also change the way that humans interact with each other and the environment, often causing multiple problems. In general, urban wages are significantly higher, so moving to the city is an opportunity to earn what was impossible in rural areas. However, the wage difference is often offset by the higher cost of living and absence of self-produced goods, including subsistence farming. A sizable proportion of new comers attach greater importance to money and gradually abandon their former way of life, thus risking losing their culture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，城市也改变了人类之间以及人类与环境互动的方式，往往造成多种问题。总的来说，城市工资明显更高，所以移居城市是一个赚取农村不可能赚到的收入的机会。然而，工资差异往往被更高的生活成本和缺乏自产物品（包括自给自足农业）所抵消。相当大比例的新来者更重视金钱，逐渐放弃原来的生活方式，从而面临失去自己文化的风险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: These new city residents are also faced with another problem. According to Statistics, crime rates are significantly higher in densely populated urban regions than in rural areas. For instance, property crime rates in our metropolitan areas are three to four times as high in comparison to the rates in rural communities. Immigrants, upon arrival into cities, typically move into the poor, blighted neighbourhoods because that is where they can afford to live. Crime in these areas is high and reflects poor living conditions, as these neighbourhoods experience great levels of poverty. This pattern also occurs for violent crimes, which is much more common in large urban areas than elsewhere.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这些新城市居民还面临另一个问题。根据统计数据，人口密集的城市地区的犯罪率明显高于农村地区。例如，我们大都市地区的财产犯罪率是农村社区的三到四倍。移民到达城市后，通常会搬进贫穷、破败的社区，因为那是他们能负担得起的地方。这些地区的犯罪率很高，反映了恶劣的生活条件，因为这些社区面临着严重的贫困。这种模式也适用于暴力犯罪，在大城市地区比在其他地方更常见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In addition, traffic congestion and industrial manufacturing are prominent features of the urban landscape, which take their toll on the natural environment and those who depend on it. Air pollution from both cars and factory emissions affect the health of countless urban residents.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，交通拥堵和工业制造是城市景观的显著特征，它们对自然环境及其依赖者造成了损害。汽车和工厂排放造成的空气污染影响着无数城市居民的健康。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Rural to urban migration can boost the urban economy. With a better economy, cities provide their residents with better welfare. But the concentration of services and facilities, such as education, health and technology in urban areas inevitably contributes to greater energy consumption. Another problem with life in the city is traffic congestion. It makes people late to work and thus stresses us out before we even get there. Deliveries can't arrive on time. Gas costs money. The quality of life of those commuters starts to decline. What's worse is that if congestion makes it harder to match the right workers to the best jobs, it is economically inefficient, as well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：农村向城市迁移可以促进城市经济。有了更好的经济，城市为居民提供更好的福利。但教育、医疗和技术等服务与设施集中在城市地区，不可避免地导致更大的能源消耗。城市生活的另一个问题是交通拥堵。它使人们上班迟到，从而使我们在到达之前就感到压力。送货不能准时到达。汽油要花钱。那些通勤者的生活质量开始下降。更糟的是，如果拥堵使得将合适的工人与最佳工作匹配变得更加困难，这也在经济上效率低下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning, Sunset Hotel. How may I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：早上好，日落酒店。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. I just saw an advert in the paper about your hotel. Where exactly is it located?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：早上好。我刚刚在报纸上看到你们酒店的广告。它具体位于哪里？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: We are situated on Sunset Avenue, north of the beach. Close to Example many scenic spots, it is an ideal choice for travellers interested in sightseeing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：我们位于日落大道，海滩以北。靠近许多景点，是观光旅行者的理想选择。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great. Is there a vacant four-bed room? We'll be travelling with our two sons aged 9 and 11, so it's best that we are able to stay in one room.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：太好了。有空的四人间吗？我们和两个儿子一起旅行，一个9岁一个11岁，最好能住在一间房里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me check, just a moment...Um, we only have a few four-bed rooms, and I'm afraid they are fully booked at the moment. The earliest time available is August, but there might be some left in July if a previous customer cancels the reservation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：我查一下，请稍等……嗯，我们只有几间四人间，恐怕现在已经订满了。最早有空房的时间是八月，但如果之前的客户取消预订，七月可能还会有空房。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that'll do. How much would the room cost me?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：哦，那也行。房间费用是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's 77.50 euros during peak time, but the price would be much lower during off-peak season. Only 50 euros.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：旺季是77.50欧元，但淡季价格会低得多。只要50欧元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: So if I book a room right now, is there any discount?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：那如果我现在订房，有折扣吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. We do offer a 30% discount for any reservation made one month ahead of schedule. It is a very reasonable price.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：有的。我们为提前一个月预订的客人提供30%的折扣。价格非常合理。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: That does sound tempting. Does the price include anything?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：听起来确实很诱人。价格包含什么吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: The price includes two breakfast vouchers per room per day. You can use them at two different restaurants in our hotel. There's also a 20-minute spa trial available, but you have to book it beforehand at the concierge or directly at the Spa Centre.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：价格包含每间房每天两张早餐券。您可以在我们酒店的两家不同餐厅使用。还有20分钟的水疗体验，但您必须提前在前台或直接在水疗中心预订。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Um, I'm wondering if there is a hairdryer in the room. It takes ages to dry my hair without one. Do I have to bring one?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：嗯，我想知道房间里有吹风机吗？没有的话吹干头发要花很长时间。我需要自带吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, there is absolutely no need to bring that for each room is equipped with a hairdryer. But I have to inform you that towels are not provided. You'll have to bring your own or hire some at the front desk.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：不，完全不需要带，每个房间都配有吹风机。但我必须告知您，酒店不提供毛巾。您需要自带或在前台租用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I see.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：哦，我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Before making a reservation, can you tell me a little bit more about your hotel?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：在预订之前，你能多告诉我一些关于酒店的信息吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, no problem. We aim to please our guests by providing impeccable service and all the modern amenities, trying to make them feel at home. In the lounge, there are a list of books, ranging from contemporary literature to classic poetry, free for any guest to read. There is also a games room offering a number of indoor games including popular board games like Monopoly as well as the beloved Table Soccer. A nice place to go to on rainy days.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：当然可以。我们致力于通过提供无可挑剔的服务和所有现代设施来取悦客人，让他们有宾至如归的感觉。休息室有一系列书籍，从当代文学到古典诗歌，供所有客人免费阅读。还有一个游戏室，提供多种室内游戏，包括流行棋盘游戏如大富翁以及深受喜爱的桌上足球。是雨天消磨时光的好地方。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Are there computers available in the hotel? I might have a few emails to respond to during my stay there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：酒店里有电脑吗？我住店期间可能需要回几封邮件。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm afraid we currently do not provide any for our customers. However, Internet is available within our hotel premises. Just use the room number and guest name to log in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：恐怕我们目前不向客人提供电脑。但是酒店内有互联网。只需使用房间号和客人姓名登录即可。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: That means I have to bring my own laptop then. All right. Um, because I'm travelling with my two sons, is there anything that they might be interested in?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：那意味着我得自带笔记本电脑了。好吧。嗯，因为我和两个儿子一起旅行，有什么他们可能会感兴趣的东西吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, a popular activity here for children is collecting shells on the beach. Our hotel has a private beach. When there are very few visitors, you can take a stroll down the beach with your children and enjoy some quality family time undisturbed.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：有的，这里孩子们喜欢的一项活动是在海滩上收集贝壳。我们酒店有私人海滩。当游客很少时，您可以在海滩上和孩子们散步，享受不受打扰的高质量家庭时光。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sound nice, but you see, my boys really love adventure. Is there something more exciting for them to participate in?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：听起来不错，但你知道，我的孩子们真的很喜欢冒险。有没有更刺激的活动让他们参加？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: We do have bicycles ready for hire. You can cycle with the boys along the bush track by the hotel which is an ideal place to explore the wonders of nature. But because there is only a limited number of bicycles, we apply a "first come, first served" rule.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：我们确实有自行车可供租用。您可以和孩子们沿着酒店附近的丛林小径骑行，那是探索自然奇观的理想场所。但由于自行车数量有限，我们实行“先到先得”的原则。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Got it. I think my boys would love it. How can I arrange the payment then? Can I pay by credit card?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：明白了。我想我的孩子们会喜欢的。那我怎么安排付款呢？可以用信用卡支付吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. We take credit cards.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：当然。我们接受信用卡。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you. You've been a great help.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：谢谢。你帮了大忙。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Receptionist
transcriptSentences.englishText: My pleasure, Ma'am.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 前台：我的荣幸，女士。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: On behalf of Northfield Sports Complex, I'd like to extend our warmest welcome to you all here this evening. I'm George Dyson, founder of Northfield Sports Complex. I am giving this speech today to celebrate a special occasion. We started the business exactly a decade ago, and today we have developed into a large firm with a sizable group of members. We've also been nominated the Most Valuable Company by Green Town at the yearly Business Awards which will be held next week. As experienced and qualified reporters, you are invited here to experience and witness this historical moment of Northfield Sports Complex together with us.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我谨代表诺斯菲尔德体育中心，向今晚在场的各位致以最热烈的欢迎。我是乔治·戴森，诺斯菲尔德体育中心的创始人。今天我发表演讲是为了庆祝一个特殊的时刻。我们正好在十年前创办了这项事业，如今已经发展成为一家拥有大量会员的大型企业。我们还被格林镇提名为年度商业奖的最有价值公司，颁奖典礼将于下周举行。作为经验丰富、合格的记者们，你们被邀请来这里与我们共同体验和见证诺斯菲尔德体育中心这一历史性时刻。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Situated within the campus of Green Town University, Northfield Sports Complex is a modern, refreshing and fully-equipped facility for sports of all kinds. As part of its commitment to the local community, Northfield Sports Complex is available not only to school children but also to local residents. It offers a wide range of facilities including a 25-metre swimming pool, paved walking and jogging paths, a well-equipped fitness gym, all-weather pitches, indoor courts for table tennis, tennis and other sports, as well as a renowned skating rink. Different age groups can all find the right sports to participate in. That's why local residents enjoy working out here. As a result, natives here are healthier than most of the people within our nation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：诺斯菲尔德体育中心位于格林镇大学校园内，是一座现代化、令人耳目一新且设备齐全的综合体育设施。作为对当地社区承诺的一部分，诺斯菲尔德体育中心不仅向学龄儿童开放，也向当地居民开放。它提供广泛的设施，包括25米游泳池、铺砌的步行和慢跑路径、设备齐全的健身中心、全天候球场、用于乒乓球、网球和其他运动的室内球场，以及一个著名的溜冰场。不同年龄段的人都能找到适合自己的运动。这就是当地居民喜欢在这里锻炼的原因。因此，这里的人比全国大多数人更健康。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The whole town is very proud of having nurtured two world champions, who were once both trained right here in our skating rink. Thus it has become the ideal venue to learn to skate and have fun. But what I take pride in most of all is the skating rink that has stirred the interest of boys and girls here in local schools to skate. Since opening, an increasing number of pupils have been paying regular visits to the skating rink.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：整个小镇都为培养出两位世界冠军而自豪，他们都曾在我们这里的溜冰场接受训练。因此，这里已成为学习和享受滑冰的理想场所。但我最引以为豪的是，这个溜冰场激发了当地学校孩子们对滑冰的兴趣。自从开放以来，越来越多的学生定期来溜冰场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A new yoga classroom with trainers will be open next month for mothers with babies. They can bring their own yoga mat and work out together with their babies. This will be a great way for them to get healthy and meet other moms. There will also be a brand new gym open to the pensioners in the near future. Just this month a new swimming pool is open to all fitness levels with special offers for those without a job.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下个月将开设一个新的瑜伽教室，配备教练，面向带婴儿的妈妈们。她们可以自带瑜伽垫，与宝宝一起锻炼。这将是她们保持健康和认识其他妈妈的好方式。在不久的将来，还将有一个全新的健身中心向养老金领取者开放。就在本月，一个新的游泳池向所有健身水平的人开放，并为失业者提供特别优惠。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our complex is open daily from 8 am to 9 pm except on Thanksgiving and Christmas. We intend to extend our business in the coming year. A list of equipment will be put up for sale ranging from exercising equipment like cardio machines to sports recovery and injury prevention facilities.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们的中心每天上午8点到晚上9点开放，感恩节和圣诞节除外。我们计划在来年扩大业务。一批设备将出售，从有氧运动器械等健身设备到运动恢复和损伤预防设施。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Within our complex, we try our best to avoid injuries of any kind. We train knowledgeable staff to guide our clients through correct workout regimens. For those who want to further ensure workout safety, they are welcome to apply to be a member of our standing committee. They are responsible for revising the safety guidelines and supervising its enforcement.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在我们的中心内，我们尽最大努力避免任何类型的伤害。我们培训知识渊博的员工来指导客户进行正确的锻炼方案。对于那些想进一步确保锻炼安全的人，欢迎申请成为我们常设委员会的成员。他们负责修订安全指南并监督其执行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now I would like to introduce some of our most popular sports facilities here at Northfield Sport Complex. Our 25-metre swimming pool is the centrepiece of the complex. Combining modern, bright and airy surroundings with fully up-to-date changing facilities, the pool is excellent for learning how to swim, improving techniques and, of course, competing in school competitions. It is also bookable for private functions, including pool parties, where lifeguards are available.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我想介绍诺斯菲尔德体育中心最受欢迎的一些体育设施。我们的25米游泳池是该中心的核心。它将现代化、明亮通风的环境与最先进的更衣设施相结合，非常适合学习游泳、提高技术，当然还有参加学校比赛。它也可以预订用于私人活动，包括泳池派对，并配备救生员。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next, we have the only climbing wall throughout the whole town. Many would see rock climbing as a type of extreme sport, exposing great risk to those who participate. But actually, under proper guidance and with close supervision by the coach here, it is a perfect sport for the youth to increase their flexibility and strengthen their muscles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：接下来，我们有全城唯一的攀岩墙。很多人认为攀岩是一种极限运动，参与者面临巨大风险。但实际上，在适当的指导和在教练的密切监督下，它是青少年提高柔韧性和增强肌肉的完美运动。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have to mention our skating rink once again. As our most popular facility, it has been prominently featured in a TV commercial we've released recently. There is no other skating rink larger than ours within the whole nation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我必须再次提到我们的溜冰场。作为我们最受欢迎的设施，它在我们最近发布的电视广告中占据了突出位置。全国没有比我们更大的溜冰场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Also, our state-of-the-art gym is an inspiring place to train and keep fit in relaxed and friendly surroundings. The Technogym equipment enables our clients to measure their performance. If you book a one-on-one trainer, he or she might suggest a future training plan and help you train more systematically.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，我们最先进的健身中心是一个在轻松友好的环境中训练和保持健康的激励性场所。泰诺健设备让我们的客户能够测量自己的表现。如果您预订一对一教练，他或她可能会建议未来的训练计划，并帮助您更系统地进行训练。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, Greg. How did it go with the research on renewable energy? Have you found anything?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：嗨，格雷格。可再生能源的研究进行得怎么样了？你有什么发现吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. But I think it's about time we exchange our findings and discuss our next move.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：有的。但我觉得是时候交换一下发现并讨论下一步行动了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: You read my mind. Right. I'll start first. Germany is the very first country I dug into in order to find innovative means of creating clean energy because 15% of its national electricity supply comes from renewable sources. I found that apart from the traditional fossil fuel industry, there's a German firm that has initiated a project using kites to generate power.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：你猜中了我的心思。好的。我先开始。德国是我为了寻找创新清洁能源方法而研究的第一个国家，因为其15%的电力供应来自可再生能源。我发现除了传统的化石燃料行业外，有一家德国公司启动了一个使用风筝发电的项目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Really, I've never heard of it before. How does it work?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：真的吗？我以前从没听说过。它是怎么工作的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: As a substitution for traditional fossil fuels that release toxic gas into the atmosphere, the power-generating kites can function in any weather. Compared to conventional wind turbines, such kites can produce twice as much energy because the overall power density is proportional to altitude.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：作为向大气释放有毒气体的传统化石燃料的替代品，发电风筝可以在任何天气条件下运行。与传统风力涡轮机相比，这种风筝可以产生两倍的能量，因为总功率密度与高度成正比。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds like an efficient way of producing power. Okay, now let me tell you what I have found. There is an American company manufacturing school buses and city buses depending solely on electricity instead of gasoline. The all-electric vehicles can save up to 20 gallons of fuel on a daily basis. This could reduce transport budgets by over $10,000 each year, not to mention maintenance savings.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：听起来是一种高效发电方式。好的，现在我来告诉你我的发现。有一家美国公司生产完全依赖电力而非汽油的校车和城市公交车。全电动汽车每天可以节省多达20加仑的燃料。这每年可以减少超过10,000美元的交通预算，更不用说维护费用的节省了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, impressive. If only there were more of these electric vehicles around.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：哇，太厉害了。要是周围有更多这样的电动汽车就好了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, over the years, South Africa has attached great importance to clean energy. The nation encourages using propane gas, which can either be extracted from natural deposits or be produced organically. It is normally stored in gas canisters as a type of cooking gas. To reduce the number of kitchen accidents, a new type of composite gas canister made of fiber was introduced. It is much safer and less likely to explode even when engulfed in fire.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：嗯，多年来，南非一直非常重视清洁能源。该国鼓励使用丙烷气体，它可以从天然矿藏中提取或通过有机方式生产。它通常以气罐形式储存，作为一种烹饪燃气。为了减少厨房事故的数量，引入了一种由纤维制成的新型复合气罐。它更安全，即使被火焰吞没也不太可能爆炸。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, about the survey, do you have any clues as to what kind of interviewees we should include?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：现在，关于调查，你对我们应该包括哪种受访者有什么想法吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: How about local companies doing business on clean energy products?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：从事清洁能源产品业务的本地公司怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Probably not the best choice of respondents. Remember the last time we asked corporate employees to do the questionnaire, only about 5% of them were actually willing to participate.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：可能不是最佳的受访者选择。还记得上次我们让企业员工做问卷，只有约5%的人真正愿意参与。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: That wouldn't be enough then. It seems we have to drop that idea. Then maybe we can ask the professors and administrative staff here to help us. They could provide their insights and understanding on energy production.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：那就不够了。看来我们得放弃这个想法。那也许我们可以请这里的教授和行政人员帮助我们。他们可以提供对能源生产的见解和理解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: It would be ideal if they would, but I'm afraid most of them are too busy to respond to the list of questions we've prepared. I guess the students here at the university would be more suitable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：如果他们愿意那是理想的，但恐怕大多数人太忙，没时间回答我们准备的问题清单。我想大学里的学生会更合适。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: You're right. And it is a much bigger sample pool too. Also, I think we should include the locals. Their opinion is key to the promotion of renewable energy here in the town.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：你说得对。而且样本池也大得多。另外，我觉得我们也应该包括当地人。他们的意见对镇里可再生能源的推广至关重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: But wouldn't it be difficult to collect data? There's no way the two of us could go from door to door to interview all the residents.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：但收集数据不会很难吗？我们两个人不可能挨家挨户地去采访所有居民。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: There's no need to worry about that. We'll make it telephone interviews. That way we'll have enough time to get sufficient data.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：不用担心。我们采用电话访谈。那样我们就有足够的时间获取充足的数据。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good idea. What should we present in our speech?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：好主意。我们的演讲应该展示什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: Due to lack of media coverage, the majority of people actually have a limited understanding on renewable energy. Most of them aren't able to identify various types of renewable sources. So I feel we could start by clarifying what it is and the benefit of it compared to fossil fuels.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：由于缺乏媒体报道，大多数人对可再生能源的实际了解有限。他们中的大多数人无法识别各种类型的可再生能源。所以我觉得我们可以先阐明什么是可再生能源，以及它与化石燃料相比的好处。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: That makes sense. We could start with wind energy. For centuries, wind has been used to do work. With the help of windmills, farmers used to pump water from wells or turn large grinding stones to grind wheat or corn. The windmills today generate electricity. The only problem is that it might not be windy all the time, so it is crucial to choose the appropriate site for wind farms.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：有道理。我们可以从风能开始。几个世纪以来，风一直被用来做功。在风车的帮助下，农民曾经从井里抽水或转动大型磨石来磨小麦或玉米。今天的风车发电。唯一的问题是可能不总是有风，所以为风电场选择合适的地点至关重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I think we can also include comparisons between clean energy and traditional energy resources like coal, oil and natural gas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：嗯，我想我们也可以包括清洁能源与煤炭、石油和天然气等传统能源的比较。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Maybe we can look into the prospect of these conventional sources of energy. The rising cost of fossil fuels and the threat of climate change is a concern to many.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：也许我们可以研究一下这些传统能源的前景。化石燃料成本的上升和气候变化的威胁是许多人关心的问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: Totally. These traditional resources will deplete eventually. Renewable energy currently makes up less than 2% of the world's primary energy supply, and although growing very rapidly, it is not on course to fill the fossil fuel gap.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：完全同意。这些传统资源最终会耗尽。可再生能源目前占世界一次能源供应不到2%，虽然增长非常迅速，但还不能填补化石燃料的缺口。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Nuclear energy is another type of energy we ought to mention. Nuclear power plants can produce dependable power constantly and release far less greenhouse gases than other traditional power plants. But most people feel that this type of energy is unsafe because radiation isn't easily dealt with, especially in nuclear waste and maintenance materials.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：核能是我们应该提到的另一种能源。核电站可以持续产生可靠的电力，释放的温室气体远少于其他传统电厂。但大多数人觉得这种能源不安全，因为辐射不容易处理，尤其是在核废料和维护材料中。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: What should we end the speech with?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：演讲应该以什么结尾？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Greg
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you heard about a new type of energy called hydrogen fuel? It is an infinitely renewable fuel that doesn't have detrimental environmental effects. The only problem is that it is so expensive that only wealthy individuals can afford it. But I think overall the benefits overshadow its high cost.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 格雷格：你听说过一种叫做氢燃料的新型能源吗？它是一种无限可再生的燃料，对环境没有有害影响。唯一的问题是它太昂贵，只有富人才用得起。但我认为总体上好处超过了它的高成本。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Syria
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think that even though this new type of renewable energy is too expensive to use at the moment, in the long run, its price will go down and become more accessible.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 西莉亚：我觉得即使这种新型可再生能源目前使用起来太贵，从长远来看，它的价格会下降，变得更易获得。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what I'm going to talk about to you today is something called Aquaculture. It has been responsible for the impressive growth in the supply of fish for human consumption. There's also been a slight improvement in the state of certain fish stocks due to improved fishery management. Aquatic food production has transitioned from being primarily based on the capturing of wild fish to the culture of increasing numbers of farmed species.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天我要讲的是一种叫做水产养殖的东西。它为人类消费的鱼类供应量的显著增长做出了贡献。由于渔业管理的改善，某些鱼类资源的状况也有所改善。水产品的生产已经从主要依赖捕捞野生鱼类转变为越来越多地养殖鱼种。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In recent years, a type of genetically-modified salmon has been farmed in the New England region. Produced by a Massachusetts-based biotech firm, this type of fish is engineered to grow twice as fast as its conventional, farm-raised counterpart. As a result, this increases the speed of the local aquaculture industry development and thus reduces the fishing pressure on wild stock. But local residents have expressed their concerns on the potential negative effects on the ecosystem should those GM fish ever escape into the sea. Stronger, healthier and faster growing, these fish might cannibalise others or outcompete wild-type fish for food. Local decision makers and regulators have thus pushed forward a number of measures, making it impossible for most GM fish to mate. A small percentage is able to breed only within confined pools.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：近年来，新英格兰地区养殖了一种转基因三文鱼。这种鱼由马萨诸塞州的一家生物技术公司生产，经过基因改造，其生长速度是传统养殖三文鱼的两倍。因此，这加快了当地水产养殖业的发展速度，从而减少了对野生种群的捕捞压力。但当地居民对转基因鱼一旦逃入大海可能对生态系统造成的潜在负面影响表示担忧。这些更强壮、更健康、生长更快的鱼可能会同类相食或与野生鱼争夺食物。因此，当地决策者和监管机构已经推出了一系列措施，使大多数转基因鱼无法交配。只有一小部分能在有限的池子中繁殖。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Despite the economic boom of genetically engineered fish, culturing traditional types of fish is still mainstream among fish farmers. Most of them prefer fish with special features, such as tuna. It is a source of high-quality protein with almost no fat. It also contains all essential amino acids required by the body for growth and maintenance of lean muscle tissue. With high nutritional value, this kind of fish will always be popular in the fish market.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：尽管转基因鱼经济繁荣，养殖传统鱼类仍然是渔民的主流。他们大多数人喜欢具有特殊特征的鱼，如金枪鱼。它是几乎不含脂肪的高质量蛋白质来源。它还含有人体生长和维持瘦肌肉组织所需的所有必需氨基酸。由于营养价值高，这种鱼在鱼市场上总是很受欢迎。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For the fish farming industry, incidents of fish escaping the farms has been a troubling issue over the years. Due to bad weather, nets that used to hold the fish were often destroyed. Thousands of salmon, worth nearly 220,000 euros escaped from a fish farm in the Norwegian region in July, raising fear that they would breed with wild fish stocks. Cages were thus built to withstand storms. The frames of the cages are made of PE which is dedicated to marine use. This material has trustable strength, resilience and tenacity. To further strengthen it, strong nets without knots are used to support the cylindrical frame.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：对于水产养殖业来说，鱼类逃逸多年来一直是一个令人困扰的问题。由于恶劣天气，用来养鱼的网经常被破坏。七月份，挪威地区的一个渔场有数千条三文鱼逃逸，价值近22万欧元，引发了人们担心它们会与野生鱼类繁殖。因此，人们建造了能够抵御风暴的网箱。网箱框架由专用于海洋用途的PE材料制成。这种材料具有可靠的强度、弹性和韧性。为了进一步加固，使用无结的强力网来支撑圆柱形框架。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A group of small villages on the island of Zanzibar, off the coast of East Africa, have been trying to develop a local aquaculture industry sustainably. They use a land-based production system that is both economically and ecologically sound. Land-based recirculation can control ocean temperature and optimise growth for the fish that are used to warmer water. All organic waste from the fish is held on land, with incoming water sterilised to avoid disease, which has historically plagued ocean-based farms. The lack of disease means that no drugs are administered to the fish. However, one problem facing the villagers is lack of suitable land on the coast for this system. Hotels and beaches opened to tourists take up most of the coastal area. Another problem facing local fishermen is the scarcity of young fish used to breed the species. This predicament stems from overfishing during the previous decades. The local commercial fishing industry has been reduced by fifty percent for this reason and the aquaculture industry has yet to thrive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：东非海岸附近的桑给巴尔岛上的一群小村庄一直在努力可持续地发展当地水产养殖业。他们使用陆基生产系统，既经济又生态合理。陆基再循环可以控制海洋温度，优化适应温暖水质的鱼类的生长。鱼类产生的所有有机废物留在陆地上，进入的水经过消毒以避免疾病，而疾病一直困扰着海洋养殖场。没有疾病意味着鱼不需要用药。然而，村民们面临的一个问题是海岸缺乏适合该系统的土地。对游客开放的酒店和海滩占用了大部分沿海地区。当地渔民面临的另一个问题是用于繁殖该物种的幼鱼稀缺。这种困境源于过去几十年的过度捕捞。由于这个原因，当地商业捕鱼业减少了50%，水产养殖业尚未蓬勃发展。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The government has taken a set of initiatives to safeguard native aquaculture and the fishing industry. An open-air seafood market has been launched. Residents are encouraged to support local fish farming businesses by purchasing marine products. As it turns out, there is a public demand for access to locally produced, sustainable sources of fresh seafood. Moreover, local fish farmers are aided to market seaweed and oysters, both of which have additional economic values. Seaweed is used in various ways in cosmetics. Seaweed extract is often found on the list of ingredients constituting creams, soaps, shampoos, powders and sprays. It is said to be useful in various ways, including the relief of rheumatic pain and the removal of cellulite. Oyster is a source of seafood popular among the local hospitality industry. Served with caviar and champagne, it is one of the world's ultimate luxury foods, appealing to gourmets with its succulent and delicate flavour. It thus appears to have the greatest potential for commercial culture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：政府采取了一系列措施来保护本土水产养殖和渔业。一个露天海鲜市场已经启动。鼓励居民购买海产品以支持当地鱼类养殖业。事实证明，公众对获取本地生产的、可持续的新鲜海产品有需求。此外，当地渔民还获得了销售海藻和牡蛎的援助，这两者都有额外的经济价值。海藻在化妆品中有多种用途。海藻提取物常出现在面霜、肥皂、洗发水、粉末和喷雾的成分列表中。据说它有多种用途，包括缓解风湿痛和消除脂肪团。牡蛎是当地餐饮业中受欢迎的海鲜来源。与鱼子酱和香槟一起供应，它是世界上终极奢侈品之一，以其鲜美多汁和细腻的味道吸引美食家。因此，它似乎具有最大的商业化养殖潜力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Even though the national and international market has shown demand for marine products in Zanzibar, it is still challenging to survive in the competitive modern fishing industry. The government ought to restore the business by encouraging aquaculture, recreation and shipping. First, it could utilise modern fish farming technology to supply more high quality marine products. Tourism is an effective stimulus to boost its sales. And with better shipping capability, more products can be delivered abroad.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：虽然国家和国际市场对桑给巴尔的海产品有需求，但在竞争激烈的现代渔业中生存仍然具有挑战性。政府应该通过鼓励水产养殖、休闲娱乐和航运来恢复该行业。首先，它可以通过利用现代鱼类养殖技术来供应更多高质量的海产品。旅游业是促进销售的有效的刺激因素。有了更好的航运能力，更多的产品可以运往国外。
