transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：下午好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon. Atlanta Travel Agency, may I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：下午好。亚特兰大旅行社，我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: I saw your advert in the newspaper this morning and decided to come over for more detailed information about some trips that you currently offer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：我今天早上在报纸上看到了你们的广告，决定过来了解一下你们目前提供的一些旅行的详细信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: What kind of trips do you have in mind?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：您想要什么样的旅行？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I enjoy surfing very much and want to get tanned, but all my friends suggest either mountain climbing or biking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：嗯，我很喜欢冲浪，想晒黑一点，但我的朋友都建议去爬山或骑车。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: We currently offer all the three types. Even though biking is the most popular type of holiday, it doesn't work for everyone. I think you should follow your heart.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：我们目前提供这三种类型。虽然骑车是最受欢迎的度假方式，但不适合所有人。我觉得您应该遵从自己的内心。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. What are my options for accommodation then?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好的。那住宿方面有哪些选择？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: For this type of holiday, you can choose to stay in a hotel or a self-catering apartment.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：对于这种假期，您可以选择住酒店或自助式公寓。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Can you introduce the hotel package first?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：您能先介绍一下酒店套餐吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. The price for our hotel package is quite reasonable compared with that of your own reservation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：当然。我们的酒店套餐价格与您自己预订相比是相当合理的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: What does the price include?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：价格包括什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: It covers the beachside hotel and free breakfast.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：包括海滨酒店和免费早餐。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good. Does the hotel have any recreational facilities?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好的。酒店有娱乐设施吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, rest assured. The hotel is fully equipped with a pool, a nightclub and a gym. Guests can enjoy a vibrant nightlife during their stay at the hotel. Five-star ratings are common for the hotel's satisfying service.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：哦，放心。酒店设施齐全，有游泳池、夜总会和健身房。客人可以在住宿期间享受充满活力的夜生活。酒店的满意服务经常获得五星评级。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: So how much does it cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：那要多少钱？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it was originally 360 euros for an adult, but we are now offering a Labour Day promotion. You can get a discount of 12.5%. So that's... 315 euros for now, a really good deal.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：嗯，原本是成人360欧元，但我们现在有劳动节促销。您可以享受12.5%的折扣。所以现在是……315欧元，真的很划算。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. What about the self-catering apartment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好的。那自助式公寓呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that'll be even cheaper. But you have to stay in a shared room with other guests. Each room has 6 bunk beds with lockers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：哦，那会更便宜。但您需要和其他客人一起住共享房间。每个房间有6张带储物柜的双层床。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK... I think the hotel is much better. Getting a good night's sleep is critical for a relaxing holiday. I can't stand sharing a room with someone who snores all night long.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：好吧……我觉得酒店好多了。睡个好觉对放松假期至关重要。我受不了和打呼噜的人同住一间房。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Can't agree more.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：非常同意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about the surfing equipment rental? I don't want to bring my own surfboard.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：冲浪设备租赁呢？我不想自带冲浪板。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: You can hire a surfboard by the hour, day or week. Just book it in advance, and it will be delivered to the hotel or even directly to the beach.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：您可以按小时、按天或按周租用冲浪板。只需提前预订，它会送到酒店甚至直接送到海滩。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: How much does it cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：要多少钱？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: It costs 15 euros for a day. But for a week's rental, it's just 75 euros. The surf station also provides surf lessons if you're interested.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：一天15欧元。但租一周只要75欧元。冲浪站如果您感兴趣的话也提供冲浪课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good to know.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：很高兴知道这个。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, there's one more thing you should know. Just in case of an accident during your trip, we recommend each customer to have the correct travel cover in place before leaving home.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：哦，还有一件事您应该知道。以防旅行中发生意外，我们建议每位客户在离家之前购买合适的旅行保险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Please tell me about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：请给我讲讲。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, we mainly offer two types of insurance. The first one is basic coverage. It costs 30 euros.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：嗯，我们主要提供两种保险。第一种是基本保障。费用30欧元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: What does it include?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：包括什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: It covers medical treatment during your trip and things like missing your flight, flight delays and cancellations. But you know extreme sports can be quite dangerous, and therefore injuries during these activities are excluded.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：包括旅行期间的医疗费用以及误机、航班延误和取消等情况。但您知道极限运动可能相当危险，因此这些活动中的伤害不包括在内。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then, how about the other one?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：那另一种呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: The second one is called premier cover. It is more expensive at 42.50 euros. But we highly recommend this one for regular surfers. If you receive an injury or hurt anyone else while participating in extreme sports like surfing, you are fully covered.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：第二种叫做高级保障。费用更高，42.50欧元。但如果您经常冲浪，我们强烈推荐这种。如果您在冲浪等极限运动中受伤或伤到别人，都完全保障。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. I think I'll go with the premier cover.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：我明白了。我想我会选高级保障。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: When your flight gets in, there will be a minivan to pick you up at the airport and take you to the hotel. But you'll have to get to London airport yourself.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：当您的航班到达时，会有小型面包车在机场接您并送您到酒店。但您需要自己去伦敦机场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's alright. I'll just take the airport shuttle.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：没关系。我坐机场班车就行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, I personally suggest you take a taxi. It is much cheaper than other types of transport, including the airport shuttle.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：实际上，我个人建议您坐出租车。它比其他交通方式便宜得多，包括机场班车。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks for the tip. I think I'll book a trip for next weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：谢谢您的建议。我想我会预订下周末的旅行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, how would you like to pay?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：好的，您想怎么付款？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you accept credit cards?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：你们接受信用卡吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Travel Agent
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, we do. But there will be a slight charge on that. If you pay by cheque, there is no extra fee.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 旅行社代理：是的，接受。但会有少量手续费。如果您用支票支付，没有额外费用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Customer
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great. I'll write you a cheque then...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 客户：太好了。那我就给您写张支票……

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: On behalf of our Community Centre, I'd like to welcome you all here today. My name is Mary Lyndon. As you can see here, this multi-purpose hall is a great venue for various events, including banquets, seminars or dances. The centre provides services for all ages. As the majority of you have already signed up for our dance workshops, I'll introduce relevant information first before we start the tour and get ourselves oriented.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我代表我们的社区中心，欢迎大家今天来到这里。我叫玛丽·林登。正如你们在这里看到的，这个多功能厅是举办各种活动的绝佳场所，包括宴会、研讨会或舞会。该中心为所有年龄段提供服务。由于你们大多数人都已经报名参加了我们的舞蹈工作坊，所以在开始参观和熟悉环境之前，我先介绍相关信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, now when participants check in for their first dancing session, they will be given a class list printed with available seasonal classes ranging from Zumba to Ballet as well as detailed descriptions and schedules. The dance studio will also give you a complimentary shoe bag to store your dance shoes. Every week will be a surprise in cardio movement. Our fitness professional will guide you through an upbeat, heart-pumping, lively dance class. Therefore it is highly advised to bring a face towel and a water bottle with you. As things get mixed up easily, you might also want to attach a name tag to your belongings. It will be sent to you by mail in advance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，当参与者第一次参加舞蹈课时，会得到一份打印好的课程列表，上面有从尊巴到芭蕾的可用季节性课程以及详细描述和时间表。舞蹈工作室还会给您一个免费的鞋袋来存放舞鞋。每周的心肺运动都会有惊喜。我们的健身专业人士将带您上一堂快节奏、充满活力的舞蹈课。因此强烈建议随身带一条面巾和一个水瓶。由于物品容易混淆，您可能还想在物品上贴上姓名标签。它会提前邮寄给您。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now let us get a closer look at our dance workshops and its curriculum. There is a list of activities to participate during and after each session. You'll have the chance to make your own costume, but it won't be held until tomorrow. You can also practice dance with music whenever the studio is available. In the first afternoon and evening of your dance class, there will be an introduction to the development of dance for the past few decades. Then we'll warm up with an informal dance. I know you don't have much experience in dancing but we'll get there soon. Rest assured, there won't be a dance test until the end of the course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在让我们仔细看看我们的舞蹈工作坊及其课程。有一系列活动可以在每次课程期间和之后参加。您将有机会制作自己的服装，但要到明天才会进行。您也可以在工作室开放时随时随音乐练习舞蹈。在舞蹈课的第一个下午和晚上，会介绍过去几十年的舞蹈发展。然后我们会以非正式舞蹈热身。我知道你们没有太多舞蹈经验，但很快就会掌握的。放心，课程结束前不会有舞蹈考试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, now a word about the layout of the centre. Our beautiful facility has 25 rooms altogether which are both very functional and aesthetically pleasing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，现在说一下中心的布局。我们美丽的设施总共有25个房间，既实用又美观。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: We are standing here, right at the entrance. To your left you can see two rooms in a row. After each dance session, you are probably soaking in sweat and in desperate need of a shower. Just go straight ahead, turn left, and the shower room is on your left-hand side. If you just want to take a nap, there is a six-bed bunkroom. It's immediately to the left of where you are standing, right before the shower room.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们站在这里，就在入口处。你们左边可以看到两个房间。每次舞蹈课后，你们可能浑身是汗，非常需要冲个澡。直走，左转，淋浴室就在你们的左手边。如果只是想小睡一下，有一个六人宿舍间。它就在你们站的位置左边，淋浴室前面。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: We also have a games room with dartboards, table tennis, pool and card games. It is a good place to have fun with friends. Just take the first right; it is the second area to your right. You can explore it well later during our tour. Further ahead in the corner there are the bike racks. You can either park your bike here or hire one if you want a ride. The first hour is free.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们还有一个游戏室，有飞镖盘、乒乓球、台球和纸牌游戏。这是和朋友一起玩乐的好地方。在第一个路口右转；是你们右边的第二个区域。稍后在我们参观时可以好好看看。再往前角落里有自行车架。你们可以把自行车停在这里，或者如果想骑也可以租一辆。第一个小时免费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, Karen. Hi, come in, take a seat. I wanted to talk to you about this assignment you've handed in. I'll give it back to you with detailed feedback, but first there are a few things I'd like to run over. You know pointers for next time. When you hand in your next assignment, can you ensure that you've gone through these aspects?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：哦，凯伦。嗨，进来坐。我想和你谈谈你交上来的这份作业。我会把它还给你，附上详细的反馈，但首先有几件事我想过一遍。你知道，就是下次要注意的要点。当你下次交作业时，你能确保已经注意了这些方面吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, sure, will do.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：嗯，当然，我会的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, the first thing is your literature review. It was not sufficient enough so I would like to see your book reports to get your complete view. So can you submit those with the next assignment? Then I can find out which parts you've chosen to leave out.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：现在，第一件事是你的文献综述。它不够充分，所以我想看看你的读书报告，以了解你的完整观点。你能在下次交作业时一并提交吗？这样我就能知道你选择了省略哪些部分。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, yes. Sorry, I didn't realise you needed them. It did cross my mind that what I've handed in is a bit thin, but then I started to work on another project and forgot to revise it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：哦，好的。抱歉，我不知道你需要它们。我确实想过我交的东西有点单薄，但后来我开始做另一个项目，忘了修改。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's alright. And I've found some errors, just small ones where you had quoted people but not recorded the information properly at the end. Don't forget to go through and make sure that your references are accurate. They were very relevant, though. Just check and revise them using the format sample that I've emailed you beforehand, OK?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：没关系。我还发现了一些错误，只是小问题，你引用了别人的话但没有在结尾正确记录信息。别忘了仔细检查，确保你的参考文献准确无误。不过它们确实很相关。用我之前邮件发给你的格式样本检查并修改一下，好吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I'll remember to check them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：好的，我会记得检查的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, you made some good points but it might be helpful if you could include a few other examples, just to drive your point home. Don't start writing more paragraphs; just slot them in at the end of what you've already written. Now the thing you have to do, if you really want to get a better mark, is expand the ideas you're presenting. Then your argument becomes more valid.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：现在，你提出了一些好的观点，但如果能加入一些其他例子会更有帮助，可以更好地阐明你的观点。不要开始写更多段落；把它们插到你已经写好的内容末尾。现在，如果你真的想获得更好的分数，你需要做的是扩展你提出的想法。这样你的论证就会更有说服力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Hum, can I talk to you about this presentation I've got to do?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：好的。嗯，我能和你谈谈我要做的这个展示吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure, of course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：当然可以。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: When shall I stage what we've studied? Am I doing it next term? I can't remember what we said.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：我什么时候展示我们学的内容？是下学期吗？我不记得我们说过的话了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the thing is, Marco couldn't do it, so you agreed to do it at the next seminar. So how can I help?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：嗯，问题是，马可不能做了，所以你同意在下一次研讨会上做。那么我能怎么帮你？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Um... actually, I'm wondering what you suggest to be the key part of the presentation. I mean, which part should I spend most of my time on?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：嗯……实际上，我在想您认为展示的关键部分是什么。我是说，我应该把大部分时间花在哪一部分？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a question to the point. Well, you have very little time really, so it's absolutely essential for you to explain the experiment. Of course, you'll have a summary in the handouts you give out but you can still start the presentation with that. It's optional, though.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：这是个切中要害的问题。嗯，你实际上时间很少，所以解释实验是绝对必要的。当然，你发的讲义里会有摘要，但你仍然可以用它来开头。不过不是必须的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: And do I have to give you the abstract first, or shall I just email it to all the students?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：我需要先把摘要给您，还是直接邮件发给所有学生？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Uh, no. I do need to see it first and see if it needs to be polished up. And then we'll get some printouts done. Now, they'll need to be done by 3rd December, so I'll need to see it by 26th November if that's OK?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：呃，不。我需要先看看，看看是否需要润色。然后我们会打印一些。它们需要在12月3日前完成，所以你需要在11月26日前给我看，可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, fine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, and I need to talk to you about where the presentation is going to be made. Given the actual number of participants and audience, we've had problems with the rooms because we'll need something bigger than usual. In our faculty, the only room available is the computer room, which is far from suitable considering the layout of the room, so we'll have to go across the road and do it in the chemistry lab. It's big enough to accommodate everyone and is equipped with the proper overhead projector in there as well.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：哦，我还需要和你谈谈展示在哪里进行。考虑到实际的参与者和观众人数，我们在房间方面遇到了问题，因为我们需要比平时更大的场地。在我们系，唯一可用的房间是电脑室，但考虑到房间布局，远不够合适，所以我们得穿过马路，在化学实验室进行。那里足够大，可以容纳所有人，而且也有合适的投影仪。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, right. And I get a grade for this, don't I?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：好的。这个会打分，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, your first one was graded by your tutor, but this one will be scored by the professor. But relax, the criteria will be consistent, and you'll get an unbiased result.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：是的，你的第一个由你的导师评分，但这个会由教授评分。不过放松，标准会是一致的，你会得到公正的结果。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, and I've sorted out my modules for next year. You asked me to tell you about my choices.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 凯伦：哦，我已经选好了明年的课程模块。您让我告诉您我的选择。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Course tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, what've you decided?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 课程导师：是的，你决定好了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Karen
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it was really hard to determine. Hum, I've already done the Data Collection once, so that wasn't really a choice. I couldn't make up my mind between Language and Society and Communication Skills. I read the syllabuses but they sound more or less the same to me. Anyway, I went for Communication Skills in the end because I know the lecturer. Actually, Social Interaction seems to cover much the same ground, so I didn't bother with that either. Hum, I thought Discourse Analysis looked really interesting. It studies and analyses the texts beyond the literal meaning of the sentences. It looks into the connotation beyond the sentences. And in fact, it also covers a little bit of Research Methodology in it, so I thought I'd do that, rather than the full methodology course. Kill two birds with one stone as it were. And then I fancied something drastically different, so I thought Psycholinguistics would be interesting, unless you think it'll be more worthwhile for me to do the Phonology course?

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good afternoon, this is the 3rd session of the series of lectures on wildlife. For this lecture, we're going to look at two studies on the habitat of birds and protection measures taken in Australia, including the basic methodology and related areas of research.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：下午好，这是野生动物系列讲座的第三讲。在本次讲座中，我们将探讨澳大利亚鸟类栖息地和保护措施的两项研究，包括基本方法论和相关研究领域。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now let me give you some background information about the first research project on birds. The study was carried out by R. B. Cunningham and his team from the Australian National University in 1995. The primary goal was to detect the breeding habits and resting sites of some birds, especially those protected species in urban regions. These species included birds like peregrine falcons and kestrels in Australia. The bird data set consisted of a total of 153 species recorded from 946 sites. One might expect that in order to obtain valid data on their distribution patterns and population densities, researchers had to count through binoculars. Instead, they managed to estimate with various standard distance sampling methods like random sampling. In addition, a mapping system was used to study their companionship behaviour. It recorded proposed birds' nesting sites to monitor the mating behaviour of targeted species.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在让我给你们一些关于第一个鸟类研究项目的背景信息。这项研究由R·B·坎宁安及其团队于1995年在澳大利亚国立大学进行。主要目标是探测一些鸟类的繁殖习性和栖息地，特别是城市地区的受保护物种。这些物种包括澳大利亚的游隼和红隼等鸟类。鸟类数据集包括从946个地点记录的153个物种。人们可能会认为，为了获得关于其分布模式和种群密度的有效数据，研究人员必须通过双筒望远镜计数。然而，他们通过随机抽样等标准距离抽样方法进行了估计。此外，还使用了一个测绘系统来研究它们的群居行为。它记录了提议的鸟类筑巢地点，以监测目标物种的交配行为。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To obtain valid data of birds' whereabouts, researchers attached identity tags to birds' legs transmitting radio signals. The tagging process was done when the birds were between 5 and 7 days of age. After the initial tagging, data was collected from subsets of radio-tagged birds, making it possible to assess the trends of birds over 15 months.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：为了获取鸟类行踪的有效数据，研究者在鸟腿上安装了发射无线电信号的识别标签。标记过程在鸟类5至7日龄时进行。初始标记后，从无线电标记鸟类的子集中收集数据，从而可以评估鸟类在15个月内的趋势。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what did they find? Well, as it turned out, many of the birds tagged had the tendency to nest in the same habitat where they grew up. Their nesting sites were quite varied and included freshwater reed beds, tidal reed beds, agricultural crops and man-made sites. Even though naturally occurring nests were common, birds sometimes accidentally nested in man-made devices like power towers, chimneys and tunnels.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么他们发现了什么？结果发现，许多被标记的鸟类倾向于在其成长的同一栖息地筑巢。它们的筑巢地点多种多样，包括淡水芦苇床、潮汐芦苇床、农作物和人工场所。尽管自然出现的巢穴很常见，但鸟类有时会意外地在电力塔、烟囱和隧道等人造设施中筑巢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This research also studied the impact of humans on bird communities and found out that pollution had contributed greatly to the declining birth rates of some species, which were considered to be extinct or threatened to vanish from the study area. These species are dependent on natural forests because of their breeding holes. They will become extinct when local natural forests continue to be polluted heavily.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这项研究还研究了人类对鸟类群落的影响，发现污染对某些物种的出生率下降贡献很大，这些物种被认为已灭绝或面临从研究区域消失的威胁。这些物种依赖天然森林，因为它们需要树洞繁殖。当当地天然森林继续受到严重污染时，它们将会灭绝。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A number of measures were thus taken by members from local animal conservation organisations to boost their alarming survival rates. Firstly, breeding boxes were placed in trees taking on the role of breeding holes that were contaminated. Protection guidelines were also introduced strictly prohibiting killing, disturbance and habitat destruction.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：当地动物保护组织的成员因此采取了一系列措施来提高它们令人担忧的存活率。首先，在树上放置了繁殖箱，替代被污染的繁殖洞穴。还出台了保护指南，严格禁止捕杀、干扰和破坏栖息地。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A further measure was taken to ensure the safety of birds from wind farms. In fact, birds are sometimes shredded by wind-turbine blades. A great deal of work was done on how to prevent them from colliding with turbines. A case in point was protecting space for bird migration by ensuring that migratory routes were kept free. Falcons generally cope well with wind turbines, but not in weather conditions where visibility is bad. So, with knowledge of how fast falcons fly, bird stations in northern Australia can notify wind farms further south of the falcons' approach so that turbines can be shut down as they pass by.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：还采取了进一步措施来确保鸟类免受风电场的危害。事实上，鸟类有时会被风力涡轮机叶片撕裂。在如何防止它们与涡轮机碰撞方面做了大量工作。一个典型的例子是通过确保迁徙路线畅通来保护鸟类迁徙空间。隼通常能很好地应对风力涡轮机，但在能见度差的天气条件下不行。因此，了解隼的飞行速度后，澳大利亚北部的鸟类监测站可以通知南部更远的风电场隼的接近，以便在它们经过时关闭涡轮机。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then another piece of research was done a couple of years later by Conway in 2006. His team detected the calling frequency of seabirds flying at night. Acoustic signals are important communication tools for birds. These signals can indicate social cohesion, prey location and breeding behaviour. Courtship songs are common among various species during mating seasons. Males produce calling songs that attract distant females, and then courtship songs will induce nearby females to respond.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：几年后，康威在2006年进行了另一项研究。他的团队探测了夜间飞行海鸟的鸣叫频率。声学信号是鸟类重要的交流工具。这些信号可以表明社会凝聚力、猎物位置和繁殖行为。求偶歌声在各种物种的交配季节很常见。雄性发出吸引远处雌性的召唤歌声，然后求偶歌声会促使附近的雌性回应。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Surveyors also took recordings of the sounds of all the individual birds detected. A tablet PC was used to process detailed information like sound pitch, spectrum, length and timing of surveys. To minimise the disturbance on the bird community, all the sounds were recorded from a distance using microphones to detect noise.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：调查人员还记录了所有探测到的个体鸟类的叫声。使用平板电脑处理详细信息，如音高、频谱、调查时长和时间。为了尽量减少对鸟类群落的干扰，所有声音都是通过麦克风从远处记录以检测噪音。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: They found that the probability of call events was much higher for solitary birds commuting early and late in the day. Further analyses indicated that during foraging, the frequency of calls was significantly greater for birds encountering schooling fish, and birds called sooner after a catch in these foraging scenarios, compared with when only single fish were encountered. The results of this study showed that increased calling activity in the presence of more profitable prey could be of crucial importance to seabirds that benefit from group foraging.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：他们发现，在一天中早晚通勤的独居鸟类发出叫声的概率要高得多。进一步分析表明，在觅食期间，遇到鱼群时鸟类的鸣叫频率显著更高，而且与只遇到单条鱼时相比，在这些觅食场景中，鸟类在捕获后更快地发出叫声。这项研究的结果表明，在更有价值的猎物面前增加鸣叫活动，对受益于群体觅食的海鸟来说可能至关重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, does anyone have more questions on...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么，有人对……有更多问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everyone, I'm Dave, the manager of Creton running sports club. Today I'll tell you something about the running competition which will be held next month. transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好，我是戴夫，克雷顿跑步运动俱乐部的经理。今天我要告诉大家关于下个月举行的跑步比赛的一些情况。如我们所知，年度跑步是我们镇上最受欢迎的活动之一，每年都吸引着老少参加。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This year we will continue the tradition, but there're some small adjustments. First about the date, the exact time of the run is still on the first Saturday of May, but we'll inform you in advance if it's to be delayed due to bad weather. In the past few years, the runners have had to complete the distance of five miles, but most people want to do a bit more than that, so we will lengthen it to seven miles this time. Some of you might not be sure whether you can run that far, so you'd better start doing a bit of training.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今年我们将延续传统，但有一些小调整。首先是日期，跑步的具体时间仍然在5月的第一个周六，但如果因恶劣天气推迟，我们会提前通知。跑步过去从公园出发，公园目前正在翻新，所以这次所有跑步者预计在城堡前集合并从那里出发。实际跑步上午9点开始，但跑步者大约8：45开始到达，所以如果你们住得远，有些人可能那天早上要早起。有人问过要跑多长距离。在过去几年中，跑步者需要完成5英里的距离，但大多数人想跑更长一些，所以这次我们将延长到7英里。有些人可能不确定自己能否跑那么远，所以最好开始做些训练。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm excited to tell you that this year we've got the sponsorship from a big company, who has promised to cover all the competition expenses, including the prize for the champion. The runner with the shortest time will be awarded sports equipment worth about one thousand pounds. Each runner will be timed from the starting point till the end. When you cross the finish line marked on the ground of the station, you'll be given a bar code, and you should take this to one of the run volunteers who will scan it. Then you can get your time on the computer immediately. And the volunteers will collect all the results.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我很兴奋地告诉大家，今年我们获得了一家大公司的赞助，他们承诺承担所有比赛费用，包括冠军奖品。用时最短的跑步者将获得价值约一千英镑的体育器材。每位跑步者将从起点到终点计时。当你们越过地面标记的终点线时，会得到一个条形码，然后你们需要把它交给一位跑步志愿者扫描。然后你们可以立即在电脑上看到自己的时间。志愿者会收集所有结果。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you are interested in the run, I suggest you register as soon as possible. The deadline is next Sunday. However, I should tell you this year you can't enrol through the Internet but have to go to the town hall and give all the personal information and sign your name. It doesn't cost anything to register, as I've just said, all the costs related to the competition will be paid by our sponsor. As for the age limit, you have to be at least sixteen, and the top limit is now seventy, though you need to obtain a health certificate from your doctor if you're over sixty years old.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你们对跑步感兴趣，我建议尽快报名。截止日期是下周日。不过我应该告诉你们，今年不能通过互联网报名，必须到市政厅提供所有个人信息并签名。报名不收费，正如我刚才说的，所有比赛相关费用将由我们的赞助商支付。关于年龄限制，你们至少年满16岁，最高年龄现在是70岁，但如果超过60岁，需要从医生那里获得健康证明。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you do come and participate in the run, I definitely recommend that you should prepare an extra pair of shoes, as last year one of the runners got something wrong with his shoes during the running and had to give up halfway through the competition. Besides, a jacket will also be advisable, so you don't catch a cold after sweating a lot during the running. There is no need to worry about snacks or drinks, as every runner will be supplied with chocolates and bottled water.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你们来参加跑步，我绝对建议你们准备一双额外的鞋子，因为去年有一位跑步者在跑步过程中鞋子出了问题，不得不中途放弃。此外，带一件夹克也是明智的，这样你们在大量出汗后不会感冒。不用担心中途的零食或饮料，因为每位跑步者都会供应巧克力和瓶装水。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To prepare for this annual running competition, our club is going to organise a training class for all the participants. In the class an experienced trainer will teach you the professional steps on how to do a running competition, like warming up before running. For those who plan to do training by yourselves, there're some suggestions for you. First, don't just do morning jogging with your dog. Remember that you're going to compete with others. I know some people like to exercise in groups, but it's more effective to run with your friend who can be your rival and stimulate your potential. Then I suggest you make a record of your running time. It can show whether you've made any progress day by day. What's more, you'd better get used to different roads and paths in the countryside or village, as you won't just be running on level ground during the competition. By the way, you don't have to run in all kinds of weather, as I've just said our competition is going to be held in good weather.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：为了准备这次年度跑步比赛，我们俱乐部将为所有参与者组织一个培训课程。在课堂上，一位经验丰富的教练会教你们如何参加跑步比赛的专业步骤，比如跑前热身。对于那些计划自己训练的人，这里有一些建议。首先，不要只是和你的狗一起晨跑。记住你们是要和别人竞争的。我知道有些人喜欢成群结队地锻炼，但和一个能成为你对手并激发你潜力的朋友一起跑更有效。然后我建议你们记录跑步时间。它可以显示你们是否每天都在进步。更重要的是，你们最好适应乡村或村庄的不同道路和路径，因为你们在比赛中不会只在平地上跑。顺便说一句，你们不必在各种天气下都跑，因为正如我所说，我们的比赛将在好天气举行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, that's all the details about the running competition. If you have any other questions, please call our club at 8345 6234. Anyone who is interested in the run, just get started.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好了，这就是关于跑步比赛的全部细节。如果你们还有其他问题，请拨打我们的俱乐部电话8345 6234。任何对跑步感兴趣的人，现在就开始吧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello Tom, sorry I'm late.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：你好汤姆，抱歉我迟到了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Mona, no problem. I heard you've finished the essay for the management course. Which company did you focus on?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：嗨莫娜，没关系。我听说你完成了管理课程的论文。你关注的是哪家公司？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: It was finished last week. I chose the hotel where I interned last summer and mainly concentrated on my work experience there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：上周完成的。我选择了我去年夏天实习的那家酒店，主要关注我在那里的工作经历。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Could you give me some details? I'm interested.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：你能给我讲讲细节吗？我很感兴趣。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, during my three-month internship, I observed every part of the hotel carefully each day and also talked with some of my colleagues. I've found some problems in different parts of the hotel and made a conclusion in the essay. Let me start from the reception desk. I noticed the staff there kept doing the same thing every day, like answering the phone, helping guests with check-in and check-out, etc. There was nothing special for them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：嗯，在我三个月的实习期间，我每天都仔细观察酒店的每个部分，也和一些同事交谈过。我发现了酒店不同部分的一些问题，并在论文中做了总结。让我从前台开始。我注意到那里的员工每天都在做同样的事情，比如接电话、帮客人办理入住和退房等等。对他们来说没有什么特别的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: That must be very boring.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：那一定很无聊。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah I think so. And in the restaurant, the employees told me that they must obey the rules exactly. For example, if they don't wear uniforms during working hours, 20% of their daily wages will be deducted. And then about the coffee bar. During peak hours, I was asked to help in the coffee bar several times, as a shortage of hands always made many customers wait long for ordering, eating or paying the bills. Their own staff could not control customer flow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：嗯我也这么觉得。在餐厅，员工告诉我他们必须严格遵守规则。例如，如果他们在工作时间不穿制服，当天工资的20%会被扣除。然后是咖啡吧。在高峰时段，我多次被叫去咖啡吧帮忙，因为人手不足总是让很多顾客在点单、用餐或结账时长时间等待。他们自己的员工无法控制客流量。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that seems a little messy.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：哦，那看起来有点乱。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, definitely. And the place where I worked was a shop selling towels, and pyjamas as well as souvenirs. Every day I had to be there from 9 am to 6 pm. My duty was to set up the window display and serve the customers. At first it seemed interesting, but later I found this work was a bit tough. Every night when I got off work, I was nearly exhausted. What I wanted was just a good rest and sleep.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：是的，绝对。我工作的地方是一家销售毛巾、睡衣和纪念品的商店。每天我都要从早上9点到下午6点在那里。我的职责是布置橱窗展示和接待顾客。一开始看起来很有趣，但后来我发现这项工作有点辛苦。每天晚上下班时，我几乎都精疲力竭。我想要的只是好好休息和睡觉。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Doesn't sound like an easy job.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：听起来不是一份轻松的工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: It definitely wasn't. Then there was the personnel office. I went there on the first day when I arrived at the hotel. As I was not familiar with everything, I asked the staff several questions. But the employee of the personnel office seemed a bit annoyed and started complaining, which gave me a very bad impression. Lastly, as regards cleaning, it wasn't too bad compared with other parts of the hotel, except the vacuum cleaners, which were probably bought such a long time ago that the sound seemed too loud when they were working. But fortunately, the hotel hasn't received any complaint from the customers so far.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：确实不是。然后是人事办公室。我到达酒店的第一天就去了那里。因为我对一切都不熟悉，我问了工作人员几个问题。但人事办公室的员工似乎有点恼火，开始抱怨，这给我留下了非常不好的印象。最后，关于清洁，与酒店其他部分相比还不算太差，除了吸尘器，可能买了太久了，工作时声音似乎太大了。但幸运的是，到目前为止酒店还没有收到任何顾客投诉。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think you've benefited a lot from the internship.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：我觉得你从这次实习中获益良多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, absolutely. In the beginning, I just wanted to complete the essay for the course. But in the end, I found it has given me some practical examples which are helpful to what I intend to do after graduation, as you know I've always wanted to do something related to hotel management. Due to the time limitation, I still haven't got a clear idea of some specific work positions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：是的，当然。一开始，我只是想完成课程的论文。但最终，我发现它给了我一些实用的例子，对我毕业后想做的事情有帮助，如你所知我一直想做与酒店管理相关的工作。由于时间有限，我对一些具体的工作岗位还没有明确的想法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I heard you're going to give us a presentation of your essay next time in class?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：嗯，我听说你下次要在课上给我们做论文展示？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, actually I'm not so good at giving a presentation. But the tutor says that's just what he wants me to do, to know what is important when doing a presentation, like how to attract the audience, make eye contact and make gestures, etc., and other students can learn from my presentation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：是的，其实我不太擅长做展示。但导师说那正是他想让我做的，让我知道做展示时什么是重要的，比如如何吸引观众、进行眼神交流和做手势等等，其他学生也可以从我的展示中学习。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm looking forward to it. You know, now I'm only in the second year of the course, and I have to write an essay next semester. But I have no idea about where I can do an internship. There're several hotels which I'm interested in. Do you think I should call their managers?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：我很期待。你知道，我现在才课程第二年，下学期要写论文。但我不知道去哪里实习。有几家酒店我感兴趣。你觉得我应该给他们的经理打电话吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I suggest you'd better not because you're more likely to be rejected by them. There is a career office on campus that has got a list of companies offering internship opportunities to students. The office will help you contact where you want to go. You just have to prepare your personal information like the CV. Oh, don't forget to provide a reference from the tutor.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：嗯，我建议你最好不要，因为你更可能被拒绝。校园里有一个职业办公室，有一份为学生提供实习机会的公司名单。办公室会帮你联系你想去的地方。你只需要准备个人信息如简历。哦，别忘了提供导师的推荐信。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! I've got it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：太好了！我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, have you got any plans for your essay?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：那你的论文有什么计划吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've noticed that the hotel industry is developing at a high speed. People are more and more concerned about the quality of accommodation. What I'm struck by is the numerous statistics showing the ever-increasing number of five-star hotels, so I intend to carry out extensive research on this aspect. I'm thinking about using video as a research method, but I haven't decided yet.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：我注意到酒店业正在高速发展。人们越来越关注住宿质量。让我印象深刻的是大量数据显示五星级酒店数量不断增加，所以我打算在这方面进行广泛研究。我在考虑用视频作为研究方法，但还没决定。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think it's an interesting topic. Anyway, if you have any questions later, I will be happy to help.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：我觉得这是个有趣的话题。总之，如果你以后有任何问题，我很乐意帮忙。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tom
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks a lot, Mona.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 汤姆：非常感谢，莫娜。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mona
transcriptSentences.englishText: You're welcome.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莫娜：不客气。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In my presentation, I'm going to talk about salt. In modern times, when we talk about salt, people may associate it with high blood pressure or increased heart risk, and many health experts warn that we should use less salt in our meals and dishes. However, we should not ignore its importance in our cuisine and even in early human history.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在我的展示中，我将讨论盐。在现代，当我们谈到盐时，人们可能会联想到高血压或心脏病风险增加，许多健康专家警告我们应该在餐食中少用盐。然而，我们不应忽视它在我们的烹饪乃至早期人类历史中的重要性。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Salt is one of the oldest, most ubiquitous food seasonings. The taste of salt is one of the basic human tastes. More importantly, salt plays an indispensable role in the health of human beings. For example, it regulates the body's acid-base balance. Because of its importance to survival, salt has often been considered a valuable commodity during human history.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：盐是最古老、最普遍的食物调味品之一。咸味是人类基本味觉之一。更重要的是，盐在人类健康中起着不可或缺的作用。例如，它调节身体的酸碱平衡。由于它对生存的重要性，盐在人类历史上常常被认为是一种有价值的商品。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: This can be tracked all the way back to Ancient Greece, Ancient Egypt and Ancient Rome when salt was highly valued and used as a method of trade and currency. In Ancient Rome, the busiest road leading to the city was the 'Via Salaria', which means 'the salt route' in English. A soldier's pay, which partly consisted of salt, was known as 'solarium argentum' in Latin, from which we derived the English word 'salary'. A soldier's salary was cut if he 'was not worth his salt', an expression still used today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这可以一直追溯到古希腊、古埃及和古罗马，当时盐被高度重视，被用作贸易和货币的方式。在古罗马，通往城市最繁忙的道路是“Via Salaria”，英语中意思是“盐路”。士兵的薪酬部分由盐组成，拉丁语中称为“solarium argentum”，我们从中衍生出英语单词“salary”（工资）。如果一名士兵“was not worth his salt”（不称职），他的薪酬就会被削减，这个表达至今仍在使用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In fact, salt was not only the first condiment discovered but also the first preservative. We know today that food goes bad because microorganisms in the food multiply in abundance, and a high-salt environment is not conducive to microbial reproduction. Extremely high concentrations of salt can even kill microorganisms in the food. The ancients certainly didn't know this, but they did know that 'salted food can be preserved for a long time'.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：事实上，盐不仅是第一种被发现的调味品，也是第一种防腐剂。今天我们都知道食物变质是因为食物中的微生物大量繁殖，而高盐环境不利于微生物繁殖。极高浓度的盐甚至能杀死食物中的微生物。古人当然不知道这个，但他们确实知道“盐腌的食物可以保存很长时间”。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The use of salt as a preservative can be traced to ancient Sweden. At first, hunting was the principal means of livelihood. In this case, meat supplies were unlikely to be frequent. What's more, fewer animals were available for hunting. In order to ensure the supply of meat, many families in Sweden began to raise animals in the surrounding forests during the summer, when the weather was suitable for animals to survive. These animals were fed every day until about three to four months later, that's in October, they were ready to be butchered for meat, and that was the only month when ancient Swedish people had fresh meat on their table. Then with the continuous increase in productivity, people finally had some meat left. However, how to store the meat had become a headache, until someone invented a whole new way to preserve food: salting. People tried to keep meat from going bad by adding some salt to it, and it could be preserved for several months and even years.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：盐作为防腐剂的用法可以追溯到古代瑞典。起初，狩猎是主要的谋生手段。在这种情况下，肉类供应不太可能频繁。此外，可供狩猎的动物更少。为了确保肉类的供应，瑞典许多家庭在夏天开始在周围的森林里饲养动物，当时天气适合动物生存。这些动物每天被喂食，直到大约三到四个月后，也就是十月，它们可以被宰杀取肉，那是古瑞典人餐桌上唯一有鲜肉的月份。随着生产力的不断提高，人们终于有了一些剩余的肉。然而，如何储存肉成为了难题，直到有人发明了一种全新的保存食物的方法：盐腌。人们尝试在肉中加入一些盐来防止变质，它可以保存数月甚至数年。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There was evidence that salt was widely used to preserve meat. Historical documents in 1573 recorded the Swedish king's everyday meals, mentioning that 175 pounds of meat was consumed each year, but over 150 pounds was salty. From this we can clearly see the importance of salt in Sweden at that time. In addition, the documents also noted the annual sales of beer in Sweden soared during that period, and this must be related to high levels of salt in their food.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有证据表明盐被广泛用于保存肉类。1573年的历史文献记录了瑞典国王的日常膳食，提到每年消耗175磅肉类，但其中150多磅是咸的。由此我们可以清楚地看到当时盐在瑞典的重要性。此外，文件还指出，瑞典啤酒的年销售量在那个时期飙升，这肯定与他们食物中的高盐含量有关。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, let's turn to the sources of salt. Where is salt from? Well, salt is common in nature. It has long been found that salt can be extracted from sea water, mineral deposits, saline lakes, brine spring, etc., among which the two most important ones are oceans and basins. On the floor of the latter often lie deserts where traces of salt can be found, such as the Sahara.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在，让我们来看看盐的来源。盐来自哪里？嗯，盐在自然界中很常见。人们早就发现盐可以从海水、矿藏、盐湖、盐泉等中提取，其中最重要的两个是海洋和盆地。后者底部常有沙漠，在那里可以找到盐的痕迹，比如撒哈拉沙漠。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Furthermore, the quality of different salt types varies a lot. For example, salt from sea water is always mixed with impurities, so after the salt is dried, the sediments and other chemicals need to be purified before eating. However, this is not the case with salt from spring water. We can hardly find any impurities, and the salt level is much more concentrated.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，不同类型的盐质量差异很大。例如，海水中的盐总是与杂质混合，所以盐干燥后，沉积物和其他化学物质需要在食用前纯化。然而，泉水盐却不是这样。我们几乎找不到任何杂质，盐浓度也高得多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then how did people distribute salt around the world? Of course, in modern times we have various ways of transporting goods. But in ancient times, it was not the case. Take ancient Sweden we mentioned before as an example. Because of the heavy use of salt in the diet, Sweden could not feed itself and had to import large amounts of salt from other countries. In order to make sure they could buy enough salt from abroad, the Swedish had to attach great importance to shipping and keep it undamaged, as it was the most crucial way at that time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么人们是如何在世界各地分配盐的呢？当然，在现代我们有多种运输货物的方式。但在古代情况并非如此。以我们之前提到的古瑞典为例。由于饮食中大量使用盐，瑞典无法自给自足，不得不从其他国家进口大量盐。为了确保能从国外买到足够的盐，瑞典人必须高度重视航运并保持其完好，因为那是当时最重要方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: While in other ancient countries, in order to distribute salt to other places, groups of men were employed. They put bags of salt on their shoulders or backs and moved them to the surrounding regions. And gradually these people were considered as a mode of transport in early times. Later, with the improvement of traffic conditions, salt trade between different regions was boosted, and long-distance food trade was also promoted, making communication between different cultures more frequent and...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：而在其他古代国家，为了将盐运到其他地方，会雇佣成群的工人。他们把盐袋放在肩膀上或背上，运到周边地区。渐渐地这些人被视为早期的一种运输方式。后来，随着交通条件的改善，不同地区之间的盐贸易得到了促进，长途食品贸易也得到了推动，使不同文化之间的交流更加频繁……

transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, hello. I wanted to enquire about the house you're going to let out. Is it still available?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. May I ask where you heard about it? Was it in an advert?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：还有。我能问一下你从哪里听说的吗？是广告上看到的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right, it was.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：是的，是广告上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, what do you want to know?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I'm going to share the house with two friends. We've been staying on campus, but we're going to graduate, so we need to find a house as soon as possible. Anyway, could you tell me the exact date when we can move in?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：嗯，我要和两个朋友合租。我们一直住在校园里，但我们快要毕业了，所以需要尽快找到房子。总之，你能告诉我确切可以搬进去的日期吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the contract with my current tenant is due next week, on May 3rd. And I need a day to clean and check the things in the house, so I think the house will be ready on 5th May. Is that OK?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：嗯，我和现在租客的合同下周到期，5月3日。我需要一天时间打扫和检查房子里的东西，所以房子5月5日应该能准备好。可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that will be fine. And what we're most concerned about is the rent. We'd like something around 500 dollars a month for each of us, but we could go up to 600 dollars if we have to. But we can't go beyond that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，那没问题。我们最关心的是租金。我们希望每人每月500美元左右，但如果必要可以提高到600美元。但不能超过这个数。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: You are lucky - the rent will be 1,700 dollars in total, which is within your budget. You'll need to pay monthly to me, by cash or credit card, I don't mind. And you'll have to pay me 1,500 dollars as a deposit before you move in. The deposit is as insurance, in case you break something.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：你很幸运——租金总共1700美元，在你们的预算内。你们需要每月付给我，现金或信用卡都可以。你们还需要在搬入前付给我1500美元的押金。押金是作为保险，以防你们损坏东西。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's reasonable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，这很合理。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I nearly forgot. One important thing is that you'll be required to provide a credit check to guarantee your ability to pay the rent every month. This will charge you 15 dollars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：哦，我差点忘了。一件重要的事情是，你们需要进行信用调查，以证明你们每月支付租金的能力。这需要收费15美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. How about the facilities?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：没问题。设施怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: First there are three bedrooms combined with two bathrooms. Then there is a shared kitchen which was refurbished several months ago. By the way, do you cook yourselves?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：首先是三间卧室配两间浴室。还有一个几个月前翻新的共用厨房。顺便问一下，你们自己做饭吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, we like cooking. Do we have to buy our own cookers?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：是的，我们喜欢做饭。我们需要自己买炉灶吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Basic facilities for cooking are available, but if you want a dishwasher, I'm sorry it needs to be added later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：有基本的烹饪设施，但如果你们想要洗碗机，抱歉需要以后添加。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think the basic facilities are enough for us. Is there any place we can park? As one of my friends has a private car.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：我觉得基本设施对我们来说就够了。有地方可以停车吗？因为我有一个朋友有私家车。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, there is a garage which not only provides space for your car but also has a special section where you can do some of your work. It's very quiet for you to concentrate.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：有的，有一个车库，不仅为你们的车提供空间，还有一个特别的区域，你们可以在那里做些工作。很安静，方便你们集中注意力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: It sounds so special!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：听起来很特别！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: There are some other utilities I have to tell you. There is a garden in front of the house, in which you will find some interesting plants and beautiful flowers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：还有一些其他设施我要告诉你们。房子前面有一个花园，里面有一些有趣的植物和漂亮的花。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do we have to take care of these plants and flowers?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：我们需要照看这些植物和花吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you don't have to worry about that. There will be a professional gardener to do the landscaping in the garden regularly. But you do need to help water the grass once a week. Is it a problem for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：嗯，你们不用担心这个。会有一个专业的园丁定期打理花园。但你们确实需要帮忙每周给草坪浇一次水。对你们来说有问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course not. We'd like to do that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：当然没问题。我们愿意做。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Another thing is, in this district every household is arranged with a cleaner responsible for cleaning up the rubbish and recycling, but this service will cost you 15 dollars every month.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：另一件事是，在这个区，每户人家都安排了一个清洁工负责清理垃圾和回收，但这项服务每月收费15美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: What other bills do we have to pay?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：我们还需要支付什么其他费用？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Bills for electricity, water and gas will also be covered by yourselves.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：电费、水费和煤气费也需要你们自己承担。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. One more question, is air-conditioning available in the house?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的。还有一个问题，房子里有空调吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you mean central air-conditioning, I'm afraid there isn't at the moment, but each room has a conditioning unit which is installed on the window.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：如果你说的是中央空调，恐怕目前没有，但每个房间都有一台安装在窗户上的空调。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: That will be fine. Anyway, I think it's a good place to live in. Can we go and see the house, please?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：那也可以。总之，我觉得这是个好住处。我们能去看看房子吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, of course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：是的，当然可以。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: May I have your name and phone number?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：能告诉我您的姓名和电话号码吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I'm Sam Dressler. That's S-A-M, D-R-E-double S-L-E-R.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：好的，我叫萨姆·德雷斯勒。拼写是 S-A-M，D-R-E-双写S-L-E-R。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, Sam Dressler, I've got that down.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：好的，萨姆·德雷斯勒，我记下了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: And my phone number is 6753 4571.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 房东：我的电话号码是6753 4571。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you very much. I'll contact you after discussing it with my two friends.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生：非常感谢。我和两个朋友商量后再联系您。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Landlord
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. Bye!

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student

transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to our radio programme Travel with Me. Today I'll recommend you a fantastic place - it's the theme park in Fun City. It has been awarded the most popular tourist attraction in the city, so just follow me to find something interesting there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎收听我们的电台节目“与我同游”。今天我要给大家推荐一个很棒的地方——欢乐城的主题公园。它被评为该市最受欢迎的旅游景点，所以跟我去看看那里有什么有趣的吧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The park opens at 9.30 every morning. For the first activity, I definitely advise you shouldn't miss the riding in the park. The actual riding begins at 10 am. But I suggest you arrive a little earlier before the opening time; otherwise, there might be a long wait.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：公园每天早上9：30开门。对于第一项活动，我绝对建议你们不要错过公园里的游乐设施。实际游乐设施上午10点开始。但我建议你们在开门时间前稍早到达；否则可能要排很长的队。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: And how much, you may ask, does an entrance ticket cost? Well, there are two types of tickets: Basic ticket and Family-fast-line Track ticket. transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: For today's session we're going to look at the job market and employers' hiring strategies. It mainly takes great people to generate and execute efficient strategies and ideas. In fact, a company's growth is strongly supported by its human resources. Therefore, we'll look at the determining factors for recruitment, the traits of a successful applicant and the possible reasons for rejection. First, let's take a look at the job market for students who have just graduated from secondary schools.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：在今天的课程中，我们将探讨就业市场和雇主的招聘策略。实施有效策略和想法主要需要优秀的人才。事实上，公司的成长得到了其人力资源的有力支持。因此，我们将探讨招聘的决定性因素、成功申请者的特征以及可能的被拒原因。首先，让我们看看刚刚从中学毕业的学生就业市场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, what should they focus on when applying for a job? Is education the most important factor in recruitment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：那么，他们申请工作时应该关注什么？教育是招聘中最重要的因素吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, actually the degree is not that important. It's not the only factor that personnel managers take into consideration. Some employees with years of work experience still have a competitive edge over fresh graduates with a higher educational degree. However, with neither an impressive educational background nor practical experience, secondary school graduates should stress that they have great enthusiasm for work. Employees who are interested in their job often work hard and are willing to take more responsibilities.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，实际上学历不是那么重要。这不是人事经理考虑的唯一因素。一些有多年工作经验的员工仍然比拥有更高学历的应届毕业生有竞争优势。然而，如果既没有令人印象深刻的教育背景也没有实践经验，中学毕业生应该强调他们对工作有很大的热情。对工作感兴趣的员工通常工作努力，愿意承担更多责任。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: What else should they highlight during a job interview?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：在求职面试中他们还应该强调什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it is wise for them to demonstrate that they possess valuable characteristics such as curiosity, willingness to learn new stuff and good interpersonal skills. Companies favour applicants who are easy going and fit in quickly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，明智的做法是展示他们拥有宝贵的特质，如好奇心、愿意学习新事物和良好的人际交往能力。公司偏爱随和、能快速融入的申请者。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. But I guess things get harder for women to re-enter the workforce and reconnect after raising children at home.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：好的。但我猜女性在家养育孩子后重新进入职场并重新建立联系会困难得多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Absolutely. After taking an extended absence from work, women with young children have to strike a good balance between work and family. Changes have to be made within the family to ensure they have sufficient working hours. Apart from that, they are working with totally new colleagues in an unfamiliar workplace. After even two or three years of absence, they face challenges of rusty or obsolete skills. Even though they're quite confident in themselves, they often find it hard to adapt to these changes. But on the other hand, many employers find these mature women valuable assets in the workplace. They are excellent role models for younger employees as being quite motivated and with a strong work ethic.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：当然。在长期离开工作岗位后，有年幼孩子的女性必须在工作和家庭之间取得良好的平衡。家庭内部必须做出改变，以确保她们有足够的工作时间。除此之外，她们在陌生的工作场所与新同事共事。即使离开两三年，她们也面临技能生疏或过时的挑战。即使她们对自己很有信心，也常常发现很难适应这些变化。但另一方面，许多雇主认为这些成熟的女性是工作场所的宝贵财富。她们是年轻员工的优秀榜样，因为她们积极性高，有很强的职业道德。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Um... Indeed, employers not only need qualified but also flexible and well-trained employees. Given the experience, perspectives and stability, these women are offered unique opportunities in today's workplace.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：嗯……确实，雇主不仅需要合格的员工，还需要灵活且训练有素的员工。鉴于她们的经验、视角和稳定性，这些女性在今天的职场中获得独特的机会。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, exactly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的，完全正确。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what kind of people do companies generally find unwelcoming? Will they consider candidates from a rival company?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：那么公司一般不喜欢什么样的人？他们会考虑来自竞争公司的候选人吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, actually, hiring employees from a competing firm is not a taboo. Highly skilled workers are always welcomed no matter where they're from. What concerns employers the most is how they left the previous company that they had worked for years. If they have been fired, they must have done something wrong during the previous job.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，实际上，从竞争公司招聘员工并不是禁忌。高技能工人无论来自哪里都受欢迎。雇主最担心的是他们是如何离开工作多年的前公司的。如果被解雇，他们一定在上一份工作中做错了什么。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about people who remain unemployed for a considerable period of time?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：那长期失业的人呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, this type of employee isn't at the bottom of the employment list. The reason why they remain unemployed is the key. Most companies cast doubts on applicants who left the job simply because they didn't like the working hours or the work assigned.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，这类员工并非处于就业名单的最底层。他们为什么长期失业是关键。大多数公司对仅仅因为不喜欢工作时间或分配的工作而辞职的申请者持怀疑态度。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you read any articles about worker retrenchment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你读过关于裁员的文章吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. Worker retrenchment on a massive scale is sometimes introduced as one of the short-term measures to resuscitate the industry through the reduction of overhead costs. Workers are also laid-off as companies restructure and reform. But what happens to these retrenched workers afterwards? Is it easy for them to find another job?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：是的。大规模裁员有时被作为通过降低间接成本来重振行业的短期措施之一。在公司重组和改革时，工人也会被解雇。但这些被裁员的工人之后会怎样？他们容易找到另一份工作吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, generally companies are reluctant to hire them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，总的来说公司不愿意雇用他们。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that? They must have plenty of work experience in the previous industry. Isn't that a strength for them in the job market?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：为什么？他们在之前的行业一定有丰富的工作经验。那难道不是他们在就业市场的优势吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, new industries are eager to hire experienced workers, but retrenched workers know nothing about other industries. And it also costs employers more to retrain them. They need training courses to acquire relevant skills and qualifications for a new career.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：实际上，新行业渴望雇用有经验的工人，但被裁员的工人对其他行业一无所知。而且重新培训他们的成本也更高。他们需要培训课程来获得新职业所需的技能和资格。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our government is providing public training programs to help them identify their current skills and acquire new skills to improve their career options. Isn't that right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：我们的政府正在提供公共培训项目来帮助他们识别现有技能并获得新技能，以改善他们的职业选择。对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. But retrenched workers are generally too old. They are less motivated and energized at work. Companies thus prefer younger employees to them. They are also reluctant to adjust and are unwilling to be retrained.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的。但被裁员的工人通常年龄太大。他们在工作中动力和精力都不足。因此公司更青睐年轻的员工。他们也不愿意调整，不愿意接受再培训。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do retrenched workers from companies with big names have an advantage over other job applicants?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：来自知名公司的被裁员工比其他求职者有优势吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. Employers today value skills more than where they're previously from.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不。今天的雇主更看重技能，而不是他们之前来自哪里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. So what are the most common factors of rejection during application?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：好的。那么申请中被拒的最常见因素是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Applicants are rejected mainly for three reasons. First, they have experience and skills that are irrelevant to the industry. Even experienced workers may receive rejection letters. Wearing appropriate clothes and how they look during an interview are key to a successful interview. No matter how good their presentation skills are, a shirt with stains or informal clothes like a pair of jeans only means the applicants aren't taking the interview seriously.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：申请者被拒主要有三个原因。首先，他们的经验和技能与行业无关。即使是有经验的工人也可能收到拒信。穿着合适的衣服和面试时的形象是成功面试的关键。无论他们的表达能力有多好，带有污渍的衬衫或牛仔裤等非正式服装只意味着申请者没有认真对待面试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, during an interview, formal dress is key to a good start and will inevitably affect how people evaluate you later. What's the third factor? Let me guess, is it interpersonal skills?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：是的，面试中，正式着装是良好开头的关键，并且会不可避免地影响人们之后对你的评价。第三个因素是什么？让我猜猜，是人际交往能力吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. Companies are eager to hire people who can work well with others and fit in quickly. It's difficult to work in an environment full of conflicts. Therefore, people who don't get along well with others are often rejected.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的。公司渴望雇用能与他人良好合作并能快速融入的人。在一个充满冲突的环境中工作是很困难的。因此，与他人相处不好的人经常被拒绝。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sansa
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 桑莎：我明白了……

What happened to organic farming in India?”
A. Yields increased.

Conclusion in an intemational organic farming review focuses on

According to the speaker, what is the main advantage of organic farming?

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi everyone, what I'm going to talk about today is organic farming. Let's first look at what organic farming is. It can be defined as one or more systems of production, which don't use synthetic fertilisers, man-made pesticides, herbicides, antibiotics or livestock feed additives to grow crops and raise animals.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家好，今天我要讲的是有机农业。我们先来看看什么是有机农业。它可以被定义为一种或多种生产系统，不使用合成肥料、人造杀虫剂、除草剂、抗生素或牲畜饲料添加剂来种植作物和饲养动物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Virtually all organic farmers prefer to use renewable resources and recycling to give what conventional farmers might consider waste back to the soil of Mother Nature. From this we can see organic farming is a sustainable production system, which is one of its advantages. Organic farmers use numerous techniques to promote the quality of life of plants and animals within existing ecosystems and minimise pollution that occurs with all conventional farming practices.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：实际上所有有机农民都倾向于使用可再生资源和回收利用，将传统农民可能认为的废物归还给大自然母亲的土地。由此我们可以看出，有机农业是一种可持续的生产系统，这是它的优势之一。有机农民使用多种技术在现有生态系统内促进动植物的生活质量，并最大限度地减少所有传统耕作方式中出现的污染。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Another benefit is that, with the increasing consumer demand for a healthier, more nutritionally-balanced product, the sales of organically produced food are promoted. According to the research, it has become the fastest growing sector of agriculture and has shown an annual increase of at least 20 percent during the last 6 years.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：另一个好处是，随着消费者对更健康、营养更均衡产品的需求增加，有机食品的销售得到了促进。根据研究，它已成为农业增长最快的领域，在过去6年中每年至少增长20%。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: What's more, both chemical fertilisers and synthetic pesticides consume non-renewable resources such as oil and coal, but the development of organic farming can lower the demand for these fertilisers and pesticides, so it is conducive to the conservation of essential energy. At the same time, it also can reduce industrial pollution caused by the production of these chemical substances.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：更重要的是，化肥和合成杀虫剂都消耗石油和煤炭等不可再生资源，但有机农业的发展可以降低对这些肥料和杀虫剂的需求，因此有利于节约基本能源。同时，它也可以减少生产这些化学物质造成的工业污染。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Organic farming differs greatly from the traditional one in a number of ways. Let's discuss it from the perspective of agricultural biodiversity firstly. For instance, earthworms are an important indicator of soil fertility. Studies have shown that the density and species number of earthworms in organically managed soils are three times as high as those in conventional fields. Moreover, the biodiversity in organic farming can also be reflected in the number of insects, which is twice as many as those in traditional farms. This might be highly related to the fact that organic vegetables are grown without any human-made pesticides, making these vegetables more likely to be damaged.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有机农业与传统农业在许多方面有很大不同。首先让我们从农业生物多样性的角度来讨论。例如，蚯蚓是土壤肥力的重要指标。研究表明，有机管理土壤中蚯蚓的密度和物种数量是传统田地的三倍。此外，有机农业中的生物多样性也可以反映在昆虫数量上，是传统农场的两倍。这可能与有机蔬菜的种植不使用任何人造杀虫剂有关，使这些蔬菜更容易受到损害。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The other main difference between organic and traditional farming lies in crop yields, one of the biggest concerns of organic farmers. Organic farms, though possibly well adapted for certain local environments, produce less food per unit of land. For example, organic vegetables like tomatoes and potatoes yielded are 40 percent less than conventional ones. In addition, research has also found the number of weeds produced in winter is about 90 percent at present, which has decreased by 10 percent than before. However, lower crop yields in organic farming are still inevitable at the moment.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有机农业和传统农业之间的另一个主要区别在于作物产量，这是有机农民最关心的问题之一。有机农场虽然可能很好地适应某些当地环境，但单位土地生产的食物较少。例如，有机蔬菜如番茄和土豆的产量比传统蔬菜少40%。此外，研究还发现目前冬季产生的杂草数量约为90%，比以前减少了10%。然而，目前有机农业较低的作物产量仍然是不可避免的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Anyway, organic farming is a new direction for agricultural development. These days a variety of organic products are cultivated not only for humans but also for animals, e.g., organic grass. It is commonly used in organic farms to feed cows. Because of the non-use of synthetic fertilisers or pesticides, it can protect cows from diseases brought by large-scale breeding, thus ensuring the quality of raw milk. But an interesting phenomenon is that its production has remained constant these years, which is quite unique compared with other types of crops.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：总之，有机农业是农业发展的一个新方向。如今，各种有机产品不仅为人类种植，也为动物种植，例如有机草料。它通常被用于有机农场喂牛。由于不使用合成肥料或杀虫剂，它可以保护奶牛免受大规模养殖带来的疾病，从而确保原奶的质量。但一个有趣的现象是，它的产量近年来保持不变，与其他类型的作物相比相当独特。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Research on organic farming has covered various aspects and involved many countries. According to one study, organic farming was proposed in India in the early 1960s, when it was faced with acute shortages of food grains due to the ever-increasing population and natural disasters. Although it could not be applied successfully at first, as farmers had been familiar with conventional instructions, proponents of organic farming claimed that organic agriculture emphasised biodiversity, and effective soil management could enhance the capacity to mitigate and even reverse the effects of climate change. So, India needed organic farming along with modern scientific agriculture. The study shows that in 2016 India became the country with the largest number of organic products, and the production of crops kept growing year on year.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：关于有机农业的研究涵盖了各个方面，涉及许多国家。根据一项研究，有机农业于20世纪60年代初在印度被提出，当时由于人口持续增长和自然灾害，印度面临严重的粮食短缺。虽然最初未能成功应用，因为农民已经熟悉传统方法，但有机农业的支持者声称，有机农业强调生物多样性，有效的土壤管理可以增强缓解甚至逆转气候变化影响的能力。因此，印度需要有机农业与现代科学农业相结合。研究表明，2016年印度成为有机产品数量最多的国家，作物产量逐年增长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Another international review about organic farming presents in the first part that people today have become increasingly interested in organic food, and this opinion is quite the same as that of other articles. But what impressed me most was the volume of the investigation the author did in different countries. He conducted a survey in 99 countries, of which 66 are convinced that organic farming is beneficial to animals, while 8 hold the opposite opinion, and the remaining 25 say it is inconclusive. Therefore, the last part of the review is mainly talking about whether organic farming brings positive effects to animals.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：另一篇关于有机农业的国际综述在第一部分指出，今天的人们对有机食品越来越感兴趣，这一观点与其他文章相同。但给我印象最深的是作者在不同国家所做的调查量。他在99个国家进行了调查，其中66个国家相信有机农业对动物有益，8个国家持相反意见，其余25个国家表示尚无定论。因此，综述的最后部分主要讨论有机农业是否对动物带来积极影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: We can see there are different views about the advantages of organic farming. Some may think it can provide more nutritious and healthier food; others may say it can protect the natural environment and benefit wildlife. However, as far as I'm concerned, it's you - the ones who buy organic products - that will decide what they can bring to you because market demand determines everything.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们可以看到关于有机农业的优势有不同的观点。有些人可能认为它能提供更有营养和更健康的食物；另一些人可能说它能保护自然环境，有益于野生动物。然而，在我看来，是你们——购买有机产品的人——将决定它们能给你们带来什么，因为市场需求决定一切。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's all I want to say, now let's open it up for discussion.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，这就是我想说的全部内容，现在让我们开始讨论。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. Community Learning Centre. What can I do for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：早上好。社区学习中心。我能为您做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, hello. I'm calling about the sports photography course you offer. I learned about it from an advert somewhere in the newspaper.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：哦，你好。我打电话来咨询你们提供的体育摄影课程。我是从报纸上某处广告得知的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, may I have your name, please?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：好的，能告诉我您的名字吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's Chris Johnson.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：克里斯·约翰逊。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you, Mr. Johnson. Is there anything in particular you would like to know?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：谢谢您，约翰逊先生。您有什么特别想了解的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. I'm eager to improve my photography skills. You know, my son has just joined the school football team this semester, and I want to keep a visual record of all these precious moments. But when I took shots, they were often too blurry. You see, I'm no expert. So I'd like to find out about the level of the course to see if it's suitable for me.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：有的。我很想提高我的摄影技巧。你知道，我儿子这学期刚加入学校足球队，我想把所有珍贵的时刻都记录下来。但我拍照时经常拍得很模糊。你看，我不是专家。所以我想了解课程的水平，看看是否适合我。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, this course is intended for beginners only. But there will be an advanced course for experienced photographers next semester.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：嗯，这门课程只面向初学者。但下学期会有一个针对有经验摄影师的高级课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good to know. I think this course works for me just fine. Do I have to go for an interview to register?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：很高兴知道这个。我觉得这门课正合适我。我需要参加面试才能注册吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is no need to do that. We have plenty of vacancies right now. So if you plan to register, I can sign you up over the phone.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：不需要。我们现在有很多空缺。所以如果您打算报名，我可以在电话里帮您注册。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great. But before that, how much does it cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：太好了。但在此之前，费用是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Official
transcriptSentences.englishText: It was 45 dollars last year for a single student. Luckily, this year we have more funding, so the price has gone down to 38 dollars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 工作人员：去年单个学生是45美元。幸运的是，今年我们有了更多资金，所以价格降到了38美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, good. So when will the next course start?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：哦，太好了。那么下一期课程什么时候开始？
