transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to the State Museum, situated in the centre of this truly multi-cultural metropolis which is home to more than 30 different nationalities. The museum has a number of exciting displays and exhibitions. And this audio guide is designed to help you fully enjoy your visit. There are 15 galleries in total, and this season sees the opening of three new exhibitions. We suggest that you start your tour with these highlights of the season.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎来到州立博物馆，它位于这座真正多元文化的大都市中心，这座城市拥有30多个不同的民族。博物馆有许多令人兴奋的展品和展览。这个语音导览旨在帮助您充分享受参观过程。总共有15个展厅，本季度有三个新展览开幕。我们建议您从本季度的这些亮点开始您的参观。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The Heritage Clothes Exhibition is located in Gallery 3 of the museum. People who live in the area have spent two years preparing this exhibition, which brings together some of the fascinating garments, traditionally worn in their own communities. They looked into the history of their communities' clothing traditions and the customs and rituals related to them. Overall, there are 16 countries from five continents being represented.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：传统服饰展览位于博物馆3号展厅。居住在该地区的人们花了两年时间准备这个展览，汇集了他们在自己社区中传统穿着的一些迷人服装。他们研究了社区服装传统的历史以及与它们相关的习俗和仪式。总共有来自五大洲的16个国家参展。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The photos that accompany each exhibit were taken by some of the city's college students who are studying design and show the clothes being modelled by the real people who wear them in the course of their everyday lives.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：每个展品附带的照片是由该市一些学习设计的大学生拍摄的，展示了这些服装由在日常生活中穿着它们的真实人物进行展示。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Another remarkable highlight of the season is the exhibition known as "Toys from the Past", which can be visited in Gallery 9. This exhibition appealing to people of all ages is on tour throughout the country and will be here for ten weeks only. Items on display include dolls produced over a century ago with beautiful porcelain faces and, in some cases, real hair. The whole collection covers antique toys such as wooden train sets from many different generations and offers plenty of fun to children and adults. The gigantic board games laid out on the gallery floor are among the most popular activities in the exhibition and should not be missed.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：本季度的另一个显著亮点是名为“过去的玩具”的展览，位于9号展厅。这个吸引各个年龄段的展览正在全国巡回展出，在这里只展出十周。展出的物品包括一个多世纪前生产的瓷娃娃，有着漂亮的瓷质面孔，有些还有真发。整个收藏涵盖了不同年代的木制火车套装等古董玩具，为儿童和成人带来许多乐趣。展馆地板上摆放的巨大棋盘游戏是展览中最受欢迎的活动之一，不容错过。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: A special display of miniature toys brings this exhibition to an end. These small objects are on loan from countries all over the world, some of which measure no more than a few centimetres. There is a tiny car made from match sticks, a toy aeroplane with the pilot and passengers made out of seashells and some delicate mini houses no higher than 4 centimetres.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：一个特别的微型玩具展示为这个展览画上句号。这些小物件是从世界各国借来的，有些尺寸不超过几厘米。有用火柴棍制成的小汽车，有一个由贝壳制成的飞行员和乘客的玩具飞机，还有一些不超过4厘米高的精致小房子。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The final highlight of the season is the Biscuit Gallery No.15. About two decades ago, this city was renowned for its biscuits, although today the factory no longer exists. Did you know, for example, that before biscuits were wrapped in paper or cardboard boxes, biscuit tins were fashion items?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：本季度的最后一个亮点是15号饼干展厅。大约二十年前，这座城市以饼干闻名，尽管现在工厂已经不复存在。例如，你知道在饼干用纸或纸板盒包装之前，饼干罐是时尚物品吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The factory manufactured round, square, triangular and hexagonal tins for a whole range of different occasions to celebrate national events, festivals, famous faces, etc. One fascinating exhibition displays people's favourite biscuits. There are sweet biscuits and savoury ones, biscuits filled with jam and biscuits filled with currants, biscuits with coloured toppings from sugar icing to chocolate sprinkles. When the factory finally closed, it announced that people's favourite biscuit was not as you might expect a chocolate biscuit or one filled with jam and cream, but a plain savoury one which was eaten with cheese.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这家工厂生产圆形、方形、三角形和六角形的罐子，用于各种不同场合，庆祝国家事件、节日、名人等。一个引人入胜的展览展示了人们最喜欢的饼干。有甜饼干和咸饼干，有果酱夹心饼干和葡萄干夹心饼干，还有从糖霜到巧克力碎等各种彩色装饰的饼干。当工厂最终关闭时，它宣布人们最喜欢的饼干不是你可能期待的巧克力饼干或果酱奶油夹心饼干，而是一种普通的咸饼干，搭配奶酪食用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: When you get to the end of the exhibition, there is an entertaining hands-on activity to fill your own biscuit tin. All the biscuits ever produced by the company are piled up on the table along with various tins. These biscuit replicas are made out of thin pieces of wood, but the weight, colours and shapes highly resemble the original biscuits. Your job is to fill the tin with biscuits, and when the lid is taken off, the biscuits are neatly placed as if the job were performed by a machine. It may not be as easy as it seems.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：当您走到展览尽头时，有一个有趣的动手活动——装满您自己的饼干罐。该公司曾经生产过的所有饼干都堆在桌子上，旁边有各种罐子。这些饼干复制品是用薄木片制成的，但重量、颜色和形状高度模仿原始饼干。您的任务是用饼干装满罐子，当盖子取下时，饼干整齐排列，仿佛是由机器完成的。这可能不像看起来那么容易。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you would like to buy a memento of your visit, there is a museum gift shop which sells postcards, souvenirs and hand-made pottery next to the information desk on the ground floor. And finally, if you don't want to carry your coats and bags around with you during your visit, please make use of the complimentary lockers provided by the museum. Enjoy your visit!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果您想购买参观纪念品，一楼咨询台旁边有一个博物馆礼品店，出售明信片、纪念品和手工陶器。最后，如果您不想在参观期间随身携带外套和包，请使用博物馆提供的免费储物柜。祝您参观愉快！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. In today's lecture, we're going to look at the Cube Houses, an iconic architectural complex in Rotterdam. First, I'm going to be telling you about the history behind it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：早上好。在今天的讲座中，我们将研究立方体屋，这是鹿特丹的一个标志性建筑群。首先，我将告诉你们它背后的历史。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As many may know, not much survived the bombing of Rotterdam during World War II, and it took a long while for the city to start the urban regeneration project. Dutch architect Piet Blom designed Rotterdam's Cube Houses in the late-'70s at the request of the city's planners. He had previously experimented with cubic architecture in the city of Helmond. So when he was offered this project in the Oude Haven area of the city, he decided to expand upon his original idea. Blom believed that urban communities should live together under an urban roof. He designed the Cube Houses to recreate daily life in a village where individuals are closely connected and yet have their own separate space. And even after more than 30 years, the Cube Houses remain one of the city's most eye-catching developments. It's easy to see why: these striking homes are cubes tilted 45-degree on their side. The result is buildings that look, feel and behave unlike anything you'll find elsewhere in the world.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：众所周知，鹿特丹在二战轰炸中幸存下来的建筑不多，这座城市花了很长时间才开始城市更新项目。荷兰建筑师皮特·布洛姆在70年代末应城市规划者的要求设计了鹿特丹的立方体屋。他之前在海尔蒙德市尝试过立方体建筑。所以当他在该市的欧德哈文地区获得这个项目时，他决定扩展他最初的想法。布洛姆认为城市社区应该生活在一个城市屋顶下。他设计立方体屋是为了重现一个村庄的日常生活，在那里人们紧密相连，但又各自拥有独立的空间。即使在30多年后，立方体屋仍然是该市最引人注目的建筑之一。原因显而易见：这些引人注目的房屋是倾斜45度的立方体。结果是这些建筑在外观、感觉和行为上都与世界上任何其他建筑不同。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The concept behind these houses is that each elevated cube seems like a tree. And collectively, the Cube Houses are in the shape of a forest with each triangular roof representing a treetop. Interestingly, these houses are located right over a pedestrian bridge across one of the busiest streets into the city centre next to a railway station. The traffic-free area that connects the cubes includes a little children's playground, as well as small offices and studios. With thriving restaurants and cafés right on the doorstep, they were designed with the community very much in mind. However, the cube housing's development endured various challenges and complications during design and construction, and it once stopped as the designer had difficulty in finance. Luckily, the project resumed within 2 weeks after the designer received another round of grants from the city council.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这些房屋背后的概念是，每个抬高的立方体看起来像一棵树。整体上，立方体屋呈森林形状，每个三角形屋顶代表树梢。有趣的是，这些房屋位于一座人行桥上方，横跨通往市中心最繁忙的街道之一，靠近火车站。连接立方体的无车区域包括一个小型儿童游乐场，以及小型办公室和工作室。由于门前就有繁荣的餐厅和咖啡馆，它们在设计时充分考虑了社区需求。然而，立方体屋的开发在设计和施工过程中经历了各种挑战和复杂情况，曾因设计师资金困难而一度停工。幸运的是，在设计师从市议会获得另一轮拨款后，项目在两周内恢复了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So what makes the Cube Houses different from traditional architecture? Let's look at some of its unique design features. Each cube house has a space of 100 square metres and is divided into 3 floors, and it is very striking to see these houses fixed on one angle. The tilted residences are constructed on three concrete pillars. The whole construction is made of 38 regular cube units all connected together with two super-sized cubes at both ends of the string. One of the two larger cubes was developed as an architecture school, and there is another building recently built between it and a warehouse.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么立方体屋与传统建筑有什么不同呢？让我们看看它的一些独特设计特点。每个立方体屋有100平方米的空间，分为三层，看到这些房子固定在一个角度上非常引人注目。倾斜的住宅建在三个混凝土柱子上。整个建筑由38个常规立方体单元组成，全部连接在一起，两端各有两个超大型立方体。两个较大的立方体中的一个被开发为建筑学校，在它和一个仓库之间最近还建了另一栋建筑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Standing at three-floors tall, their ground floor is the entrance. When you enter a cube house, the first thing to get used to is that all the walls are slanted. You must take a narrow staircase to reach the lower floor. This level and the top level are both triangle-shaped. The lower level contains an open kitchen and a living room. The medium level houses a bathroom and two bedrooms, while the top level provides a great view since the apex of the room is a three-sided pyramid with windows all around. In some cases, the top floor is used as a small rooftop garden. And as you enter the top half of the structure, your initial inclination may well be to mind your head.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：高约三层，底层是入口。当你进入一个立方体屋时，首先需要适应的是所有的墙壁都是倾斜的。你必须走狭窄的楼梯才能到达下层。这一层和顶层都是三角形的。下层有一个开放式厨房和客厅。中间层有浴室和两间卧室，而顶层提供了很好的视野，因为房间的顶部是一个三面金字塔形，四周都有窗户。有些情况下，顶层被用作小型屋顶花园。当你进入建筑的上半部分时，你最初的反应很可能是小心碰头。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now that you know the history and design features behind these odd-looking houses, you might be thinking about how it is to live in them. After curious bystanders kept disturbing the Cube Houses' residents, one shrewd owner opened the Show Cube Museum, which gives visitors the chance to take a tour around a fully furnished cube house. It also highlights some of the everyday challenges that the residents face, such as buying and fitting furniture for a structure without straight walls.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在你们了解了这些外观奇特的房子背后的历史和设计特点，可能会想知道住在里面是什么感觉。在好奇的旁观者不断打扰立方体屋居民之后，一位精明的业主开设了立方体展示博物馆，让游客有机会参观一个设施齐全的立方体屋。它还展示了一些居民面临的日常挑战，比如为没有直墙的建筑购买和安装家具。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In recent years, Rotterdam's Cube Houses have been joined by another architectural icon just across the square. Rotterdam's market hall, the largest indoor market in the Netherlands, is another multipurpose residential and retail complex that will live long in your memory - as well as helping to fill your belly with tasty treats.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：近年来，鹿特丹的立方体屋在广场对面迎来了另一个建筑标志。鹿特丹的市场大厅——荷兰最大的室内市场——是另一个多功能住宅和零售综合体，它将长久地留在你的记忆中——同时也能帮你品尝美食。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 2009, the Rotterdam-based Personal Architecture BNA converted one of the larger cubes for one of the leading Stayokay hostel chains in the Netherlands. Today, the hostel invites everyone to experience what it's like to live in a Cube House and enjoy a stunning panoramic vista of the surrounding area. What attracts guests most is its ideal location with a major railway station within a 5-minute walk. The accommodation is also offered at a fair price, which appeals to visitors both from home and abroad...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：2009年，总部位于鹿特丹的Personal Architecture BNA将其中一个较大的立方体改造为荷兰领先的Stayokay青年旅舍连锁之一。如今，该旅舍邀请每个人来体验住在立方体屋的感觉，并欣赏周边地区令人惊叹的全景。最吸引客人的是它的理想位置，步行5分钟即可到达主要火车站。住宿价格也很合理，吸引着国内外的游客……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. Ken's Appliance. Can I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：早上好。肯氏电器。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. I'm ringing about my fridge. It's not working at the moment.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的。我打电话来关于我的冰箱。它现在不工作了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'd like to find out a few more details, if I may.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：如果可以的话，我想了解更多细节。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, sure.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的，当然。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: First I need to make sure if your fridge is still covered by warranty.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：首先我需要确认您的冰箱是否仍在保修期内。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, right. I bought it just last week and it originally came with 2 years of warranty coverage, but I've extended the period to 3 years. So it's definitely under warranty.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，对。我上周刚买的，原本有2年保修期，但我延长到了3年。所以肯定在保修期内。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Now, what model is it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的。是什么型号？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me take a look... It should be somewhere on this warranty card. Oh, here, on the top right-hand corner. It's a Top Mount.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：让我看看……应该在保修卡上的某个地方。哦，这里，右上角。是Top Mount型号。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: And the colour of the fridge?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：冰箱的颜色呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's a silver one. It is really modern and perfectly matches the whole décor of my kitchen.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是银色的。非常现代，和我厨房的整体装饰完美搭配。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've made a note of that. So can you tell me the exact date you purchased the fridge?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：我记下了。那您能告诉我冰箱的具体购买日期吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I remember it was delivered on January 15th. I must have bought it a couple of days earlier. Right, it was on the 12th.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我记得是1月15日送货的。我一定是提前几天买的。对，是12日。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Then what is the problem with the fridge?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的。那冰箱出了什么问题？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it's a complete disaster. First there is something wrong with the alarm. I mean it is beeping continuously, even when the door is shut. It's really annoying. And there's also a problem with its temperature control. It's now 10 degrees, but I set it to be minus 8. It seemed to be working fine for the first couple of days.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，简直是一场灾难。首先报警器有问题。我是说它会不停地响，即使门关着也响。真的很烦人。还有温控也有问题。现在是10度，但我设定的是零下8度。头几天似乎工作正常。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sorry about that, but rest assured, Madam. We'll fix it all.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：很抱歉，但请放心，女士。我们会全部修好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Where is your maintenance centre?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：你们的维修中心在哪里？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ken's Appliance is located on Elm Street, just a few steps from the station. And, did the broken fridge cause any loss to you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：肯氏电器在榆树街，离车站只有几步路。另外，冰箱损坏给您造成了什么损失吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, actually it was used to store food for my sandwich shop.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的，实际上它是用来存放我的三明治店的食材的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Any idea of the total value of loss?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：您知道损失的总价值吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me make an estimate here. The vegetables in the fridge cost me around $50, and the meat cost more than $100. So the overall loss is about $180. I didn't notice the abnormal temperature until something inside went bad and the whole fridge smelled terrible. I had to toss everything away. Luckily, no one ate the food inside and got sick.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我来估算一下。冰箱里的蔬菜大约花了50美元，肉类花了100多美元。所以总损失大约180美元。直到里面的东西坏了，整个冰箱发出难闻的气味，我才注意到温度异常。我不得不把所有的东西都扔掉。幸运的是，没有人吃了里面的食物而生病。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a relief.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那还好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: But the damage has really caused me great inconvenience. I've nowhere to put the raw materials and thus could not open for business these days. The longer it takes to fix the fridge, the more it will cost me. You know... I have a whole bunch of bills to pay, like water, electricity, rent...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：但这次损坏真的给我带来了很大的不便。我没有地方放原材料，所以这些天都不能营业。修冰箱花的时间越长，我的损失就越大。你知道……我有一大堆账单要付，水费、电费、房租……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Don't worry, we'll attend to your problems as soon as possible.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：别担心，我们会尽快处理您的问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I need to know precisely when you can send a guy to fix all the problems. It is very urgent. Is there anyone who can keep me posted on the latest information?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我需要确切知道你们什么时候能派人来修好所有问题。非常紧急。有没有人能让我随时了解最新情况？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: How about this? I'll have the manager ring you later. Does that work for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：这样如何？我让经理稍后给您打电话。这样可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK... I'll be expecting his call then. Do you know what exactly is wrong with the fridge?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的……那我就等他的电话了。你知道冰箱到底哪里出问题了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: For your case, we assume it's the door that has to be fixed. The abnormal temperature and the noisy alarm both indicate that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：对于您的情况，我们推测是门需要修理。温度异常和报警器噪音都表明这一点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, indeed. I've just noticed that the door is dented.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的，确实。我刚注意到门有凹痕。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: It may have to be replaced then. But we'll have to check the availability of our repair guy first. We'll phone you back later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那可能需要更换了。但我们需要先检查维修人员的空闲情况。我们稍后再给您回电话。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, thank you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的，谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: You're welcome. Bye.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：不客气。再见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning everyone, I'm Sally, tour guide from Travelite Travel Agency. Today I'm going to introduce a great trip to Southern Scotland for you. I'm sure you will find it a fantastic place.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好，我是莎莉，Travelite旅行社的导游。今天我要为你们介绍一次精彩的南苏格兰之旅。我相信你们会发现那是一个很棒的地方。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is lots to see in Southern Scotland. To begin with, we will go to Sheepfoul, which has one or two beautiful gardens. One thing that's definitely worth doing is climbing to the top of the mountain. You will be fascinated by the beautiful scenery alongside the mountain road. When you get to the top, you can overlook the coastline and enjoy the stunning view.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：南苏格兰有很多可看的地方。首先，我们将去希普富尔，那里有一两个漂亮的花园。绝对值得做的一件事是爬到山顶。你会被山路旁美丽的风景所吸引。当你到达山顶时，可以俯瞰海岸线，欣赏令人惊叹的景色。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: From there we will go on to Brown Mare. Brown Mare used to be famous for its farm, but it is being refurbished at the moment and isn't likely to be reopened by the time we go there. But you can walk for hours there in the peaceful green surroundings along a wide variety of tracks. I think you will be struck by the beautiful roses in Mother Nature.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：从那里我们将前往布朗梅尔。布朗梅尔过去以其农场而闻名，但目前正在翻新，在我们去的时候可能不会重新开放。但你可以在那里沿着各种小径在宁静的绿色环境中漫步数小时。我想你会被大自然中美丽的玫瑰所打动。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In Doris, there were several old barns, but they have been converted into a special section where animals and plants are protected. From there you can see a range of rare breeds as well as flowers. This place is usually favoured by university students as a destination for their field trips.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在多丽丝，有几座旧谷仓，但它们已被改造成一个动植物的保护区。在那里你可以看到一系列的稀有品种以及花卉。这个地方通常受大学生欢迎，作为他们实地考察的目的地。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then we will go to Lodge Estate, which is the most favourite location for children as they can watch the baby deer. But remember, don't give food to them. Photography is allowed there, and when you leave you can get one free photo at the exit. But please don't move rocks or branches to take photos. You should leave the site intact.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后我们将去洛奇庄园，这是孩子们最喜欢的地点，因为他们可以看到小鹿。但记住，不要给它们喂食。那里允许拍照，离开时可以在出口获得一张免费照片。但请不要为了拍照移动岩石或树枝。你应该保持场地的原貌。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our next stop is Aurden. I strongly recommend that you visit the ancient town which was constructed nearly 1,000 years ago. There is not much of the original buildings left, but still plenty to see. The site is being excavated, and you will be able to help out if you want to.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们的下一站是奥尔登。我强烈建议你参观这座建于近1000年前的古镇。虽然原始建筑所剩不多，但还是有很多可看的。遗址正在挖掘中，如果你愿意，也可以帮忙。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Finally, we will spend some time in Eastlake, which changes with the seasons with different events happening at different times of the year. At the moment when we arrive there, it will be the most spectacular month with the arrival of Canada geese. I'm pretty sure that this visit will give you an unforgettable experience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，我们将在伊斯特莱克停留一段时间，那里随季节变化，一年中不同时间有不同的活动。当我们到达那里时，将是最壮观的月份，因为加拿大雁会到达。我很确定这次参观将给你一次难忘的经历。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Some of you have asked me about the place where we're going to stay. So, next I will introduce different types of accommodation there. First, many tourists may consider visiting a bed and breakfast, also called a B&B, as they don't have to be worried about what to eat in the morning. But you have to pay attention that this type of accommodation is only available on a daily basis. The cheapest possible option is to stay in a hostel, but you should be aware that sometimes you are provided with only a single bed with several people sharing the same room, and meals are not included. But some people think they have never had such an experience before that they want to have a try. More importantly, they don't have to change accommodation for a whole week. For those who want to visit the castles, I recommend you stay in the cottages nearby with beautiful surroundings. The owner promises that the rent can be paid every seven days, so just be relieved to have a peaceful life there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有些人问过我关于我们将要住的地方。所以，接下来我将介绍那里不同类型的住宿。首先，许多游客可能会考虑住民宿（B&B），因为他们不用担心早上吃什么。但你需要注意，这种住宿只按天提供。最便宜的选择是住青年旅舍，但你应该知道有时只提供一张单人床，几个人共用同一个房间，而且不包餐。但有些人认为他们以前从未有过这样的经历，所以想尝试一下。更重要的是，他们一整周都不用换住处。对于那些想参观城堡的人，我推荐你们住附近环境优美的小屋。主人承诺可以每七天付一次租金，所以放心在那里享受宁静的生活吧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For our members, I will introduce some benefits you can get from our travel agency. As for the accommodation I just mentioned, someone has asked if we offer a discount. I'm afraid to tell you this is only for premium members who can benefit from 10% off the original price. For those self-driving travellers, you might be interested in the parking service. Parking space is always limited at the hotel, so we only offer free parking service to premium members as well. I'm afraid ordinary members have to pay a fee for parking. The good news is, all of you can enjoy our guide service without any charge, including the visit to attractions like the castles. But remember, the entrance fee has to be paid by yourself. Oh, I nearly forgot, you can also receive regular copies of magazines about the native food and attractions in Scotland absolutely for free. It's a gift for you. I hope you will like it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：对于我们的会员，我将介绍你们可以从旅行社获得的一些福利。关于我刚才提到的住宿，有人问我们是否提供折扣。很遗憾地告诉你们，这只对高级会员开放，他们可以享受原价10%的折扣。对于那些自驾旅行者，你们可能对停车服务感兴趣。酒店的停车位总是有限的，所以我们也只向高级会员提供免费停车服务。普通会员恐怕需要支付停车费。好消息是，你们所有人都可以免费享受我们的导游服务，包括参观城堡等景点。但记住，门票费用需要自己承担。哦，我差点忘了，你们还可以完全免费定期收到关于苏格兰当地美食和景点的杂志。这是给你们的礼物。希望你们会喜欢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's all I want to share today. If you have any more questions about the trip, please call me at...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好的，这就是我今天想分享的全部内容。如果你们对这次旅行还有任何问题，请打我的电话……

transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, and then we can think about how we will put our data together, as you see, we have to do a presentation in next week's marketing seminar, OK?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：好的，然后我们可以想想如何整合数据，你看，我们下周要在市场营销研讨会上做展示，对吧？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, sure. I think first we should talk about the purposes for which these cars were originally designed.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：是的，当然。我觉得首先我们应该谈谈这些车最初的设计目的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I've found some data on that here. Well, four-wheel drives or sports utility vehicles as they're officially known, SUVs for short, were actually first designed for off-road use by those who need to get to the areas with quite a distance, but the interesting thing is that at present they're also frequently used by people who live in cities.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：哦，我这里找到了一些数据。嗯，四轮驱动车，或者正式名称运动型多用途车，简称SUV，最初是为那些需要到达较远地区的人设计的越野用途，但有趣的是，现在城市居民也经常使用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. From this we can see how they make use of them differently. Then in the second part let's talk about their advantages, shall we?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：没错。从这里我们可以看出人们使用它们的方式不同。那在第二部分我们来谈谈它们的优点，好吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah. Let me look at here. OK, first, they're generally used for commercial reasons, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：好的。让我看看。首先，它们通常用于商业用途，对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that's the same with what I've found.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：是的，和我的发现一样。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. What else?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：好的。还有什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, another advantage from my notes is that the power of the engine is increased.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：嗯，我的笔记中另一个优势是发动机功率增加了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I think that's a big benefit. In addition, I've got one more point here - SUVs are heavier, so they're suitable for towing larger loads.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：是的，我觉得这是一个很大的好处。另外，我这里还有一点——SUV更重，所以它们适合牵引更大的负载。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, that's why SUVs have become so popular in the market then?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：所以，这就是SUV在市场上变得如此受欢迎的原因？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's part of it. But they've gained popularity now for rather different reasons. For example, relevant research shows that people buy them for business mainly because of the image they present. And nowadays, many moms like to drive their kids to school in SUVs because they think that they're safe, so that's another reason.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：哦，这只是部分原因。但它们现在受欢迎是因为相当不同的原因。例如，相关研究表明，人们购买它们用于商务主要是因为它们呈现的形象。如今，许多妈妈喜欢开SUV送孩子上学，因为她们认为SUV安全，所以这是另一个原因。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: And then I think a larger seating capacity is also a factor, you know, we can get about seven people into one SUV, while in an ordinary car, there are only five seats.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：然后我觉得更大的座位容量也是一个因素，你知道，一辆SUV可以坐大约七个人，而普通汽车只有五个座位。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, and I think that's why families with two or more children like to buy SUVs.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：是的，我觉得这就是为什么有两个以上孩子的家庭喜欢买SUV。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right, and another thing I've found from my research is that drivers tend to buy SUVs with higher seats, which means they can get a better view of the traffic ahead.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：对，我从研究中发现的另一件事是，司机倾向于购买座椅更高的SUV，这意味着他们可以更好地看到前方交通状况。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, so these are all the reasons.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：是的，这些就是所有的原因。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: But I think some of these reasons just don't work. For example, to some extent, SUVs are safe, but if we look at them in a collision, they can do terrible damage to a small car. So I think it's just a misconception.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：但我觉得其中一些原因并不成立。例如，在某种程度上，SUV是安全的，但如果我们看它们在碰撞中的表现，它们会对小型车造成可怕的损害。所以我认为这只是一个误解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, I agree with you. So next shall we discuss the disadvantages of SUVs?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：嗯，我同意。那接下来我们讨论SUV的缺点好吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. So, firstly from what we've just considered, we can see that SUVs are harmful in central areas, and the damage they cause is highly related to their weight. Right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：好的。首先从我们刚才考虑的内容来看，我们可以看到SUV在中心区域是有害的，它们造成的损害与它们的重量高度相关。对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. And I've also got something about their chassis. The bodywork on SUVs is stiffer, so it doesn't crumple to absorb impact in an accident the way it does in smaller cars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：是的。我还有一些关于它们底盘的信息。SUV的车身更硬，所以在事故中不会像小型车那样通过变形来吸收冲击力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, moreover, as SUVs have a high centre of gravity, it's more likely for them to roll over than ordinary cars. That's another disadvantage from my research.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：嗯，此外，由于SUV重心较高，它们比普通汽车更容易翻车。这是我从研究中发现的另一个缺点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good. So these are all the disadvantages. How about the last part?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：好的。这些就是所有的缺点。最后一部分呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, maybe we could end up with a few ideas on how to limit the use of these SUVs.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：嗯，也许我们可以最后提出一些限制SUV使用的想法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 1
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. For one thing, I think we should restrict them to people like farmers, to whom SUVs are used very frequently.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1：好的。一方面，我认为我们应该把SUV限制给那些经常使用的人，比如农民。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 2
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, that's a good idea, but it might be difficult to enforce. And I think companies could also increase the insurance paid by SUV drivers, as we know it will cause more damage when there is an accident.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生2：嗯，这是个好主意，但可能难以执行。我觉得公司也可以提高SUV司机支付的保险费用，因为我们知道发生事故时会造成更大的损害。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Student 3
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, that's a good idea too. I think we've got very useful information together. Next, I'll write up these notes onto the slide so that everyone can see them when we give the presentation in the seminar.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生3：嗯，这也是个好主意。我觉得我们一起收集了非常有用的信息。接下来，我会把这些笔记写到幻灯片上，这样我们在研讨会上做展示时大家都能看到。

transcriptSentences.englishText: Student 1 & 2: Good idea.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 学生1和2：好主意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Today I'm going to talk about my research on learner persistence. Let me first introduce why I wanted to carry out such research. As a university teacher, I found learners' responses to certain things vary a lot. For example, some students may completely give up their degree studies because of a temporary illness, while others may overcome all kinds of difficulties and try their best to continue their studies. The latter are the students with learner persistence, and this is the group that I'm particularly interested in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天我要谈谈我对学习者坚持性的研究。首先让我介绍一下我为什么想要进行这项研究。作为一名大学教师，我发现学习者对某些事情的反应差异很大。例如，一些学生可能因为一次暂时的疾病就完全放弃学位课程，而另一些学生可能克服各种困难，尽最大努力继续学业。后者是具有学习者坚持性的学生，而这正是我特别感兴趣的群体。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: To do the research, first I selected my undergraduate students as the research sample, with a total of 200 people. All the students selected were seniors, and they had already stayed the course very well. Although the sample was drawn from a range of ages, there were deliberately a large number of mature students. And there was one thing in common - all of those students were living at home in the local region. I wanted to maintain this element of consistency, so I didn't include those coming from outside this area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：为了进行研究，我首先选择了我的本科生作为研究样本，共200人。所有入选的学生都是大四学生，他们已经很好地完成了课程。虽然样本来自不同的年龄段，但特意包含了大量成熟学生。他们有一个共同点——所有学生都住在当地家里。我想保持这种一致性，所以没有包括来自该地区以外的学生。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then I designed a questionnaire that aimed to find out what their concerns had been when they began the course and then what had made them stick at the three-year studies in university. Findings from the first section pointed out there were different concerns when they started their university studies. For example, some worried about the financial circumstances, while others were concerned about their careers after graduation. However, the research found the biggest concern for mature students tended to be the relationship with their children at home.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后我设计了一份问卷，旨在了解他们在开始课程时有哪些顾虑，以及是什么让他们坚持完成了三年的大学学习。第一部分的研究结果表明，他们在开始大学学习时有不同的顾虑。例如，一些人担心经济状况，而另一些人担心毕业后的职业发展。然而，研究发现成熟学生最大的顾虑往往是他们与家中子女的关系。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Next I wanted to find out what had made those students persist with their university studies. So in the second part, I designed my questionnaire under three main headings: social and environmental factors, other factors, and personal characteristics. And I included three levels of importance for each of these three headings. At the first level, those points identified by the respondents were regarded as the most important in learner persistence.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：接下来我想找出是什么让这些学生坚持大学学习。所以在第二部分，我在三个主要标题下设计了问卷：社会和环境因素、其他因素和个人特征。我为这三个标题中的每一个都包含了三个重要级别。在第一级别，受访者确定的那些点被认为是学习者坚持性中最重要的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's look at them one by one. For the first column, that's the social and environmental factors. A significant number of students said it was crucial to have effective support, whether from their tutors or friends. For other factors, students were driven not so much by high grades, but by what they regarded as a success in their studies. This was quite different from what I'd expected. Regarding personal characteristics, a sizable percentage of participants said they liked to take up a challenge, which was seen as a very important factor.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：让我们逐一看看。对于第一列，即社会和环境因素。相当多的学生表示获得有效的支持至关重要，无论是来自导师还是朋友。对于其他因素，学生不是由高分驱动的，而是由他们认为的学习成功所驱动。这与我预期的相当不同。关于个人特征，相当一部分参与者表示他们喜欢接受挑战，这被视为一个非常重要的因素。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then at the second level of importance, in the first category, many of the respondents regarded the life they enjoyed at school as an important social factor because this gave them good experiences. In the second column, other factors, a lot of people said that the most significant thing was decent health, which was also conducive to their persistence in the studies. And then under the third column, quite a number of respondents had the same view that they should have a range of interests in their everyday lives because this could broaden their minds and give them a sense of perspective which less persistent learners might lack.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在第二重要级别，在第一类中，许多受访者认为他们在学校享受的生活是一个重要的社会因素，因为这给了他们良好的体验。在第二列，其他因素中，很多人表示最重要的是身体健康，这也有利于他们对学习的坚持。在第三列下，相当多的受访者持相同观点，认为他们应该在日常生活中有广泛的兴趣，因为这可以开阔他们的思维，给他们一种不那么坚持的学生可能缺乏的视角。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: And then onto the third level of importance, under social factors, several respondents said that they had been keeping close to their tutors in their three-year university studies. In the second column, for other factors, they mentioned it was very important to live in a family without any problems. And finally, under column three, they talked about the capacity for multi-tasking, which was the ability to simultaneously deal with different problems.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后到了第三重要级别，在社会因素下，一些受访者表示他们在三年的大学学习中一直与导师保持密切联系。在第二列，对于其他因素，他们提到生活在一个没有任何问题的家庭中非常重要。最后，在第三列下，他们谈到了多任务处理能力，即同时处理不同问题的能力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: From these findings, I've concluded some recommendations on how to promote students' learner persistence. Primarily, I suggest that we should distribute questionnaires to the freshmen, so as to make clear of their maturity when they begin the course. This is really our most important concern.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：从这些发现中，我得出了关于如何促进学生学习者坚持性的一些建议。首先，我建议我们应该向新生分发问卷，以便了解他们在开始课程时的成熟度。这确实是我们最重要的关注点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Secondly, I propose that we should find ways to offer some training sessions to the students who are selected to encourage them to play the role of advisors. The purpose of this is to make support much more approachable to other students.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：其次，我建议我们应该找到方法为被选中的学生提供一些培训课程，鼓励他们扮演顾问的角色。这样做的目的是使支持对其他学生来说更加容易获得。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thirdly, in the evening and night when offices are closed, students may have no one to turn to for help. As a result, I think we should provide online services to those in need. Researches have pointed out that this service is actually more accessible than traditional services.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第三，在晚上办公室关闭时，学生可能没有人可以求助。因此，我认为我们应该向有需要的人提供在线服务。研究表明，这项服务实际上比传统服务更容易获得。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: And finally, if students don't submit their assignments before the deadlines, I think we teachers should contact the students first, rather than waiting for the students to come to us.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，如果学生没有在截止日期前提交作业，我认为我们老师应该首先联系学生，而不是等学生来找我们。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, this is all I want to share on my research. Now let's turn to the next part. Are there any questions about...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这就是我想分享的关于我研究的所有内容。现在让我们进入下一部分。关于……有什么问题吗？

transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello, North Bay Aquatic Centre, Jane speaking.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：您好，北湾水上中心，我是简。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, hello. I'm calling to apply for a part-time lifeguard position. Am I speaking to the right person?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：哦，你好。我打电话来是想申请一份兼职救生员的工作。您是负责人吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, you are. We are currently recruiting lifeguards for two different positions. But first, I'll have to jot down some of your personal information before we officially invite you for an interview. Is that alright?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：是的，我是。我们目前正在招聘两个不同岗位的救生员。不过在正式邀请您面试之前，我得先记下您的一些个人信息。可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. No problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：当然。没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: May I have your name, please?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：请问您叫什么名字？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's Peter, Peter Smith.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：彼得，彼得·史密斯。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. And what is your current address?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。您现在的地址是？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's 130 South Main Street, Lake Elsinore.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：南主街130号，埃尔西诺湖。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm sorry, Elsinore?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：抱歉，埃尔西诺？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it's E-L-S-I-N-O-R-E, Elsinore.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：哦，拼写是E-L-S-I-N-O-R-E，埃尔西诺。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Got it! What is your phone number?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。记下了！您的电话号码是？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: My home phone number is 0-double 7-double 9-5-3-6-2. Actually, it's easier to reach me by my cellphone number. It's O-double 7-8-9-6-2-4-5. I'm mainly out these days.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我家电话是0-双7-双9-5-3-6-2。实际上，打我的手机更容易联系到我。号码是0-双7-8-9-6-2-4-5。我这几天大多在外面。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Can you tell me about your work experience?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。能告诉我您的工作经历吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I now work as a waiter. And that's just a part-time gig. It requires serving customers, and I also have some cleaning duties.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，我现在做服务员。那只是一份兼职。需要招待顾客，我也有一些清洁工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. Do you have any other part-time job?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。您还有其他兼职吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. But I'm majoring in physical education right now. I'm learning exercise physiology, sports nutrition and individual fitness activities. And I want to become a baseball coach for a local high school.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：没有。但我现在主修体育教育。我在学习运动生理学、运动营养学和个体健身活动。我想成为当地一所高中的棒球教练。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, do you have any other relevant work experience to a lifeguard position?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：那么，您有与救生员岗位相关的其他工作经历吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, right. I also worked part-time as a rescue diver for a local beach last summer. I'm certified for open water rescue missions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：哦，对。去年夏天我还在一处当地海滩兼职做过救援潜水员。我有开放水域救援任务的资格认证。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Excellent. That's exactly what we're looking for.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：很好。那正是我们要找的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Before we continue, I need to know a few more things to ensure that you are qualified for maintaining water safety during work.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：在我们继续之前，我需要多了解一些情况，以确保您有资格在工作中维护水上安全。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. Go ahead.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：好的。您请问。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: As a lifeguard, you will spend most of your time monitoring the area near the water and reducing risks to everyone here. So we are looking for someone who can stay focused. Do you have difficulties concentrating or any related disorders?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：作为一名救生员，您大部分时间要监控水域附近区域，并降低所有人的风险。所以我们希望找一位能保持专注的人。您在集中注意力方面有困难或有任何相关障碍吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. I don't have any medical disorders relating to that sort of problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：没有。我没有与这类问题相关的任何医学障碍。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: We're also expecting someone with good eyesight because a lifeguard must be able to recognise and respond to any struggling swimmers quickly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：我们也希望招聘视力好的人，因为救生员必须能够快速识别并对任何溺水的游泳者做出反应。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have sharp vision. I mean, both eyes are 20-10 without correction.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我视力很好。我的意思是，双眼裸眼视力都是20-10。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good. Do you have relevant skills in terms of lifeguarding?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。您在救生方面有相关技能吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm good at diving. You know my previous job requires training in that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我擅长潜水。您知道我之前的工作需要这方面的训练。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: We only need lifeguards with certification. I assume you already have one, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：我们只招有资格证的救生员。我猜您已经有了，对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. To get the certificate, I received training for waterfront lifeguarding two years ago. The training includes things like providing first aid and emergency care. But mine is about to expire in November. Oh, wait, let me check. It's a month earlier, in October.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：是的。为了拿到证书，我两年前接受了海滨救生培训。培训内容包括提供急救和紧急护理等。但我的证书十一月就要到期了。哦，等等，我查一下。是提前一个月，十月到期。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. You're good for now before it expires. But if you want to work here for the whole year, you'll have to renew.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。在到期之前都没问题。但如果您想在这里工作一整年，就需要续期。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: What time do you prefer to work?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：您更喜欢什么时间工作？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I already work part-time in a restaurant on weekdays. So I'd like to work on the weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我平时已经在餐厅兼职了。所以我想周末工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: We already have enough people working here on Sundays.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：我们周日的员工已经够了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I can work on Saturday mornings then.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：那我可以在周六上午工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: And I can start from 6 o'clock in the morning. I'm a morning person.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我可以从早上6点开始。我是个早起的人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds great. Where did you hear about our recruitment information from?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：听起来不错。您是从哪里得知我们的招聘信息的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I heard it on radio this morning while driving. I wouldn't say I like reading newspapers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我今天早上开车时从收音机里听到的。我不太喜欢看报纸。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you for calling. We'll notify you about the interview details in two days.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：感谢您的来电。我们会在两天内通知您面试细节。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you. Bye.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：谢谢。再见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jane
transcriptSentences.englishText: Goodbye.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 简：再见。

Inthe Visitors’ Centre, people can
A. hire a bicycle.
B. buy refreshments.
C. leam about local history.

If cyclists want to travel between Elmsden and Langton by train,

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to our holiday special. Today, I'll be talking about a new cycle route in this area called the Elmsden Way. It's well sign-posted, so you can see exactly where to go, and it's an easy ride with no steep hills. It's 35 kilometers long from Elmsden to Langton and consists partly of cycle paths and partly of roads. Let me outline the route briefly, starting at Elmsden railway station.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎来到我们的假期特别节目。今天，我要谈谈这个地区一条新的自行车路线，叫做埃尔姆斯登路。它有很好的路标，所以你可以清楚地知道该往哪里走，而且骑行轻松，没有陡峭的山坡。从埃尔姆斯登到兰顿全长35公里，部分路段是自行车道，部分路段是公路。让我从埃尔姆斯登火车站开始，简要介绍一下路线。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first part is a cycle path running eastwards roughly parallel to the rail track. Almost immediately, the railway curves away and goes around the southern side of a little lake, but the cycle path takes the northern route around the lake. Keep your eyes open for the swans that nest there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第一部分是一条大致与铁路线平行的向东延伸的自行车道。几乎就在不远处，铁路线拐弯绕到一个小湖的南侧，但自行车道走的是环湖的北线。留意在那里筑巢的天鹅。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The path then joins the road and the next landmark is a group of massive rocks that tower over the countryside. You'll see them to the east of the road just before the road goes under the railway. They're imposing. Soon you'll come to a fork in the road where you'll leave the road and head off towards the river. But if you want to make a detour to Corley nature reserve, go straight on instead of leaving the road here.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：接着路径与公路汇合，下一个地标是一组巨大的岩石，高耸在乡村之上。你会在公路东侧看到它们，就在公路从铁路下方穿过之前。它们很壮观。很快你会来到一个岔路口，在那里你将离开公路，朝河方向前进。但如果你想绕道去科利自然保护区，就在此直走，而不是离开公路。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Continuing along the cycle path, you'll reach the river Cleve. The cycle path follows the river southwards. After a bit, you'll see the Ashington china factory, which closed in 1962. It now offers guided tours to the public which is worth a visit. Right after the factory, there's a bridge over the river and you carry on with farmland to the north right after the bridge and the Langton forest to the south. Somewhere between the cycle route and the railway line sited a statue of Captain Cook, which dates back to the 18th century. The route ends at Langton village, where you'll find a railway station. So, you can either catch the train here or cycle back to Elmsden.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：沿着自行车道继续前行，你会到达克里夫河。自行车道沿河南下。过一会儿，你会看到阿辛顿瓷器厂，它在1962年关闭了。现在它向公众提供导览服务，值得一游。过了工厂，有一座桥跨过河流，桥后北边是农田，南边是兰顿森林。在自行车路线和铁路线之间的某个地方矗立着一座库克船长的雕像，可以追溯到18世纪。路线的终点是兰顿村，那里有一个火车站。所以，你可以在这里乘坐火车，也可以骑车返回埃尔姆斯登。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: One point to remember when cycling on the Elmsden Way is to keep your eyes open for sheep, which occasionally stray onto the cycle path from the adjoining fields. So be careful to avoid accidents. The park is well-constructed, so wet or muddy conditions do not affect it. There'll be old cars or tractors when you're cycling on roads, but most traffic has been diverted to the main road that bypasses the whole area.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在埃尔姆斯登路上骑行时有一点要记住，就是要留意羊，它们偶尔会从相邻的田地走到自行车道上。所以要小心避免事故。这条路线修建得很好，所以潮湿或泥泞的天气不会影响它。在公路上骑行时会有老式汽车或拖拉机，但大部分交通已被分流到绕过整个区域的主干道上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now a bit more about some of the places you'll see. The starting point, Elmsden Station, was quite busy in the early 20th century with services to several major cities, but it was closed in the 1950s. Eventually, a small company was set up to turn it into a sort of railway museum, maintaining it in the style of the 1950s, and the station was ready for trains to start using it again earlier this year. It's only used by a few local trains, though.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在再详细说说你们将会看到的一些地方。起点埃尔姆斯登火车站，在20世纪初相当繁忙，有通往几个主要城市的火车服务，但在20世纪50年代关闭了。最终，一家小公司成立，把它变成了某种铁路博物馆，保持了20世纪50年代的风格，火车站在今年早些时候重新投入使用了。不过只有少数本地列车使用它。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There's a Visitors' Centre at the station, which houses a small exhibition about the history of railway transport all over the world, and a facility for hiring bikes if you don't have one of your own. A small shop just across the road from the station also sells refreshments.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：车站有一个游客中心，里面有一个关于世界各地铁路运输历史的小型展览，如果你没有自行车，那里还有租车设施。车站对面的一家小商店也出售茶点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As I said, you can cycle to Langton and return to Elmsden by train or the other way because you can take your cycle on the train. There's no need to make a reservation; there's plenty of room and no extra charge. However, the service is limited, and the trains between these places don't run on weekdays.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如我所说，你可以骑车到兰顿，然后乘火车返回埃尔姆斯登，反之亦然，因为你可以把自行车带上火车。不需要预订；有很多空间，不额外收费。不过，班次有限，而且这些地方之间的火车在工作日不运行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you want to see the River Elm, there's a footpath from Elmsden station. And you can safely leave your bike in the car park there. Leave yourself plenty of time, though. Going down is easy, but climbing up is pretty steep, so walking back up to the top can take quite a while. But it's worth the effort. The scenery is lovely and the footpath runs right next to the river down to a waterfall.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你想看埃尔姆河，从埃尔姆斯登火车站有一条人行步道。你可以放心地把自行车停在停车场。不过要给自己留出充足的时间。下山容易，但上山相当陡峭，所以走回山顶可能要花不少时间。但这是值得的。风景很美，步道紧挨着河流一直延伸到一处瀑布。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Finally, there are many other cycle paths if you like to do more cycling in the area. We'll be talking on the radio about them, and you'll be able to get fuller details in the Saturday edition of the local paper. The national cycle network also has some details on its website, although I have to say they don't have any local ones yet. But that may change, so get out your bicycle...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，如果你想在这一带进行更多骑行，还有许多其他自行车路线。我们会在电台节目中介绍它们，你可以在周六版的当地报纸上获得更详细的信息。国家自行车网在其网站上也有一些信息，不过我不得不说，他们还没有任何本地路线。但情况可能会有变化，所以拿出你的自行车吧……

In Erica’s view, what is wrong with Ian’s last presentation?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hey Ian, how far along are you on preparing the presentation on volcanoes next week?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：嘿，伊恩，你下周关于火山的展示准备得怎么样了？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Not much.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：不多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Maybe we can straighten things out first?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：也许我们可以先把事情理清楚？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. I decided to start with shield volcano. The name derives from its similarity in shape to a warrior's shield lying face up. The Hawaiian shield volcanoes are the most famous examples. Professor Joan mentioned that many scholars have already done quite a lot of research in this field. We could retell conclusions from published papers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：好的。我决定从盾形火山开始。这个名字来源于它的形状类似于一个正面朝上的战士盾牌。夏威夷的盾形火山是最著名的例子。琼教授提到，该领域的许多学者已经做了相当多的研究。我们可以转述已发表论文中的结论。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm not sure. I mean, is that even allowed? I know we don't have to use first-hand data we collect, but copying others?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：我不太确定。我的意思是，这允许吗？我知道我们不必使用自己收集的一手数据，但照搬别人的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Come on, it's not like we are using their findings as our own. The professor said it would be okay as long as we cited our sources.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：拜托，我们又不是把他们的发现当作自己的。教授说只要我们注明来源就可以。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, okay.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：哦，好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you have any ideas about stratovolcanoes?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：你对层状火山有什么想法吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Stratovolcanoes, also known as composite volcanoes, develop over many thousands of years through repeated eruptions and other volcanic activity. But the current information I have at hand is only very vague. Fuller descriptions are needed for this.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：层状火山，也称为复合火山，是经过数千年反复喷发和其他火山活动形成的。但我手头目前的信息非常含糊。这部分需要更完整的描述。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm sure you can find them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：我相信你能找到。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Alright then. Leave that to me. Have you read anything about rhyolite caldera complexes?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：好吧。那就交给我了。你读过关于流纹岩破火山口复合体的资料吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, they are the most explosive volcanoes on Earth and don't even look like volcanoes. The origin of these volcanoes, like Yellowstone, is associated with a hotspot.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：是的，它们是地球上最具爆发性的火山，而且看起来甚至不像火山。这些火山，比如黄石公园，其起源与热点有关。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: You've got most of the information correct. Unfortunately, the last bit you mentioned is wrong. The origin of this type of volcano remains a mystery. The hotspot origin theory doesn't work for most other rhyolite calderas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：你大部分信息都是对的。不幸的是，你提到的最后一点是错的。这类火山的起源仍然是个谜。热点起源理论不适用于大多数其他流纹岩破火山口。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. I'll change that part. What about the position on monogenetic fields?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：好的。我会改掉那部分。那关于单成因火山田的观点呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's shocking to see the photos of these immense volcanoes. There are numerous monogenetic fields in the American southwest and Mexico. But I got all the information from a website without specifying its source. We'll have to examine the content again later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：看到这些巨大火山的照片真是令人震惊。在美国西南部和墨西哥有大量的单成因火山田。但我所有信息都来自一个没有注明来源的网站。我们之后还得再审查一下内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay. I can help with that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：好的。我可以帮忙。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Lastly, we have cinder cones. What do you have on that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：最后是火山渣锥。你有哪些资料？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, this type of volcano is usually tiny to the other volcanoes and thus sounds less attractive. Maybe we should leave it out. It seems pretty unimportant to me.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：嗯，这种类型的火山与其他火山相比通常很小，所以听起来不太有吸引力。也许我们应该把它忽略掉。对我来说它似乎很不重要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: I agree. It's impossible to cover everything.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：我同意。不可能涵盖所有内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Erica, can you work on the delivery part? I don't want to do it anymore.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：艾丽卡，你能负责演讲部分吗？我不想再做了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm okay with that. But why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：我没问题。但为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: I was marked so low for the last presentation and didn't even have a clue why. Maybe it's because I didn't include enough data on it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：我上次展示得分很低，甚至不知道原因。也许是因为我没有包含足够的数据。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I'm not sure about that. I think maybe you did not prepare the topic well enough. You tried to explain the contributing factor forming the Ring of Fire in the Pacific Ocean, but you just read everything out loud without fully comprehending it yourself.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：嗯，我不确定是不是那样。我觉得也许你没有充分准备好那个主题。你试图解释形成太平洋火环的成因因素，但你只是大声朗读了所有内容，自己却没有完全理解。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. That must have been it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：对。那肯定就是原因了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: We also have to look for supporting materials to illustrate the formation of different volcanoes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：我们还得找一些支持材料来说明不同火山的形成。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about documentaries?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：纪录片怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: They can be an excellent way to illustrate the volcanic eruption, but that might be too long for our presentation. We've only got 20 minutes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：纪录片是说明火山喷发的极好方式，但对我们展示来说可能太长了。我们只有20分钟。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have you considered adding photos to our handouts?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：你考虑过在我们的讲义中加入图片吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's an option. But people may focus on these photos rather than paying attention to what we have to say. Maybe we can search online for part of a film about volcanoes and add it to the end of our presentation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：那是一个选择。但人们可能会关注这些图片而不是注意我们要说的话。也许我们可以在网上搜索一段关于火山的电影片段，加到展示的末尾。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: That would be better. So how should we start our presentation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：那会更好。那我们该怎么开始展示呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Maybe we can first introduce some terms like extinct volcanoes and dormant volcanoes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：也许我们可以先介绍一些术语，比如死火山和休眠火山。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Even though they are widely-accepted terms among ordinary people, academia wouldn't accept them because there are no set definitions. For example, an extinct volcano would be one nobody expects to erupt again. But there have been several eruptions from widely-acknowledged 'extinct' volcanoes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：尽管这些术语在普通民众中被广泛接受，但学术界不会接受它们，因为没有确定的定义。例如，死火山被认为是不再会喷发的火山。但公认的“死火山”也曾多次喷发。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's an excellent way to start our presentation. What did the professor say about your last presentation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：这是开始我们展示的好方法。教授对你上次的展示说了什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is still room for improvement. She said that I had an in-depth analysis and provided enough statistics, but I didn't carry on and discuss my take on it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：还有改进的空间。她说我有深入的分析并提供了足够的统计数据，但我没有继续讨论自己的看法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. So maybe we could also discuss the impact volcanoes have on humans and our planet.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：对。所以也许我们也可以讨论火山对人类和我们星球的影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Erica
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah. There's little doubt that volcanoes have been instrumental in wiping out countless species during major extinction events. But volcanic activity also shapes new habitats, enriching the soil with nutrients that allow life to thrive. People haven't realised that there are abundant mineral resources waiting to be exploited in volcanoes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾丽卡：是的。毫无疑问，火山在大规模灭绝事件中消灭了无数物种。但火山活动也塑造了新的栖息地，丰富了土壤中的养分，让生命得以繁荣。人们还没有意识到火山中有丰富的矿产资源等待开发。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Ian
transcriptSentences.englishText: I agree. So now we can...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 伊恩：我同意。那我们现在可以……

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In today's lecture, we'll dive into the topic of dolphin intelligence, discussing dolphin behaviour and their physical structure in an attempt to shed light on the question: how intelligent are dolphins?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在今天的讲座中，我们将深入探讨海豚智力的话题，讨论海豚的行为和它们的身体结构，试图阐明这个问题：海豚有多聪明？

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, concerning body size, dolphin brains are among the largest in the animal kingdom---more extensive than chimpanzees. And certain species, like bottlenose dolphins have brains even bigger than humans. However, some current tests suggest that they do not possess the same cognitive abilities as humans despite having a similar brain size. For instance, dolphins are often trapped in gill nets originally intended for tuna fishing. These entanglement cases have led to unnecessary injury or deaths of dolphins, gradually depleting their numbers. Clearly, dolphins don't realize that they could just jump over these vertical barriers and swim to safety.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：嗯，关于体型，海豚的大脑是动物王国中最大的之一——比黑猩猩的还大。而某些物种，比如宽吻海豚，大脑甚至比人类的还大。然而，目前的一些测试表明，尽管拥有相似的大脑尺寸，它们并不具备与人类相同的认知能力。例如，海豚经常被困在原本用于捕捞金枪鱼的刺网中。这些缠绕事件导致海豚不必要的伤亡，逐渐耗尽了它们的数量。显然，海豚没有意识到它们可以跳过这些垂直障碍游到安全的地方。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: People often mistakenly view dolphin's eternal smile as signs of intelligence and joy. Actually, this is not a facial expression at all, but a fixed design of their head. Unlike human beings with greater than 40 facial muscles, dolphins have no such powers with which to form an expression.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：人们常常错误地将海豚永恒的微笑视为智慧和快乐的标志。实际上，这根本不是面部表情，而是它们头部固定的结构。与拥有40多块面部肌肉的人类不同，海豚没有形成表情的能力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: On the other hand, small-brained animals are sometimes underrated for their level of intelligence. Pigeons and rats are typical examples of small brain animals which can perform tasks so complex that most humans would have trouble with them. Over the last few decades, scientists have conducted countless studies on the cognitive abilities of these overlooked animals, with quite surprising results. Pigeons are aware of their bodies when they see their reflections in the mirror. Pigeons are also trained under specific conditions and gradually form instinctive reactions. In an experiment in 2009, a group of 12 pigeons was given a reward like food and water every time they pecked a key on a lab table. All birds successfully performed the trick. These test results indicate that brain size is probably not the sole factor in determining intelligence. Another argument steers the attention to the correlation between intelligence and the constituents of brains rather than their sheer sizes. It's been found that dolphin brains are comprised chiefly of fatty cells, which serve as a protective barrier between the systemic blood and the extracellular environment of the central nervous system. They are also essential components of nerve cell membranes, affecting problem-solving skills performance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：另一方面，小脑动物有时被低估了它们的智力水平。鸽子和老鼠是典型的例子，它们能完成大多数人类都会觉得困难的任务。在过去的几十年里，科学家们对这些被忽视的动物的认知能力进行了大量研究，结果令人相当惊讶。鸽子在看到镜中的自己时能意识到自己的身体。鸽子也在特定条件下被训练，逐渐形成本能反应。在2009年的一项实验中，一组12只鸽子每次啄击实验台上的一个键时都会获得食物和水等奖励。所有鸟类都成功地完成了这个把戏。这些测试结果表明，大脑尺寸可能不是决定智力的唯一因素。另一个论点将注意力引向智力与大脑成分的相关性，而不是它们的纯粹大小。研究发现，海豚的大脑主要由脂肪细胞组成，这些细胞在全身血液和中枢神经系统的细胞外环境之间充当保护屏障。它们也是神经细胞膜的重要组成部分，影响解决问题的能力表现。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now the second mainstream view is that dolphins are highly intelligent. Research into the behaviour of dolphins in the wild and in captivity has yielded incredible data on the intelligence of these marine mammals. Studies show that dolphins not only have the ability to learn as individuals, but those individuals can then pass their new knowledge on to others.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第二种主流观点是海豚非常聪明。对野外和圈养海豚行为的研究产生了关于这些海洋哺乳动物智力的令人难以置信的数据。研究表明，海豚不仅有能力作为个体学习，而且这些个体还能将新知识传授给其他个体。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's take a look at some typical examples. Among these are tested with Billy, a dolphin trapped in a sea loch and rescued. Billy spent three weeks in rehabilitation and was released back into the wild. There, researchers noticed that Billy had started tail walking, a skill only mastered by captive dolphins who imitated the keepers. Billy had not been trained to tail-walk but had learned the skill simply by observing other dolphins in the rehab centre.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：让我们来看一些典型的例子。其中一个是关于比利——一只被困在海上湖湾中被救出的海豚。比利在康复中心度过了三周，然后被放归野外。在那里，研究人员注意到比利开始学会用尾巴行走，这是一种只有模仿饲养员的圈养海豚才能掌握的技能。比利没有被训练过用尾巴行走，而只是通过在康复中心观察其他海豚学会了这一技能。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Another study involves a female dolphin named Karen. Karen was given a test in which she was rewarded with a fish for every piece of litter she brought to researchers. To maximise its bounty, she quickly learned to take a newspaper, keep it at the bottom of a tank, and tear off smaller pieces to get more fish.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：另一项研究涉及一只名叫凯伦的雌性海豚。凯伦被安排了一项测试，她每给研究人员带来一片垃圾就会得到一条鱼作为奖励。为了最大化她的回报，她很快学会了拿一张报纸，把它放在水箱底部，然后撕成小块以获取更多的鱼。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Over the past hundred years, researchers have proven that dolphins are extremely social species and have evolved to have highly-developed brains. These factors are the most significant contributors to their intelligence and become the means of survival for dolphins.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在过去的一百年里，研究人员已经证明，海豚是高度社会化的物种，并进化出了高度发达的大脑。这些因素是它们智力的最重要贡献者，也成为海豚的生存手段。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 2008, researchers tracked a group of around 400 dolphins. One female dolphin in the group was having a lot of trouble swimming and kept flipping upside down or sinking into the water. The other dolphins crowded around it. They paddled side by side with the injured female on their backs. By keeping the wounded female above water, they may have helped it to breathe, avoiding drowning.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：2008年，研究人员追踪了一组约400只海豚。其中一只雌性海豚游泳时遇到很多困难，不停地翻倒或沉入水中。其他海豚围在它身边。它们并排游动，让受伤的雌性海豚趴在它们背上。通过让受伤的雌性海豚保持在水面以上，它们可能帮助了它呼吸，避免溺水。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So how do they communicate with each other? Well, Scientists have discovered through observation and meticulous testing that every dolphin has a different sound resembling the whistle that other dolphins recognize as a particular individual. Dolphins can emit a wide variety of sounds. The frequency levels range ten times beyond what humans can hear.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：那么它们是如何相互交流的呢？科学家通过观察和仔细测试发现，每只海豚都有一种不同的声音，类似于哨声，其他海豚能认出这是某个特定的个体。海豚可以发出各种各样的声音。频率范围是人类的十倍以上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: But of course, there are other means of communication for dolphins besides sound. During mating season, male dolphins stroke females with flippers after a fight to affirm social bonds.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：当然，除了声音之外，海豚还有其他的交流方式。在交配季节，雄性海豚在打斗之后会用鳍状肢轻抚雌性海豚以确认社会联系。
