transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great Countryside Holidays, Jack speaking. Can I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：大乡村假日旅行社，我是杰克。能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I hope so. I've heard that your travel agency provides holidays in the countryside.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的，希望如此。我听说你们的旅行社提供乡村度假服务。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. We've specialized in countryside holidays with many years of experience, so we can ensure that we provide perfect holidays with several destinations.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：没错。我们专营乡村度假多年，经验丰富，可以确保为您提供多个目的地的完美假期。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great! My husband and I are planning a countryside holiday with the whole family, and I'm calling just for the accommodation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：太好了！我和丈夫计划带全家去乡村度假，我打电话来主要是为了住宿。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Where are you going to spend your holiday? There're some excellent accommodations on our list in different destinations.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。您打算去哪里度假？我们的名单上有不同目的地的优秀住宿。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, last year we spent our holiday in the southern part of the city, but this time we'd like to live in the northeast. I have a friend who's just returned and had great fun there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：嗯，去年我们在城市南部度假，但这次我们想去东北部。我有个朋友刚回来，在那里玩得很开心。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. And what about the time of your holiday?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。那度假时间呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: It'll be in the first week of September, which we think will be off-peak travel time. At peak season, the attractions are always crowded with people, and hotels or restaurants might overcharge you, so we try to avoid that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：在九月的第一周，我们认为那是非高峰旅游时段。旺季景点总是人满为患，酒店或餐厅可能会收费过高，所以我们尽量避开。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, arranging your holiday during off-peak time is wise as you can enjoy the attractions and facilities better.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：是的，在非高峰时段安排度假很明智，因为您可以更好地享受景点和设施。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：没错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then how long are you going to stay?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：那您打算住多久？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our holiday will last three days, and we will stay there for a weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我们的假期会持续三天，我们将在那里过周末。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. That's the location and time of the holiday. Then let's turn to the accommodation itself. Do you have any particular requirements for housing?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。那是度假的地点和时间。现在我们来谈谈住宿本身。您对住所有什么特殊要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, the first priority we've considered is, of course, a quiet environment so that both young and old can have good rest during our stay.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：有的，我们考虑的首要因素当然是安静的环境，这样老少都能在住宿期间休息好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then we'd prefer a cottage on a good beach where my children can play with great fun. My little daughter loves collecting shells and building sandcastles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：然后我们想要一个在好沙滩上的小屋，这样我的孩子们可以尽情玩耍。我的小女儿喜欢收集贝壳和堆沙堡。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. I'll take that down. A seaside cottage is excellent. It also means secluded nights and fresh sea air.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。我记下来。海边小屋很好。也意味着宁静的夜晚和清新的海风。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Oh, another thing is, I'm kind of a foodie, and whenever I visit a new place, I'm always desperate to try the local cuisine. So if possible, I'd prefer a good restaurant not far away from where we live.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的。哦，还有一件事，我算是个美食家，每到一个新地方，我总是很想品尝当地美食。所以如果可能的话，我想要一个离住处不远的好餐厅。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. Tasting the local cuisine is one of the delights of the holiday.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：没问题。品尝当地美食是度假的乐趣之一。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then what about the actual room? Are there any other requirements?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：那实际房间呢？还有其他要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our family has five members, so we'll need a cottage with three living rooms and a separate bathroom with a shower.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我们家有五口人，所以我们需要一个有三人间和带淋浴的独立浴室的小屋。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Three living rooms and a separate bathroom with a shower.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。三人间和带淋浴的独立浴室。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, another important thing is, my father got his backache last week, and climbing stairs might cause trouble. I'm concerned that he might not recover from it during our holiday, so there shouldn't be any stairs in the cottage, I'm afraid.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，另一件重要的事是，我父亲上周背痛，爬楼梯可能会带来麻烦。我担心他在假期中可能恢复不了，所以恐怕小屋里不能有楼梯。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: No stairs. OK, I've taken that down. Do you need a balcony?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：没有楼梯。好的，我记下了。您需要阳台吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, it's not necessary for us, but if possible, we need a garden, you know, where the children can play.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：实际上，对我们来说不需要，但如果可能的话，我们想要一个花园，你知道，孩子们可以在那里玩。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: No problem. Several cottages cater to your need.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：没问题。有几间小屋满足您的需求。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! Well, that's all our needs for the accommodation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：太好了！嗯，这就是我们对住宿的全部需求。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, I've written down all the details. And I'll contact you as soon as I find the one which can satisfy your needs.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的，我已经记下了所有细节。我会尽快联系您，找到一间能满足您需求的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll need your personal details. What's your surname?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：我需要您的个人信息。您姓什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Cheffins, that's C-H-E-double F-I-N-S.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：谢芬斯，拼写是C-H-E-双写F-I-N-S。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, Mrs Cheffins.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的，谢芬斯太太。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: And my telephone number is 0192477285.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我的电话号码是0192477285。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: All right. Before we finish, I'd like to know where you heard about us. Did your friend tell you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：好的。在我们结束之前，我想知道您是从哪里听说我们的。是您的朋友告诉您的吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, not. I saw the ads of your travel agency in a magazine called Countryside Living.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：实际上不是。我在一本叫《乡村生活》的杂志上看到了你们旅行社的广告。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jack
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. That's a popular magazine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰克：我明白了。那是一本很受欢迎的杂志。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning, everyone! My name's Janet Parker, and I'm the Human Resources Manager of this company. Thank you for joining us and coming to this training session, which I hope will help you quickly learn about our company and know what you will do in your position.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家早上好！我叫珍妮特·帕克，是本公司的HR经理。感谢大家来参加这次培训，希望能帮助你们快速了解公司并知晓岗位职责。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First, briefly introduce the history of our company. We're quite an old company, specializing in electronic toys for more than thirty years. The founder, Ronald Stevenson, got the idea of establishing his own company when he finished his apprenticeship. With the support of his grandfather, he got enough start-up capital and the company was set up and succeeded in a short period. To satisfy the demands of customers, we've expanded the premises considerably over the past years, and the number of staff members has grown up on a regular basis.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，简要介绍一下我们公司的发展史。我们是一家相当老牌的公司，专营电子玩具三十多年。创始人罗纳德·史蒂文森在完成学徒期后萌生了创立自己公司的想法。在祖父的支持下，他获得了足够的启动资金，公司在短期内成立并取得成功。为了满足客户需求，我们多年来大幅扩建了厂房，员工人数也不断增长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Recently we found the sales of our products creeping up very slowly, and we decided to introduce new electronic toys to give that a boost, so we have to look for more workers to help us, and that's the reason why you are here. The first week may be pretty challenging as there will be a lot of new information. But don't worry too much about trying to remember everything. The important thing is to check with someone if you're unsure what to do. According to the contract, you'll be expected to work here for six months. Some of you asked me if there is a possibility for you to be employed as our full-time member. I can't give you a definite answer now. It'll depend on your job performance during the employment and whether we have job vacancies then.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最近我们发现产品销售增长缓慢，于是决定推出新的电子玩具以提振销量，所以需要招聘更多员工，这就是你们在这里的原因。第一周可能会很有挑战性，因为会有大量新信息。但不要过于担心要记住所有东西。重要的是，如果不确定该怎么做，要及时确认。根据合同，你们将在这里工作六个月。有些人问我是否有可能被聘为全职员工。我现在无法给出明确答复，这取决于你们在雇佣期间的表现以及届时是否有职位空缺。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: About two hundred full-time staff members in our company, seventy percent of whom are responsible for sending out goods, while the minority of jobs are in the manufacturing line. You will work in different departments according to our needs, which I'll explain to you in detail later. Working in our company, you'll be impressed by our modern machinery and production methods, advanced skills and friendly working atmosphere. However, I must tell you one thing which is not so pleasant. Because the manager of the payroll department is on sick leave that you won't get paid on time this month. But don't worry too much; it'll be solved very soon.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我们公司大约有两百名全职员工，其中70%负责发货，少数岗位在生产线上。你们将根据我们的需求分配到不同部门，稍后我会详细解释。在我们公司工作，你们会对现代化机械和生产方式、先进技术以及友好的工作氛围印象深刻。不过我必须告诉你们一件不太愉快的事：由于薪资部门经理病假，这个月的工资可能无法按时发放。但不用担心，很快就会解决的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In the second part of this training session, I'll explain what you will be responsible for in the following working days. There are five positions and you'll be working in different departments. As I've mentioned before, we're in urgent need of someone who can deal with the salary problem, so our staff can get paid as soon as possible, and that's the primary job for the first person. Then the second of you will be working in the manufacturing line to help develop new products, and I'm sure you will be pretty busy in the following days. The third person will work on the sixth floor, and your main job is to look after the mechanical side. It includes checking equipment daily to ensure they are working correctly and doing some repair work if necessary. Without your help, many processes like manufacturing or packaging won't work well. Then, the fourth person will work in the technology department to deal with problems related to software and hardware. We're getting new laptops next week, and you must install new programs. And the last of you will work in the after-sale service department. You are expected to keep a long-term relationship with customers, including collecting feedback regularly, dealing with customer complaints, enhancing customer satisfaction etc.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在培训的第二部分，我将解释你们接下来工作中的职责。有五个职位，你们将在不同部门工作。正如我提到的，我们急需有人处理薪资问题，让员工尽快拿到工资，这是第一个人的主要工作。第二个人在生产线上协助开发新产品，接下来几天会很忙。第三个人在六楼工作，主要负责机械设备方面，包括每日检查设备是否正常运转，必要时进行维修。没有你们的帮助，生产和包装等流程都无法正常运转。第四个人在技术部处理软硬件相关问题，下周会有新笔记本电脑，需要安装新程序。最后一个人在售后服务部，负责维护客户关系，包括定期收集反馈、处理投诉、提升客户满意度等。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Today I'd like to look at another type of amphibian - the African clawed frog, whose Latin name is Xenopus laevis. Its name is derived from the three short claws on each hind foot, which it uses to tear apart its food. The Latin word Xenopus means 'strange foot' and laevis means 'smooth'.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天我想看另一种两栖动物——非洲爪蟾，其拉丁名为Xenopus laevis。它的名字来源于后脚上的三个短爪，用于撕裂食物。拉丁词Xenopus意为“奇特的脚”，laevis意为“光滑的”。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll start with a general description. The African clawed frog is a species of frog that can be commonly found in the eastern and southern parts of Africa. They have a flattened head and body but no tongue or external ears. As the Latin name suggests, African clawed frogs have smooth skin, unlike the toad, whose skin always has a rough texture. The body of African clawed frogs is covered with mucus, which can give their sensitive skin protection, thus playing an indispensable role in their survival.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我先从总体描述开始。非洲爪蟾是一种常见于非洲东部和南部的青蛙。它们有扁平的头部和身体，但没有舌头或外耳。正如拉丁名所示，非洲爪蟾皮肤光滑，不像蟾蜍的皮肤总是粗糙的。非洲爪蟾的身体覆盖着粘液，可以保护它们敏感的皮肤，在它们的生存中起着不可或缺的作用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Male and female African clawed frogs can be easily distinguished through several characteristics, and the major one is their size. Generally, male frogs are about half as big as females. Specifically, female frogs are usually 4.5 inches long, weighing around 7 ounces, while males are generally 2.5 inches long and 2 ounces heavy.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：雄性和雌性非洲爪蟾可以通过几个特征轻松区分，主要的是体型。通常，雄性大约是雌性的一半大小。具体来说，雌性通常长4.5英寸，重约7盎司，而雄性通常长2.5英寸，重2盎司。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then let's turn to their habitats. African clawed frogs are entirely aquatic frogs, so they live in water all their life, whether they are tadpoles or adult frogs. Although they can live in a wide range of freshwater environments, they particularly like still water instead of fast-flowing streams. During the summer, African clawed frogs are mainly found in warm rivers, and during the rainy season, they tend to move into flooded forests.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在来看它们的栖息地。非洲爪蟾是完全水生的青蛙，所以它们一生都生活在水里，无论是蝌蚪还是成蛙。虽然它们可以生活在各种淡水环境中，但特别喜欢静水而不是急流。夏天，非洲爪蟾主要在温暖的河流中被发现，雨季则倾向于迁移到被水淹没的森林中。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In the wild, African clawed frogs are highly adaptable to changes in the environment around them, whether in oases or glacier-covered lakes. Besides, they can even survive in water with high salt levels. It is because African clawed frogs have a unique physiological mechanism in their body that could automatically regulate the balance of water inside and outside their body. In dry weather, African clawed frogs always burrow themselves into mud, where they can survive for more than a year. They are incredibly hardy and long-lived, with an average lifespan of five to fifteen years. Some are even recorded to have lived for twenty to twenty-five years. However, African clawed frogs are susceptible to the pollution of the water even though they are not listed as endangered species.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在野外，非洲爪蟾对周围环境变化适应能力很强，无论是在绿洲还是冰川覆盖的湖泊中。此外，它们甚至能在高盐度的水中生存。这是因为非洲爪蟾体内有一种独特的生理机制，可以自动调节体内外的水平衡。在干燥天气里，非洲爪蟾会钻进泥里，在那里可以存活一年多。它们非常耐寒且长寿，平均寿命五到十五年。甚至有记录显示有些活到了二十到二十五年。然而，非洲爪蟾对水污染很敏感，尽管它们未被列为濒危物种。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, let's talk about the diet of African clawed frogs. They are carnivores that like hunting insects, spiders, worms, fish etc. African clawed frogs depend on the sense of smell to detect their prey. They first use the claws on their hind feet to tear pieces of ample food, then the front feet, which are not webbed, play an important role in feeding. African clawed frogs use their front feet to push food into their mouths, and meanwhile, a distinctive pump system is used to draw or suck food in their mouths.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在来看看非洲爪蟾的饮食。它们是肉食动物，喜欢捕食昆虫、蜘蛛、蠕虫、鱼类等。非洲爪蟾依靠嗅觉来探测猎物。它们先用后脚上的爪子撕碎大块食物，然后前脚——没有蹼——在进食中发挥重要作用。非洲爪蟾用前脚把食物推进嘴里，同时用一种独特的泵系统来吸入食物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: So we can see African clawed frogs are voracious predators and can quickly adapt to many habitats. Therefore, in some parts of the world, African clawed frogs act like invasive species which will negatively affect other species in the freshwater ecosystems. The evidence shows that they have devastated the populations of native frogs and other creatures by eating their young. As a result, African clawed frogs are illegal to own, transport, or sell without any permit in some states of America like California, Washington, Arizona etc., where African clawed frogs have been seen as a type of pest. However, it's legal to own African clawed frogs in Canada.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：由此可见，非洲爪蟾是贪婪的捕食者，能迅速适应许多栖息地。因此，在世界上的一些地方，非洲爪蟾像入侵物种一样，对淡水生态系统的其他物种产生负面影响。有证据表明，它们通过捕食本地青蛙和其他生物的幼体，摧毁了它们的种群。因此，在美国加利福尼亚、华盛顿、亚利桑那等一些州，未经许可拥有、运输或出售非洲爪蟾是违法的，在那里它们被视为一种害虫。但在加拿大拥有非洲爪蟾是合法的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: But not many people know that African clawed frogs are also used in medicine. As we mentioned before, the skin of African clawed frogs is covered with mucus, which has properties of antibiotic. This chemical can help kill bacteria and cure the infection and is widely used by both the medical profession and the general public. So we shouldn't ignore the medical value of African clawed frogs.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：但没多少人知道非洲爪蟾也被用于医学。如我们之前提到的，非洲爪蟾的皮肤覆盖着粘液，具有抗生素的特性。这种化学物质有助于杀死细菌和治疗感染，被医学界和公众广泛使用。所以我们不应忽视非洲爪蟾的医学价值。

transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, good morning. I saw your advert in today's paper about hot air balloon trips. It sounds pretty exciting, and I wonder how much it costs.

transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh boy. That's impressive. How long is a single ride?

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: And what time are the flights?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：飞行时间是几点？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: Our flights generally meet about an hour before sunrise on the day. You will be notified of the exact meeting time the evening before your flight. Night flights are avoided due to weather conditions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：我们的飞行通常在当天日出前一小时集合。具体集合时间会在飞行前一晚通知您。由于天气原因，不安排夜间飞行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Fair enough.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：有道理。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Which month do you recommend for a hot air balloon trip?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：你推荐哪个月份进行热气球旅行？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: Autumn is the best time of year to take the trip. Not only can you see the changing hues of the trees from above, but it is a great way to spend time with the whole family before it gets too cold.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：秋季是一年中最好的旅行时间。你不仅可以从上面看到树木变幻的色彩，而且这是在天气变冷之前与全家人共度时光的好方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: But please note that our flight may be cancelled, and you will be notified by phone the day before.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：但请注意，我们的飞行可能会被取消，我们会提前一天电话通知您。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: It can be quite dangerous to fly under bad weather conditions like a thunderstorm. So our experienced pilots will not go under such conditions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：在雷暴等恶劣天气条件下飞行可能相当危险。所以我们的经验丰富的飞行员不会在这种条件下飞行。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: What should I wear for the ride?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：飞行时我应该穿什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: We suggest wearing comfortable clothing like a jacket. Multiple layers are always better. Wearing a helmet for safety concerns is also a good idea. Sandals are not permitted.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：我们建议穿舒适的衣服，比如夹克。多穿几层总是更好的。出于安全考虑戴头盔也是个好主意。不允许穿凉鞋。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Can children or older people participate?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：儿童或老年人可以参加吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: All children must be above the minimum age of 9 years old. And they have to be accompanied by at least a parent or guardian. However, an adult has no age limit as long as they meet the health requirements.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：所有儿童必须年满9岁的最低年龄。而且必须有至少一位家长或监护人陪同。然而，只要符合健康要求，成年人没有年龄限制。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: What exactly are the health requirements?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：健康要求具体是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: Participants must at least be in fair physical condition. For example, they shall have no significant knee, hip or back problems and no recent surgeries or broken bones. They must also stand unassisted for an hour during the flight. It is the required position during the whole flight. As the balloon comes to land, all passengers will need to adopt the landing position with knees bent in front of them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：参与者至少要有良好的身体状况。例如，不应有严重的膝盖、臀部或背部问题，近期无手术或骨折。他们还必须能在飞行中独立站立一小时。这是整个飞行中的要求姿势。当热气球降落时，所有乘客需要采取膝盖弯曲在身前的降落姿势。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Are those rides safe?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：这些飞行安全吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hot air balloon companies are required to have a Commercial Balloon Pilot licence, and all our pilots go through rigorous training before they are allowed to fly. It is a relatively gentle activity. However, the impact of a balloon landing can vary drastically depending on factors like wind speed. Sometimes it is similar to the momentum of jumping off a small chair. If you cannot jump off a small chair, speaking to your doctor before booking a balloon flight is best.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：热气球公司必须持有商业热气球飞行员执照，我们所有的飞行员在获准飞行前都经过严格的训练。这是一项相对温和的活动。然而，热气球降落时的冲击力因风速等因素而差异很大。有时类似于从一把小椅子上跳下来的动量。如果你不能从一把小椅子上跳下来，最好在预订热气球飞行前咨询医生。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thank you very much. I think that's all I need to know.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：非常感谢。我想这就是我需要了解的全部了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jason
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks for calling. Goodbye.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 杰森：感谢您的来电。再见。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: I have in this studio with me Mary Smith from York Town Tourism, who is here to tell us about some of the events happening in our state capital over the next three weeks at the Spring Festival. So, Mary, what can we expect to see?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：今天我的演播室请到了来自约克镇旅游局的玛丽·史密斯，她将告诉我们未来三周在州府举行的春节活动。那么，玛丽，我们会看到什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mary
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, being in York Town is such an exciting time. To kick off the Spring Festival, a vast firework will be displayed down by the lake, starting at 9 p.m. this Saturday, the 4th of September. Over ten thousand fireworks will be set off. All are choreographed to music and broadcast simultaneously here on Radio Yorkee. You should get there early if you want to get close to the action. So, bring along a picnic and a blanket, as it could get chilly in the evening. One thing that attracts visitors to the festival from all over the country is the fantastic collection of flowers on show in Central Park throughout the festival. Special buses will run daily from the town centre to the show at 20-minute intervals for those who prefer public transport. If you are interested in seeing the latest in cars, from the fastest to the most expensive, then head over to The Motor Show at the Exhibition Centre from the 10th to the 15th of September. It will be open daily from 9 a.m. until 10 p.m. So, you can even pop in there after work. Do you like photography? Then go along to 'Grow Your Imagination', an exhibition of photographs of famous gardens, which will be held at the art gallery from the 11th to the 19th of September. Come and be inspired by some of the world's most beautiful gardens. I have a sneak preview of some of the photographs, and they are magnificent. If music is more your thing, then you should come and hear the Australian Philharmonic Orchestra performing 'Swing in Spring' at the concert hall on Friday the 17th and Saturday the 18th of September. It's a celebration of dance music from the 1940s and 50s. There will be three performances. Both evenings start at 7 p.m., and a matinee performance at 2.30 on Saturday. So, get your dancing shoes on and hit there. It's a guarantee to get your feet tapping.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 玛丽：嗯，在约克镇是一段激动人心的时光。为了拉开春节的序幕，本周六（9月4日）晚上9点，湖边将举行大型烟花表演。将燃放超过一万发烟花。所有烟花都与音乐配合，并在约基电台同步播出。如果你想靠近现场，应该早点到。所以要带野餐和毯子，因为晚上可能会冷。整个节日期间，中央公园展出的精美花卉收藏是吸引全国游客的一大亮点。喜欢公共交通的游客，每天有从镇中心到展览的专线巴士，每隔20分钟一班。如果你想看最新款的汽车，从最快的到最贵的，可以在9月10日至15日去展览中心的汽车展。每天从上午9点到晚上10点开放。所以你甚至可以在下班后顺便去看看。你喜欢摄影吗？那就去“激发你的想象力”摄影展吧，这是9月11日至19日在美术馆举办的著名花园摄影展。来欣赏世界上最美丽的花园，获得灵感。我提前看了一些照片，非常壮观。如果你更喜欢音乐，那就在9月17日周五和18日周六来音乐厅听澳大利亚爱乐乐团演奏的“摇摆的春天”。这是对20世纪40年代和50年代舞曲的庆祝。将有三场演出。两场晚间演出都在晚上7点开始，周六下午2：30有一场日场。所以穿上你的舞鞋去吧，保证让你的脚跟着打拍子。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Mary
transcriptSentences.englishText: Those are just a few of the attractions on offer. But for something a little different, you could try 'Balloons Down Under', which is the largest gathering of hot air balloons in the southern hemisphere. It's well worth it because over 25 balloons of all shapes and sizes will be a fantastic sight. I'm also happy to announce that one lucky person will get to go up in one of these free balloons. That is the prize in our unique Spring Festival competition. It usually costs you 200 dollars. So, it's not a bad prize. I'm sure you all want a chance to win, so you'll need to fill out the entry form in today's paper of the York Town News. Don't forget to include your phone number and send it to Radio Yorkee. Make sure your entry reaches us by 5 p.m. on Thursday, the 9th of September. Then to see if you've won, check out the festival's website on Saturday, the 11th of September, where we will publish the name of the lucky winner. It's such a fantastic prize. So, hurry up and get your entry in. So there you have it, just a few special events happening here in York Town over the Spring Festival. And if you like any more details about...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 玛丽：这些只是其中的一些活动。但如果你想体验一些不同的，可以试试“南半球热气球节”，这是南半球最大的热气球聚会。非常值得，因为超过25个各种形状和大小的热气球将是一幅奇观。我还要高兴地宣布，一位幸运儿将有机会免费乘坐其中一个热气球。这是我们独特的春节比赛的奖品。通常要花费200美元。所以这不是个差劲的奖品。我相信你们都想要机会赢，所以需要填写今天《约克镇新闻》上的报名表。别忘了写上你的电话号码并寄到约基电台。确保你的报名在9月9日周四下午5点前到达。然后想知道是否赢了，可以在9月11日周六查看节日网站，我们会公布幸运获胜者的名字。这是多么棒的奖品。所以赶快报名吧。以上就是春节在约克镇举办的一些特别活动。如果你想了解更多的细节……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hey Gabriella, how is it going?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：嘿，加布里埃拉，最近怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've been pretty busy lately.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：我最近很忙。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, what are you up to?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：哦，你在忙什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've been working on a dissertation on music education specializing in music performance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：我一直在写一篇关于音乐教育的论文，专攻音乐表演。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds intriguing. What have you found?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：听起来很有趣。你有什么发现？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I interviewed 18 freshmen majoring in music performance as my sample population. I first asked about their music background before being accepted to music schools.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：嗯，我采访了18名音乐表演专业的大一新生作为我的样本。我首先问了他们进入音乐学院之前的音乐背景。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me guess, have they all got relevant qualifications in music?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：让我猜猜，他们都有相关的音乐资格证书吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, even though there is a wealth of music qualifications available, most of the students didn't receive any until they entered music schools. Some capabilities like music production or music technology are pretty tough going.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：嗯，尽管有大量音乐资格证书可供选择，但大多数学生直到进入音乐学院才获得任何证书。音乐制作或音乐技术等一些能力相当困难。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now that you've mentioned it, I recall that I got mine in sound engineering in my sophomore year.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：既然你提到了，我记得我大二时获得了音响工程的证书。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. But the majority of these students admitted that they had performed in front of a large crowd. Around 80% of them had performed on stage as band members in secondary schools. A few of them played piano or guitar at the time. And it also surprised me that they were generally able to play multiple instruments with proficiency.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：是的。但这些学生中的大多数承认他们曾在大型观众面前表演过。大约80%的人在中学时曾作为乐队成员登台表演。他们中少数人当时弹钢琴或吉他。让我惊讶的是，他们通常能熟练地演奏多种乐器。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Have they tried to compose a piece of music before?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：他们以前尝试过作曲吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Only in rare cases did they have prior experience in composition.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：只有极少数情况他们有作曲经验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: They would have to do it sooner or later. There is a whole module for it. What did they say about practising?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：他们迟早要做的。有一个完整的模块是关于这个的。他们关于练习说了什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: All subjects mentioned that they feared being marked too low and tried their best.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：所有受访者都提到他们害怕得分太低，所以尽力而为。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: So they were like practising every single day?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：所以他们每天都练习？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Not for most people. Some students worked with others in a band, so they had to arrange the time for rehearsals. But all 18 students had sufficient amount of practice. And they frequently mentioned that playing technical pieces was exhilarating.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：对大多数人来说不是。一些学生与其他人在乐队中合作，所以他们必须安排排练时间。但这18名学生都有足够的练习量。他们经常提到演奏技术性强的曲目令人兴奋。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: I feel that way, too.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：我也有同感。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: And then I asked questions about how they chose the pieces that were assessed and their attempts to improve their performance in recital classes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：然后我问了他们如何选择被评估的曲目，以及他们在独奏课上改进表现的尝试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: What did they say?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：他们说了什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Two students mentioned that they always asked their tutors' advice on the pieces they were going to perform because they felt that would give them a competitive edge over those who had no clue of tutors' preference in music.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：两名学生提到，他们总是就即将表演的曲目征求导师的意见，因为他们觉得这能让他们比那些不了解导师音乐偏好的人有竞争优势。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, that's a bit sneaky.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：嗯，那有点狡猾。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: But the most common remark was that they had a minimal interest in pieces that the public barely knew. Instead, most prefer popular pieces that other students would also choose.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：但最常见的评论是，他们对公众几乎不知道的曲目兴趣不大。相反，大多数人更喜欢其他学生也会选择的流行曲目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: How come?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: They said that this could mirror their weaknesses and thus help them to perfect the techniques for handling the most difficult bits. All but one of the 18 students admitted that to perform well, they had to learn the music by heart, or otherwise, they would have to divert their attention and thus make some errors.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：他们说这可以反映他们的弱点，从而帮助他们完善处理最困难部分的技巧。18名学生中除一人外都承认，要表演得好，他们必须背谱，否则会分散注意力从而出错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: I agree.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：我同意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then I asked them about their thoughts on practising in different aspects. And some of their answers were entirely unexpected.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：然后我问了他们关于不同方面练习的想法。他们的一些回答完全出乎意料。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, what aspects did you look into?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：哦，你研究了哪些方面？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: I first asked how they feel about playing solo.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：我首先问了他们独奏的感受。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: What did they say?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：他们说了什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: They said being a solo performer takes desire, focus and hard work. And the performance would not pull off if one took the stage without confidence. But they all took great pleasure in it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：他们说作为一个独奏者需要渴望、专注和努力。如果没有信心就上台，表演是不会成功的。但他们都乐在其中。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, that's quite different from playing in an orchestra, where musicians have to work with other members to produce a harmonious sound that is pleasing to the ear.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：是的，这与在管弦乐队演奏很不同，在那里音乐家必须与其他成员合作，产生悦耳的和谐声音。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. And I also asked whether the choice of the piece to play would affect their performance.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：对。我还问了演奏曲目的选择是否会影响他们的表现。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, that's a big yes for me. When I play a song I don't like, I won't devote myself to it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：嗯，对我来说答案是肯定的。当我弹一首不喜欢的歌时，我不会全心投入。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's widely accepted. The audience can tell when performers are being authentic and inspired by the music they are performing. Many would spend hours or even days choosing the right piece.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 加布里埃拉：这是普遍接受的。观众能分辨出表演者是否真诚，是否被演奏的音乐所启发。很多人会花几个小时甚至几天选择合适的曲目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Troy
transcriptSentences.englishText: You have to put a lot of thought into it before it's too late. So what kind of musical genre do they prefer?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 特洛伊：你得在来不及之前好好考虑。那他们喜欢哪种音乐类型？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Gabriella
transcriptSentences.englishText: The answers vary vastly. But one thing in common is that they rarely switch from one style to another.

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: My project is on the 19th-century British architect George Dodds, who used to be famous not just in the northeast of the UK but throughout the country. At first, I chose him for my term project because, in my early teens, I had always admired Mitten Hall, a mansion he built near my home. Later, I wanted to learn more about the man responsible for it. I thought I'd used the project as an excuse and managed to unearth a wealth of information about architecture and fascinating life.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我的项目是关于19世纪英国建筑师乔治·多兹，他不仅在英格兰东北部有名，而且在全国都有名。起初，我选择他作为我的学期项目，因为在我十几岁时，我一直很欣赏米滕庄园——他建在我家附近的一座宅邸。后来，我想更多地了解建造它的人。我想用这个项目作为借口，设法挖掘出了大量关于建筑和他的迷人生活的信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: I thought I'd start today by telling you a little about Dodds himself before looking at a selection of his more substantial buildings. He was the son of a landscape gardener and had a brief but successful career in his father's business. But the young Dodds started to resent what he saw as his father's old-fashioned approach to landscape. Dodds began to spend a lot of time thinking about how he could break with convention, creating buildings in a new relationship with their surroundings.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我想今天先简要介绍一下多兹本人，然后再看他的一些重要建筑。他是一位园艺师的儿子，在父亲的生意中有一段短暂但成功的职业生涯。但年轻的多兹开始反感他父亲那种在他看来过时的园艺方式。多兹开始花大量时间思考如何打破常规，创造与周围环境有全新关系的建筑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 1810, Dodds, aged 23 at the time, decided to go to London to study art under the eminent watercolourist Jack Vamos. His friends strongly encouraged him to stay and work in London as architects were highly regarded there. But by 1811, he decided to move back to northeast England because he discovered that more clients would hire him for his fashionable ideas from London. Having a large customer base, the city council included, Dodds was able to set up an architectural firm of his own. Dodds distanced himself from other builder-architects and gradually established himself as one of the new breed of professional architects. And one of his signature designs was the Royal Arcade, which was commissioned by the city council. Although never practised in London, Dodds gained a national reputation when he joined the newly-formed Northern Architectural Association and was elected to be its first chairman. He retired from active work in his 70s after suffering a stroke, from which he never fully recovered. Dodds died at the age of 77 at his home. Dodds was versatile and could build houses of many different styles that his clients desired. His country houses are too little known, mainly because they are not so large that they are open to the public and are often still in private hands, hidden behind parkland and trees. One was Mitten Hall, built in 1824 and finished two years later. The outstanding characteristics of Mitten Hall are Dodds' use of beautiful golden sandstone, Grecian styled entrance porticos, elegant staircases leading to an upper gallery. The building has a domed ceiling with a glass centrepiece. Even though the quality of the stonework was superb, some of the windows seemed to leak on rainy days. The building was renovated in 1987 and is now served as a conference centre.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：1810年，当时23岁的多兹决定去伦敦跟随著名的水彩画家杰克·瓦莫斯学习艺术。他的朋友强烈鼓励他留在伦敦工作，因为建筑师在那里很受重视。但到了1811年，他决定回到英格兰东北部，因为他发现更多的客户会因为他从伦敦带来的时尚理念而雇用他。拥有庞大的客户群，包括市议会，多兹得以成立自己的建筑事务所。多兹与其他建筑商保持距离，逐渐确立了自己作为新型专业建筑师的地位。他的标志性设计之一是皇家拱廊，由市议会委托建造。尽管从未在伦敦执业，但多兹在加入新成立的北方建筑协会并被选为第一任主席后获得了全国声誉。他在70多岁时因中风而退休，从未完全康复。多兹在77岁时在家中去世。多兹多才多艺，能建造客户想要的多种不同风格的房屋。他的乡间别墅鲜为人知，主要是因为它们不够大，不对公众开放，而且往往仍为私人所有，隐藏在公园和树林后面。其中一个是米滕庄园，建于1824年，两年后完工。米滕庄园的突出特点是多兹使用了美丽的金色砂岩、希腊风格的入口门廊、通往上层画廊的优雅楼梯。建筑有一个带玻璃中心装饰的圆顶天花板。尽管石工质量精湛，但有些窗户在雨天似乎会漏水。该建筑于1987年翻新，现在用作会议中心。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 1830, the town council decided to build Royal Arcade on a site that used to be a corn exchange market and entrusted George Dodds with the design. And the shopping arcade was completed by 1832. The whole design was intended as an elegant shopping experience and was renowned for its grand balcony. Unfortunately, the Royal Arcade was not a commercial success, as it was positioned too far from the town centre, causing great difficulty in delivery. The arcade was demolished as early as the 1880s and is now used as a car park for neighbouring shops today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：1830年，镇议会决定在以前是粮食交易市场的场地上建造皇家拱廊，并委托乔治·多兹设计。购物拱廊于1832年完工。整个设计旨在提供优雅的购物体验，并以其大阳台而闻名。不幸的是，皇家拱廊在商业上并不成功，因为它离镇中心太远，导致物流困难。拱廊早在19世纪80年代就被拆除了，现在被用作邻近商店的停车场。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The final building I want to show you is Morton Gaol which Dodds completed in 1839. It is a sturdy building with impressive towers based on medieval castles. However, although beautiful, the gaol wasn't 100% functional. More striking was the absence of any space for exercise for the prisoners. An extra courtyard had to be added for this at a later date. Morton ceased to be a penal institution in the 1940s, when it was scheduled for demolition, but was purchased for use as a hotel. That never came to pass. And as many of you will know, it is now run as a Transport Museum with a whole collection of vehicles that tell the city's story through transport.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：我想展示的最后一栋建筑是多兹于1839年完成的莫顿监狱。这是一座坚固的建筑，有着基于中世纪城堡的令人印象深刻的塔楼。然而，尽管美丽，监狱并非100%实用。更引人注目的是完全没有供囚犯锻炼的空间。后来不得不为此增加了一个额外的院子。莫顿在20世纪40年代不再是监狱，当时计划拆除，但被收购用作酒店。但那从未实现。正如你们许多人知道的，它现在作为交通博物馆运营，收藏了大量车辆，通过交通讲述城市的故事。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: College Accommodation Office, Darren speaking, how may I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：学院住宿办公室，我是达伦，我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, good morning. I am starting at the college in September and need to find some accommodation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，早上好。我九月份就要入学了，需要找住处。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Well, there is a list of options. The first one is to live on campus. And that'd be a single room.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：好的。有几种选择。第一种是住校内宿舍。是单人间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: How much would that cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：费用是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it depends. You'll be expected to cover 3276 pounds for a standard room for the year. That's just for a room with a washbasin. And it'll be 3834 pounds if you want a regular suite equipped with a small bathroom.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：嗯，这取决于情况。标准间一年3276英镑。那只是一个带洗脸盆的房间。如果想要带小浴室的普通套房，需要3834英镑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. That's a bit over what I expected.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我明白了。这比我预期的要高一点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: It does include heating, which is quite a saving because energy costs can be high these days, especially in winter.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：这包括了暖气费，能省不少钱，因为现在能源费用很高，尤其是冬天。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hum, does it include meals as well?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：嗯，也包括餐食吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. All our rooms are self-catering now. But there is a shared kitchen on each floor where you can cook if you want to. Or there are plenty of places to eat out on campus.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：不。我们现在所有的房间都是自炊式的。但每层楼都有一个共用厨房，如果你想做饭的话可以用。或者校园里有很多地方可以吃饭。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ok. And you mentioned that is the price for the whole year?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的。你提到那是一整年的价格吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you pay annually. But actually, it's just for 36 weeks. It doesn't include holidays. You'll have to vacate the room then.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：嗯，是按年支付。但实际上，这只是36周的住宿。不包括假期。到时你得腾出房间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, hum, I need somewhere for the holidays. It'll be a long way home, and the flights are too expensive.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，嗯，假期我需要地方住。回家太远了，机票也太贵了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, there is another option. Several families who work at the college or have children studying here offer overseas students a room in their homes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：嗯，还有另一种选择。一些在学院工作或孩子在这里读书的家庭会向留学生提供家中的房间。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, tell me about it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，给我讲讲。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: We call this arrangement 'Home Welcome'. And we've still got a few places left at the moment. You pay 150 pounds per week and that includes breakfast, a packed lunch and dinner, as well as heating.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：我们把这个安排叫做“家庭欢迎”。目前我们还有一些名额。每周150英镑，包括早餐、打包午餐和晚餐，以及暖气。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Is there a contract? Do you have to stay for the whole year?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：有合同吗？必须住满整年吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, it's flexible.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：不，是灵活的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hmm, it sounds perfect, but I'm not sure. I want to be a little more independent.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：嗯，听起来很完美，但我不确定。我想更独立一些。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Is there somewhere available off campus?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：校外有地方吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, you can rent a property in town privately. You might want to rent a room in a shared house. You'd have a room and a shared kitchen and bathroom with other tenants.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：有的，你可以在镇上私人租房。你可以考虑租一个合租房的房间。你会有一个房间，和其他租客共用厨房和浴室。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about if I don't want to share?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：如果我不想合租呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: You can get what we call a studio. They are often relatively small, but they'll have everything you need.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：你可以租我们称之为“单身公寓”的房子。通常相对较小，但有你需要的一切。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. How much would those two options be?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的。这两种选择要多少钱？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, prices vary depending on which part of the town the property is in. Generally speaking, the cheapest is around 275 pounds a month for each student.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：嗯，价格取决于房产在镇上的哪个区域。一般来说，最便宜的每月约275英镑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that's not too bad.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，那还不错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, but it can also be up to 490 pounds, and you still have to pay all your other bills.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：是的，但也可能高达490英镑，而且你还需要支付所有其他费用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: What sort of amount would I be looking at for those?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那些费用大概是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Last year, students were paying, on average, about 43 pounds per month for gas and electricity. This year, it would probably be somewhere in the region of 48 pounds.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：去年，学生平均每月支付约43英镑的煤气费和电费。今年，可能在48英镑左右。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's a lot.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那很多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, they've gone up quite a bit. And on top of that, you have to pay for water, which would probably be around 9 pounds.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：是的，涨了不少。除此之外，还要付水费，大概9英镑左右。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That didn't occur to me. And I guess I'd have to pay for transportation, too.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我没想到这个。而且我想我还得付交通费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. Most of these properties are quite a long way from the college.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：没错。这些房产大多离学院相当远。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it just gets worse and worse. What's the minimum contract for this type of accommodation?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，情况越来越糟了。这种住宿的最低合同期是多久？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: Six months. And you have to pay a deposit upfront. But of course, you can stay there over the holidays.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：六个月。而且你需要预付押金。但当然，你可以在假期住在那里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's true.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那倒是。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: And you'd have to provide references. They want two from someone in this country.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：你还需要提供推荐信。他们需要两份来自英国国内的人。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. That's not a problem.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：我明白了。那没问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Darren
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you prefer this accommodation, we can't find the property for you. You'd have to contact the real estate agent who manages the property for the owner.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 达伦：如果你倾向于这种住宿，我们不能帮你找房。你得联系为业主管理房产的房地产中介。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Thanks. I'd like to see what's available privately. Could you give me the real estate agent details...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的。谢谢。我想看看私人出租的房源。你能给我房地产中介的联系方式吗……

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to our lovely tour around Hobson Park. Visible from much of Auckland, this is a widely recognised local landmark. I hope you'll enjoy your stay here. But first, let me briefly introduce its history to you before we stroll around the park.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎来到我们可爱的霍布森公园之旅。从奥克兰大部分地区都能看到它，这是当地广泛认可的地标。我希望你们在这里玩得开心。但首先，在我们漫步公园之前，让我简要介绍一下它的历史。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hobson Park is located on an island that used to be a volcano, which emerged just 600 years ago. You can still enjoy the breathtaking views of a nearby lake today. The lava flow at the end of Takapuna Beach enveloped a kauri forest. It is known to be New Zealand's only example of a fossil forest preserved in a lava flow.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：霍布森公园坐落在一个曾经是火山的岛上，这座火山大约在600年前形成。今天你仍然可以欣赏到附近湖泊令人叹为观止的景色。塔卡普纳海滩尽头的熔岩流包裹了一片贝壳杉森林。据知这是新西兰唯一在熔岩流中保存下来的化石森林。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, Hobson Park was named after William Hobson, a British captain and also the first governor of New Zealand. At the time, the British were making plans to claim New Zealand as a colony to ensure their trade interest. War broke out between Maori troops and government forces. After years of revolt, two Maori chiefs were invited to the island to restore peace. They signed a treaty and shook hands with Governor Hobson. While local tribes started to celebrate their success, the two Maori chiefs didn't stop promoting Maori self-determination in meetings and correspondence with the government.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：实际上，霍布森公园是以威廉·霍布森命名的，他是一位英国船长，也是新西兰的第一任总督。当时，英国正计划将新西兰殖民化以保护其贸易利益。毛利军队和政府军之间爆发了战争。经过多年的反抗，两位毛利酋长被邀请到岛上恢复和平。他们签署了条约，与霍布森总督握手。当地部落开始庆祝成功时，这两位毛利酋长并没有停止在会议和与政府的通信中推动毛利自决。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In 1840, Hobson chose Auckland as the site for his capital. The same year, plans for founding Hobson Park were initiated. But it was in 1842 that the park was actually created and officially opened to the public.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：1840年，霍布森选择奥克兰作为他的首府。同年，建立霍布森公园的计划开始启动。但公园实际上是在1842年建成并正式对公众开放的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: As you can see, the park is immense. It is comprised of many natural wonders as well as artificial features. Just a few hundred metres away, there is a duck pond where you can observe the waterbirds, including some rare breeds. But remember to keep a distance from them and refrain from feeding them. Across the iron bridge, you'll get to formal gardens used for experiments on breeding local wild species. If you keep roaming down the trail, you'll see the old residence of Maori people forming a small village. These houses are full of local paintings, sculptures and artefacts, all donated by the city council to showcase the history and culture of Maori people living there. And these are not something you'll stumble upon in a regular museum.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：正如你所见，公园很大。它由许多自然奇观和人工设施组成。几百米外有一个鸭塘，你可以观察水鸟，包括一些稀有品种。但要记住与它们保持距离，不要喂食。过了铁桥，你会到达用于本地野生物种繁殖实验的正式花园。继续沿着小径走，你会看到毛利人的旧居形成的一个小村庄。这些房屋里满是当地绘画、雕塑和工艺品，都是由市议会捐赠的，用以展示生活在那里的毛利人的历史和文化。这些不是你在普通博物馆里能偶然看到的东西。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, and don't forget to visit the Temperate House. It's only a ten-minute walk away from the duck pond. It accommodates a whole range of wild plants from around the country. But what makes it unique is the forest of kauri trees, a native species to New Zealand. However, the kauri tree population was threatened by the spread of kauri dieback disease and is now under the protection of the Department of Conservation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：哦，别忘了去温带温室。从鸭塘走过去只需十分钟。那里容纳了全国各地的各种野生植物。但它的独特之处在于贝壳杉树林，这是新西兰的本土物种。然而，贝壳杉种群受到贝壳杉枯死病传播的威胁，现在受到保护部的保护。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me point out the whereabouts of some other critical features in the park in case you need them. If you are a plant lover and want to take some local greenery home, you may wish to visit the plant nursery, where you can choose from an extensive collection of plants from succulents to some rare local species. It's right next to the museum, on the same side of the road.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：让我指出公园里其他一些重要设施的位置，以防你们需要。如果你是植物爱好者，想带一些本地绿植回家，可以去苗圃，那里有从多肉植物到一些稀有本地物种的广泛选择。它在博物馆旁边，同侧路边。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There is a pine tree hill with tracks for hikers of all abilities. The whole trip takes about half an hour. There is a steep climb in places. Tread carefully and stick to the formal tracks. You'll be rewarded with great views. If you leave your car in the car park, you can see it just across the road towards George Street entry.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：有一座松树山丘，有适合各种能力的徒步者的步道。全程大约半小时。有些地方有陡峭的爬升。小心行走，坚持走正式步道。你会看到美丽的景色。如果你把车停在停车场，可以看到它就在乔治街入口对面的路边。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Or if you are an experienced hiker and want some challenge, you can choose Eagle Mountain. It offers fantastic hiking routes. It's also an ideal spot for bird watching, with many wild species unique to New Zealand. We are right here, at the Wellington entrance. Then take the 1st right, and you'll see eagle mountain immediately to your right.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：或者如果你是有经验的徒步者，想要一些挑战，可以选择鹰山。它有很棒的徒步路线。也是观鸟的理想地点，有许多新西兰特有的野生物种。我们现在就在惠灵顿入口。然后第一个路口右转，你会立刻看到鹰山就在你的右侧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you're hungry and want to take a quick bite, there is a nearby food kiosk providing snacks and beverages. Start from the Wellington entrance, take the 1st left, keep walking down the road, and after the junction a road connecting the George Street entry, you'll see it on your right. And lastly, there is a conservation area protecting kauri trees just by the Winter Garden. Unfortunately, it's currently out of bounds to the public.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你饿了想吃点东西，附近有一个食品亭提供小吃和饮料。从惠灵顿入口出发，第一个路口左转，沿着路走，经过连接乔治街入口的路口后，你会看到它在你的右侧。最后，冬季花园旁边有一个保护贝壳杉的保护区域。不幸的是，它目前不对公众开放。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ok, now, if you have anything else to ask, I'm here to help...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好了，如果你们还有其他问题，我随时可以帮忙……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, Shona.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗨，肖娜。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi, Peter. Have you made up your mind about which internship programme to apply for?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：嗨，彼得。你决定申请哪个实习项目了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, pretty much.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：是的，差不多决定了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm entirely at a loss. I mean, there are so many good ones. Can you give me some tips?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：我完全没主意了。我的意思是，有太多好的选择。你能给我一些建议吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：当然。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: What is your top priority when weighing up these programmes?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：你在权衡这些项目时首要考虑的是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I guess I'd go for ones that can help me with the skill set I lack for my future career. I still need a lot of practical training in dealing with statistics. But keep in mind that you don't want to set your goal too grand, like drawing up a business plan. You might end up nowhere.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，我想我会选择那些能帮助我获得未来职业所需技能的。我仍然需要大量关于统计学的实践训练。但要记住，不要把目标定得太宏大，比如制定商业计划。你可能会一事无成。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. So, I want to learn how to organise ideas and present them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：我明白了。所以，我想学习如何组织思路和进行陈述。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good. Now you've nailed step one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：好。现在你完成了第一步。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now what?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：然后呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: You must also consider your strengths for a suitable internship programme. Otherwise, you might get rejected or end up with one that you are incapable of doing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：你还必须考虑自己的优势，以选择适合的实习项目。否则，你可能会被拒绝，或者最后得到一个你无法胜任的项目。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: But I have no idea what I'm good at.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：但我不知道自己擅长什么。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Communicate with people around you or whom you've worked with. That's what I did. I thought I was a good team leader, but many people I've worked with for various projects mentioned something else. They admire that I could work around the clock to finish projects on time. And indeed, I'm more focused and perform better when I'm pushed for time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：和你周围的人或与你共事过的人交流。我就是这样做的。我以为自己是个好的团队领导，但和我合作过各种项目的很多人都提到了其他优点。他们欣赏我能夜以继日地按时完成项目。确实，当时间紧迫时，我更专注，表现也更好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good point. So what do you plan to do next?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：说得好。那你接下来打算做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll visit the careers officer to help me with the school application form. You know, the one we have to submit before applying to companies.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我会去找职业顾问，帮我处理学校申请表。你知道，就是在申请公司之前必须提交的那份。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: But it is unnecessary to fill it in. It's only optional.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：但不需要填写。那只是可选的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Really? I'm glad I heard from you. Then I'll ask the careers officer to look at my personal statement and give me some tips on polishing it up.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：真的吗？很高兴你告诉我了。那我会请职业顾问看看我的个人陈述，给我一些润色建议。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Don't you need help with your CV?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：你不需要帮助修改简历吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, I'm good. I have already learned to write it in class.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：不用，我挺好的。我已经在课上学过了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good. So what kind of company did you choose?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：很好。那你选择了哪种公司？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've decided to apply for an IT company.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我决定申请一家IT公司。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, even though I've learned how the IT industry developed in the past from different lectures, I know nothing about its latest trends. I'm prepared to work in an IT company and fill in the information gap.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，虽然我从不同的讲座中了解了IT行业过去的发展，但对它的最新趋势一无所知。我准备好在一家IT公司工作，填补这一信息空白。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. What do you plan to do next term?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：我明白了。你下学期打算做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think I'll stick to most of the optional modules I've chosen. But regarding the language sessions, I'm doing poorly in Japanese. I'd better drop it before wasting more time. I think I'll learn Spanish instead.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我想我会保留大部分已选选修课。但关于语言课程，我日语学得很差。最好在浪费更多时间之前放弃它。我想我会改学西班牙语。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I learned Spanish for a year. I think you'll find it interesting.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：哦，我学过一年西班牙语。我想你会觉得它有趣的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Do you know what job opportunities these companies offer interns?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：你知道这些公司给实习生提供什么工作机会吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I've searched online and browsed some of the schemes. Do you know SAIC?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我在网上搜索并浏览了一些项目。你知道SAIC吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. I heard they offer internship positions dealing with customer interaction management. But I'm not quite sure what that means.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：知道。我听说他们提供客户互动管理方面的实习岗位。但我不太确定那是什么意思。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the position offers the chance to become fully aware of customer value and keep in touch with customers to keep them highly engaged and satisfied. These include activities such as PR, communications, marketing and customer service.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：嗯，这个岗位提供了充分了解客户价值并与客户保持联系以保持他们高度参与和满意的机会。这些包括公关、沟通、市场营销和客户服务等活动。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds like loads of work to do. What about Gemini Technologies?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：听起来工作量很大。那Gemini Technologies呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's an IT consulting company. Although many employees say it's stressful working there, I want to apply for this one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：是一家IT咨询公司。虽然很多员工说在那里工作压力很大，但我想申请这家。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why is that?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：为什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Actually, the company provides service to improve software architecture. But that's pretty demanding as a team of software engineers has to provide detailed analysis and suggestions for required changes before the deadline. As an observer and participant of a particular project, an intern can learn how to work to a strict deadline.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：实际上，这家公司提供改进软件架构的服务。但这要求很高，因为一组软件工程师必须在截止日期前提供详细分析和所需变更建议。作为特定项目的观察者和参与者，实习生可以学习如何在严格的截止日期下工作。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's not my area of expertise. But I'm sure you'll excel at this.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：那不是我的专业领域。但我相信你会做得很好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: I certainly do hope so. Have you checked out Deloitte?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：我当然希望如此。你了解过德勤吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Shona
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. That's a renowned accounting firm, and thus its internships offer excellent learning experiences in this regard. You know, things like examining a company's financial statements - the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement. I want to give it a try. But I might get rejected, so I need a backup plan. Have you read anything about Kearney?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 肖娜：当然。那是一家著名的会计师事务所，因此它的实习在这方面提供了极好的学习经验。你知道，比如审查公司的财务报表——利润表、资产负债表和现金流量表。我想试试。但我可能会被拒绝，所以我需要一个备用计划。你读过关于科尔尼的信息吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Peter
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. It is another consulting firm. It provides opportunities to reach out to other business partners and pay attention to...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 彼得：是的。这是另一家咨询公司。它提供了接触其他商业伙伴的机会，并关注……

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For the last few sessions, we've been looking at the different architecture for both their utilitarian purposes and aesthetic features as well. In today's lecture, I want to continue this series by first introducing to you a unique underground museum in Japan. And then, we'll discuss the pros and cons of underground architecture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在过去的几节课中，我们一直在研究不同建筑的实用目的和美学特征。在今天的讲座中，我想继续这个系列，首先向你们介绍日本一个独特的地下博物馆。然后，我们将讨论地下建筑的利弊。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now this museum was built in 1996, and around eighty percent of the museum is buried underground to preserve the lush natural beauty. It houses an impressive collection of artworks. The exhibits consist of works from ancient civilizations, including the Egyptians, Romans, and various Asian cultures, with the pieces mainly coming from the founder's private collection.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：这座博物馆建于1996年，大约80%的建筑埋在地下，以保护茂盛的自然美景。它收藏了令人印象深刻的艺术品。展品包括来自古埃及、古罗马和多种亚洲文化的古代文明作品，主要来自创始人的私人收藏。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: But perhaps the most intriguing aspect of the museum is the design of its structures and how they are integrated into their natural surroundings. The museum is humbly embedded in mountains, close to a subway station connecting the nearest metropolis in about an hour.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：但也许博物馆最吸引人的方面是其结构设计以及它们如何融入自然环境。博物馆谦逊地嵌入山中，靠近一个地铁站，大约一小时可到达最近的大都市。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The design was inspired by an ancient Chinese story titled "Peach Blossom Valley". The architect read it when he was a schoolboy. It is about a fisherman who loses his way, and his boat carries him upstream. He is drawn into a cave by the fragrant scent of a forest of blossoming peach trees. After travelling through a narrow road behind the cave, the man finds an idyllic village amid a splendid view. The museum has been conceived as a real-world version of this village. Visitors must pass through a tunnel first and then a cable bridge suspended over a gorge before arriving at the museum.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：设计灵感来自中国古代故事《桃花源记》。建筑师在学生时代读过这个故事。讲述的是一个渔夫迷路了，他的船把他带到上游。他被一片盛开的桃花林的芳香吸引进了一个洞穴。穿过洞穴后面一条狭窄的道路，他发现在壮丽的景色中有一个田园诗般的村庄。这座博物馆被设想为这个村庄的现实版。游客必须先穿过一条隧道，然后经过一座悬挂在峡谷上的索桥才能到达博物馆。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The museum's details reflect the designer's innovative endeavor to break new ground. The architect changed the design numerous times to ensure the building was in harmony with the natural landscape. It becomes evident as tourists walk around the building as the detail is very fastidious and makes for a unique experience. Once visitors enter the museum, a sloping roof made of wide expanses of glass draws their attention right away. The web-like structure filtered the light through and scattered it across the surface, making visitors feel like being outside with a vibrant backdrop of seasonal colours.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：博物馆的细节反映了设计师创新开拓的努力。建筑师多次修改设计，以确保建筑与自然景观和谐。游客在建筑周围走动时这一点很明显，因为细节非常讲究，营造出独特的体验。一旦游客进入博物馆，一个由大面积玻璃制成的倾斜屋顶立刻吸引他们的注意。网状结构过滤光线并将其散射到表面，让游客感觉像在外面，背景是充满活力的季节色彩。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is now clear that underground buildings have many advantages over traditional above-ground houses, and many architects are looking into the possibilities of this type of subsurface structure. The most important advantage of these houses, especially in the current scenario of environmental degradation, is that they can better preserve indigenous flora and fauna. But the advantages of underground architecture go beyond that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在很明显，地下建筑比传统地上房屋有许多优势，许多建筑师正在探索这种地下结构的可能性。这些房屋最重要的优势，尤其是在当前环境退化的背景下，是它们能更好地保护本土动植物。但地下建筑的优势不止于此。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For one thing, the earth surrounding the homes absorbs noise and thus provides natural soundproofing, creating a quiet living space with privacy. Choosing an underground house will be peaceful and calming, even in a noisy region.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，房屋周围的土壤吸收噪音，从而提供天然的隔音效果，创造一个安静的私密生活空间。选择地下房屋会很宁静平和，即使是在嘈杂的区域。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Moreover, there is less part of underground houses that can catch fire. For the most part, wood is no longer needed for building a home underground. The concrete foundations and metal structures of these homes all ensure good fireproofing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，地下房屋容易着火的部分更少。大多数情况下，地下建屋不再需要木材。这些房屋的混凝土地基和金属结构都确保了良好的防火性能。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now underground houses also have the potential to save energy in the long run as they can tap the earth's heating or cooling power. The earth's temperature doesn't vary as much as the temperature of the air outside. It ensures that even though the climate outside fluctuates between extremes, the conditions inside the subterranean homes remain more or less stable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：从长远来看，地下房屋也有节能潜力，因为它们可以利用地球的加热或冷却能力。地球的温度不像外部空气温度那样变化大。这确保了即使外部气候在极端之间波动，地下房屋内的条件仍然或多或少保持稳定。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: However, there are also concerns over earth-sheltered homes. There may be a psychological adjustment needed for a person shifting from a traditional above-ground house to an underground house. Many people feel there is insufficient space in underground buildings. But in fact, these people also admit that they often visited shopping centres located in the basement and did not feel claustrophobic.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，地下房屋也存在一些担忧。从传统地上房屋搬到地下房屋可能需要心理调整。许多人觉得地下建筑空间不足。但事实上，这些人也承认他们经常去位于地下的购物中心，并没有感到幽闭恐惧。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In addition, underground houses cannot be built in regions experiencing flooding due to their unique geographical location. And even for areas that are suited for underground structures, drainage should be planned carefully to prevent moisture retention.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，由于其独特的地理位置，地下房屋不能在遭受洪水的地区建造。即使对于适合地下结构的区域，也应仔细规划排水系统以防止湿气滞留。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: While the advantages far outnumber their drawbacks, it may be a good idea to wait a little longer for these houses to come mainstream...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：虽然优势远远超过缺点，但也许等到这些房屋成为主流是更好的主意……
