transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. How may I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：早上好。我能为您做什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. We spoke on the phone last week, and I'm ringing to get more details about the job.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：早上好。我们上周通过电话，我打来是想了解更多关于那份工作的细节。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. Thank you for sending in your CV. We've carefully looked at it, and I think we have several jobs that might suit you.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：是的。感谢您寄来简历。我们仔细看过了，我觉得有几个职位可能适合您。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：太好了！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first one is in a magazine based in North London. They're looking for a reporter.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：第一个是一家位于伦敦北部的杂志社。他们在招聘记者。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: What sort of magazine is it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：是什么类型的杂志？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: They're called Home Solutions, which publishes articles on housing every week, and they want to find someone responsible for collecting the latest news and writing relevant articles.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：叫《家居解决方案》，每周出版关于住房的文章，他们想找一个人负责收集最新消息并撰写相关文章。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: What are the hours of work?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：工作时间是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you will be expected to work forty hours a week, but there may be opportunities to do overtime during busy periods. For example, some may work more than fifty hours a week and get extra pay. But you're not required to do this.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：嗯，您需要每周工作四十小时，但在繁忙时期可能会有加班机会。例如，有些人可能每周工作五十小时以上并获得额外报酬。但这不是强制性的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's reasonable. Do you know what the rates of pay are?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那很合理。您知道薪资标准吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. It says you'll get a monthly pay of 7000 pounds for the first six months. And after the probationary period, you'll be eligible for a salary of more than that, maybe 7500 pounds or more.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：知道。上面说前六个月月薪为7000英镑。试用期过后，您将有资格获得更高的薪资，可能7500英镑或更多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那很好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: So, is that something that might interest you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那么，您对这个感兴趣吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is, yes. The only thing is, you say they are in North London, so it would be a pretty long commute for me.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：是的，感兴趣。唯一的问题是，您说他们在伦敦北部，所以对我来说通勤路程会相当长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: In that case, the second position might suit you better regarding location. That's a researcher for an electronic engineering company in South London.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那样的话，第二个职位在位置上可能更适合您。那是伦敦南部一家电子工程公司的研究员。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that would be a lot closer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：是的，那会近很多。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Your CV shows you have relevant working experience in this field.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：您的简历显示您在该领域有相关工作经验。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I worked in the office of a computer engineering company for two years. What about the working hours?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：是的，我在一家计算机工程公司的办公室工作了两年。工作时间呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: For this job, you'll have to work 45 hours a week and the starting salary is 7200 pounds for the six-month probationary period.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：这份工作每周需要工作45小时，六个月试用期的起薪是7200英镑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That should be nice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那应该不错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: I can arrange for you an interview if you're interested. But before that, may I ask where you heard about us? Was it in an advert or did your friend tell you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：如果您感兴趣，我可以为您安排面试。但在此之前，我能问一下您是从哪里听说我们的吗？是广告还是朋友告诉您的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Neither. It was a website. Then I just got your number from the phone book.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：都不是。是一个网站。然后我从电话簿上找到了您的号码。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, right.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：哦，好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Apart from full-time jobs, we have some part-time work that might suit you. Here several magazines are recruiting part-time writers. Are you interested?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：除了全职工作，我们还有一些可能适合您的兼职。有几家杂志在招聘兼职撰稿人。您感兴趣吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: What kind of writer exactly? I mean, what types of articles should I write about?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：具体是什么样的撰稿人？我是说，我应该写哪种类型的文章？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the first one is to do with sports reports. For this, you're expected to write sports articles twice weekly.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：嗯，第一个是与体育报道有关的。您需要每周写两篇体育文章。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I love sports. I'm a football fan. But as far as writing is concerned, I'm not entirely keen on that. I think I'll rule it out.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：嗯，我喜欢体育。我是个足球迷。但就写作而言，我不太热衷。我想我会排除这个。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Then how about writing something for entertainment? Does it appeal to you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的。那写娱乐方面的呢？对您有吸引力吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Entertainment is an exciting topic. I like reading news or articles in this category, but I'm not sure if I should write something about it. Anyway, I'll think about that. Could you give me more details?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：娱乐是一个令人兴奋的话题。我喜欢读这方面的新闻或文章，但我不确定是否应该写这方面的内容。总之，我会考虑的。您能给我更多细节吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, I've got your email, and I will send the details to you later.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的，我有您的邮箱，我会稍后把细节发给您。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Thanks.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：谢谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: And the third one is writing reviews for soap dramas.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：第三个是为肥皂剧写评论。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, soap drama is my favourite. I worked as a freelance writer in this field three years ago. I think it's pretty worthwhile to give my own opinions and recommendations to the audience.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：哦，肥皂剧是我的最爱。我三年前在这个领域做过自由撰稿人。我觉得向观众提供自己的观点和建议是很有价值的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's good. And the last one is writing articles for a business economy magazine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：那很好。最后一个是为一本商业经济杂志写文章。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm unfamiliar with this field, so I think it might not be easy.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：我对这个领域不熟悉，所以我觉得可能不容易。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: Don't worry too much. Experience is not essential for this job. They've got a training session for every recruit.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：别太担心。经验不是这项工作的必备条件。他们对每个新员工都有培训课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That sounds not too bad.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：听起来还不错。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Woman
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, would you like me to send you the pamphlet so that you can learn more about it?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 女士：好的，您需要我把宣传册发给您以便了解更多吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That will be nice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：那太好了。

transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's it. I'll send you all the information later and...

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello, everyone! I'm Hazel, the guide from Travelite Agency. Since we mentioned the trip to Muna Island in the last program, we've received several online messages from those who have been there. As a result, we've collected some helpful dos and don'ts for new visitors, which will hopefully help you to know the island better and enjoy your stay to the fullest!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家好！我是黑兹尔，Travelite旅行社的导游。自从我们在上次节目中提到了穆纳岛之旅，我们收到了很多去过那里的人的在线留言。因此，我们收集了一些对新游客有用的注意事项，希望能帮助你们更好地了解该岛，充分享受你们的逗留！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first suggestion is about tips. Although tipping is required in most circumstances in Muna Island, the amount you should give differs significantly. If you take a taxi, there is no set rate on how much you should leave to the driver. Someone may give a generous tip if he thinks the service is fantastic. It's up to you entirely. However, if you go to the hairdresser's or enjoy a meal in a restaurant and the bill comes with no service charge, a 10% tip is advisable.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：第一条建议是关于小费的。虽然在穆纳岛大多数情况下都需要给小费，但你应该给的金额差别很大。如果你坐出租车，没有固定标准规定你应该给司机多少小费。如果有人认为服务很好，可能会给慷慨的小费。这完全取决于你自己。然而，如果你去理发店或在餐厅用餐，账单上没有服务费，建议给10%的小费。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Muna Island has got relatively good medical service. If you get sick, the quickest way is to ask the hotel to arrange an English-speaking doctor for you, but remember it's not a complimentary service. The other alternative is to visit the local clinic, and you have to prepare for the charge as well. I should remind you that the medical service on the island can be pricey, so it's better to buy your insurance before you leave.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：穆纳岛有相对较好的医疗服务。如果你生病了，最快的方法是让酒店为你安排一位会说英语的医生，但记住这不是免费服务。另一个选择是去当地的诊所，你也需要准备支付费用。我应该提醒你，岛上的医疗服务可能很昂贵，所以最好在出发前购买保险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: When you visit Muna Island, you'll see the notice nearly everywhere: tap water is safe to drink. But you might not get used to its weird taste because it contains minerals. In this case, you can buy bottled water sold in every shop, but you'd better make sure the sealed lid is untouched, as the locals often put tap water into the bottle.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：当你访问穆纳岛时，几乎到处都能看到告示：自来水可以安全饮用。但你可能不习惯它奇怪的味道，因为它含有矿物质。这种情况下，你可以购买每家商店都有售的瓶装水，但最好确保密封盖没有被打开过，因为当地人经常把自来水灌进瓶子里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then I'll focus on transportation in Muna Island. The bus is the most commonly used means of transportation for local residents. Although there aren't many bus lines, they're always on time. However, some people complained that the road was so bumpy that they even got nausea and dizziness. As a result, it's not a good choice if you want to sit peacefully and relax on the way. And another thing is, before you jump on the bus, enquire of the driver about where the bus will go. Unlike most cities, here in Muna Island, you cannot find the destination shown in front of the bus or at the bus stop.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后我来谈谈穆纳岛的交通。公共汽车是当地居民最常用的交通工具。虽然公交线路不多，但总是准点。然而，有些人抱怨道路太颠簸，以至于他们感到恶心和头晕。因此，如果你想在路上安静放松地坐着，这可不是一个好选择。另一件事是，在上车之前，向司机询问巴士的去向。与大多数城市不同，在穆纳岛，你无法在公交车前面或公交车站看到目的地显示。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Maybe you've found the bus service is not so enjoyable, in that case, you can always rent a car. If you choose this way, I advise you to prepare well beforehand. Although some taxi companies provide car rental services, many visitors sometimes find nobody answering the phone, so leave this way when you are in a hurry. It's wise to compare several car rental companies online beforehand, as the price may vary a lot. Booking via hotel may be overcharged, as it contains a 10% commission, so it's also not advisable. More importantly, don't forget to check with the company what the price covers in detail, like daily rental expenses, car insurance, commission etc. It usually includes unlimited mileage too, but fuel is excluded.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：也许你发现巴士服务不太令人满意，在这种情况下，你总是可以租车。如果你选择这种方式，我建议你事先做好准备。虽然一些出租车公司提供汽车租赁服务，但许多游客有时发现没人接电话，所以赶时间的时候不要依赖这种方式。事先在网上比较几家租车公司是明智的，因为价格可能差别很大。通过酒店预订可能会被多收费，因为其中包含10%的佣金，所以也不建议。更重要的是，别忘了向公司确认价格具体包含什么，比如每日租金、汽车保险、佣金等。通常也包括无限里程，但燃料不包括在内。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: If you don't want to drive, a taxi is the quickest and most comfortable way, although few are available on Muna Island. If you want to find a taxi quickly, it's not a good idea to reserve through the taxi company, as sometimes you'll have quite a wait, especially in the rush hour. The easiest way is just waving your hands on the street to stop the taxi. Otherwise, the driver will drive away directly after he drops off the guests. Oh, another thing is, I have to remind you that there is no meter for taxis in Muna Island, so before you jump in the taxi, you'd better negotiate with the driver about how much you're going to pay. For example, if you take a taxi from the airport at night, it may cost you. So, confirm the price before you get in.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：如果你不想开车，出租车是最快捷舒适的方式，尽管穆纳岛的出租车很少。如果你想快速找到出租车，通过出租车公司预订不是个好主意，因为有时你需要等很久，尤其是在高峰期。最简单的方法是在街上挥手拦车。否则，司机在送完客人后会直接开走。哦，还有一件事，我必须提醒你，穆纳岛的出租车没有计程器，所以在上车之前，你最好和司机协商好要付多少钱。例如，如果你晚上从机场打车，可能会很贵。所以，上车前确认价格。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's all about the tips for Muna Island that I want to share today. And are there any questions?...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：好了，这就是我今天想分享的关于穆纳岛的全部建议。有问题吗？……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Excuse me, Professor. Can I talk to you for a minute?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：打扰一下，教授。我能和您谈一会儿吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, do come in. So you're Sally Layman?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，请进。你是莎莉·莱曼？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: You want to discuss with me changing courses, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你想和我讨论换课程的事，对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: All right. What course are you doing at present, Sally?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。你目前在学什么课程，莎莉？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's Economic History.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：经济史。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. And when did you begin this course?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。你是什么时候开始这门课的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me think. Erm... it was last September.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：让我想想。呃……是去年九月。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Good. Before we talk through all your problems with the course, I want to know what courses you'd like to change to.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。在我们详细讨论你在这门课上的所有问题之前，我想知道你想换到什么课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, there're several courses that I've thought about, but my first choice would be Politics.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：嗯，我考虑过好几门课，但我的第一选择是政治学。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, it's one of the most popular courses in our college.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：哦，那是我们学院最受欢迎的课程之一。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I know. So it means there might not be places available?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，我知道。所以这意味着可能没有名额了？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. I'll still make a note of that. But it's better to give another option.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的。我还是会记下来。但最好再给一个备选。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I've thought of changing the course entirely to Business Studies, but then I realize it is new to me, so I think Philosophy might be a better choice.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：嗯，我考虑过完全换成商科，但我意识到那对我来说是新的，所以我觉得哲学可能是更好的选择。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's useful to know. Then let's talk through any problems you've been having at the moment and see if there is any possibility for us to offer help. After all, with all the efforts that you've made already, it'll be a pity to give up the present course and completely start a new one.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，知道这个很有用。那么我们来谈谈你目前遇到的任何问题，看看我们是否有机会提供帮助。毕竟，你已经付出了这么多努力，放弃目前的课程完全重新开始一个会很可惜。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I agree with that. I've learnt something valuable about Economic History.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，我同意。我学到了关于经济史的一些有价值的东西。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good. Well, let's talk about your problems. What do you think is your significant difficulty in the course?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：很好。那么，我们来谈谈你的问题。你认为你在课程中最大的困难是什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I have to say the biggest problem is that the lectures are difficult.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：嗯，我得说最大的问题是讲座很难懂。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. And have you tried something to overcome this problem?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。你试过什么方法来解决这个问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I have. I tried recording the lectures because I couldn't follow what the lecturer said.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，我试过。我试过录下讲座，因为我跟不上讲师说的内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, that's a good idea. And did you find it helped?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的，那是个好主意。你觉得有用吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: To a certain extent, but...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：在一定程度上，但是……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, recording is a good strategy, but I also advise you to take part in the discussion group with other fellow students to discuss the lectures and exchange ideas with them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，录音是个好策略，但我也建议你参加和其他同学的小组讨论，讨论讲座内容并交流想法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I've seen some of my classmates doing that. I'll ask them if I can join.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，我看到我的一些同学在这样做。我会问他们我能不能加入。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good, I'm sure you'll find it helps. And any other problems?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，我相信你会发现它有用的。还有其他问题吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, the second problem is, I think there aren't enough tutorials for this course.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，第二个问题是，我觉得这门课的辅导课不够。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. I think you can talk to your tutor about this.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。我想你可以和你的导师谈谈这个问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I did that. But the tutor is so busy that I must wait until she is available.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：是的，我谈了。但导师太忙了，我必须等到她有空。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Why don't you try arranging meetings ahead of time?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：你为什么不试试提前安排会面呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I can try this way.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：嗯，我可以试试这个方法。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: But I suppose the thing that made me upset recently is my poor assignment grade.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：但我想最近让我沮丧的事情是我糟糕的作业成绩。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, the grade is an important issue.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：哦，成绩是个重要问题。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I think I've tried my best to achieve a good score. I did more background reading than before for the last assignment we just submitted.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：嗯，我想我已经尽力取得好成绩了。对我们刚交的上一份作业，我做了比以前更多的背景阅读。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good, and did you feel that helped?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：很好，你觉得那有用吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh yes, I think so.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：哦是的，我觉得有用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I think you can try another strategy, which is to visit student services, which offer a lot of helpful advice on assignment preparation.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，我觉得你可以尝试另一个策略，就是去学生服务中心，他们在作业准备方面提供了很多有用的建议。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I've never heard about that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：哦，我从没听说过。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'll give you a booklet with details on this. You'll find it well worth trying.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：我会给你一本详细说明的小册子。你会发现它很值得一试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, I'll certainly try it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的，我一定会试试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, that's all the problem. Well, I've made a record of our discussions and suggested strategies. Typically, we advise you to try out these suggestions for a short period and then come back to discuss the situation to see whether it is improved. If not, we will start considering alternative courses.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，问题就这些。嗯，我已经记录了我们的讨论和建议的策略。通常，我们建议你尝试这些建议一小段时间，然后回来讨论情况是否有改善。如果没有，我们会开始考虑替代课程。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, when shall I come back?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的，我什么时候回来？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: How about in a month's time?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：一个月后怎么样？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That will be on the 17th of February. How about half past three in the afternoon? Is that all right for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：那将是2月17日。下午三点半怎么样？你方便吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, sure. And where shall I meet you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的，当然。我在哪里见您？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: I'm afraid I will be on leave at that time. But I'll leave this record to our senior adviser, and you will meet with him then in this office.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：恐怕那时候我正在休假。但我会把这份记录留给我们的高级顾问，届时你会在这间办公室见他。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good, that's it! Let's see whether things can improve, Sally.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的，就这样！让我们看看情况是否能改善，莎莉。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Sally
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. Thanks very much!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 莎莉：好的。非常感谢！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: My pleasure. Bye!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不客气。再见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For my presentation today, I will focus on earth-sheltered housing or underground housing as it's more commonly known. I'll illustrate how it can meet the demands of ecological environmental planning regarding building and energy resources.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：今天我的展示将聚焦于覆土建筑，或者说更常被称为的地下建筑。我将说明它如何满足关于建筑和能源资源的生态环境规划要求。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let's first look at the advantages of earth-sheltered housing. Perhaps the most significant merit of earth-sheltered housing is the low impact on the environment since houses built underground can hardly be seen from the surface. Then, earth-sheltered houses are not only environmentally friendly but also surprisingly efficient regarding energy. It is because underground housing can make great use of the alternative technologies to improve energy efficiency.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先让我们看看覆土建筑的优势。也许覆土建筑最重要的优点是对环境影响小，因为建在地下的房屋从地面几乎看不到。其次，覆土建筑不仅环保，而且在能源方面也出奇地高效。这是因为地下建筑可以很好地利用替代技术来提高能源效率。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Moreover, many earth-sheltered housing projects use natural, non-toxic building materials. Some are even more durable than standard building materials. As a result, earth-sheltered houses have a lifespan of 500 years or more. This type of building technique means less exposure to the outside elements like sunshine, storm, snow etc., so it can give the houses actual protection and keep the maintenance of the houses to the minimum.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：此外，许多覆土建筑项目使用天然无毒的建筑材料。有些甚至比标准建筑材料更耐用。因此，覆土建筑的寿命可达500年或更长。这种建筑技术意味着更少暴露在阳光、风暴、雪等外部环境中，因此能为房屋提供切实的保护，并将房屋维护降到最低。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Earth-sheltered houses also give people a quiet environment. As we know, noise is a severe problem in modern society, and many people consider moving home because of this. In that case, earth-sheltered houses might be a good choice because living underground means those people will no longer suffer from the disturbances caused by the traffic on the road.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：覆土建筑也为人们提供了一个安静的环境。如我们所知，噪音是现代社会的严重问题，许多人因此考虑搬家。在这种情况下，覆土建筑可能是一个好选择，因为住在地下意味着那些人不再遭受道路上交通造成的干扰。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: And lastly, earth-sheltered houses also bring significant health advantages to people. Because of the sophistication of the ventilation systems installed in earth-sheltered houses, it provides a comfortable living environment for people who have asthma and other chest diseases.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：最后，覆土建筑还给人们带来显著的健康优势。由于覆土建筑中安装的通风系统复杂精良，它为患有哮喘和其他胸部疾病的人提供了舒适的生活环境。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then let's move on to earth-sheltered housing in the UK. Despite all the apparent advantages we mentioned above, earth-sheltered housing still isn't a popular choice for most British families, as the statistics show. The British Earth-sheltering Association tries to persuade people to try this type of accommodation, saying that it's easier to get planning permission for an earth-sheltered house. In contrast, for a conventional home, there is always too much red tape. A lot of evidence shows that the building development offices are more sympathetic to earth-sheltered projects, especially in the conservation areas. On the sites where conventional houses aren't usually allowed to build, earth-sheltered housing might be a feasible solution. And there is even a possibility that one day, earth-sheltered houses can take the place of mobile homes along the coastlines in the UK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在我们来看看英国的覆土建筑。尽管有上述所有明显优势，但统计数据显示覆土建筑仍然不是大多数英国家庭的热门选择。英国覆土建筑协会试图说服人们尝试这种住宿方式，称覆土建筑更容易获得规划许可。相比之下，传统住宅总是有太多繁文缛节。大量证据表明，建筑开发办公室对覆土项目更友好，尤其是在保护区。在通常不允许建造传统房屋的地方，覆土建筑可能是一个可行的解决方案。甚至有一天，覆土建筑可能取代英国沿海地区的移动房屋。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In the last part, I'd like to talk about two different projects in the UK: Mole Manor and Hockerton. When it was first built, Mole Manor attracted wide publicity around the world. A newspaper poll conducted by the Earth-sheltering Association showed that Mole Manor was voted as one of the twelve most desirable places to live in the world. Similarly, Hockerton aroused considerable interest from the international media as well, winning several awards for its innovative environmental design.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在最后部分，我想谈谈英国的两个不同项目：鼹鼠庄园和霍克顿。鼹鼠庄园刚建成时，引起了世界各地的广泛关注。由覆土建筑协会进行的一项报纸民意调查显示，鼹鼠庄园被选为世界上最理想的十二个居住地之一。同样，霍克顿也引起了国际媒体的极大兴趣，因其创新的环保设计赢得了多个奖项。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The running cost for Mole Manor is much lower than that of conventional houses. It is because Mole Manor is installed with an effective insulation system, significantly reducing its heating bill. While at Hockerton, all the basic needs of families living there are satisfied by energies in this area. For example, wind power, solar energy and rain are used to generate enough warmth, water for washing and drinking, and electricity for lighting and cooking. As a result, people there can live a lifestyle in harmony with the environment.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：鼹鼠庄园的运营成本远低于传统房屋。这是因为鼹鼠庄园安装了有效的隔热系统，大大降低了取暖费用。而在霍克顿，居住在那里家庭的所有基本需求都由该地区的能源满足。例如，风能、太阳能和雨水被用来产生足够的热量、洗涤和饮用水，以及照明和烹饪用电。因此，那里的人们可以过着与环境和谐相处的生活方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is also proved that at Hockerton, earth-sheltered houses can be built on a modest budget because it gives priority to cost when designing the houses. But it is not the case with Mole Manor, which pays more attention to style than cost. Compared with the homely cottage style at Hockerton, the houses at Mole Manor are expensive, beautiful and comfortable, and it is said that these houses are worth more than 800,000 pounds today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：事实证明，在霍克顿，覆土建筑可以在适度的预算下建造，因为它在设计房屋时优先考虑成本。但鼹鼠庄园的情况并非如此，它更注重风格而非成本。与霍克顿简朴的小屋风格相比，鼹鼠庄园的房屋昂贵、漂亮且舒适，据说这些房屋今天价值超过80万英镑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In conclusion, Mole Manor and Hockerton Projects show that earth-sheltered housing has numerous advantages. They can not only provide comfortable and stylish houses to people but are also beneficial to the environment. And with the help of new energy-saving technology, it can meet all the criteria for ecological and environmental planning.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：总之，鼹鼠庄园和霍克顿项目表明覆土建筑有许多优点。它们不仅能为人们提供舒适时尚的房屋，而且对环境有益。在新型节能技术的帮助下，它可以满足生态环境规划的所有标准。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. Welcome to the Early Learning Childcare Centre. How can I help you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：早上好。欢迎来到早期学习托儿中心。我能为您效劳吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good morning. I came across the advertisement for your childcare centre last week, and I'm calling to get some details. I'm thinking of enrolling my daughter.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：早上好。我上周看到了你们托儿中心的广告，打电话来了解一下详情。我正在考虑给我女儿报名。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. What do you want to know, sir?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：好的。您想了解什么，先生？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I've learnt from the brochure that there are different types of caring, and I'm interested in the short-day one. How much is the cost?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：嗯，我从宣传册上了解到有不同的托育类型，我对短日托感兴趣。费用是多少？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, it depends on the age of your child. For children over the age of two, we charge 30 dollars a day, and for those younger than two, you have to pay 37.50 dollars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：嗯，这取决于您孩子的年龄。两岁以上的孩子每天收费30美元，两岁以下的则需支付37.50美元。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Does it include meals?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：包括餐食吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I'm afraid not. You have to pay extra for them. But we offer you free care for 20 hours weekly. It used to be 10 hours, but this month, we extended the length of time as a special offer for our clients.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：嗯，恐怕不包括。您需要额外付费。但我们每周提供20小时的免费托育服务。以前是10小时，但这个月我们作为给客户的特别优惠延长了时长。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, that will be of great help. OK, that's about the fee. Then may I know more about your centre, something about the children's activities, the staff etc.?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：哦，那会很有帮助。好的，费用方面了解了。那我能更多了解一下你们的中心吗，比如孩子的活动、员工等方面？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. We offer a diversity of indoor activities, which cater for children of different ages, for example, paintings with watercolours, singing, dancing, games etc. Moreover, when the weather is good, we always take children to our playground and organize different programmes in the open air.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：好的。我们提供多种室内活动，适合不同年龄段的孩子，例如水彩画、唱歌、跳舞、游戏等。此外，天气好的时候，我们经常带孩子们去我们的游乐场，在户外组织不同的活动。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great! Outdoor activities are essential for children. What about the teachers? Are they experienced?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：太好了！户外活动对孩子们至关重要。老师们呢？他们有经验吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course! All teachers in our centre have relevant working experience of at least three years and specialize in primary school education.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：当然！我们中心的所有教师都有至少三年的相关工作经验，专攻小学教育。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! Then they must be professional in dealing with children. Another thing is, I've heard from other parents that they can receive a report from their caring centres every weekend about how their children perform during that week, and I wonder, is there anything like that in your centre?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：太好了！那他们一定很专业。还有一件事，我听其他家长说他们每周末会收到托育中心关于孩子一周表现的报告，我想问你们中心有这样的服务吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, we provide that too.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：是的，我们也提供。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Great! Then I want to enrol my daughter as soon as possible.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：太好了！那我想尽快给我女儿报名。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I'm afraid we have no vacancy at the moment, and you can't join until the beginning of September because one child will finish caring at the end of August.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：嗯，恐怕我们现在没有名额了，您要到九月初才能加入，因为有一个孩子八月底结束托育。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：我明白了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then I will talk about our staff. All of our centre's members are well trained so that they will take care of your children in every aspect. For example, when doing activities with special needs, our staff will prepare all the necessities for children, like aprons in the painting class, sunglasses and sun cream when playing outside in a sunny day.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：那我来说说我们的员工。我们中心的所有成员都受过良好培训，因此他们会全方位照顾您的孩子。例如，在进行有特殊需求的活动时，我们的员工会为孩子准备所有必需品，比如绘画课上的围裙，晴天户外活动时的太阳镜和防晒霜。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's great that you can consider that. I thought we had to prepare for these by ourselves.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：你们能考虑到这些真是太好了。我以为这些得我们自己准备。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: You must provide something - a family photo. Many children may miss their parents, especially during the first week, so our staff will take photos of every child in case they need them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：您必须提供一些东西——一张全家福。很多孩子可能会想父母，尤其是第一周，所以我们的员工会为每个孩子拍照，以备他们需要。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. Apart from the professional knowledge of caring, are there any other requirements for your staff?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的。除了专业的育儿知识，你们的员工还有其他要求吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, actually, when we do the recruitment, the priority we consider is the general health of the staff, so each applicant must provide a health certificate from the doctor.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：嗯，实际上，我们在招聘时，优先考虑的是员工的整体健康状况，所以每位申请者都必须提供医生的健康证明。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I agree it's essential. I've learned about your centre and am pretty interested. But I still have to discuss it with my wife.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：是的，我同意这很重要。我已经了解了你们中心，很感兴趣。但我还得和我妻子商量一下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. Then I'll give you the contact detail of our centre, and if you want to register, you can call us or even have a visit if you like.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：当然。那我给你我们中心的联系方式，如果你想报名，可以打电话甚至来参观。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. What's your address?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的。你们的地址是？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's NO.75, Calliope Avenue, that's C-A-double L-I-O-P-E Walkley.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：卡利奥佩大道75号，拼写是C-A-双写L-I-O-P-E，沃克利。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, NO.75, Calliope Avenue.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的，卡利奥佩大道75号。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: And the telephone number is 4789 6354.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：电话号码是4789 6354。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. That's everything I want to know. Thank you very much.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：好的。这就是我想了解的全部了。非常感谢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Director
transcriptSentences.englishText: You are welcome! Bye!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 主任：不客气！再见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Man
transcriptSentences.englishText: Bye!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 男士：再见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Welcome to our radio program "Travel with Me in Australia". I'm Anna, the presenter of the radio show. In today's session, I will introduce a fantastic place to you - the Coconut Beach Resort, which was newly built and opened to the public several months ago. I visited the resort and had a wonderful time there. Now I will give some details.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：欢迎收听我们的电台节目“澳大利亚与我同行”。我是安娜，这档电台节目的主持人。在今天的节目中，我将向大家介绍一个很棒的地方——椰子海滩度假村，它几个月前新建并向公众开放。我去过那个度假村，在那里度过了美好的时光。现在我来介绍一些细节。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First of all, who is the target group? As it is a beach resort, it's not suitable for backpackers, of course. With little houses alongside the beach, this resort is the best place to spend time with your beloved one. I know several newlyweds booked cabins there to spend their honeymoon. However, it isn't an ideal destination for families with several children because it may be beyond the budget.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先，目标客户群是谁？作为一个海滨度假村，它当然不适合背包客。海滩边有小屋，这个度假村是与爱人共度时光的最佳场所。我知道有几对新婚夫妇在那里预订了小木屋度蜜月。然而，对于有几个孩子的家庭来说，这不是一个理想的目的地，因为它可能超出预算。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: About the accommodation, you can choose from different types of rooms, and the price differs a lot. Take the bathing facilities, for example; I booked a room with a spa bath for the first two days, which is the most cost-effective one. But for the three days left, I changed the room and lived in the one with a private pool. It was my favourite; I have to say. Every night I could relax in the pool, which is so personal and secluded. And the third option is a room with a private beach, which I want to experience next time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：关于住宿，您可以选择不同类型的房间，价格差异很大。以洗浴设施为例，头两天我预订了一间带水疗浴缸的房间，那是最划算的。但剩下的三天，我换了房间，住进了一间带私人泳池的房间。我得说，那是我的最爱。每天晚上我都可以在泳池里放松，那非常私密和隐蔽。第三种选择是带私人海滩的房间，我下次想体验一下。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: The resort has various facilities catering to the needs of different visitors. There is a golf course, and if you want to play, you can either hire the equipment on the course or buy it in the golf shop. If you're going to bring some snacks and drinks and relax in the open air, you can go to the picnic area, which was extended recently. The good news is that a horse ranch was added to the resort, so you can try horse riding if interested.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：度假村有各种设施，满足不同游客的需求。有一个高尔夫球场，如果您想打球，可以在球场租用设备或在高尔夫用品店购买。如果您想带些零食和饮料在户外放松，可以去野餐区，那里最近扩建了。好消息是度假村增加了一个马场，所以如果您感兴趣可以尝试骑马。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: You can also visit a range of attractions, like the farm, waterfall etc. I went to the town on the first day to enjoy the local food and talk with the local people. Then, the next day, I joined a tour group to the rainforest. It was my first time seeing a rainforest, and I was struck by the thick vegetation...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：您还可以参观一系列景点，如农场、瀑布等。第一天我去了镇上品尝当地美食并与当地人交谈。第二天，我参加了一个旅行团去了雨林。那是我第一次看到雨林，我被茂密的植被所震撼……

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: Erm... hello Professor, I'm Russ. I spoke to you on the phone last week.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：呃……你好，教授，我是拉斯。我们上周通过电话。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Ah, yes, come in and have a seat. You want to talk to me about the archaeology course, right?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：啊，是的，请进坐下。你想和我谈谈考古学课程的事，对吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, I've read the handbook, but I still have some questions and want to know more details before deciding whether to do it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：是的，我读了手册，但还有一些问题，想在决定是否选这门课之前了解更多细节。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right. So, what would you like to know?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：好的。那你想了解什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, first of all, when I choose the archaeology course, can I integrate it with other subjects? For example, one in anthropology?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：嗯，首先，如果我选了考古学课程，能和其他学科结合吗？比如人类学？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes, it can be combined with any other subjects apart from classical history. That's because there is some overlap in the lecture times for those two courses. We weren't able to coordinate them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的，它可以与除古典历史以外的任何其他学科结合。那是因为那两门课的讲座时间有重叠。我们没能协调好。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's OK. Then about the modules, could you tell me the details?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：那没问题。那关于课程模块，您能告诉我细节吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: In the first semester, there are three modules, all of which are compulsory.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：在第一学期，有三个模块，都是必修的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about optional modules?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：那选修模块呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, we don't offer optional modules until next semester.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，我们下学期才提供选修模块。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: The first module is called Object Matters, and Dr Morris teaches it. This module is mainly about what can be learnt from specific artifacts such as pottery and stone tools.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：第一个模块叫“物件研究”，由莫里斯博士授课。这个模块主要是关于从陶器和石器等特定文物中可以学到什么。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's something I've never heard about. I'm interested. How is the module presented? I mean, is it all lectures?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：这是我从未听说过的。我很感兴趣。这个模块的授课方式是什么？我的意思是，全是讲座吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, you mean the learning method. In this case, its lectures are combined with practical sessions, so it's a mixture.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：嗯，你是说学习方法。在这个案例中，它是讲座与实践课相结合，所以是混合式的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about the content of the module? I suppose we will be looking at different kinds of archaeological remains and how to date them, that kind of thing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：那模块的内容呢？我想我们会研究不同类型的考古遗迹以及如何确定它们的年代之类的内容。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: To some extent, yes. But the module is based on processes. And it covers four aspects in detail: first of all, recording material, and then classification, then the interpretation of the data, that's how archaeologists conclude their findings, and finally, display. Is that OK for you?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：在某种程度上是的。但这个模块基于过程。它详细涵盖了四个方面：首先是记录材料，然后是分类，然后是数据解释——那是考古学家如何得出结论的——最后是展示。你觉得可以吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: I think so. Yes, thanks! Oh, one important thing, how is the module assessed? Should we take an exam at the end of the semester?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：我觉得可以。是的，谢谢！哦，还有一件重要的事，这个模块如何评估？我们期末要考试吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. It's all based on coursework after each lecture, so try your best when the lecturer assigns you a task.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不。完全基于每次讲座后的课程作业，所以当讲师给你布置任务时要尽力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: The second module's title is Towns and Cities. It is taught by Professor Elliot, the head of our department. And as the name suggests, the module focuses on the origins of built environments and how they developed.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：第二个模块叫“城镇与城市”。由我们系的主任埃利奥特教授授课。顾名思义，这个模块关注建成环境的起源及其发展方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's mainly factual, I suppose.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：那主要是事实性的，我想。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: It is. And for that reason, it is assessed by examination. But instead of a written exam, we set it as an oral one, as we think most students prefer this way.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：是的。因此，它通过考试来评估。但我们不采用笔试，而是口试，因为我们认为大多数学生更喜欢这种方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: It sounds a bit scary. I prefer written exams.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：听起来有点可怕。我更喜欢笔试。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Don't worry too much. Most of our students find they enjoy it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：别太担心。我们的大多数学生发现他们喜欢这种方式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：好的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: And then the third module is called Method and Science. And in this module, Dr Thompson will introduce you to the standard techniques used in archaeological fieldwork and analysis, such as excavating and dating.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：第三个模块叫“方法与科学”。在这个模块中，汤普森博士将向你介绍考古田野工作和分析中使用的标准技术，如挖掘和测年。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about the learning method for this module? Are there any lectures, or it's all laboratory work?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：这个模块的学习方法是什么？有讲座吗，还是全是实验室工作？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, there aren't any lectures. It combines half lab work and half seminars.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：哦，没有任何讲座。它由一半实验室工作和一半研讨课组成。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: What about the assessment?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：那评估呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, you are lucky; this module has no formal assessment. But right at the end of the module, you will have to take part in a site survey.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：哦，你很幸运；这个模块没有正式的评估。但在模块结束时，你必须参加一次实地勘测。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's great! Where shall we go for the site survey?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：太好了！我们去哪里进行实地勘测？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sorry, I can't tell you the location yet. That would be announced later. The date for that is the week beginning the 10th of March.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：抱歉，我还不能告诉你地点。那会稍后公布。日期是3月10日开始的那一周。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Russ
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK. That's all I want to know. Thank you very much, Professor. Bye!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 拉斯：好的。这就是我想了解的全部了。非常感谢您，教授。再见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: Tutor
transcriptSentences.englishText: You are welcome, Russ. Bye!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 导师：不客气，拉斯。再见！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: In today's lecture, I'm going to talk about digital technology, especially the changes occurring due to the rapid spread of digital technology in the last decade of the 21st century. First, what is digital technology? Well, digital technology includes any computer related devices like mobile phones, the Internet, email, instant messaging, and so on. This lecture is based on the opinions of Marc Prensky and what he believes are the main effects that high exposure to digital technology has had on young people today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：在今天的讲座中，我将讨论数字技术，特别是由于21世纪最后十年数字技术的迅速普及而发生的变化。首先，什么是数字技术？嗯，数字技术包括任何与计算机相关的设备，如手机、互联网、电子邮件、即时通讯等。本次讲座基于马克·普伦斯基的观点，以及他认为高度接触数字技术对今天的年轻人产生的主要影响。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Prensky believes that because today's young people have been born into a digital world and spent a long time simply playing with technology, they have changed in fundamental ways. He thinks they are evolving differently and, as a result, processing information differently from the last generations. These young people's brains may have physically changed, although no clear evidence exists. Prensky believes that we humans can be divided into digital natives and digital immigrants. Of course, today's young people belong to the group of digital natives because they were born into this new digital age and grew up just as native speakers of the digital language of computer technology. However, digital immigrants are the people born in the generations before the digital age. When people learn a second language, they often retain their foreign accent. It is the same with digital immigrants. They aren't quite as effective at speaking the digital language as the natives are.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：普伦斯基认为，由于今天的年轻人出生在数字世界，花了很长时间摆弄技术，他们在根本层面上发生了变化。他认为他们的进化方式不同，因此处理信息的方式也与前几代人不同。这些年轻人的大脑可能在物理上发生了变化，尽管没有明确的证据。普伦斯基认为，人类可以分为数字原住民和数字移民。当然，今天的年轻人属于数字原住民群体，因为他们出生在这个新的数字时代，就像说计算机技术数字语言的母语者一样长大。然而，数字移民是那些出生在数字时代之前几代人。当人们学习第二语言时，他们往往会保留外国口音。数字移民也是如此。他们在说数字语言方面不如原住民那样有效。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Prensky illustrates this in detail. For example, instead of using the Internet as a primary source of information, digital immigrants prefer finding phone numbers with a phone book or looking up information in an encyclopaedia. Prensky refers to this as the digital accent. Another example of the digital accent is scanning a manual for a computer program, but the program itself will teach you how to use it. People with a digital accent always rely on their original non-digital means of sourcing information. They prefer doing things as they've always done rather than typing something into a computer.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：普伦斯基详细阐述了这一点。例如，数字移民不把互联网作为主要信息来源，而是喜欢用电话簿查电话号码或在百科全书中查找信息。普伦斯基把这称为数字口音。数字口音的另一个例子是阅读计算机程序的说明书，而程序本身会教你如何使用它。有数字口音的人总是依赖他们原来非数字的信息获取方式。他们更喜欢像以前一样做事，而不是把东西输入电脑。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Due to this, Prensky predicts it will bring many changes, especially in education. Other educators and theorists, such as Thompson Allen, Samuel James, and Peter Vander, also give their opinions. Samuel James is a famous educator from The University of Sydney. He agrees with Prensky's idea that today's educators are no longer thriving in how they teach. However, some more traditional theorists like Peter Vander and Thompson Allen don't agree. They criticize many of Prensky's assertions.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：因此，普伦斯基预测这将带来许多变化，尤其是在教育领域。其他教育家和理论家，如汤普森·艾伦、塞缪尔·詹姆斯和彼得·范德，也给出了他们的观点。塞缪尔·詹姆斯是悉尼大学的著名教育家。他同意普伦斯基的观点，即今天的教育者在教学方式上不再蓬勃发展。然而，像彼得·范德和汤普森·艾伦这样的更传统的理论家并不同意。他们批评了普伦斯基的许多论断。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Vander argues that a typical classroom is much more different from what Prensky believes, with students from various backgrounds. He believes that many of these students are not necessarily proficient with technology.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：范德认为，典型的课堂与普伦斯基所认为的非常不同，学生来自不同的背景。他认为这些学生中的许多人并不一定精通技术。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then, Allen adds his opinion that even though most students in modern times can access computers at home or school easily, some don't find the digital medium appealing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后，艾伦补充了他的观点，即尽管现代大多数学生可以轻松地在家里或学校使用电脑，但有些人对数字媒介并不感兴趣。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: However, James disagrees. He argues that all today's students share the same basic interesting knowledge of digital technology. However, even so, James believes that our younger students can communicate with their digital immigrant teachers and still learn with the teaching methods that were quite effective in the past.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，詹姆斯不同意。他认为今天所有学生都拥有相同的对数字技术的基本有趣知识。然而，即便如此，詹姆斯相信我们的年轻学生可以与他们的数字移民老师交流，并且仍然可以用过去相当有效的教学方法学习。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Allen believes that both digital natives and digital immigrants have to process a large amount of information in today's digital world. He thinks that although most young students today are good at playing computer games or surfing the Internet, they use computers in important ways. They are not used to using computers at advanced levels, for example, to carry out complex information searches, which are essential for university study today.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：艾伦认为，在今天的数字世界中，数字原住民和数字移民都必须处理大量信息。他认为，尽管今天的大多数年轻学生擅长玩电脑游戏或上网，但他们使用计算机的方式并不重要。他们不习惯在高级水平上使用计算机，例如进行复杂的信息搜索，而这对于今天的大学学习是必不可少的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Unlike Allen's research, James believes that computer games can play an important role in the classroom. For example, teachers can combine interesting computer games with the lessons to attract students' attention.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：与艾伦的研究不同，詹姆斯认为电脑游戏可以在课堂上发挥重要作用。例如，教师可以将有趣的电脑游戏与课程结合起来吸引学生的注意力。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: However, Vander has different opinions. He argues that teachers are always the leading part of the classroom, and no computer program comes close to doing what a human teacher does every day. As a result, we should think of better ways to assist teachers rather than focusing on developing games.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然而，范德有不同的观点。他认为教师永远是课堂的主导者，没有任何计算机程序能接近人类教师每天所做的事情。因此，我们应该考虑更好的方式来帮助教师，而不是专注于开发游戏。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Morning, Emma! How was your holiday? Did you go anywhere nice?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：早上好，艾玛！你假期过得怎么样？去什么好地方了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, I did! I went over to Jackson Island. It's such a lovely place to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：是的，去了！我去了杰克逊岛。那真是个放松和享受户外的好地方。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sounds brilliant! I was actually thinking about going there this summer. Got any tips on what to do?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：听起来太棒了！我其实也在考虑今年夏天去那里。有什么活动推荐吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Of course. I stayed in Camford, the capital, at my cousin's. I spent quite a lot of time shopping, actually.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：当然。我住在首府坎福德，在我表姐家。实际上我花了不少时间购物。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, so there are good shopping centres then?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哦，所以那里有好的购物中心？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, yes, but to be honest they're much the same as the ones back home. I preferred the market---it's fantastic.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：嗯，是的，但说实话它们和家里那边的差不多。我更喜欢那个市场——太棒了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: What's worth buying there?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：那里有什么值得买的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Definitely bags and shoes. Just make sure you've got some cash on you because most of the stalls don't take cards.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：绝对是包和鞋子。不过要确保身上带现金，因为大多数摊位不接受刷卡。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Right, good to know. Where else did you go?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好的，知道了。你还去了哪里？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: We also went to Newtown. It's famous for its modern architecture. We only had half a day there, so we did a bus tour. But honestly, I wouldn't bother if I were you. Unless you're really into architecture, the buildings all look a bit similar. There is a museum though, which is meant to be excellent---you might enjoy that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：我们还去了纽敦。它以现代建筑闻名。我们只有半天时间，所以坐了巴士游览。但说实话，如果我是你我就不会费这个劲。除非你真的很喜欢建筑，那些建筑看起来都差不多。不过有一个博物馆，据说很不错——你可能会喜欢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: OK, I'll keep that in mind. And then?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好的，我会记住。然后呢？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Then we went to Golden Beach to meet up with an old friend of mine. Unfortunately, all the hotels were booked up, so we had to stay in a caravan.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：然后我们去了金色海滩见我的一个老朋友。不幸的是，所有酒店都订满了，所以我们只好住在大篷车里。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh no! But is the view really as stunning as in the brochures?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：哦不！但景色真的像宣传册里那样美吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Absolutely---it's gorgeous. We did a bit of sailing, and the sea was so clear that you could see right down to the seabed quite far out. Honestly, I could've stayed there much longer. If I were you, I'd plan at least four days. We only had two and it really wasn't enough.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：绝对美——太美了。我们玩了一会儿帆船，海水清澈到你能看到很远的海底。说实话，我可以待得更久。如果我是你，我会计划至少四天。我们只有两天，真的不够。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Brilliant, I'll definitely put that on my list. Did you visit anywhere else?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：太好了，我一定会把这个列入计划。你还去了别的地方吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, we drove inland to White Mountain.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：是的，我们开车去了怀特山。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: You mean it's literally white?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：你是说它真的是白色的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's right. The island's amazing---you can go from the beach up to snow-capped mountains in just a few hours. We'd brought a tent, planning to camp, but it was absolutely freezing. It was snowing so heavily that we ended up staying in a motel instead.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：没错。这个岛太神奇了——你可以在几个小时内从海滩上到白雪皑皑的山顶。我们带了帐篷，打算露营，但那里实在太冷了。雪下得太大，我们最后只好住进了汽车旅馆。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: So did you go skiing?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：那你们去滑雪了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: No, we tried snowboarding instead. Much trickier than it looks! When you watch other people it seems easy, but it took me ages to get the hang of it. I wish I'd booked some lessons beforehand, but you do need to reserve ahead of time.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：不，我们试了单板滑雪。比看起来难多了！你看别人做的时候好像很简单，但我花了很长时间才掌握要领。我真希望我提前预订了课程，但确实需要提前预约。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good tip---I'll remember that.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好建议——我会记住的。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Any other recommendations?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：还有其他推荐吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Let me think... Oh yes! There's a really charming little café at the foot of the mountain. Honestly, it's worth a visit just for the cakes---they're amazing.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：让我想想……哦对！山脚下有一家非常迷人的小咖啡馆。说实话，单是那里的蛋糕就值得一去——太好吃了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Nice, I'll definitely give that a try. And how did you get around the island?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：好的，我一定会去试试。你们在岛上怎么出行的？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, we thought about hiring a motorbike at first---they're cheap and fun, and the roads are really smooth. But the weather changes so quickly, so in the end we went for a car. Much more sensible. And don't worry about finding a rental place---there are loads. The roads are well signposted too, so it's easy to get about.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：嗯，我们一开始考虑租摩托车——便宜又有趣，路也很平坦。但天气变化太快，最后我们选择了汽车。明智多了。不用担心找不到租车的地方——到处都是。路标也很清楚，出行很方便。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: I suppose I can just pick up a map when I get there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：我想我到那里拿张地图就行了。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Emma
transcriptSentences.englishText: You can, but they're quite pricey on the island. Better to grab one before you go.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 艾玛：可以，但岛上的地图挺贵的。最好去之前先拿一张。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Jim
transcriptSentences.englishText: Good point. Thanks a lot for all the advice, Emma!
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 吉姆：说得对。非常感谢你的建议，艾玛！

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hello everyone, and welcome to Grampic Arts Campus for our annual Residential Arts Weekend. I'm Richard Smith, the programme coordinator. Since the campus is quite large, I'll give you a quick run-through of the key locations so you don't get lost. I'm glad you've all managed to find your way to the reception area here.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：大家好，欢迎来到格兰匹克艺术校区参加我们的年度住宿艺术周末。我是理查德·史密斯，项目协调员。由于校区相当大，我会快速带大家过一遍关键位置，这样你们就不会迷路了。很高兴你们都能找到这里的接待区。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: First off, parking. We do have a free temporary car park. To get there, head out from the entrance, drive north along Small Street, and then turn onto North Road at the second junction. You'll see the car park on your left. If you've come by bike, the cycle sheds are close by---just walk down South Lane towards the accommodation blocks and you'll spot them on your left.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：首先是停车。我们有免费的临时停车场。去那里的路线：从入口出去，沿着小街向北行驶，然后在第二个路口转到北路。停车场就在你的左手边。如果你是骑自行车来的，自行车棚就在附近——沿着南巷走向住宿楼，你就会在左手边看到它们。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Dinner will be served in the dining hall at 7.30 this evening. If you're peckish before then, the snack shop is a good bet. The quickest way is to go across South Lane and cut straight through the office building---it's a shortcut that lots of people use, and the staff are quite used to it. Once you're through, you'll come out by an ornamental pond, and the shop is in the building just to the left of that. You'll find not only snacks, but also fresh fruit and hot drinks there.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：晚餐将于今晚7：30在餐厅供应。如果在那之前你饿了，小吃店是个不错的选择。最快的路线是穿过南巷，直接穿过办公楼——这是很多人走的捷径，工作人员也习惯了。穿过去之后，你会来到一个观赏池塘旁，商店就在池塘左边的那栋楼里。那里不仅有零食，还有新鲜水果和热饮。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, about the fitness facilities. We'd outgrown the old gym next to the office, so this year we've moved into brand-new rooms. To reach them, walk up to North Road and you'll find the gym at the very end, in the last building next to the dining hall.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：现在说说健身设施。我们以前的健身房在办公室旁边，已经不够用了，所以今年我们搬进了全新的房间。去那里的路线：走到北路，健身房就在尽头的最后一栋楼，紧挨着餐厅。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Accommodation is close at hand. The single rooms are in the tall block you can see just across South Lane, over to the far left. Families and couples are in the family rooms right next door to that. Please note there are no televisions in the bedrooms---we ask everyone to help us keep the atmosphere quiet. But there is a TV room, which you might have already noticed---it's the big red building opposite us. If you're thinking of a party or karaoke, please use the TV room rather than the bedrooms. As for activities, you may have read about them in the brochure, but there are a few updates. Starting with drama: unfortunately, the theatre and practice rooms are closed for refurbishment. We thought about using the sports hall, but in the end decided against it. Instead, lecture rooms have been converted into a temporary theatre just for this weekend.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：住宿近在咫尺。单人房就在南巷对面远处左边的那栋高楼里。家庭和夫妻住在紧挨着它的家庭房。请注意卧室里没有电视——我们请求大家帮助保持安静的氛围。但有一个电视房，你可能已经注意到了——就是我们对面的那栋红色大楼。如果你想开派对或唱卡拉OK，请使用电视房而不是卧室。关于活动，你可能已经在宣传册上读过了，但有一些更新。从戏剧开始：不幸的是，剧院和排练室因翻新而关闭。我们考虑过使用体育馆，但最后决定不用。取而代之的是，讲座教室已被改造成临时剧院，仅在这个周末使用。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: There's also a change to the photography option. This year it's not open to everyone---it's reserved for complete beginners. No special equipment is needed; everything will be provided. And I should add, children won't be allowed this time round, as last year it was far too disruptive. But if you're 18 or over, you're very welcome.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：摄影选项也有变化。今年不向所有人开放——只面向完全的初学者。不需要特殊设备；所有东西都会提供。我还要补充一点，这次不允许儿童参加，因为去年太混乱了。但如果你年满18岁或以上，非常欢迎。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: Now, the writing workshop. In previous years, we focused on how to start writing a novel. We did think about switching to poetry this year, but because so many people wanted short stories, we'll turn our attention to that. So you'll be working on one or more short stories over the weekend. Poetry may well come back in future.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 发言人：然后是写作工作坊。前几年我们专注于如何开始写小说。我们确实考虑过今年转成诗歌，但因为很多人想要短篇小说，我们会转向短篇小说。所以你们将在周末创作一篇或多篇短篇小说。诗歌将来可能会回归。

transcriptSentences.speaker: SPEAKER
transcriptSentences.englishText: For the music option, there's a mistake in the brochure---it says you'll be going to a concert. In fact, you'll be creating and performing your own show instead. transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hey, Taylor. Have a seat.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：嘿，泰勒。请坐。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Hi Johnson, thanks! Ready to compare notes for next week's presentation on pigeons?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：嗨，约翰逊，谢谢！准备好为下周关于鸽子的展示交流想法了吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah! I've gathered some excellent sources on different pigeon types. Honestly, it's been eye-opening.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：是的！我收集了一些关于不同鸽子种类的优秀资料。老实说，这真是大开眼界。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Same here. There are so many species! I read this fascinating new study on the Australian Crested Pigeon. It actually makes a unique sound to warn the rest of the flock about danger.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：我也是。种类太多了！我读了一项关于澳洲冠鸽的新研究，非常有趣。它实际上会发出独特的声音来警告鸽群其他成员有危险。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, the alarm call behaviour is pretty common among birds. Many use calls for mates or warnings. What makes this one so special?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：嗯，警报叫声行为在鸟类中相当普遍。很多鸟类用叫声来求偶或发出警告。这个有什么特别之处？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: It uses its wings. Once the pigeon gets startled, its wings make a whistling sound---that's the warning signal to others.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：它用翅膀。一旦鸽子受惊，它的翅膀会发出哨声——那就是给其他鸽子的警告信号。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Cool! What about the Rock Pigeon? I found quite a lot on them. They're the most widely distributed type.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：酷！那岩鸽呢？我找到了很多关于它们的资料。它们是最广泛分布的品种。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Definitely. Out of all pigeon species, they've been the most successful in adapting to diverse environments. In contrast, some pigeons are restricted to specific habitats, like the Black-banded Pigeon, which is only found in Northern Australia. Unlike the pigeons commonly seen on the pavements or roads, this species lives high up in the trees of the rainforest.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：确实。在所有鸽子品种中，它们在适应不同环境方面最成功。相比之下，有些鸽子仅限于特定栖息地，比如黑带鸽，只在澳大利亚北部发现。与通常在人行道或道路上看到的鸽子不同，这个物种生活在雨林高处的树上。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: That is unusual. I also read their diet can be really specific. For instance, the Galapagos Pigeon gets all its nutrients from a particular cactus that grows on the island where it lives.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：那很不寻常。我还读到它们的饮食可能非常特定。例如，加拉帕戈斯鸽从它生活的岛上生长的一种特定仙人掌获取所有营养。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Oh, I have no idea about that. Are there foods pigeons should avoid?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：哦，我不知道这个。有什么鸽子应该避免的食物吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: In fact, they should be kept away from meat as the bacteria it contains are harmful to them.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：事实上，它们应该远离肉类，因为其中含有的细菌对它们有害。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: All right. You know, I used to think all pigeons looked the same, but their plumage varies a lot. The Indonesia Nicobar Pigeon, for example, is very stunning with its metallic green feathers.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：好的。你知道吗，我以前以为所有鸽子都长一样，但它们的羽毛差异很大。例如，印度尼西亚尼科巴鸽非常惊艳，有着金属绿色的羽毛。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, it's surprising that they aren't hunted more for those feathers, really.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：是的，真奇怪它们没有被更多地猎取羽毛。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Okay, for the second part of our presentation, we'll talk about why urban pigeons are now considered as pests and what measures are being taken to control them. A lot of people in cities have got used to feeding them, haven't they?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：好的，对于展示的第二部分，我们将讨论为什么城市鸽子现在被视为害鸟，以及正在采取什么措施来控制它们。城市里很多人都习惯喂它们，不是吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yeah, the problem is that, although some people view it as a kind gesture, it's actually not a good idea.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：是的，问题是，虽然有些人认为这是一种善意的举动，但实际上这不是个好主意。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Exactly! And human food isn't very healthy for birds, especially fast food.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：正是！而且人类的食物对鸟类来说不太健康，尤其是快餐。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: In fact, since the pigeons don't have to spend much time searching for food, they get more time to mate and reproduce, leading to a population explosion.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：事实上，由于鸽子不需要花太多时间寻找食物，它们有更多时间交配和繁殖，导致种群爆炸。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: I see. The city gets completely overrun. That affects both the city and the pigeons negatively. Well, recently I've heard that Melbourne City Council is trying to address their pigeon problem. I wonder if they're trying to scare the pigeons away from the city.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：我明白了。城市被完全占领了。这对城市和鸽子都有负面影响。嗯，最近我听说墨尔本市议会正在试图解决他们的鸽子问题。我想知道他们是不是在试图把鸽子赶出城市。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: No. They've built some special nesting places in a park downtown. These are designed to house the pigeons, stopping them nesting on buildings.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：不是。他们在市中心的一个公园里建了一些特殊的筑巢点。这些是为了安置鸽子，阻止它们在建筑物上筑巢。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: But that doesn't solve the problem, just changes the location.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：但这没有解决问题，只是改变了地点。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: It's just the first step. They replaced pigeon eggs with dummy ones in the second phase. It's a form of birth control.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：这只是第一步。他们在第二阶段用假蛋替换了鸽子蛋。这是一种生育控制的形式。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Wow, such an elaborate approach. Someone would need to go in and exchange those eggs by hand.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：哇，真是精细的做法。需要有人进去手工交换那些蛋。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Yes. As a means of population control, the project has had some effect; however, the financial burden on the taxpayer is pretty high.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：是的。作为控制种群的手段，这个项目取得了一些效果；然而，纳税人的财政负担相当高。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Indeed, I can imagine.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：确实，我可以想象。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Recently, the most successful programme for pigeon control was in Basel, Switzerland.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：最近，最成功的鸽子控制项目是在瑞士巴塞尔。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Brilliant! What exactly did they do?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：太棒了！他们具体做了什么？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: The city council found that teaching the public about the negative effects of feeding pigeons was more effective than trapping them or providing them with alternative nesting sites. They've tried both before.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：市议会发现，教育公众了解喂鸽子的负面影响比捕捉鸽子或为它们提供替代筑巢地点更有效。他们之前两种方法都试过。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: That's an amazing finding. We should definitely add that. Do you think we should research more and add anything else?
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：这是个惊人的发现。我们一定要加进去。你觉得我们应该多研究并补充其他内容吗？

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Well, I was wondering if we should clarify why urban pigeons are undesirable at the beginning.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：嗯，我在想我们是否应该在开头澄清为什么城市鸽子不受欢迎。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: I agree. I have information on how their feathers can block gutters and pipes, thereby causing water pollution.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：我同意。我有关于它们的羽毛如何堵塞排水沟和管道从而导致水污染的信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: I can add some details related to how their droppings damage buildings. But I haven't found anything on health risks to humans.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：我可以补充一些关于它们粪便如何损坏建筑物的细节。但我没有找到任何关于对人类健康风险的信息。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Taylor
transcriptSentences.englishText: Me neither. That's definitely essential. Let's search for information on that and cover it.
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 泰勒：我也没有。那绝对是必要的。我们搜索一下这方面的信息并涵盖它。

transcriptSentences.speaker: Johnson
transcriptSentences.englishText: Sure. When can we meet again to discuss...
transcriptSentences.chineseText: 约翰逊：当然。我们什么时候再见面讨论……
